Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Aerovel (the Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program) is looking for a Material Handler to join our Warehouse Operations Team based in Bingen, WA. In this role you will perform a variety of tasks in support of warehouse operations including receiving, stocking, picking and shipping of material. Including using knowledge of warehouse and inventory control procedures. Preparing all required forms, records and documents to ensure accountability for all transactions required in order to maintain the integrity of warehouse operations. Meet the Team: The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea. Your Working Environment: Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer! How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Primary Responsibilities: Kitting: 55% Kit manufacturing orders using Costpoint in accordance with warehouse procedures. Deliver material to the respective technicians. Relieve finished goods and stock the material in accordance with warehouse procedures. Receiving: 15% Receive all vendor purchase orders and ensure number of cartons match the Airway Bill or Bill Of Lading Check and receive purchase orders into Costpoint, bag and label as necessary and match corresponding goods receipt document to parts. Stocking: 15% Stock parts using Costpoint in accordance with warehouse procedures. Transfer material to and from buildings. Packing: 15% Pack shipments both physically and systematically in order of priority in Costpoint in accordance with warehouse procedures and ASTM (American Society of Testing and Materials) Standards Ship material by priority for customer requirements in accordance with contract requirements. Additional Responsibilities: Other duties as assigned: Your Boarding Pass: Required: High school education or equivalent Minimum of two (2) years warehouse experience Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license) Effective communication skills, both verbal and written Good customer service skills Must be detail oriented Ability to communicate effectively in verbal and written form in English Ability to effectively use a computer Preferred: Prior Costpoint experience Hazmat certifications (49CFR and IATA) Physical Requirements: Onsite or remote: 100% Onsite Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Daily Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily Equipment Operation: Able to operate personal computer, telephone, fax machine and related equipment. Able to operate warehouse material handling equipment including forklift and pallet jack. Daily Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 50lbs/23kgs. Daily Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 50lbs/23kgs. Daily Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull carts and small items up to 50lbs/23kgs. Daily Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Daily Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Daily Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Candidates for this position must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license) Pay Range: Hourly range based on the required profile: $21.70 - $35.68.hour. Actual minimum and maximum may vary based on geographic differential. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors. title: Manager transformation gestion configuration
description_text:
Job Description: Sommaire du poste : Sous la supervision du Directeur programmes, le Manager Transformation Gestion Configuration a pour mandat de piloter, d'adapter et de garantir le déploiement local de l'ensemble de processus « R03 » applicable à son périmètre. Expert des méthodologies Kaizen et de la gestion du changement, sa mission est d'assurer le réalignement stratégique et opérationnel de tous les départements par rapport à ce nouveau cadre de processus. Il agit également comme leader d'une équipe multifonctionnelle (MFT) dédiée à la gestion du changement de configuration, le tout sans gestion directe de personnel. Principales responsabilités : ● Établir la feuille de route et les actions requises pour assurer l'intégration et l'exécution du plan de transformation axé sur le R03.
● Animer les chantiers Kaizen et optimiser/redéfinir au besoin les processus existants pour s'aligner parfaitement sur les exigences du R03.
● Assurer le suivi de la transformation via une structure de gouvernance régulière auprès des comités directeurs.
● Travailler en étroite collaboration avec toutes les fonctions internes (Opérations, Qualité, Ingénierie, Industrialisation, Approvisionnements) pour réaligner leurs méthodes de travail en fonction du R03.
● Parcourir la chaîne de valeur du Programme pour briser les silos, rassembler les parties prenantes et résoudre les enjeux techniques liés à l'adoption de ces nouveaux processus.
● Mener les revues dédiées avec le client et la haute direction pour partager l'avancement, les succès et le niveau de préparation (readiness) de la transformation. Exigences du poste ● Expérience : Un minimum de 10 à 15 ans d'expérience pertinente en aérospatiale (génie industriel, processus, amélioration continue).
● Baccalauréat en génie industriel, gestion de projet, ou toute autre formation pertinente ● Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet/programme de transformation ou en déploiement de chantiers Kaizen.
● Expérience solide en animation d'équipes multifonctionnelles (MFT) et en gestion du changement de configuration.
Exigences particulières :
● Forte capacité d'influence au sein d'une équipe multifonctionnelle (leadership d'influence, sans lien hiérarchique).
● Très autonome, motivé et souple ; excellente gestion des priorités et forte aptitude à synthétiser des questions complexes pour les comités directeurs.
● Bilinguisme français-anglais, avec un niveau avancé à l'oral et à l'écrit, requis pour les communications et les revues avec le client et les équipes internationales (France).
● Maîtrise de la suite Office / Google. Ce que nous offrons : Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux haut de gamme (assurances collectives, régimes de retraite). Régime d'achat d'actions exclusif aux employés. Formule de travail flexible [Optionnel - Hybride / Présentiel : à préciser selon la politique du site]. Opportunités de développement professionnel et de formation continue au sein d'un leader mondial. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. title: Coordonnateur des opérations de transport / Coordinator Transportation Operations
description_text:
Job Description: Job Description **THE ENGLISH POSTING FOLLOWS** Vous avez une expérience dans les opérations de transport, vous avez travaillé dans le secteur manufacturier et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Constructeur d'avions commerciaux, avec des divisions Espace et Défense ainsi que des hélicoptères, Airbus est la plus grande entreprise aéronautique et spatiale en Europe et un leader mondial. Chez Airbus Canada, nos collaborateurs travaillent ensemble à faire évoluer la mobilité partout dans le monde, une bonne idée après l'autre. Si vous avez une bonne idée, nous avons l'environnement pour qu'elle devienne un produit unique ou une expérience client exceptionnelle. Vos idées sont notre énergie. Vous serez en relation directe avec le responsable des transports pour l’A220. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus
facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la
flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Recevoir, organiser, mettre en place et assurer le suivi des demandes de transport end to end, provenant des clients externes et internes ; Gérer les opérations de transport hors gabarit (oversized) et general cargo pour le programme A220 ; S'assurer de l'exécution des opérations de transport auprès des différents prestataires de services ; Effectuer un suivi minutieux des transports de façon quotidienne auprès des clients internes et externes ; S'assurer du respect des plannings au niveau des différentes opérations de transport ; S'assurer de suivre, mettre en place et actualiser les processus afférents aux diverses opérations de transport ; S'assurer de respecter les règles de transport et douanières au niveau international aérien, maritime, routier pour les marchandises oversized et general cargo ; S'assurer de respecter les règles de notre compagnie en fonction des requis pour les opérations de l'A220 ; Représenter un interlocuteur clé pour les diverses opérations de transport pour le programme A220 auprès de nos différents services internes (logistique, production, approvisionnement...) et de nos prestataires externes ; s'assurer d'une bonne communication avec ces derniers ; Mettre à jour, suivre et respecter les KPI internes ; Participer aux réunions mensuelles opérationnelles ; Travailler du lundi au vendredi et être de rotation en fin de semaine à raison d'une fois par mois pour répondre aux transports urgents ; Être force de proposition face à un problème de transport et savoir proposer des solutions . Votre profil: Vous possédez un diplôme de licence en transport et logistique ou une expérience équivalente dans ce domaine d'activité ; Vous avez un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du transport ou un poste similaire, avec connaissance du marché nord-américain, des opérations de transport oversized et/ou general cargo ; Vous faites preuve de résilience ; Vous êtes orienté client ; Vous êtes proactif, réactif et vous savez anticiper les demandes et les besoins ; Vous avez une bonne communication interne et externe ; Vous êtes soucieux du respect des règles, processus et politiques internes ; Vous êtes organisé, méthodique, consciencieux et rigoureux ; Vous êtes soucieux de la qualité de service ; Vous savez travailler en équipe . Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de
conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ***************************************************************************************** You have experience in transport operations, have you worked in the manufacturing sector, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This position is for you! Manufacturer of commercial aircraft, with Space and Defense divisions as well as Helicopters, Airbus is the largest aeronautics and Space Company in Europe and a world leader. At Airbus Canada, our people work together to make mobility evolve around the world, one good idea after another. If you have a great idea, we have the environment for it to become a unique product or a great customer experience. Your ideas are our energy. You will report and be in direct contact with the HO of Transportation. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (depending on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy. Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program and on-site Medical Service. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. Your challenges: Handle, arrange and follow all transportation requests end to end from our different customers; Handle oversized and general cargo transportation operations and requirements of the A220 program; Ensure effective execution of all transportation activities for incoming and outgoing material with our different service providers; Ensure the daily follow-up of all transportation activities with the service providers and communicate with internal clients; Be accountable for all orders to be shipped and delivered on the agreed dates; Be accountable for smooth transportation processes and update them; Ensure compliance with international (air, ocean and ground) transportation and customs rules for oversized and general cargo; Ensure compliance with legal regulations and company policies; Be a key contact for all transport operations for the A220 program; Be the interface and have good communication with all internal business departments to support on-time deliveries with the Logistics Department, Procurement, Supply and Production; Measure, consolidate, update and follow the KPIs; Participate in the operational monthly review with our different service providers; Work 40 hours per week from Monday to Friday, with weekend rotation (once per month) to handle urgent shipments; Be proactive and able to propose back-up solutions when facing a transport issue. Your boarding pass: You hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Transport and Logistics or equivalent background in training and/or relevant experience; You have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in a similar position; You have good knowledge of the North American transportation market; You have solid knowledge of oversized transportation by ground and ocean, and also of general cargo (air and ocean); You are stress resistant; You are customer-oriented; You are logical, proactive and reactive, and always one step ahead of the demands; You have good interaction and communication skills at all levels, both inside and outside the organization; You follow internal processes, rules and company policies; You are organized, conscientious, methodical and rigorous; You are quality service-oriented; You have a strong team spirit; This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. development solutions. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Meet the Team: Our Engineers at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facility take our aircraft from concept to customer delivery – working with production teams on every aspect of assembly from managing technical information, quality control, maintenance tasks and health & safety – along flowlines and flightlines. Join our team and watch our aircraft come to life. Your Working Environment: Mobile, AL On ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: C(“EAP”) anomprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility. Position Summary: Responsible for defining, measuring and managing the quality requirements for A320 Family aircraft assembly jigs, tools, and measurement systems at the Final Assembly Line (FAL) - USA. Your Challenges: Define Quality Assurance (QA) requirements in the technical specifications for Airbus Jigs, tools and measurement systems.
Coordinate and lead QA measures with Jigs, tools and measurement systems suppliers and monitor their implementation.
Participate in supplier evaluation, pre-development production concepts, defining testing characteristics, and verifying that new production and control means align with established requirements.
Define and conduct all relevant QA activities (Verification and validation, measurement system analysis, inspection plans…) Conduct product testing in manufacturer and purchaser sites. Including but not limited to acceptance, commissioning and validation tests from small standalone tooling to entire production lines and integrated industrial systems. Coordination of logistical activities related to testing and support coordinate metrology tasks on new and in production means.
End to end non-conformity management during the design, manufacturing and commissioning phases for all relevant products. Including investigation, correspondence, resolution and documentation. Perform troubleshooting by determining root causes of errors and both initiating and verifying the effectiveness of remedial measures. Collaborate with development teams to analyze requirements, define measurement means and processes, evaluate uncertainty, and design and implement robust measurement systems. Evaluate and cascade geometric and dimensional tolerances from high-level requirements to the specific product, ensuring that tooling capabilities are fully aligned with the necessary task specifications.
Provide production support for measurement and tolerancing issues. Assist with the resolution of non-conformities.
Provide reporting on all assigned projects.
Operate all applicable process steps in the FU.IN.03.02 (Develop and Realize Integrated Industrial Systems and Jigs & Tools) and FU.IN.03.06 (Implement Measurement Systems) Airbus processes. Other duties as assigned: Propose changes to improve the relevant processes, resolve process non-conformances and contribute to process risk analysis management
Lead special projects assigned by the manager.

Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Airframe MRB Engineer to join our Engineering department based in Mobile, AL. The A320 Family MAP Structures Design Engineer is a highly technical, operational role responsible for the development, justification, and engineering approval of design solutions related to aircraft primary and secondary structure non-conformities. Operating directly within the fast-paced environment of the Final Assembly Line (FAL), flight line, and delivery center, the jobholder acts as a critical functional interface on the shop floor between local manufacturing operations and the transnational Airbus Design Offices and Chief Engineering networks. The core mission of this role is to deliver immediate, high-quality, and structurally sound engineering design solutions to keep production moving without compromising aircraft safety or continued airworthiness. The scope of accountability covers metallic and composite airframe structures across all relevant ATA chapters, ensuring that shop floor deviations, damages, and concessions are permanently resolved or mitigated according to strict design principles. Meet the team: Our Engineers at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facility take our aircraft from concept to customer delivery – working with production teams on every aspect of assembly from managing technical information, quality control, maintenance tasks and health & safety – along flowlines and flightlines. Join our team and watch our aircraft come to life. Your working environment: Nearby on ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. How we care for you: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programs and both national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and accessibly. Wherever possible, we support flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges: Non-Conformity & Repair Resolution: Author, validate, and authorize technical solutions, repair drawings, rework instructions, and design datasets within the primary and secondary structural perimeters. Airworthiness Accountability: Secure and guarantee absolute compliance with Aircraft Safety, Airbus Design Principles, and continuous Airworthiness requirements across all released engineering files. Temporary Aircraft Definitions: Create, approve, and authorize temporary aircraft definitions (special instructions) in line with design and airworthiness requirements for testing purposes. Autonomous Fix Execution: Exercise autonomous decision-making to release standard structural repair instructions, while coordinating major reworks through global Airbus engineering departments. FAL Liaison & Interface: Act as a critical functional interface on the shop floor between Chief Engineering/Design Offices and local Manufacturing and Quality Assurance departments. Proactive Engineering Input: Review and interpret complex design data, prepare materials for technical team briefings, and provide relevant input. Operational Optimization & Milestone Gates: Formulate, validate, and authorize technical design solutions and structure repair drawings for deviations discovered during assembly, outfit inspection, or production flights. Maintain strict adherence to the quality, completeness, and lead-time thresholds established in site Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Transnational Alignment & Technical Authority: Represent the A320 Family Chief Engineering office and global Design Offices by delegation. Coordinate regularly with overseas engineering and center-of-competency departments to resolve complex, non-standard structural problems where previous solutions are unknown. Aircraft Flight Line Readiness & Integration: Provide continuous on-site structures engineering support across the entire manufacturing process, from initial section delivery to the final delivery flight. Deliver clear technical explanations to the required department and act as an engineering representative during customer acceptance negotiations. Proactive Eradication & Engineering Efficiency: Launch and monitor engineering design improvements, permanent modification drawings, drawing updates, and Design Query Notes (DQNs) to systematically eliminate recurring industrial defects and maximize product performance. Global Design Standardization: Partner directly with Airbus Americas and European Engineering departments to align local assembly line solutions with global engineering methods and core design principles. International Technical Collaboration: Represent the local manufacturing site and engineering perimeter in international technical working blocks to resolve cross-border anomalies and establish cross-functional consensus. Peer Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Share technical expertise across the wider engineering community, providing functional guidance and mentoring to team members within the structural design perimeter. Customer & Stakeholder Relations: Deliver technical explanations and present complex structural repair configurations directly to internal/external customers, suppliers, and the flight test department. Your boarding pass: Bachelor of Science degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Systems Engineering (or an equivalent combination of education and experience). 3+ years of progressive experience in aircraft structure (airframe) design engineering support Airframe Structures Expertise: In-depth knowledge and experience in primary and secondary aircraft structures design, repair design principles, and structural data assessments. Airbus Frameworks & Procedures: Comprehensive understanding of internal Airbus Design Principles, industrial procedures, processes, and tools Technical Documentation: Expert capability navigating standard Airbus manuals, including the Structural Repair Manual (SRM), Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM), and Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC) Configuration & Change Management: Solid understanding of Airbus aircraft configuration management rules, the full change request process, and product structure tracking. Non-Conformity Toolsets: Direct proficiency tracking and managing shop-floor and flight line non-conformities, concessions, and Design Query Notes (DQNs). Eligible for employment in the US. Job Description: SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS check (including a criminal record check) TRAVEL REQUIRED: Occasional travel within UK and international LOCATION: Filton, Bristol (80% of your working week must be office based) TYPE: Full time WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Financial Reward: Competitive salary, annual profit share, contributory pension, share options, car leasing scheme, free onsite parking, season ticket loan, tax-free technology scheme, shopping discounts and much more Work / Life Balance: 35 hour week, flexible working around core hours and Friday afternoons off, flexible working, option to buy/sell holiday Personal Development: Personalised development plan, Airbus Leadership University and unlimited access to 10,000+ E-learning courses, internal mobility including international opportunities Health & Wellbeing: Bupa health insurance (including assisted fertility treatments and gender dysphoria & reassignment support), wellbeing benefits (including 24/7 online GP and mental health support), discounted family health / dental insurance / eye tests, cycle-to-work scheme, on-site canteen and coffee shop, lunchtime yoga / meditation Family and Caregiving: Life assurance, enhanced pay for maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave and caregiving and purpose built maternity rooms on site Inclusive Environment: Wellbeing room, Multi-faith room, Employee Representative Groups (Gender, LGBTQ+, International, Generational, Disability, Social & Cultural Diversity, Neurodiversity) Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change? Join our Landing Gear systems team in Filton and play a vital role in keeping worldwide fleets flying safely and efficiently. As a Technical Data Engineer at Airbus, you will ensure our commitment to customers extends throughout the entire aircraft lifecycle by capturing design changes and maintaining highly accurate aircraft configurations. You will be at the forefront of aviation safety, delivering high-quality maintenance instructions that directly support daily airline operations and resolve critical in-service issues. Step into an innovative, transnational environment and apply today to help shape the future of digital aviation services! HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM Create, verify, and validate critical maintenance manuals (AMM, TSM, and AFI for ATA 32 Landing Gears) in strict compliance with international standards and EASA regulations. Evaluate technical drawings, design modifications, and source data to ensure maintenance manuals perfectly reflect the exact configuration of every delivered aircraft. Resolve daily customer technical queries via the Tech Request tool and provide proactive, on-time solutions for critical Aircraft On Ground (AOG) situations. Monitor, steer, and review subcontracted authoring activities to ensure documentation is delivered according to approved schedules, budgets, and quality standards. Actively contribute to future digital initiatives, optimize Technical Data processes, and achieve Quality Authorisation (C1 Incoming Inspection) to enhance overall service delivery. ABOUT YOU Professional background and experience in Aerospace Engineering or Aircraft Maintenance. Strong technical knowledge of aircraft systems, maintenance operations, and production processes: Specific to landing gear Demonstrated capability in Aircraft Configuration Management. Working knowledge of international technical authoring standards and related documentation tools. Applied experience in technical risk and opportunity management. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions. HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at the interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request. Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process – you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. description_text:
Job Description: Zum nächstmöglichen Termin suchen wir Ausstattungsmechaniker (d/m/w) für den Bereich Single Aisle Endlinie in Hamburg! Dein Standort Du arbeitest in der größten Produktionsstätte für zivile Flugzeuge in Hamburg. Durch die Lage am südlichen Elbufer besteht die Möglichkeit, mit der Fähre zu pendeln. Erlebe in deiner Freizeit das besondere Flair Hamburgs, wo pulsierende Weltstadtkultur auf nautisches Erbe trifft. Unsere Benefits für dich Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird Dein neues Arbeitsumfeld Wir suchen begeisterte und erfahrene Ausstattungsmechaniker für unsere neueste 4. Linie. Diese ist die Airbus-weit modernste Endmontage mit neuen Technologien und hohem Automatisierungsgrad. Hat ein Flugzeug die Final Assembly Line (FAL) durchlaufen, ist es fertiggestellt. Es wird dann noch lackiert und im Flug getestet. In der FAL gibt es verschiedene Stationen: Auf Station 41/42/43 werden die vordere und hintere Rumpfsektion angeliefert. Bevor diese verbunden werden, kommen die großen Kabinenelemente wie Küchen und Toiletten an ihre Plätze. Danach erfolgt die Verbindung der Bauteile mit Nieten. Auf Station 40 werden die Flügel, die Triebwerksaufhängung und das Fahrwerk montiert. Die Montage von Höhen- und Seitenleitwerk erfolgt auf Station 35. Weiterhin läuft parallel die Kabinenausstattung und die elektrisch- / hydraulische Verbindung zwischen Flügel und Flugzeug. Auf Station 25 wird das Kraftstoff- und Hydrauliksystems installiert und getestet. Ebenso wird der Kabinendrucktest durchgeführt und das Hydrauliksystem des Flugzeuges erstmalig in Betrieb genommen. Weiterhin wird die Kabinenausstattung wie z.B. Teppichverlegung, Sitzmontage, Türenverkleidung, Sauerstoffmasken vervollständigt. Zuletzt werden auf Station 23 die Kraftstofftanks endmontiert und die Belly Fairing installiert. Weitere Tests sind die Durchführung von Flügeltankdichtigkeitstests, Funktionstests der Flugsteuerungsanlage sowie der Kabinenausstattung. Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Das Installieren und Testen der elektrischen Bauteile und Komponenten inklusive der Fehlerbehebung. Die Montage von Ausstattungs- und Kabinen Komponenten, wie z.B. Seitenverkleidungen, Hatracks, Trennwänden, Cockpittüren, Sitzen, Teppich/ NTF, Rollbahnen etc. inklusive der Inbetriebnahme der Systeme, Fehlersuche und Fehlerbehebung. Die Installation von Großkomponenten wie Toiletten und Küchen mit den entsprechenden Anschlußarbeiten sowie das Anschließen von Luftkanälen und Luftschläuchen. Die Installation von Türkomponenten, das Testen von Bauteilen und Komponenten und die Inbetriebnahme von Systemen wie Water, Waste und SCS. Deine Tätigkeiten umfassen weiterhin das Kennzeichen, Ausrüsten, Verlegen, Montieren, Anpassen, Konfektionieren, Kleben und Messen sowie die Dokumentation von Arbeiten, Bauteilen und Beanstandungen. Deine Qualifikationen Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fluggerätemechaniker oder vergleichbar. Mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung im Bereich Flugzeugbau oder Umrüstung, idealerweise im Kabinenbau. Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Bauunterlagen und Arbeitsaufträgen. Wenn Du Dir regelmäßig Gedanken machst, wie man Arbeitsschritte vereinfachen oder verbessern kann und nicht nur Probleme erkennst, sondern Dir selbständig Lösungen überlegst, bist Du bei uns richtig. Weiterhin arbeitest Du gerne im Team, gehst sorgfältig vor, stehst Veränderungen offen gegenüber und bist gut in der Kommunikation mit verschiedensten Leuten. Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse und die Bereitschaft für Schichtarbeit runden Dein Profil ab. Wir passen zu dir und du zu uns? Dann bewirb dich jetzt online mit deinem Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen und Zertifikaten unter Angabe deiner Gehaltserwartung und Kündigungsfrist. description_text:

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Une offre d’apprentissage intitulée « Apprenti(e) en ingénierie géomètre-topographe (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Connected Intelligence sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 14 personnes au sein du département « RF & Deployment team » en charge du déploiement de segments sol Satcom sur des programmes civils et militaires, activité allant de la conception jusqu’à l’implémentation et au maintien opérationnel. Cet apprentissage consistera à: l’optimisation géométrique de réflecteurs d’antennes SatCom Cet apprentissage débutera à la rentrée scolaire 2026 pour une durée de 1 ou 2 an(s). Le/la manager (et/ou tuteur(trice)) organisera des entretiens avec les candidat(e)s présélectionné(e) avant de choisir le/la candidat(e) final(e) retenu(e) sur le poste. Qu'il s'agisse de rémunérations compétitives ou de régimes de soins de santé complets, nous offrons à nos employé(e)s des avantages et des privilèges en fonction de nos implantations dans le monde - certains sont spécifiques à chaque pays. En outre, nous offrons diverses possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnels, afin de garantir l'évolution constante de vos compétences et de votre expertise. Pour en savoir plus, nous vous invitons à consulter notre site : https://www.airbus.com/en/careers/life-at-airbus/reward-and-benefits Information complémentaire Dans l'éventualité où notre offre d'alternance retiendrait votre intérêt, veuillez préparer les informations suivantes, qui vous seront demandées au moment de votre candidature : 1. Nature du contrat envisagé (contrat d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation) par l’école. English version: Want to spread your wings? What if your adventure begins with us? title: Airbus UpNext Internship 2026 - Study of superconducting AC coils (m/f)
description_text:
Job Description: CRYOPROP is a 3-year effort to explore the potential of superconducting materials and cryogenic temperatures on the performance of an aircraft’s electrical propulsion system. As a ground-test demonstrator, CRYOPROP is an ambitious, futuristic and disruptive superconducting and cryogenic experimental powertrain for hybrid/full electric propulsion system. CRYOPROP will be composed of an ground-test electric demonstrator including a superconducting DC/AC network, a cryogenic motor control unit, a superconducting electric motor and of a cryogenic system. It also includes a ground-test cryogenic demonstrator, to analyse the behaviour of cryogenic components (heat-exchanger, valves, cryofan) for the cryogenic cooling system. The opportunity of an internship on superconducting AC coils has risen within the team, based in Toulouse. This internship will ideally begin September 2026 and will last for a period of 4 months. Main Missions This internship investigates the electromagnetic interactions between AC-operated superconducting coils and surrounding metallic structures, such as vacuum chambers and piping. Your principal missions will be: Simulation and calculation of the losses in a superconducting coil in different electric conditions and environment. Perform electrical measurement on a superconducting coil at cryogenic temperature in liquid nitrogen or cooled by cryogenic helium. This includes instrumenting the coils to perform the different relevant measurements. Conceptualize a small test bench to validate the theoretical results. Compile and analyze the experimental results to compare them to theoretical calculations. Derive some design rules for upgrading the existing test bench. You will need to collaborate with a diverse technical team in order to understand the multi-disciplinary constraints around the superconducting coil. An open personality and the ability to work with a good autonomy level in a multi-cultural business environment will be necessary. Your boarding pass As the successful candidate you will be able to demonstrate some or all of the following skills and competencies: Master degree in electrical engineering or equivalent Strong knowledge of electromagnetics Previous knowledge in finite element modeling Familiarity with superconductivity and cryogenics will be appreciated Autonomy, Adaptability, Availability, Accountability Team-Player Hands-on and solution oriented attitude Passionate about technology, science Sharing the values of transparency, courage, humility, empathy Willing to have fun. About us Founded in 2017, Airbus UpNext is actively shaping the future of aerospace by using demonstrators to evaluate, mature and validate new products and services. Designed as a talent incubator, Airbus UpNext is a place where you can act and think like a startup while building on the strong expertise of Airbus, a place where you are empowered to challenge and test new processes and ways of working. Our purpose is: To identify the trends that could disrupt the future of the aerospace industry and evaluate them to demonstrate their potential as a viable product. To accelerate traditional research cycles and prototype development to achieve proof of concept in a real environment and at a convincing scale and speed. To develop real-world applications for emerging aerospace technologies, thereby driving their maturity and increasing their value. Provide feedback to Strategic and Procurement Operations from external suppliers regarding forecast. Manage information loop with programs to ensure on time completion of PO’s and sales orders for new and rework parts. Job Description: Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Ingénieur(e) Safety Système au sein des équipes System Safety. Business Unit Safety Assurer la sécurité à long terme, la fiabilité, la navigabilité et l'optimisation des performances des solutions/systèmes des moyens de transports actuels et nouveaux. Notre mission est d'améliorer la sécurité en contribuant à de nouvelles normes de sécurité, en assurant la conformité réglementaire et en veillant à ce que les utilisateurs finaux soient toujours protégés.
Avec plus de 650 spécialistes, nous soutenons nos clients en garantissant le niveau de sécurité et la performance de disponibilité de leurs produits (plateformes, systèmes, équipements) et services. Ceci couvre l'ensemble du processus du cycle de vie du produit/service, de la conception à la fabrication, de l'exploitation au recyclage, tant pour les clients civils que militaires. Missions & Responsabilités La sûreté de fonctionnement est un élément essentiel dans la conception des systèmes avion et leur intégration. Elle permet de maîtriser les risques associés aux défaillances en suivant le développement du système depuis les phases préliminaires jusqu’à l’intégration. En tant que filiale du groupe AIRBUS, Airbus Protect est positionné sur des activités clés du groupe, autant sur le développement des grandes familles d’avions que sur des projets R&T stratégiques. En plus, notre présence en dehors du groupe nous permet d’accompagner d’autres entreprises du milieu aéronautique pour assurer la sûreté de leurs produits. Chez Airbus Protect vous intégrerez l’équipe en charge des activités de sûreté de fonctionnement des systèmes avion dont les tâches principales sont : évaluer les risques associés aux défaillances du système, évaluer et contribuer au choix des solutions d’architecture en fonction des exigences de sûreté applicables, contribuer aux analyses de causes communes, établir la conformité du système aux exigences de sûreté. En tant qu’ingénieur safety, vous serez un acteur clef du processus de développement des systèmes aéronautiques. En collaboration avec le bureau d’études, le programme et d’autres activités support ; vous serez responsable de l’accompagnement des projets de recherche et futurs développements (multi-systèmes, multi programmes) pour atteindre les objectifs de sûreté. Les compétences qui comptent pour nous: Vous êtes ingénieur avec de solides connaissances en architecture systèmes avion et vous connaissez le processus de développement de systèmes complexes. Vous êtes Ingénieur Aéronautique / Aérospatial, de formation grandes écoles ou universités. Vous possédez une expérience en aéronautique. title: Senior Aviation Safety Officer
description_text:
Job Description: Entra nel mondo di Airbus Helicopters Italia, dove l'innovazione incontra la tradizione.
Siamo leader indiscusso nel settore dell'aviazione, un punto di riferimento per la manutenzione avanzata e la gestione operativa degli elicotteri. Non solo offriamo servizi di manutenzione di base e di linea con standard d'eccellenza, ma siamo anche un Centro di Addestramento certificato da Airbus
Helicopters e Safran H.E., il che testimonia il nostro impegno nell'offrire competenze d'avanguardia.
Grazie alla nostra struttura CAMO garantiamo ai nostri clienti la continua navigabilità dei loro aeromobili, assicurando il massimo della sicurezza e dell'affidabilità.
Entrare a far parte del nostro team significa contribuire a una missione di eccellenza operativa in un ambiente dove la sicurezza
e l'innovazione sono sempre al primo posto.
Se vuoi fare la differenza in un settore in continua evoluzione, unisciti a noi! Stiamo cercando un Senior Aviation Safety Officer che si unisca al nostro team per contribuire attivamente alla gestione della Safety delle nostre operazioni.
Se desideri far parte di una realtà dinamica, dove ogni giorno è un'opportunità per imparare e crescere, questa è la tua occasione. Scopo della Posizione
In qualità di Senior Safety Officer, sarai il punto di riferimento operativo per i Safety Managers
nell'implementazione e nel mantenimento del Safety Management System (SMS) integrato per le nostre organizzazioni Part-145 (Base & Line), CAMO, DOA e POA.
La tua missione sarà garantire il più alto standard di sicurezza operativa, assicurando la conformità ai regolamenti EASA (inclusa la Part-IS) e l'integrazione con i requisiti di gestione del rischio dello standard EN 9100. Agirai come catalizzatore della Just Culture e del miglioramento continuo in tutti i dipartimenti aziendali.
Responsabilità Principali
Safety Management System (SMS): Coordinare il processo di identificazione dei pericoli e gestione dei rischi (Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment). Monitorare l'efficacia delle azioni di mitigazione.
Occurrence Reporting: Gestire il flusso delle segnalazioni (interne ed esterne), guidando le investigazioni di Safety per identificare le root causes e i fattori umani coinvolti.
Information Security (Part-IS): Supportare attivamente l'implementazione del Sistema di Gestione della Sicurezza delle Informazioni aeronautiche, monitorando le minacce e la conformità ai nuovi requisiti EASA.
Safety Assurance & Auditing: Pianificare ed eseguire audit di Safety e verifiche interne, assicurando che i processi operativi siano allineati ai manuali e agli standard di Sicurezza.
Compliance & Documentation: Collaborare alla revisione e all'aggiornamento dei manuali aziendali (MOE, CAME, DOH, POE) e delle procedure SMS, garantendo l'allineamento tra le diverse approvazioni.
Reporting & Data Analysis: Elaborare i Safety Performance Indicators (SPI) e i relativi target(SPT), preparando report analitici per il Safety Board e le Autorità Competenti.
Promozione della Safety Culture: Progettare e condurre sessioni di addestramento e workshop sui fattori umani e sulla Sicurezza, promuovendo attivamente la cultura della segnalazione
Come convincerci che sei la persona giusta
Esperienza Consolidata: Almeno 3-5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Safety o Quality all'interno di organizzazioni aeronautiche regolate EASA (preferibilmente con focus su elicotteri o gestione componenti/motori).
Competenze Normative: Conoscenza approfondita dei regolamenti EASA Part-145, Part-CAMO, Part-21 (J & G). La conoscenza del regolamento EASA Part-IS è considerata un forte valore aggiunto.
Expertise in Risk Management: Padronanza delle metodologie di analisi del rischio e delle tecniche di investigazione sugli incidenti/anomalie.
Qualifiche di Auditing: Certificazione come Internal Auditor (ISO 19011 o EN 9100). La familiarità con lo standard AS/EN 9100 è importante.
Soft Skills & Human Factors: Approfondita conoscenza dei principi di Human Factors e capacità di influenzare positivamente il comportamento del personale operativo.
Lingue e Strumenti: Eccellente padronanza dell'inglese tecnico (fondamentale per la manualistica e i rapporti con le Autorità).
Ottima dimestichezza con software gestionali aeronautici e tool di analisi dati.
Completano il profilo elevata capacità analitica, autonomia decisionale e doti comunicative per interfacciarsi con i diversi dipartimenti (Manutenzione, Ingegneria, Produzione, Progettazione).
Cosa Offriamo
L’opportunità di essere parte di un Gruppo internazionale leader di mercato nel settore aeronautico, avendo la possibilità di prendere parte a programmi di mobilità internazionale;
Inserimento nel sistema incentivante aziendale;
Orario di lavoro flessibile;
Formazione continua e specifica per lo sviluppo del proprio percorso professionali;
Convenzioni e scontistiche dedicate con aziende del territorio.
_____________________________________________________________________________
Step into the world of Airbus Helicopters Italia, where innovation meets tradition. We are an undisputed leader in the aviation sector and a benchmark for advanced maintenance and operational helicopter management. Not only do we offer base and line maintenance services with standards of excellence, but we are also an Authorized Training Center for Airbus Helicopters and Safran H.E., testifying to our commitment to providing cutting-edge expertise.
Thanks to our CAMO structure, we guarantee the continuing airworthiness of our clients' aircraft, ensuring the highest levels of safety and reliability. Joining our team means contributing to a mission of operational excellence in an environment where safety and innovation always come first.
If you want to make a difference in a constantly evolving sector, join us!
We are looking for a Senior Aviation Safety Officer to join our team and actively contribute to the Safety management of our operations. If you desire to be part of a dynamic reality, where every day is an opportunity to learn and grow, this is your chance.
Role Purpose
As a Senior Safety Officer, you will be the operational point of reference for Safety Managers in the implementation and maintenance of the integrated Safety Management System (SMS) for our Part-145 (Base & Line), CAMO, DOA, and POA organizations.
Your mission will be to ensure the highest standard of operational safety, ensuring compliance with EASA regulations (including Part-IS) and integration with the risk management requirements of the EN 9100 standard. You will act as a catalyst for Just Culture and continuous improvement across all company departments.
Main Responsibilities
Safety Management System (SMS): Coordinate the Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment process. Monitor the effectiveness of mitigation actions.
Occurrence Reporting: Manage the flow of internal and external reports, leading Safety investigations to identify root causes and involved human factors.
Information Security (Part-IS): Actively support the implementation of the Information Security Management System, monitoring threats and compliance with new EASA requirements.
Safety Assurance & Auditing: Plan and execute Safety audits and internal verifications, ensuring that operational processes are aligned with manuals and Safety standards.
Compliance & Documentation: Collaborate on the review and update of company manuals (MOE, CAME, DOH, POE) and SMS procedures, ensuring alignment between different approvals.
Reporting & Data Analysis: Develop Safety Performance Indicators (SPI) and relative targets (SPT), preparing analytical reports for the Safety Board and Competent Authorities.
Promotion of Safety Culture: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops on Human Factors and Safety, actively promoting a reporting culture.
How to convince us you are the right person
Consolidated Experience: At least 3-5 years of experience in Safety or Quality roles within EASA-regulated aviation organizations (preferably with a focus on helicopters or component/engine management).
Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of EASA Part-145, Part-CAMO, and Part-21 (J & G) regulations. Knowledge of EASA Part-IS is considered a strong added value.
Expertise in Risk Management: Mastery of risk analysis methodologies and investigation techniques for incidents/anomalies.
Auditing Qualifications: Certification as an Internal Auditor (ISO 19011 or EN 9100). Familiarity with the AS/EN 9100 standard is important.
Soft Skills & Human Factors: Thorough knowledge of Human Factors principles and the ability to positively influence the behavior of operational personnel.
Languages & Tools: Excellent command of technical English (essential for manuals and relations with Authorities). Proficiency with aviation management software and data analysis tools.
Attitude: High analytical capacity, decision-making autonomy, and communication skills to interface with various departments (Maintenance, Engineering, Production, Design).
What We Offer
The opportunity to be part of an international market leader Group in the aeronautical sector, with the possibility of participating in international mobility programs;
Inclusion in the company incentive system;
Flexible working hours;
Continuous and specific training for the development of one's professional path;
Dedicated agreements and discounts with local companies. title: Thèse CIFRE /PhD - Apprentissage par renforcement multimodal pour la robotique (M/F)
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un(e) étudiant(e) en thèse sur le sujet: “Apprentissage par Renforcement Multimodal pour la Robotique (M/F)” pour rejoindre le département Central Research & Technology, Airbus SAS basé à Toulouse, France. Le département travaille en collaboration avec des laboratoires du CNRS (le LAAS pour son expertise robotique et le CerCo pour l’IA inspirée des neuro-sciences), également impliqués dans la chaire synergie C3PO du cluster IA toulousain ANITI. Le travail de recherche sera réalisé à Toulouse : il est prévu à 40% dans les locaux d’Airbus et à 60% dans les locaux académiques (CNRS/ANITI). Le début de la thèse est envisagé en Octobre 2026. Etes-vous prêt à faire progresser l'intelligence des robots pour qu'ils s'adaptent dynamiquement aux instructions humaines dans un environnement industriel aéronautique ? Votre environnement de travail : Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services. Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos challenges : Contexte de la thèse : L'apprentissage par renforcement (“Reinforcement Learning” ou RL) est devenu un acteur majeur dans la prise de décision séquentielle en robotique, notamment pour gérer des entrées multimodales complexes (informations vectorielles, perception visuelle, instructions en langage naturel…). Dans le secteur aérospatial, le RL multimodal ouvre des perspectives de développement de robots plus adaptatifs, capables d'opérer dans des environnements industriels pour des tâches variées : inspection, manipulation, navigation, etc. La robotique est un champ de recherche actuellement très actif, avec deux impulsions récentes qui révolutionnent le domaine. La première vient du RL qui, depuis l’avènement de simulateurs massivement parallèles, permet par exemple de générer des politiques de marche en quelques minutes/heures. La seconde est l’utilisation de modèles de fondation robotique pré-entrainés type VLA (Vision-Language-Action), une extension naturelle des LLM (Large Language Models) & VLM (Vision-Language Models) à la robotique, permettant de capitaliser sur des connaissances acquises pour ne pas apprendre de zéro. L'objectif de cette thèse est d’utiliser le RL multimodal pour apprendre aux robots à adapter dynamiquement leur comportement à partir d’instructions de haut niveau fournies par des humains, en évitant de passer par l’ingénierie de fonction de récompense complexe. Ceci sera abordé en s’appuyant sur des modèles VLA pré-entrainés ainsi que sur la théorie du Global Workspace pour une fusion efficace des différentes modalités (proprioception, vision, instructions en langage naturel). Il est à noter qu’il existe plusieurs types de robots (bras robotiques, quadrupèdes…) qui peuvent jouer un rôle dans les opérations visées. Ainsi, des algorithmes généralistes applicables à différentes morphologies seront à privilégier dans ce contexte. Le travail de thèse consistera donc à : Réaliser un état de l'art sur le RL multimodal, les modèles Vision-Language-Action (VLA) et les mécanismes de fusion multimodale (Global Workspace Theory) Concevoir un cadre de RL multimodal basé sur des modèles de fondation robotique Proposer des méthodes pour simplifier/automatiser l’ingénierie de la fonction de récompense Développer des techniques de transfert robuste et valider les politiques apprises sur des plateformes robotiques physiques Votre carte d’embarquement : Master (de Recherche idéalement) en Intelligence Artificielle, Robotique ou Apprentissage par Renforcement Aisance en programmation Python & librairies de deep learning (PyTorch, Jax…) Compétence en apprentissage par renforcement (RL) et idéalement en simulation robotique Connaissances en IA pour la vision, le traitement du langage naturel et la fusion multimodale Intérêt pour la recherche scientifique et les applications industrielles, autonomie Vous ne matchez pas à 100% ? Pas d'inquiétude ! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant ! ENGLISH VERSION Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a PhD student on the subject : “Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Robotics (M/F)” to join our Central Research & Technology department based in Toulouse, France. The department works in collaboration with CNRS laboratories (LAAS for its robotics expertise and CerCo for neuroscience-inspired AI), also involved in the C3PO synergy chair of the Toulouse AI cluster ANITI. The research work will be carried out in Toulouse: 40% is planned in Airbus premises and 60% in academic premises (CNRS/ANITI). The start of the thesis is planned for October 2026. Are you ready to advance robot intelligence so they can dynamically adapt to human instructions in an aeronautical industrial environment ? Your working environment : Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you : Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges : PhD thesis scope: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a major player in sequential decision-making in robotics, particularly for managing complex multimodal inputs (vector information, visual perception, natural language instructions, etc.). In the aerospace sector, multimodal RL opens up perspectives for developing more adaptive robots, capable of operating in industrial environments for varied tasks: inspection, manipulation, navigation, etc. Robotics is currently a very active field of research, with two recent impulses that are revolutionizing the domain. The first comes from RL which, since the advent of massively parallel simulators, enables for instance walking policies to be generated in a few minutes/hours. The second is the use of pre-trained robotic foundation models such as VLAs (Vision-Language-Action models), a natural extension of LLMs (Large Language Models) & VLMs (Vision-Language Models) to robotics, making it possible to capitalize on acquired knowledge and avoid learning from scratch. The objective of this thesis is to use multimodal RL to teach robots to dynamically adapt their behavior based on high-level instructions provided by humans, while avoiding the need for complex reward function engineering. This will be addressed by relying on pre-trained VLA models as well as the Global Workspace theory for efficient fusion of different modalities (proprioception, vision, natural language instructions). It should be noted that there are several types of robots (robotic arms, quadrupeds…) that can play a role in the target operations. Thus, generalized algorithms applicable to different morphologies will be favored in this context. The thesis work will therefore consist of: Conducting a state of the art on multimodal RL, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and multimodal fusion mechanisms (Global Workspace Theory) Designing a multimodal RL framework based on robotic foundation models Proposing methods to simplify/automate reward function engineering Developing robust transfer techniques and validating learned policies on physical robotic platforms Your boarding pass : Master (of Research ideally) in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics or Reinforcement Learning Comfortable in Python programming & deep learning libraries (PyTorch, Jax…) Competence in Reinforcement Learning (RL) and ideally in robotic simulation Knowledge of AI for vision, natural language processing and multimodal fusion Interest in scientific research and industrial applications, autonomy Not a 100% match? description_text:
Job Description: Are you interested in joining into a team that offers you the possibility of having a multidisciplinary view of the A/C development process, having a close relationship will all the Centres of Competence (Design offices), Chief Engineering Offices, Services organization, System Suppliers, Airworthiness Authorities and in some cases with operational customers? To support the Aircraft Development Safety team in Getafe, we are looking for a System Safety Engineer who will ensure that Airbus products are designed, developed and supported according to the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations). Tasks As a member of the Aircraft Development Safety team, you will develop the following challenging tasks and activities: Performing System Safety Assessment activities for military aircraft systems, supporting the development phases until certification.
Performing a systematic and comprehensive examination of System functions to identify and classify failure conditions of those functions according to their severity.
Establishing the System Safety requirements and performing preliminary evaluations to determine that the proposed architecture can reasonably be expected to meet the safety objectives.
Generating evidences to demonstrate in front of the Airworthiness Authorities that the final system architecture meets required System Safety requirements.
Performing analyses of Common-Cause (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis).
Performing Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to demonstrate the Continuous Airworthiness of the platform.
Manage and establish safety requirements at the interface to interacting systems.
Manage input from and output to interfacing technical domains and technology (processes, maintenance, human factos, aircraft performance, structures, quality, etc.).
Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability. All these activities comprise all levels of development, from Aircraft level down to detailed requirements regarding hardware and Software. Good Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems.

title: Simulation Software Developer (m/f/d) for Eurodrone Virtual Engineering – Join Our Innovative Team!
description_text:
Job Description: Eurodrone Programme: With its ground-breaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, the European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. The European MALE RPAS is not just the first programme to fully implement digital design manufacturing and services (DDMS). It is also seen as a ‘light-house’ programme, not only within Airbus, but also for the entire aeronautics industry in Europe. Become part of the UAS business and rise to the challenges ahead! Mission and activities: In the Airbus Defence & Space Military Aircraft Simulation Domain we develop top notch, high fidelity Engineering and Training Simulations for a variety of aircraft, supporting the entire development lifecycle. Under the term “Virtual Engineering” (VE), the VE team is establishing a new way-of-working in the European MALE RPAS (Eurodrone) programme: The mission is to generate and deploy a central simulation and all associated governance, processes and tools, in order to support the development, integration and verification of the European MALE RPAS. title: Deputy Maintenance Manager
description_text:
Job Description: About AHUK...
Airbus Helicopters is the world’s largest helicopter manufacturer and the company’s site at Oxford Airport is Britain’s civil helicopter hub.
AHUK offers considerable experience in helicopter sales, bespoke completions, maintenance and spares support. Its in-house engineering capabilities include design, customisation, installation, flight-testing and certification, as well as technical support,
maintenance, training and the supply of spares for civil and military applications. AHUK is the MoD’s chosen provider of helicopters and maintenance for its No.1 Helicopter Flying school (referred to as MFTS) located in RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) and RAF Valley (Anglesey). The Reward: Why Join Airbus?
We offer a competitive base salary and a robust suite of benefits designed to support your health, wealth, and lifestyle:
● Holiday Allowance: We value loyalty and work-life balance; your annual leave entitlement grows with you, rewarding your commitment with an extra day of leave for each year of service (up to an additional 4 days)
● Health: Private Medical Insurance (Bupa). You also have the flexibility to add family members to your policy at an additional cost. Other options include Health-care Cash Schemes and Den-Plan.
● Future Wealth: up to 8% Company Pension contribution, when you contribute 6%. Plus Yearly Share Incentive Plans, and Discretionary Group Bonuses.
● Everyday Savings: Access to exclusive shopping discounts, including a cashback card to help your money go further.
● Lifestyle: Bikes to Work scheme (up to £3,000), Mydrive car purchase scheme, and Technology purchase schemes.
● Added Protection: Benefit from Personal Accident Insurance, Health-care Cash Schemes, and professional Financial/Legal advice.
● Refer a friend Scheme : We offer a generous Referral Bonus for any successfully placed candidates you recommend to the business.
● Inclusive Space: We provide a dedicated Multi-Faith Prayer Room, ensuring a quiet, private space prayer during the day.
● Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Your mental health matters. Gain access to 24/7 confidential support, counseling, and resources for both your professional and personal life.
● The Canteen Hub: A dedicated space to take a break and recharge, featuring on-site vending machines for quick snacks and refreshments.
● Fuel Your Day: Enjoy free tea and coffee throughout the day, because sometimes the best ideas happen over a fresh brew. The Opportunity
● Reporting directly to the Maintenance Manager, the Deputy Maintenance Manager acts as the senior production leader on the hangar floor. This role is the driving force behind the technical execution of our Completions and Modification activity, alongside the active management of daily Base Maintenance activities. As the formal second-in-command, you will fully deputise for the Maintenance Manager in their absence, assuming operational oversight to ensure continuous, compliant, and safe facility operations.
● You will be the "pulse" of the hangar—leading daily team briefs, setting the operational tempo, and serving as the primary enforcer of Part 145 standards, tool control, and housekeeping across all crews. A critical focus of this role is tactical resource planning and capacity management. You will dynamically allocate supervisors and engineering teams to ensure the facility operates within its capacity, maintaining strict turnaround times for base maintenance inputs while concurrently ensuring crews hit the modification project milestones defined by the Project Management Office (PMO). Additionally, you will act as the crucial technical bridge between the hangar floor and Part 21 Design, ensuring teams have the correct data before work begins. Knowledge and Skills
Essential
● Proven ability to actively manage and balance both routine base maintenance activities and complex modification projects simultaneously.
● Capability, confidence, and leadership presence to fully deputise for the Maintenance Manager and assume facility-wide operational control when required.
● Strong production leadership skills, with the ability to lead daily shift briefs, direct supervisors, and keep engineering teams focused and moving.
● Proven experience in tactical resource planning, including manpower forecasting, shift management, and dynamic capacity allocation to ensure the facility operates efficiently within its limits.
● Demonstrated track record of driving hangar efficiency to maintain strict aircraft turnaround times (TAT) and executing project milestones.
● Deep understanding of the Part 145 regulatory environment and the ability to strictly enforce these standards (tool control, 5S, health & safety) across multiple crews.
● Strong analytical problem-solving skills to unblock technical hurdles and resolve scheduling conflicts between Base Maintenance and Completions.
Desirable
● A good working knowledge of Part 21 Subpart J (Design) and Subpart G (Production) interfaces, specifically how they apply to the hangar floor.
● A dual background spanning both mechanical base maintenance and bespoke helicopter completions/modifications.
● Familiarity with interpreting and implementing Supplemental Type Certificates (STCs) and complex engineering drawings.
● Prior experience in a formal leadership or supervisory role within a busy rotary-wing MRO Education, Qualifications or Training
● Active EASA Part 66 B1.3 (Rotary Mechanics) or B2 (Avionics) license. (A dual background or B2 is highly advantageous for completions, but strong mechanical base maintenance experience is equally critical).
● A minimum of 7 years of hands-on aviation experience in rotary-wing maintenance.
● Demonstrated experience in a senior supervisory or production management capacity.
● Formal training in human factors, safety management systems (SMS), or lean hangar practices (e.g., 5S) is highly advantageous. Additional requirements
● This position is subject to National Security Vetting. Candidates must be able to obtain SC clearance, which generally requires having lived in the UK for the last five years. All successful applicants will also undergo a mandatory BPSS check.
● Applicants must meet any/all requirements of Export Compliance Regulations.
● All candidates must possess the current, legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Airbus will not be able to offer sponsorship for any employment Visa's. Data Protection

description_text:
Job Description: Spécialiste en Analyse des Contraintes - Structures Métalliques pour l'A220 Vous possédez une vaste expérience en analyse des contraintes dans l'industrie aéronautique, vous avez travaillé sur l'analyse de tolérance aux dommages et souhaitez-vous progresser et développer de nouvelles compétences ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Airbus Commercial recherche un Spécialiste en Analyse des Contraintes - Structures Métalliques pour rejoindre notre équipe A220 In-service Engineering basée à Toulouse, France. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Analyse des Contraintes (Stress), responsable de l'analyse des rapports de dommages et de l'approbation des solutions de réparation du point de vue de la résistance structurale, en conformité avec les exigences de certification pertinentes pour tous les composants et/ou assemblages structuraux de la flotte A220 en service (Pour l'ensemble de la structure avion : toutes les sections ATA 5x). Nous travaillons en partenariat avec l'équipe d'ingénierie en service de Mirabel (Canada) afin de toujours fournir le meilleur support à nos clients. Votre environnement de travail Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche spatiale, Toulouse est une ville dynamique dans le sud-ouest de la France, desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et proche des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses options d'activités de plein air ! Équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée : Jours de congé supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales, option de transfert de jours de congés, un Comité d'Établissement proposant de nombreuses activités sociales, culturelles et sportives ainsi que d'autres services. Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. Effectuer des analyses de résistance statique et de durabilité pour des réparations structurelles métalliques spécifiques ou génériques, en soutien à la flotte A220.
