description_text:
Job Description: In order to support our Eurodrone Program Quality Management organisation (TAOQU), Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Program Quality Manager for the PDTs (Product Delivery Team) (d/f/m) Introduction of role, department, team and project The European EuroDrone (Medium-Altitude, Long-Endurance Remotely Piloted Aircraft System) is the first Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) designed for flight in non-segregated airspace and will be capable of performing a range of ISTAR missions, both wide area and in theatre. The EuroDrone is designed to become one of the main pillars of any future combat air system, prepared for integration into civil airspace based on minimal restrictions and easy transportability due to its modular design. As a Program Quality Manager (PQM) within the TAOQU organisation, you will be the single point of contact for Quality within your assigned Product Delivery Team (PDT#). You will be fully responsible for ensuring the deployment of quality activities on Quality, on Time, and on Cost along the entire product lifecycle (engineering and operations). This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. Your location Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Your tasks and responsibilities Quality Governance & PDT Interface: Act as the Single Point of Contact for Quality within the PDT#; ensure the communication, negotiation, and implementation of all quality, safety, and reliability requirements throughout the company’s operational processes (develop, fulfil, support, source). Lifecycle & Product Assurance Planning: Devise, plan, and implement the Product Assurance Plan throughout the programme lifecycle (from offer to in-service phase), providing the PDT Manager with the required evidence and degree of quality on time and on cost. Conformity & Attestation: Monitor and attest the conformity of the product with regards to contractual requirements, legal rules, and customer expectations, ensuring all processes comply with required standards. Data Analysis & Preventive Action: Collect, analyze, and visualize product and/or in-service performance data (manual and automatic) to prevent early deviations; deploy preventive techniques (APQP) during baseline changes such as product modifications or manufacturing process updates. title: Data Scientist
description_text:
Job Description: The Airbus India Innovation Centre (AIC) is at the forefront of the company’s digital transformation, particularly within the Innovation and Engineering departments. As we move towards Industrialisation of AI, the department focuses on applying Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, and Deep Tech to solve critical aerospace challenges—ranging from generative design and predictive maintenance to autonomous systems. In this fast-paced environment, the Innovation Team acts as an internal incubator for disruptive technologies. Our projects follow a rigorous lifecycle from Proof of Concept (PoC) to full industrial deployment. To support these goals, AIC seeks to onboard a Data Scientist to explore ill-defined complex business problems around data using scientific methods and to transform them into insights solutions based on state of the art machine learning, AI and statistics with the focus on forward-looking applications. The Data Scientist will work closely with AI lead and Product Managers to ensure data integrity throughout the product life cycle. Job Description: Understand and translate business needs into statistical, machine learning, or AI problem spaces. Collaborate with IT and Data Analysts to extract and integrate structured and unstructured data from various sources. Work closely with Data Engineers to design scalable data pipelines and ensure efficient data flow for model training and evaluation. Analyze data properties and apply scientific methods to propose or develop solutions using statistical, machine learning, or AI techniques. Design and execute controlled experiments to identify and validate optimal solutions. Implement solutions using state-of-the-art algorithms and software engineering best practices. Create monitoring protocols to ensure models align with evolving business needs. Contribute to the development and reusability of industrial-grade AI solutions. Share best practices, insights, and techniques with the wider data community. Ensure compliance with all external and internal regulations and standards. Develop solutions responsibly in line with Airbus ethical AI principles Key Competencies: Competency & Skill Level AI: Machine Learning & Deep Learning : 3 - Advanced Level Artificial Intelligence (AI) Approaches : 3 - Advanced Level Applied probabilities & Statistics : 3 - Advanced Level Software engineering fundamentals : 2 - Autonomous Level Data Governance Management System : 2 - Autonomous Level Data Science: Advanced Analytics : 3 - Advanced Level Data Science: Data visualisation & Coms : 3 - Advanced Level Data Science: Data Wrangling : 3 - Advanced Level Data Security : 1 - Basic Level Generative AI Essentials & Prompting : 3 - Advanced Eco-design & Sustainability of Digital services : 2 - Autonomous Level Competency Scale: Basic Level: Basic level of expertise, performs routine and/or recurrent tasks, implies partial supervision. Autonomous Level : Ability to solve problems autonomously, no supervision required in these tasks. Can deal with unforeseen issues. Advanced Level: High Level of knowledge and wide experience which is internally recognised. Could be a mentor/coach/advisor to support skill development of other colleagues Education and Experience: Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative technical field (Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Aerospace Engineering). A Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (e.g., Physics, Mathematics, Aerospace Engineering, or Computer Science) is an advantage. Industry Tenure: 8+ years of experience in data-related roles, with a proven track record of leading technical teams through the full AI project lifecycle. Advanced knowledge of modern architectures, including CNNs and Transformers. Hands-on experience with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and hybrid modeling approaches is an advantage Proficiency with GenAI toolkits such as Hugging Face, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside agentic frameworks (e.g., Google ADK). Expert-level coding in Python and deep familiarity with the ecosystem (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn). Expert knowledge of SQL and database systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle), including terminal-based workflows (e.g., Claude Code). Subject matter expertise in aviation datasets (flight data, maintenance records, passenger telemetry) and business processes is definite advantage Practical knowledge of containerization and cloud/on-premise deployment to ensure models move from research to production. The ability to translate complex model outputs into "The Story Behind the Data" for non-technical global stakeholders. Ability to operate within a Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring all code and research is reproducible, audit-ready, and meets "aircraft-grade" standards. Comfortable with a "fail-fast" innovation mindset while maintaining the rigorous safety and quality requirements of the aerospace industry. Experience working cross-functionally with AI Engineers and Product Managers for End-to-End delivery. description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Defence & Space recherche un d’Ingénieur expérimenté de design électronique VHDL FPGA pour équipements spatiaux (f/h) pour rejoindre notre entité Space Electronics basée à Elancourt (78), France. Description du poste : Au sein de l’équipe de design FPGA, vous participerez activement au développement, à la justification et à la validation de solutions FPGA et ASIC destinées à être embarquées sur des équipements spatiaux (avionique, cartes processeurs, traitement de signal et d'images, stockage de masse, télécommunications, cryptographie, etc.). Vos challenges : Porter la responsabilité technique : Piloter la conception d’un ou plusieurs FPGA spatiaux, incluant la participation aux propositions techniques, la définition des spécifications et la réalisation d'études de trade-offs d'architecture.
Réaliser des implémentations algorithmiques : Traduire des algorithmes complexes (ex: GNSS, commande moteur) en architectures matérielles performantes, optimisées en termes de ressources, de latence et de consommation.
Participer au cycle de conception complet : Spécifier, architecturer, assurer le développement (codage VHDL), la simulation , le placement et routage (P&R), l'intégration sur carte, la validation fonctionnelle et la caractérisation des performances.
Concevoir pour l'espace : Intégrer, dès la phase de conception, les contraintes spécifiques au domaine spatial (résistance aux radiations, gestion thermique, contraintes d'assemblage).
Investiguer : Participer à l’analyse de code VHDL et à la résolution de problèmes répartis sur plusieurs domaines techniques.
Gérer des projets : Rédiger la documentation technique requise par les clients, assurer le suivi des coûts et du planning de vos activités, et animer une équipe technique sur des projets dédiés.
Collaborer :
Participer aux échanges inter-métiers (électronique analogique, conception de cartes, logiciel, validation, etc.)
Assurer la revue de conception (relectures de documents techniques) pour les autres projets de l'équipe. Des déplacements professionnels occasionnels sont à prévoir en France et en Europe. Votre profil : Expérience ingénierie dans le domaine de l’électronique, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 10 ans minimum en conception FPGA.
Vous disposez :
D'une très bonne connaissance du VHDL, de la simulation, de la synthèse, du placement routage de FPGA,
D’une connaissance du software bas niveau en C (pour ARM) et des langages de script Perl et Python (voire du TCL) ,
De connaissances d’un ou plusieurs des protocoles suivants : AMBA4, SPW, 1553, CAN, DDR.
De compétences en gestion de versions, notamment Git
De compétences linguistiques : niveau négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.
D’une connaissance de l’électronique au sens large
D’une précédente expérience en architecture FPGA (d’un point de vue système)

description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for a Airworthiness & Quality Engineer (Logistics/Procurement) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Quality Logistics and Transport Team (part of Procurement Quality). Our main mission is to secure the implementation and application of Quality standards to Transport & Logistics across all Air Power programs. We focus on protecting product integrity from supplier dispatch to final receipt, ensuring compliance with aerospace regulations (PART21 and PART145), and preventing any logistics or transport-related non-conformities that could impact safety or certification. The team is dynamic, collaborative, and works closely with internal business units, local teams, and external stakeholders. The jobholder will reinforce our warehouse and certifying activities, taking part in material certification processes, quality inspections, and new initiatives to improve material management for our manufacturing customers. Job Description: In order to support the Eurofighter System Support Center (SUZ EF), a cooperation between Airbus and the German Air Force (Luftwaffe) at the Airbus site in Manching, provides operational technical and logistical support for the Eurofighters currently in service, we are surching for an IT Product & Test Engineer - Eurofighter Support Systems (d/f/m) The wide range of our competencies makes us a unique, universal point of contact for Eurofighter system support. In this role, you will take over tasks and support activities in the areas of Requirements Capturing and Test Automation & Execution for the German Air Force's Eurofighter In-Service Support Workflow Tool (ASTECS). Your responsibilities will span from gathering and documenting requirements to executing and evaluating tests and feeding the results back into the development process. Your location Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. Your tasks and responsibilities Requirements Capturing Management (RCM): Align and capture functional, content-related, and procedural requirements with both internal stakeholders (e.g., SUZ EF User Help Desk) and the national German customer (specifically the Air Force and BAAINBw). Process Analysis: Analyze the In-Service Support processes of the Eurofighter weapon system, track process changes regarding their impact on ASTECS, and subsequently derive and document requirements. Test Management & Strategy: Implement the test strategy for ASTECS, including translating requirements into test designs (e.g., creating and enriching User Stories, acceptance criteria, and activity diagrams within Enterprise Architect). Quality Assurance: Support QA through test execution (both specific manual tests and automated test runs), evaluate the results, and feed them back into the software development process. Documentation & Templates: Create and maintain various documentations within the development lifecycle, such as Release Notes, the ASTECS user manual, and various templates within the tool. Software Engineering: Sound knowledge and experience within software development projects up to the point of customer delivery, including familiarity with Agile development methodologies. Database & Tooling: Good knowledge of Oracle / SQL (Programming Language SQL). Experience with Confluence, Jira, Enterprise Architect (specifically UML knowledge) and QF-Test is highly desirable and a major advantage. Testing Expertise: An ISTQB Certification (or equivalent) as well as practical experience in automated testing are strong assets. Domain Knowledge: Previous experience with In-Service Support processes, particularly regarding flying weapon systems (e.g., Eurofighter), is highly preferred. Soft Skills & Languages: Excellent communication skills, autonomy, a high sense of responsibility, resilience, and strong assertiveness. title: Service Delivery Manager (HEMS)
description_text:
Job Description: About our Team... Airbus Helicopters is the world’s largest helicopter manufacturer and the company’s site at Oxford Airport is Britain’s civil helicopter hub. AHUK offers considerable experience in helicopter sales, bespoke completions, maintenance, CAMO and spares support. Its in-house engineering capabilities include design, customisation, installation, flight-testing and certification, as well as technical support, maintenance, training and the supply of spares for civil and military applications. AHUK is also the MoD’s chosen provider of helicopters and maintenance for the UK Military Flight Training System located in RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) and RAF Valley (Anglesey). Description/Overall Purpose of the Job Reporting to: Head of Services Delivery We are seeking an experienced and dynamic candidate to provide leadership for the delivery of our Civil Helicopter Maintenance Projects with a primary focus on Helicopter Emergency Medical Services (HEMS), Private & Business, and National Resilience (non-NPAS). The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) for Civil Helicopter Maintenance Projects is one of three new SDM roles responsible for ensuring delivery of base and off-site maintenance contracts to schedule, cost and quality. Reporting to the Head of Services Delivery (Hd SD), the SDM shall ensure an end-to-end flow from customer contract through to handover of the aircraft back to the customer. You will facilitate a multi-functional delivery team formed as a matrix organisation, aligning a value stream approach to drive the day-to-day delivery of KPIs defined by the contract and as directed by the Hd SD. The service-delivery matrix organisation will comprise personnel from MRO, Materiel Management, CAMO, Customer Support Managers (CSMs), Commercial, Finance, Tech Support, PMO and Aircrew. The SDM will also be supported by a cost controller and the MRO Production Planning Engineer. Key responsibilities of the SDM for Civil Helicopter Maintenance Projects include: Operational Performance: Responsible for end-to-end delivery performance (schedule, cost and quality) of each maintenance contract plus any ad-hoc arisings. In a change from previous methods, the SDM will monitor and control hours and schedule versus an agreed baseline for the maintenance input using live data metrics that are to become an integral part of the daily and weekly operational routines. In the detail, this will require the SDM to perform the following tasks: Manage the production and updates (re-baselining) of project-level budgets (hours and materials) for each aircraft maintenance input. Manage the allocation of budget manhours, commitments and forecasts to maintenance-module level. Daily progress monitoring and problem solving. Supporting the Cost Controller production of cost reports, dashboard updates and metrics. In conjunction with the Cost Controller, maintain strong coordination with all departments to ensure all costs are accurately booked, allocated and in line with contract performance requirements. Manage requirements for additional and emergent work (defects) to ensure appropriate costs are captured for invoicing to the Customer. Cross-Functional Integration & Synchronisation: Ensure seamless cross-functional integration, synchronisation and collaboration among each function represented within the Delivery Team. Regular Operational Reviews: Perform daily progress reviews with the Delivery Team to monitor and control progress against the contracted performance, identify bottlenecks/issues and ensure appropriate actions are taken or escalated to ensure prompt resolution. These meetings will adopt the Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, People (SQCDP). Routine Reporting: In conjunction with the Cost Controller, conduct analysis and continuous SQCDP reporting on work in progress (WIP) of the overall delivery programme and for each more-detailed aircraft project, including KPIs, CPI/SPI and other metrics as defined by Hd SD. Historic Data: Compilation of a data pool from completed projects for the retrospective analysis of performance/cost issues, recurring trends and satisfaction of contracted requirements. Focus on improving charge-out rates to increase profitability and competitiveness, and supporting future bid development. Customer Reporting: Liaison with the CSM to maintain dialogue with the Customer, producing customer reports in line with contractual agreements, supported by conference calls and in-person visits as required. Process Optimisation & Efficiency: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the scope of the Delivery Team, identifying opportunities to improve customer satisfaction as well as internal adherence to contract performance metrics. Implement lean methodologies/analyses to identify and implement time and cost savings opportunities to maximise value-added and minimise non-value-added business practices. Knowledge and Skills Successful operations management experience. Strong understanding of support contracts, MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) operations, and/or complex project delivery. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and motivate at all levels. Ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making. Proficiency in operational excellence methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) is highly desirable. Sound commercial acumen and experience with budget management. Knowledge of aviation regulations and safety standards is highly advantageous. Education, Qualifications or Training Essential Extensive experience with technical and/or commercial roles within the aerospace industry. and/or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's degree. Desirable Specific experience relating to the management of Airbus helicopter customers and/or support & services. Direct experience of HEMS/Private programme delivery, either in the capacity as a senior officer or through commercial collaboration at the same level. About You Results-oriented and committed to continuous improvement. Highly organised and meticulous with attention to detail. Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and demanding environment. Collaborative team player with strong relationship-building skills and able to work in an international environment. Addition Informal Requirements Position based at Oxford Airport, UK. Infrequent travel to the customer sites from time to time. Due to the nature of this position, you will require DBS and be eligible for SC clearance. Applicants must meet any/all requirements of Export Compliance Regulations. Als Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) (m/w/d) sind Sie Teil unserer Informationssicherheitsstrategie: Sie sind der technische Sparringspartner für Engineering & Service, heben unsere Security-Maturity messbar (Threat Modeling, Secure-by-Design, Security-Initiativen) und führen gleichzeitig die notwendigen Governance-Programme.
Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Head of Engineering, dem Rollout und Service, sowie den Platform-Teams und anderen Stakeholdern im Unternehmen zusammen.

Für diese Stelle ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. muss eine solche von den anerkannten Behörden erteilt werden. Hier genießen Sie die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt und werden Teil einer Stadt, die gleichzeitig ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt und die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus US Manufacturing Facility is looking for an Aviation Production Support Technician (Contract) to join our Final Assembly Line based in Mobile, AL. Airbus is seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our aviation team as a Production Support Technician. You will be responsible for the precision cleaning of aircraft components—removing metallic debris and chemical residues—as well as maintaining the organization and cleanliness of our specialized tooling and production environment. Meet the team: Our Engineers at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facility take our aircraft from concept to customer delivery – working with production teams on every aspect of assembly from managing technical information, quality control, maintenance tasks and health & safety – along flowlines and flightlines. Join our team and watch our aircraft come to life. Your working environment: Nearby on ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. Your challenges: Primary Responsibilities: Clean as you go: 40% Perform intermediate cleaning steps during the drilling process to prevent the contamination (metal shavings, oil, sealant). Scrape sealant before curing time to reduce customer presentation preparation time. Containment at Source: Implement active cleaning techniques to capture metal shavings and oil at the point of generation,preventing debris from migrating to other sections of the aircraft. Real-Time Disposal: Ensure all scrap, used wipes, and other waste are disposed of immediately in designated containers to keep the workspace clear and avoid FOD migration. Customer presentation preparation: 50% Debris Removal: Utilize industrial vacuums and specialized scrapers to remove metal shavings (swarf), dust, and particles from tight aircraft structures. Chemical Cleaning: Apply qualified solvents and cleaning agents to remove oils, greases, and excess sealant according to technical specifications. Quality Assurance: Ensure all surfaces meet "white-glove" standards to meet quality criteria according to technical specifications. 5S and general cleaning of the station: 10% Protection cleaning : Ensure all returned protection are clean before installed on the aircraft. Platform floor cleaning : Perform cleaning of the floor platform and work surfaces once a shift. Jigs and tool cleaning : During downtime, put in place a rotation to clean the jigs and tools on the station and open broken tool report if tool identified broken. Tool boxes inventories and issues declaration. Your boarding pass: Attention to Detail: Ability to spot minor defects or debris in complex assemblies. Technical Literacy: Ability to read and follow "Qualified Product Lists" (QPL) to ensure the correct chemicals are used on specific alloys. Physical Stamina: Comfortable working in confined spaces for extended periods, at heights on platforms. Safety Mindset: Strict adherence to PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) and FOD (Foreign Object Debris) prevention protocols. Required : High School Diploma or Equivalent. Required: 1-3 years experience working with cleaning operations. Preferred: 2-4 years experience working with cleaning operations in an aviation manufacturing or repair environment. Prior experience working in a LEAN Environment. Must be able to work in confined spaces. Knowledge of OSHA regulations regarding confined space entry,respiratory protection,proper use of PPE,fall protection,hazardous communications and other relevant regulations. Must be able to transition work platforms and ladders safely. Must be able to use basic hand tools such as screwdrivers,scrapers,wrenches,etc. Keep tools and support equipment in safe operating condition at all times. English : Spoken and written. Eligible for employment in the US. This position is a temporary (contract) position with no specific time period but could be extended or shortened as needed. Contractors are employed by a 3rd party vendor and placed on assignment to Airbus in America. Physical Requirements: Vision: Able to see and utilize fine work tools, computer screens, able to move through the office and from point to point to find specific co- workers and in-house expats. Hearing: Able to normal conversations and respond to warnings and signals. Carrying: able to carry up to 40 lbs. on occasion. Speaking: Able to participate in normal business conversations. Carrying: Able to occasionally carry up to 20lbs/9kg while engaging in training, addressing production issues or as part of continuous improvement projects. Lifting: Able to lift up to 40 lbs. Climb or Balance: Able to climb or balance in production areas. Pushing/Pulling: Able to push/pull items in office areas and on the shop floor. Sitting: Able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Squatting/Kneeling: Able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Standing: Able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Travel/Mobility: Able to travel independently and at short notice. Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): Able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site. Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor. With over 130,000 employees and as the largest aeronautics and Space Company in Europe and a worldwide leader, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry. We build the most innovative commercial aircraft and consistently capture about half of all commercial airliner orders. Thanks to our deep understanding of changing market needs, customer focus and technological innovation, we offer products that connect people and places via air and space. Come and join us. #WeMakeItFly Job Position Health Engineer- Propulsion Systems Job Description Team Description The Health Engineering Team at Airbus India utilizes primarily System Engineering and Health engineering competencies. This team is responsible for defining the maintenance systems of tomorrow for the aircraft, developing diagnostic and prognostic solutions to improve the maturity of systems and to provide health monitoring capabilities by applying machine learning algorithms, reliability concepts, an adept understanding of aircraft systems and modeling and simulation capabilities. The team works with both commercial and defense & space ecosystems and is also engaged on Airbus Skywise (the singular access point to data analytics) utilizing Big Data, Java & Python skills to create data-driven models. We are a team strongly invested in R&T initiatives that are dedicated to supporting future aircraft health needs. This team is part of Advance Engineering & System Studies, a department that works on providing simulation means for most aircraft systems and industrial needs through the application of systems engineering and design. description_text:
Job Description: Ice Protection Methods and Tools Designer – Airbus Commercial Engineering Center As part of Airbus’s ambition to grow a proficient and competitive Engineering organisation, we are launching a Commercial Aircraft Engineering Centre in Poland. This initiative aims to leverage Poland’s talent pool and technological ecosystem, while supporting our broader Engineering workload and competitiveness requirements, and reinforcing Airbus’ strategic engagement with Poland. Role Overview Join the “System Integration” department responsible for the seamless integration of Propulsion System into Airbus aircraft. Within the department, Wing and Nacelle Ice Protection Systems (IPS) are key to ensure aircraft safety and performance. You will act as Ice Protection Methods and Tools Designer, in charge of Wing and Nacelle Ice Protection Systems, Methods and Tools for Airbus commercial aircraft. Developing and maintaining existing in-service systems require a deep understanding of the system performance and the associated ice physics and associated thermal behaviour of the aircraft element to be protected. This is where we need you, to help define, design and validate the next generation of aircraft. Your challenges You will be involved in Ice Protection System design activities to support aircraft programmes evolutions and participate in future technologies maturation. Identify, perform or support the team in the projects aiming at improving our knowledge of icing conditions or in our methods to develop Ice Protection System. title: PhD on Autonomous Operations and Cognitive Processor Implementation for Space Systems (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: In order to support the advancement in the field of conjunction analysis and collision avoidance of space assets, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a PhD on Autonomous Operations and Cognitive Processor Implementation for Space Systems (d/f/m) Are you looking for a PhD opportunity and want to gain deep hands-on experience in spacecraft autonomy, real-time embedded systems, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) robotics? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the department of Functional Architecture and Validation as a PhD candidate. Location: Friedrichshafen
Start: 01.09.2026
Duration: 3 years Your location At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing. Your benefits Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).
International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
Work with modern/diversified technologies.
At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network. Your tasks and responsibilities This PhD project will be carried out as part of our advanced research activities exploring the application of Artificial Intelligence and autonomous Navigation & Guidance in space-borne systems. The project bridges the gap between software simulation and physical reality by deploying advanced algorithms onto a space-representative Cognitive Processor (System-on-Chip/FPGA). As a PhD candidate, your work will be uniquely split between applied engineering and academic research. You will be responsible for the core technical implementation of the processing hardware, establishing complex real-time interfaces with physical sensors and robotic testbeds, while simultaneously driving the research definition of autonomous operations and higher-level functions executed on the edge processor. In your role as PhD candidate you will be responsible of the following tasks Research & Definition: Define and research novel architectures and methodologies for autonomous operations and higher-level GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) functions on embedded space hardware.
Hardware Implementation: Set up and configure the Cognitive Processor (SoC/FPGA), establishing and managing hardware transmission protocols (e.g., MIPI CSI-2, LVDS, GigE Vision) to interface with physical sensors (RGB cameras, LiDAR) and simulation PCs.
Real-Time Systems: Implement, configure, and maintain a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) environment (e.g., embedded Linux / PetaLinux with PREEMPT_RT) to guarantee strict timing deadlines for closed-loop robotic control.
Software Deployment: Support the integration, optimization, and deployment of external C++ GNC and AI code provided by project partners onto the target processing board.
Robotic Integration: Actively participate in FlatSat and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test campaigns, integrating the processor with physical robotic facilities (e.g., cable-driven robots) to validate closed-loop autonomous behaviors.
Academic Contribution: Document findings and results comprehensively, driving publications in high-ranking conferences and scientific journals over the 3-year period. Desired skills and qualifications Completed Master’s degree (and eligible for PhD enrollment) in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
Strong hands-on background in Embedded Linux and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
Experience with SoC/FPGA architectures and hardware description languages (VHDL/Verilog).
Knowledge of high-speed hardware transmission protocols (particularly MIPI and LVDS).
Solid programming skills in C++ for embedded systems; familiarity with Python or MATLAB/Simulink is a plus.
Practical experience with robotics, hardware integration, or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing environments.
A strong drive to tackle both low-level technical implementation challenges and high-level academic research.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, research-oriented environment. ​Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, masters’ degree certificate. Definition working student Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis. This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. Job Description: Für Airbus Defence and Space in Koblenz suchen wir für den Bereich „Global Business" in der Abteilung "KAM Team Germany" einen Key Account Manager (w/m/d) für das BAAINBw. Das Key Account Management Team Germany ist die Schnittstelle von Airbus Defence & Space zu den deutschen Kunden und der Bundeswehr. Durch intensive Kontakte mit den Kunden und Nutzern verfügt das Key Account Management über eine detaillierte Marktsicht, die zur Implementierung der Strategie, zur Positionierung der Division im Markt und zum Ausbau des Geschäfts genutzt wird. Ein zentrales Element dabei ist die Vorbereitung, vertragliche Umsetzung und Begleitung von Projekten mit dem BAAINBw als zentraler Beschaffungsbehörde der Bundeswehr sowie die strategische Zusammenarbeit mit den Wehrtechnischen Dienststellen als nachgeordneten Bereichen des BAAINBw sowie dem Innovationszentrum der Bundeswehr. Als Key Account Manager (KAM) BAAINBw Space Systems and Space Digital Business sind Sie integraler Bestandteil des KAM Teams Deutschland und vertreten Airbus Defence and Space hinsichtlich des Leistungsportfolios der Geschäftsbereiche Space Systems und Connected Intelligence im Markt sowohl gegenüber dem BAAINBw und der Bundeswehr als auch Airbus intern. Sie übernehmen als KAM eine zentrale Rolle zur Sicherstellung einer wettbewerbsfähigen Positionierung ihres Perimeters im deutschen Markt. In Zusammenarbeit mit den Sales und Business Growth Managern, dem Marketing und Public Affairs sowie den Programm-Linien begleiten Sie Beschaffungsprogramme zum Schließen von Fähigkeitslücken, der Fortentwicklung bestehender Lösungen und liefern essentielle Beiträge für Raumfahrt- und Digitalisierungskampagnen von Airbus Defence and Space. Sie stellen eine koordinierte Kundenbearbeitung und eine permanente Begleitung des Vertriebsprozesses bezüglich Ihres Perimeters sicher. Neben der Betreuung der Dienststellen der Bundeswehr, insbesondere des BAAINBw, gehört das Wahrnehmen von repräsentativen Aufgaben zu den weiteren Tätigkeiten, ebenso wie der Auf- und Ausbau eines hochwertigen Beziehungsmanagements zu Entscheidungsträgern von Kunden und industriellen Stakeholdern, wie weiteren Marktteilnehmern, Forschungsinstituten und Verbänden. Diese Rolle beinhaltet regelmäßige Geschäftsreisen im In- und Ausland und verlangt ein hohes Maß an Mobilität, zugleich aber auch eine enge Bindung an den Standort Koblenz. Für diese Stelle ist ein hohes Maß an Sensibilität bezüglich der Compliance Regeln der Airbus Defence and Space sowie des spezifischen deutschen Kunden erforderlich. This position supports the fleet in-service repair of aircraft structures and is responsible for the justification of repair solutions from a Static Stress point of view, on Time, to Cost and to Quality. Duties include performing static analysis for both metallic and non-metallic parts while working in close collaboration with design and fatigue colleagues to provide repair solutions. Methods include the use of both classical hand calculations and computer techniques to develop efficient repair solutions to satisfy airworthiness requirements and customers (Airlines/MROs). Meet the Team: Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world. Your Working Environment: Located on the Wichita State University (WSU) innovation campus is Airbus’ first dedicated engineering facility outside of Europe. Our team of 200+ support staff and engineers focus on aerostructure design including analysis of aircraft primary structures, such as wings and fuselages, for all major Airbus products across the globe. Perform stress/strength analyses to assess that structural integrity requirements have been met using standard hand and computer methods. Assignments include structural sizing/documentation and subsequent certification documents for in-service fleet support. Perform durability and damage tolerance analyses to verify that structural integrity requirements have been met. Assignments may include detail part sizing, layout maturation, trade study analysis, weight reduction efforts, certification activity, or in-service support. title: Solution Innovator
description_text:
Job Description: Job Description - Solution Innovator
About the Team & Department Digital Innovation is at the forefront of shaping the future of Customer Services Digital Solutions. Our mission is to lead the end-to-end co-creation of groundbreaking digital solutions, addressing the primary needs of the Air Transport System from idea to MVP maturity. We achieve this through an Open Innovation and Co-Creation process, leveraging Airbus's unique assets, hands-on experience, and proven methodologies like Design Thinking, Lean UX, Lean Start-up, and (Scaled) Agile. We support the transformation of different Airbus customer services business lines by supporting them through specific missions. You will be an integral part of the Innovation for Digital Solutions team, a dynamic group of Strategic Designers, Value Architects, and Solution Innovators organized into Digital Growth Squads. Our core activity revolves around identifying new solutions to help our customers solve complex problems and unlock significant business value by designing desirable, viable, and feasible services. Co-creation, Design Thinking, and Lean UX are embedded in our daily philosophy and ways of working. Role Purpose As a Solution Innovator, you will drive the development of innovative digital solutions, bridging customer needs, business value, and technical feasibility. This pivotal role focuses on leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and advanced software development, to define and operationalize disruptive new services that meet critical demands within the aerospace context. Key Responsibilities AI-Driven Prototyping & Development: Lead the conceptualization, design, and development of technical prototypes, with a strong focus on Artificial Intelligence, particularly Generative AI, to de-risk technology bricks and validate solution feasibility. Actively identify, learn, and apply new and emerging AI technologies (e.g., Machine Learning, Multi-agent systems) to address customer needs and drive innovation. Drive the vision and foster a network around the strategic usage of Generative AI for Customer Services. Aerospace Business Context Integration: Apply a deep understanding of the aerospace business context, including Aircraft Maintenance domains, Fleet Performance, and Aircraft Configuration and Data, to identify and define high-impact digital solutions. Translate complex operational challenges within the air transport industry into innovative technical solutions that enhance predictability and resilience of airline operations. Support squads in establishing innovation roadmaps where AI is a key enabler for in-service maintenance and operations, including Prognostic Health Monitoring. Feasibility Assessment & Management: Rigorously assess the feasibility of proposed solutions across operational, technical, schedule, economic, legal, and sustainability axes. Work closely with Strategic Design and Early Adopters to understand user personas, pain points, and journeys, and gather solution feedback through various testing methods. Collaborate with Value Architects to assess the potential value a solution could generate for customers and Airbus. Define the key features of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in collaboration with Product Owners, developing capability and feature lists and user stories. Strategic & Collaborative Innovation: Actively participate in Ideation Sessions, Brainstorms, Creative Thinking workshops, and Design Sprints to qualify and select high-potential ideas aligned with strategic intent. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams including Strategic Designers, Value Architects, Digital Architects, Business & Functional Architects, and ad-hoc experts to scope, design, and deliver innovative solutions. Perform continuous technology watch and scouting to identify emerging technologies and new trends relevant to digital services in the aerospace industry. Contribute to the development of business cases and operating plans, including cost structure evaluations and defining global roadmaps and budgets for future technical solutions. Project & Stakeholder Management: Drive the multidisciplinary team through lean, agile-based incubation and early adoption processes (Build, Learn, Adapt). Prepare and conduct handovers to industrialization teams, ensuring comprehensive support and technical documentation (user guides, training material, operations dossiers). Work closely with data governance to define and maintain principles of data governance (e.g., GDPR, Export Control) and actively identify measures to protect intellectual property. Required Skills & Competencies Technical Expertise: Proven hands-on skills in quickly prototyping and developing software solutions, with a strong emphasis on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, ideally including Generative AI. Strong understanding of mobile, cloud, and web technologies. Experience with functional architecture and modeling languages. Ability to conceptualize and implement technical & functional integration between complementary software products. Aerospace Domain Knowledge: Demonstrated understanding of the Air Transport industry and specific knowledge of Aircraft Maintenance domains, Fleet Performance, and Aircraft Configuration and Data. Ability to identify the application of technology to complex business problems within the aerospace sector. Innovation & Strategic Thinking: An entrepreneurial drive to define and develop new solutions, coupled with an ability to think strategically and creatively. Working knowledge of agile development methodologies (Lean Start-up, Scrum, Kanban). Customer-minded, challenging, curious, and open-minded approach to problem-solving. Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Superior interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence through persuasive written and verbal communication. Excellent leadership skills with experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. Ability to set and manage expectations at the senior leadership level. Organizational & Problem-Solving: Capacity for self-motivation, independent initiative, and creative problem-solving. Diligent attention to detail and strong technical intuition. Ability to manage time and schedules to meet aggressive deadlines. Autonomous and self-organized with strong problem-solving capabilities. Data & IP Management: Ability to understand and manage data sensitivity and classification such as GDPR and export compliance. Qualifications A Master's degree from an accredited educational institution in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, or a related field) or equivalent working experience as a Functional/Technical Architect or Senior Developer on cutting-edge solutions. What We Offer At Airbus, we foster a culture that encourages flexibility, collaboration, and continuous innovation. This is a unique opportunity to directly impact the future of aerospace, delivering significant value by creating groundbreaking digital services that resolve critical customer pain points within a highly dynamic and innovative environment. description_text:
Job Description: Senior Full Stack Data Engineer - Methods & Tools Team: Airbus India - Engineering Methods & Tools About the team: We are a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The team is composed of people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have. Some examples of the digital solutions are Data driven designs of wiring, Automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based products aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. title: ALT 2026 - Apprenti(e) Ingénieur IA et Facteurs Humains (ALL GENDER)
description_text:
Job Description: Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être l’apprentissage qu’il vous faut ! Vous rejoindrez une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Une offre d’apprentissage intitulée « Apprenti(e) Ingénieur IA et Facteurs Humains (ALL GENDER)» vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Helicopters sur son site de Marignane. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 10 personnes au sein du département «Documentation Technique » service en charge de l'expertise, l'innovation et des Facteurs Humains. Cet apprentissage consistera à soutenir l'accélération d'un projet d'IA Générative vers son industrialisation en garantissant l'interaction Homme-IA, et supporter les tests de cartes de travail sur hélicoptères. Cet apprentissage débutera à la rentrée scolaire 2026 pour une durée de 2 ou 3 an (s). Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Tâches et responsabilités: Encadré(e) par votre tuteur(trice), vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur les activités suivantes : Déploiement de la solution IA : Participer à l'extension horizontale et verticale de l'application (nouveaux manuels au-delà du manuel de maintenance, sur plusieurs hélicoptères, et ajouts de scopes supplémentaires). Facteurs Humains & Interaction Homme-IA : Identifier les risques et faire le lien entre les activités de données techniques et les besoins réels des utilisateurs pour assurer une interaction fluide et efficace avec l'IA. Support Tests : Réaliser des tests de cartes de travail directement sur hélicoptères pour optimiser la sécurité et la qualité de la documentation, dans une logique d'efficacité et de réduction des coûts. Compétences & Prérequis : Vous allez intégrer une formation de niveau BAC +5 dans le domaine de l'Ingénierie, Développement IA, Architecture Logicielle avec une sensibilité aux Facteurs Humains et une conception centrée utilisateur pour un apprentissage d’une durée de 2 à 3 ans. Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes : Compétences techniques : Solides connaissances en développement logiciel, architecture et IA. Compréhension des processus de documentation technique. Facteurs Humains / UX : Capacité à analyser les interactions Homme-Machine et à adapter les outils aux besoins opérationnels. Savoir-être : Esprit d'innovation, autonomie, capacité d'analyse et bon relationnel. Compétences linguistiques : Anglais : courant Français : courant Vous pourrez, selon les offres proposées, être amené(e) à vous déplacer. Notre processus de sélection: L’étude des candidatures est réalisée par un recruteur. Si votre candidature est validée par le recruteur, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo différé. Cet entretien vidéo sera visionné par le recruteur. Si votre candidature est présélectionnée à l’issue de cette étape, elle sera transmise au/à la manager du poste. Le/la manager (et/ou tuteur(trice)) organisera des entretiens avec les candidat(e)s présélectionné(e) avant de choisir le/la candidat(e) final(e) retenu(e) sur le poste. Avantages liés à l’entreprise: Notre engagement en faveur du bien-être de nos employés s'étend à la fois à leur vie professionnelle et à leur vie personnelle. Qu'il s'agisse de rémunérations compétitives ou de régimes de soins de santé complets, nous offrons à nos employé(e)s des avantages et des privilèges en fonction de nos implantations dans le monde - certains sont spécifiques à chaque pays. En outre, nous offrons diverses possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnels, afin de garantir l'évolution constante de vos compétences et de votre expertise. Pour en savoir plus, nous vous invitons à consulter notre site : https://www.airbus.com/en/careers/life-at-airbus/reward-and-benefits Information complémentaire: Dans l'éventualité où notre offre d'alternance retiendrait votre intérêt, veuillez préparer les informations suivantes, qui vous seront demandées au moment de votre candidature : 1. description_text:
Job Description: Chez Airbus Atlantic, on façonne l’aéronautique de demain ! Nous vous proposons de rejoindre Airbus Atlantic, leader industriel mondial en matière d'aérostructures, de sièges pilotes et de fauteuils passagers de classe affaires et de première classe. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable. Notre site Airbus Atlantic basé à Saint Nazaire (44) recherche son futur Responsable d'Equipe Autonome de Production (All Gender). Au sein d'une Unité Autonome de Production vous managerez une équipe de production en 2*8. Vous intégrez une équipe de manager de production dynamique et motivée. Le responsable d'équipe autonome de production est responsable de la sécurité et de l'environnement ainsi que des performances d'amélioration continue dans son entité, en tant que premier élément de la chaîne hiérarchique. 🎯 Votre mission Assurer la sécurité de ses équipes ; Faire appliquer les consignes en vigueur en matière d'hygiène, de sécurité et d'environnement ainsi que les dispositions du règlement intérieur ; Assurer la qualité des pièces produites ; Assurer la qualification de ses équipes et organiser l'activité en cohérence avec les compétences ; Encadrer et piloter les activités de production pour respecter les engagements de qualité, délai et coûts ; Piloter la performance économique du secteur en respectant l'adéquation charge/effectif et planning au niveau qualitatif et quantitatif ; Coacher les routines de l'équipe autonome de production (SQA) ; Assurer une communication ascendante et descendante sur son périmètre ; Animer et promouvoir la dynamique d'amélioration continue dans son EAP ; Fédérer les équipes support autour des objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et de satisfaction des clients internes et externes ; Participer au bon climat social et alerter sur le sujet quand c'est nécessaire ; Assurer le développement individuel de ses collaborateurs. 🛠️ Votre profil (Ce qui fera la différence) Vous justifiez d'une expérience en management de production dans un contexte industriel de minimum 2 ans. Vous êtes autonome, engagé et pragmatique avec un leadership affirmé. Vous avez une expérience significative dans la production de pièces élémentaires aéronautique (Usinage, Ajustage, Formage). Vous avez une forte volonté d'améliorer la performance de votre Unité Autonome de Production. 💎 Notre entreprise Boostez votre carrière : Un accompagnement sur-mesure et mobilité interne boostée. Équilibre vie pro/vie perso : Bénéficiez de 6 semaines de congés payés, de RTT et de la possibilité de télétravailler (selon l'éligibilité du poste). Package attractif : Plan d’épargne salariale, actionnariat salarié et une mutuelle individuelle ou familiale. Engagement au quotidien : incitation financière à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage, transports) et opportunité de participer à des projets caritatifs et sociaux stimulants. Qualité de vie : Restaurant d’entreprise et un CSE dynamique (loisirs, culture, vacances). Culture inclusive : La diversité fait partie de notre ADN. ✈️ Le site de Saint-Nazaire Le site de Saint-Nazaire, centre d’excellence des pièces élémentaires complexes est spécialisé, entre autres, dans l’usinage de rails et de lisses, l’étirage et l’usinage mécanique de panneaux de fuselages 3D, la production des cadres structures, l’usinage 5 axes de pièces complexes de grandes dimensions, le cintrage et le soudage de tuyauteries et le traitement de surfaces / peinture. Grâce à son activité de livraison en cycles courts (Fil Rouge), le site de Saint-Nazaire est capable de répondre en urgence aux besoins de production de ses clients.

title: HAPS Structure and Mechanisms Engineer (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: As part of our HAPS team, you will perform the following activities: 1. Mechanism Design & Kinematics Design and optimize complex, lightweight moving mechanisms, including deployment systems (wings, solar arrays, antennas), actuation linkages, hinges, and latching systems.
Ensure mechanisms can operate reliably in the extreme thermal environments of the stratosphere (ranging from -70ºC to +50ºC) without seizing or binding.
Select and integrate aerospace-grade bearings, lubricants, gears, and electric actuators. 2. Hands-on Assembly & Integration (AIT) Lead the physical assembly and structural integration of the HAPS airframe, payloads, and mechanical subsystems.
Perform precision alignments, bonding, fastening, and torqueing of critical composite and metallic components.
Troubleshoot mechanical fitment, interference, and tolerance stack-up issues directly on the hardware during build cycles. 3. Structural & Functional Testing Define, set up, and execute rigorous physical test plans, including structural load tests, environmental (thermal-vacuum) testing, and mechanism deployment lifecycle testing.
Instrument test articles with strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, and displacement sensors.
Correlate physical test data back to analytical models to continuously improve future designs. 4. Structural Analysis & Materials Perform hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to validate the structural integrity of both static structures and moving mechanisms.
Utilize advanced CAD software to create detailed 3D models and manufacturing/assembly drawings. About you ​ We would love to hear who you are, talk about your experience, vision and how you think you could help us. In the meantime, it would be great if you had the following: 1. Required Qualifications & Skills Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field (industrial, robotics, etc.).
Experience: 3+ years of experience with a strong focus on mechanism design and hands-on mechanical assembly/testing within the aerospace, UAV, or robotics industries.
Hands-on Expertise: Proven experience in a lab or workshop environment doing mechanical integration, structural bonding, and using precision measurement tools.
Simulation Tools: Proficiency in CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, CATIA, NX) and FEA/Kinematic simulation software.
AIT Know-How: Experience setting up test rigs, integration processes, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and working with sensors (strain gauges, load cells).
Electronic Control Systems (Highly Appreciated - Bonus): Strong familiarity with or understanding of electronics, microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32), servo/stepper motor controls, and basic scripting (Python or C/C++) to program, actuate, and test mechanisms automatically. 2. Non-technical Skills Excellent communication skills: English, Spanish spoken and written at professional level. Catalan, French and German are a plus

Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and changing environment, handling multiple priorities
Proactive thinking, risk taker, fast learner, flexible
Emotional intelligence, empathic, ability to be in someone else's shoes
Open minded to diversity, inclusion and other cultures
Entrepreneurial spirit

Job Description: Responsable du domaine des solutions numériques d'entreprise ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi: Vous avez une expérience dans le numérique, vous avez travaillé sur des solutions d'entreprise et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Responsable du domaine des solutions numériques d'entreprise pour l'Amérique du Nord pour rejoindre notre équipe Numérique basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous serez chargé(e) de concevoir, mettre en œuvre et gérer des stratégies numériques qui soutiennent nos fonctions d'entreprise. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe de direction Numérique responsable de toutes les activités numériques pour la région Amérique du Nord, couvrant les États-Unis et le Canada, pour toutes les divisions d'Airbus. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant que Responsable du domaine des solutions numériques d'entreprise pour l'Amérique du Nord sera de diriger une équipe pour stimuler l'amélioration continue de nos outils et plateformes numériques, en veillant à ce qu'ils s'alignent sur les objectifs commerciaux et améliorent l'excellence opérationnelle. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à proximité de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous: Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel et application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Stratégie et planification (15 %) : Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie numérique complète pour les solutions d'entreprise qui soutient les objectifs de l'organisation et améliore l'efficacité opérationnelle. Collaborer avec la haute direction, l'informatique, les RH et d'autres départements pour aligner les initiatives numériques sur les stratégies organisationnelles plus larges. Transformation numérique des RH, installations, juridique et communication (20 %) Diriger la transformation numérique de ce périmètre fonctionnel. Mettre en œuvre des technologies et des plateformes pour les RH, les installations, le juridique et la communication qui rationalisent les flux de travail, améliorent l'expérience des employés, l'efficacité opérationnelle et l'harmonisation avec les processus d'Airbus. Fusions et acquisitions (F&A) et Extended Enterprise (15 %) Soutenir régionalement les activités de F&A, y compris la diligence raisonnable, la planification de l'intégration et l'intégration post-fusion. Tirer parti des solutions Airbus Extended Enterprise pour une utilisation régionale afin de rationaliser la collaboration avec les parties prenantes externes, de réduire les risques et d'accélérer la réalisation des synergies Analyse de données (10 %) Diriger la mise en œuvre régionale des plateformes centrales d'analyse de données pour stimuler la prise de décision basée sur les données dans toute l'organisation. Collaborer avec les équipes de science des données et d'analyse pour développer des modèles prédictifs, des tableaux de bord et des rapports qui fournissent des informations sur la performance et les tendances commerciales. Intelligence Artificielle (IA) (10 %) Identifier et mettre en œuvre régionalement des solutions d'IA centrales/de groupe qui automatisent les processus, améliorent la prise de décision et favorisent l'innovation. Collaborer avec des spécialistes de l'IA pour développer et déployer des modèles d'IA qui répondent à des défis et opportunités commerciaux spécifiques. Engagement des parties prenantes (10 %) Dialoguer avec les employés à tous les niveaux pour comprendre leurs besoins et leurs défis, en veillant à ce que les solutions numériques d'entreprise répondent à leurs exigences et améliorent leur expérience. Établir des relations solides avec les parties prenantes clés, tant internes qu'externes, pour stimuler l'adoption et le succès des initiatives numériques en milieu de travail. Relation Europe/Centrale - Assurer un alignement complet avec les parties prenantes centrales de chaque division pour maintenir les opérations quotidiennes, permettre l'évolution de l'infrastructure régionale et contribuer à la stratégie numérique locale. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs externes pour garantir la qualité des services et des produits. Gestion (15 %) Surveiller et optimiser les performances pour garantir une expérience utilisateur fluide et efficace. Superviser la planification, l'exécution et la livraison des principaux projets de solutions numériques d'entreprise, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient achevés dans les délais, dans le budget et aux normes de qualité requises. Élaborer et gérer le budget, en optimisant les coûts sans compromettre la qualité. Diriger une équipe de spécialistes du numérique, en favorisant une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'amélioration continue. Assurer le mentorat et l'orientation des membres de l'équipe, en soutenant leur développement professionnel et en assurant des niveaux de performance élevés. Votre profil: Expérience avérée dans un rôle similaire, avec un solide historique de direction de projets de transformation numérique; Compréhension approfondie des technologies et tendances modernes, y compris les technologies RH, les solutions financières, les outils EE (Extended Enterprise), l'analyse de données et l'IA; Excellentes compétences en leadership et en gestion, avec la capacité d'inspirer et de motiver une équipe; Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec une approche décisionnelle basée sur les données; Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'établir des relations efficaces à tous les niveaux; Minimum de 15 ans et plus dans des rôles numériques tels que l'architecture de solutions et d'infrastructure, la gestion de projet, l'analyse commerciale, la conception de systèmes, le développement de logiciels; Expérience en gestion du changement où vous avez dû mettre en œuvre de nouvelles pratiques au sein d'une organisation. Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels (dans le monde entier). Déplacements requis : Ce poste implique de fréquents déplacements professionnels et, à ce titre, vous devez être en mesure de voyager en conséquence. Possibilité d'astreinte pendant les week-ends et/ou les périodes de vacances. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* Head of Corporate Digital Solutions Domain Do you have Digital experience, have you worked in Corporate solutions and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for a Head of North America Corporate Digital Solutions Domain to join our Digital team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing digital strategies that support our corporate functions. You will be part of the Digital leadership responsible for all Digital activities for the North America region, across US and Canada, for all Airbus Divisions. The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as Head of North America Corporate Digital Solutions Domain will be to lead a team to drive continuous improvement in our digital tools and platforms, ensuring they align with business objectives and enhance operational excellence. Collaborate with senior leadership, IT, HR, and other departments to align digital initiatives with broader organizational strategies. Leverage Airbus Extended Enterprise solutions for regional usage to streamline external stakeholders collaboration, reduce risks, and accelerate the realization of synergies. Data Analytics (10%): Lead the regional implementation of central data analytics platforms to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization. Collaborate with data science and analytics teams to develop predictive models, dashboards, and reports that provide insights into business performance and trends. Artificial Intelligence (AI) (10%): Identify and implement regionally AI central/group solutions that automate processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation. Collaborate with AI specialists to develop and deploy AI models that address specific business challenges and opportunities. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, both internally and externally, to drive the adoption and success of digital workplace initiatives Europe/Central relationship - Ensure full alignment with central stakeholders of each divisions to sustain daily operation, enable evolution of the regional infrastructure and contribute to local digital strategy Manage relationships with external vendors to ensure quality of service and products.
