description_text:
Job Description: Join us to be part of the new Airbus UpNext strategic demonstrator paving the future of Aircraft Connectivity. This demonstrator will accelerate the development of new technologies to bring tangible learnings to the business. Designed as a talent incubator, Airbus UpNext is a place where you can act and think like a startup while building on the strong expertise of Airbus, a place where you are empowered to challenge and test new processes and ways of working. The Transverse Software Lead position is within Airbus UpNext and it consists of a limited contract linked to the delivery of the demonstrator (estimated completion date February- 2028), starting ASAP. Mission: As the Transverse Software Lead, you will be a hands-on technical team member, responsible for bridging the gap between physical hardware on a plane and scalable, cost-effective infrastructure in AWS . Your main tasks and responsibilities will include: Full-Stack Apps: Quickly build backend APIs and frontend tools to process and view data. Smart Data Handling: Manage a heavy, constant flow of live data (telemetry) from sensors and aircraft equipment. Offline-First Logic: Design systems that store data locally when the internet drops out and sync it automatically when reconnected. Advanced AWS: Design and manage complex, multi-account AWS setups while keeping cloud costs low (FinOps). Secure Networking: Connect on-board plane systems to the cloud using secure networks (VPNs, firewalls, and routing). DevOps & Containers: Package apps using Docker/Kubernetes and automate deployments using IaC and CI/CD. Hardware Integration: Connect software directly to aircraft hardware, sensors, and wireless access points (WAPs). Modern Tools: Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) to write, document, and clean up code faster. Monitoring: Set up tracking tools to monitor system performance across both local hardware and the cloud. Your boarding pass What you bring: Expertise in SW and Application development, End-to-End SW system architecture, Ground-to-Air communications, and Cybersecurity. Experience in Systems integration, IoT protocols and server management. Curiosity and agility with new development tools Ability to troubleshoot complex data drops across multiple hops. Systems-thinking approach; ability to troubleshoot complex data drops across multiple hops. Ability to troubleshoot complex architectures and find innovative solutions What you get: Pivotal Role in a Strategic Mission: play a key part in a project and participate in the Aviation Connectivity revolution. Build Something that Last: Your work will create a high-value asset and learning contribution for Airbus’s future. Develop Critical Competences: Acquire and develop a sound background in connectivity technologies, a field essential for the future of aerospace. This experience can provide a unique career development opportunity within Airbus. Agile and Empowering Environment: Thrive in a work culture that empowers you to act and think like a start-up while being supported by the strong expertise of Airbus. We value an eagerness to take initiative and propose efficient ways of working. A Great Team and Culture: Be part of a high-achieving, experienced and fun team in a shared open-space office with highly skilled colleagues. We are guided by the “Care for Each Other” value. And yes, we have complimentary freshly ground coffe ☕ and beverages 🧃 About us Founded in 2017, Airbus UpNext focuses on flying future technologies at speeds well beyond what seems feasible today. In doing so, it is actively shaping the future of the aerospace industry. Designed as a talent incubator, Airbus UpNext is a place where you can act and think like a startup while building on the strong expertise of Airbus, a place where you are empowered to test & challenge new processes and ways of working. Airbus UpNext’s demonstrators evaluate, mature and validate potential new products and services that encompass radical technological breakthroughs. It has three flagships locations in France, Germany and Spain, to rapidly develop and test future technologies in scaled applications. Our mission is: To identify the trends that could disrupt the future of the aerospace industry and evaluate them to demonstrate their potential as a viable product. To accelerate traditional research cycles and prototype development to achieve proof of concept in a real environment and at a convincing scale and speed. To develop real-world applications for emerging aerospace technologies, thereby driving their maturity and increasing their value. description_text:
Job Description: Chef de quart Centre de réponse à la Clientèle - Duty Manager Customer Response Center ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Avez-vous des connaissances techniques sur les systèmes et la structure des aéronefs, avez-vous travaillé dans des environnements de soutien à la clientèle et souhaitez progresser et développer de nouvelles compétences ? Alors cet emploi est fait pour vous ! Le Programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est à la recherche d'un Chef de quart pour rejoindre notre équipe du Centre de Réponse Client (CRC) basé à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les autres départements d'Airbus pour soutenir les clients A220 du monde entier. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe du Centre de Réponse Client responsable de fournir/coordonner le soutien requis pour permettre l'exploitation efficace de la flotte A220 dans le monde entier. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie pour promouvoir l'autonomie, la collaboration transversale, le soutien mutuel et l'apprentissage collectif. Votre rôle en tant que Chef de quart sera d'être responsable de la coordination des activités de remise en service entre les différentes équipes au sein d'Airbus pour les aéronefs en condition AOG et/ou après des événements anormaux, d'établir des données de gouvernance et d'assurer la visibilité au sein de l'organisation; d'identifier les opportunités de créer de l'efficacité et d'assurer la qualité. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Établir les plans d'action, pour rencontrer la priorité agréée par le client, du Centre de réponse à la clientèle (CRC) pour améliorer le temps du retour en service d’un avion au sol (AOG); Déterminer les spécialistes requis en utilisant toutes les ressources nécessaires au sein d’Airbus, des fournisseurs et/ou des partenaires, pour assurer la résolution rapide et la remise en service de l'avion du client; Assurer une visibilité au client (au besoin) et à la gestion à l’aide de base de données, tout au long de la résolution des cas; Développer et implanter des plans d’action, en collaboration avec les spécialistes, afin d’assurer le retour en service de l’avion. Job Description: An opportunity for a Commodity Manager has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Strategic Sourcing Team. The department is in charge of orchestrating and executing end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives for assigned product categories or service groups. How we care for you: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Perform advanced troubleshooting to diagnose malfunctioning systems and components to determine corrective action required to assure safety and airworthiness of aircraft. Conduct applicable airframe calendar/hourly inspections, hidden damage inspections of airframe structures and sub-assemblies. Conduct operational and functional checks of structures, systems, and/or components as required verifying acceptability/airworthiness. Responsible for ensuring physical security of aircraft, partner with fixed base operator (FBO) if needed. Participate in flight tests on aircraft. Perform track and balancing of rotor systems and vibration analysis. Strictly observe foreign object damage/debris (FOD), tool control and calibrated tool policies. Accept field assignments on request Accomplish in-process and final inspections for maintenance, repair, modification, and rework of aircraft components and sub-assemblies. Tasks will include "Clearance-to-close" inspections, torque check verifications, dimensional checks, flight control system installation verifications and flight control rigging checks of Airframe, Engine(s), hydraulic, pneumatic, and fuel systems for integrity and compliance with manufacturer’s and FAA requirements and regulations Perform thorough receiving inspection of aircraft, determining overall airworthiness of aircraft through physical examination of aircraft and associated records. Proficient in inspections to determine airworthiness impacts of any found discrepancies. Lead Technician Responsibilities: 20% Conduct daily “huddle” meetings Assign maintenance tasks to the technicians Identify / elevate work performance issues / safety concerns On-Site Customer Support: 10% Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, including highest level complex issues, identified by Airbus customers. Perform on-site customer support and the tasks contracted by the customer. Documentation/Compliance: 10% Update applicable maintenance tracking program daily. Monitor and forecast for upcoming maintenance and assure timely compliance with inspections. Ensure compliance with production and repair station policies / procedures / forms and FAA Regulations. Research, compile and document all applicable maintenance for airframe, engine, accessories and components in accordance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approved regulations and company procedures. Ensure compliance with all applicable calendar/hourly inspections, life limited or cycle limited components, airworthiness directives and alert service bulletins. Document and return airframe, engine, accessories or components to service after maintenance, repair or modification. Review all 337s associated with the aircraft. Tracks and coordinates forecasted removals, repairs and material requirements for all TBO (Time between Overhaul) and SLL (Service Life Limit) assets. Compose and prepare all necessary Aircraft maintenance documentation in relation to qualifying the airworthiness or return to service of aircraft, engines, parts, components and systems. Perform aircraft mass and balance record calculations in accordance with AC 43.13-1B, chapter 10 in conjunction with applicable Aircraft Maintenance Manuals. Ability to obtain a DoD CAC (Common Access Card). Physical Requirements: Onsite or remote: Varies; this position does not report on-site to an Airbus location. This position reports on-site to customer locations or work remote. From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way. If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR! Our leadership profile: People Centric Entrepreneurial Inspiring Exemplary Innovative Humble At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages! We are looking for a Supplier Account Manager Referent to come onboard in our Head of Material Supply Management in Nadia SULIGNANO’s team : a team of twelve collaborators! The Supplier Account Manager, is in charge of the overall performance and compliance of suppliers to ensure On Time and On Quality deliveries to our stock & customers. Your Mission As a Supplier Account Manager Supply Operations:
Ensure global supplier performance on quality, on time to meet ATR requirements,
In charge of the Purchase Orders creation, acknowledgment, estimated delivery dates, delay and priority for a dedicated portfolio of Suppliers,
Be the focal point and preferred contact with the Supplier to ensure and manage the daily workflow,
Performance Follow-up:
Manage & follow the Supplier performance with specific KPIs :
OTD, OQD, OTIF (On Time in Full), DOD (Depth of Delay), Discrepancies, Sales orders backlog VS Suppliers backlog.
Manage the dedicated SAP & Excel reports for the Supplier follow-up,
Manage the relations between Supplier & ATR internal Services for Spares orders,
To submit timely reports and prepare presentations/proposals as assigned,
To set-up operational review meetings with Suppliers in order to monitor performances and address open issues,
Performing regular industrial assessment at the Supplier facilities - Gemba walk,
To support Procurement teams to settle Procurement disputes.
Crisis Management:
Be the focal point to manage the Supply Chain crisis for a dedicated portfolio of Suppliers,
Provisioning follow-up through ‘Line of Balance’, Shortages Management & dedicated weekly ‘Crisis’ meetings,
Catch information & updates from the Suppliers and share them with our internal Customers: Front Offices, Vendors, Procurement… + update the ERP
Participate as Supply Chain representative to the dedicated internal “Task Forces” associated to the portfolio of Suppliers.
Continuous improvement:
Lead transversal projects (Supply and related to IT Dpt.),
Develop and analyze performance reporting in order to improve the Inventory Supply Activities As a Referent: Management Support & Activity Monitoring
Act as a manager relay to daily monitoring business activities, operational priorities awareness,
Drive operational KPIs and identify risks by anticipating major crisis and co-build mitigation actions,
Foster communication by being the team speaker to represent/coordinate the team on across stakeholders.
Process & Operational Focal Point

Ensure compliance with Supply Chain processes and operational standards,
Provide operational guidance and day-to-day support to team members,

Drive transversal projects in collaboration with Supply Chain, Procurement, and IT departments,

title: Quality Logistics and Transport
description_text:
Job Description: Description of the job Airbus Defence and Space Quality Logistics and Transport (part of Procurement Quality), to secure the implementation and application of Quality standards to Transport & Logistics in the different programmes/projects for all Air Power programmes. Our main quality responsibility focuses on protecting product integrity from supplier dispatch to final receipt, ensuring compliance with aerospace regulations (including material certification for PART21 and PART145 on behalf of civil and military authorities), and preventing any logistics/ transport related non-conformities that could impact safety or certification. Our Team You will be part of the Quality Logistics and Transport team in one of the selected sites (Getafe/ San Pablo Sur), which has a wide variety of quality projects. This dynamic and collaborative team works closely with internal business units, local teams and external stakeholders. As a Quality Assurance warehouse and certifying staff member you will be involved in the material certification processes quality inspections and new initiatives in the area of Quality Logistics and Transport to improve the material management for all our customers in Manufacturing. Your tasks Within the scope of this position, you will be in charge of: - Contribute to the integrity of the Quality Management System in front of Official Civil and military regulations/requirements (Part 21, Part 145, Peram 145, EMAR FR, EMAR NLD, EN9100, PECAL/AQAP). - Ensure compliance with applicable normative/regulation. - Certifying material with airworthiness certificates in accordance with EASA Part21, EASA Part 145, Peram 21, Peram 145, Emar FR 21/145, Emar NLD 21/145, CAA Part 21, CAA Part 145 or any other authorization given and approved by any authority. The activity includes: Checking the airworthiness directives for any material certification. Checking and validating any material against Civil and Military regulations approvals. Checking any Component Maintenance Manuals for Part145 certification. Creating discrepancies in different Airbus systems and supporting its resolution. Issuing the proper documentation in accordance with customer requirements. Checking and validating of all delivered Civil and Military airworthiness certificates information. Additional Part21 checks if needed. - Supporting and being involved in quality audits (internal and external) - Cross-functional Collaboration: work closely with engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality assurance teams to ensure full alignment with airworthiness and production requirements. - Surveillance of aeronautical material reception flow (including: partners/third parties, material coming from customer, planned and urgent deliveries to plants, direct shipment, DEUs, PTUs and repairs) and manufacturing CoC emission activity in the Logistics Service Provider (providing Q performance visibility gathering and updating the adequate KPIs). - Optimize current Inspection activities. - Deployment of Improvement projects to increase process performance and product adherence to standards to deliver Customer satisfaction in compliance with our regulatory requirements. -Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to logistics and transport quality, identifying areas for continuous improvement and implementing appropriate actions. - Non-Conformance & Incident Management: launching the adequate corrective and preventive actions to eradicate deviations (non conformities and/or customer complaints). Root cause analysis investigation (PPS, 5Why's/ RCA) and corrective action plans management. Our requirements - Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering or equivalent. - At least 5 years of experience in activities that have allowed you to acquire the knowledge and foundations in: quality, logistics, production, engineering, manufacturing. - Strong experience and understanding of airworthiness - Knowledge of Lean and Process improvement methods. - Experience with quality tools (8D, PPS/ RCA). - English (negotiation level is mandatory). An advanced level of French would be a plus. -Strong attention to detail with a zero-defect mindset. Risk-based thinking and preventive approach. - High level of accountability and compliance awareness. - Availability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required and in different shifts as per company needs. Key competences - Ability to anticipate, assess and mitigate risks. - Strong communication skills including active listening and empathy. - Strong negotiation skills and the ability to persuade, influence and convince others. - Excellent skills in relationship building, team building, empowering, motivating others and conflict management. - Knowledge of Civil and Military approvals, Quality IT tools and EASA/CAA/FAA and military regulations would be a plus. Job Description: ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous avez une expérience dans l'aéronautique ou toutes autres industries, vous avez travaillé dans le domaine des achats et/ou approvisionnement et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche d’un(e) acheteur(teuse) équipement & systèmes (h/f) pour rejoindre notre équipe achat / approvisionnement basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec l'équipe achat d'Airbus basée à Toulouse/Hambourg. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe achat équipement et système chargée de / qui développe la stratégie d'approvisionnement, contractualisation et gestion de la performance fournisseur. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant qu' acheteur(teuse) équipement & systèmes (h/f) sera de gérer le portefeuille achat et le processus d’approvisionnement, coordonner et animer l’équipe multifonctionnelles (sub MFT), administrer le(s) contrat(s), développer et mettre à exécution les stratégies afin de soutenir les objectifs de réduction des coûts de votre périmètre. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette gratuite entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Gérer le portefeuille achat et le processus d’approvisionnement pour différents systèmes incluant les besoins de simulateurs de vols au sein de l’organisation achat Équipement & Systèmes. Mener la définition et mettre en oeuvre les stratégies de produits Coordonner et aligner les parties prenantes multifonctionnelles (sub MFT) pour votre périmètre d’achats (ingénierie, programme, finances, chaîne d'approvisionnement, etc.) et contribuer aux activités de l’équipe multifonctionnelle (MFT) qui englobe l’ensemble des systèmes sur votre périmètre. Administrer le(s) contrat(s) incluant: Suivi de la mise en place des contrats avec les fournisseurs et les parties prenantes internes. Assurer , tout au long du cycle de vie du contrat, l’ application des conditions contractuelles afin de garantir la performance des fournisseurs dans toutes les dimensions (logistique, support, qualité, coût...). Mettre en place le suivi nécessaire des impacts associés et la gestion du fournisseur, au besoin. Mettre à jour les contrats applicables tout au long du cycle de vie des équipements & systèmes, y compris la négociation des demandes de changement. Développer et mettre à exécution les stratégies afin de soutenir les objectifs de réduction des coûts de votre périmètre Dans ce rôle, vous rapporterez fonctionnellement au responsable de la commodité basé à Toulouse (France) et hiérarchiquement au responsable Achats des équipements et systèmes de l’A220 basé à Mirabel (Canada). Votre profil: Une expérience en matière d'achat est essentielle, bien que les candidatures de candidats ayant une bonne expérience commerciale, technique et une connaissance du processus d'approvisionnement sont également les bienvenues. Expérience de travail dans un environnement multifonctionnel. Expérience dans la relation et la gestion des clients internes. Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation. Des connaissances commerciales/contrats/financières sont demandées. Niveau de négociation en anglais, d'autres langues seraient un atout. ***déplacements*** Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels occasionnels à l’étranger (US & Europe). Déplacements requis : <5% de déplacements internationaux. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* Job description : Do you have experience in aeronautics or any other industry, have you worked in Procurement and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for Equipment & Systems buyer (f/m) to join our Procurement team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will work jointly with the Airbus Procurement team based in Toulouse (France) and in Hamburg (Germany). You will be part of the Equipment & systems Procurement team responsible for / developing Sourcing strategy, contracting and supplier performance. The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as Equipment & Systems buyer will be to manage the procurement portfolio, Coordinate & align the multi-functional team, manage the contract(s) and develop & execute strategies to support your scope’s cost reduction objectives. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy. Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, free shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. Your challenges: Manage the procurement portfolio and processes for your perimeter including flight simulators for the A220 within the Equipment & Systems procurement organization. Drive the definition and implementation of product and sourcing strategies Coordinate & align the multi-functional stakeholders (engineering, program, finance, supply chain, etc.) and contribute to the multi-functional team (MFT) which includes your scope. Manage the contract(s) including: Monitor the contract implementation with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Ensure the application of contractual conditions throughout the contract life cycle in order to guarantee the suppliers’ performance in all dimensions (logistics, support, quality, cost ...). Secure the associated consequential follow-up and management with the supplier, if needed. Contractual updates throughout the life cycle of equipment & systems, including the negotiation of change requests / modifications (MOD/PCR) Develop & execute strategies to support your scope’s cost reduction objectives In this role you will report functionally to the Commodity Leader (SCL), based in Toulouse (France), and hierarchically to the A220 equipment and systems procurement manager, based in Mirabel. Your boarding pass: Procurement experience is essential, although applications from applicants with good business and/ or technical experience and knowledge of the Procurement process are also welcomed. Experience in working in a multi-functional environment. Experience in stakeholder management and influencing internal customers. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Commercial / Contract / Finance knowledge is required. Negotiation level in English, other languages would be an asset. ***travel*** This role may involve some occasional travels for business within US & Europe, consequently you must be willing to travel accordingly. Travel Required: <5% International. title: Multifunction Maintenance Manager
description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for a Facilities & Technical Maintenance Engineer has arisen within Airbus Operations, Getafe. The selected candidate will join the TFS organization of Facility Management & Real Estate Spain. In this role, you will lead operational activities focused mainly (but not limited to) Cluster 2, managing mechanical maintenance activities such as HVAC, compressed air, and cranes across divisions. You will work in a multicultural, dynamic environment, closely collaborating with internal partners and managing key external suppliers to guarantee a safe work environment, business continuity, and energy efficiency across Airbus sites. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Manage and maintain facilities, infrastructure, and technical equipment to guarantee a safe environment and secure business continuity. Lead and monitor maintenance suppliers and lump-sum contracts, ensuring delivery on time, quality, and cost according to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and KPIs. Write technical specifications and actively participate in Call For Tender (CFT) processes, acting as the main point of contact (IOS) for supplier employees. Control and optimize the annual OpEx and CapEx budget assigned to the maintenance scope. Drive continuous improvement and process harmonization across Spanish sites, making massive use of the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS). Support the Energy department by contributing to the ISO 50001 Certification, controlling water and energy billing, and promoting energy efficiency and metering projects. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: University degree in Engineering or a related discipline. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in Maintenance, Energy Management, or Sustainability. Technical knowledge: Mastery of digital tools for Maintenance and Energy, specifically CMMS (Maximo tool). Soft skills: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, analytical mindset, proactive attitude, strong focus on customer satisfaction, and an innovative approach. Languages: Fluency in both English and Spanish is required. Valuable / Nice to have: A multi-purpose profile capable of supporting other FMRE functions when required, and willingness to travel occasionally to other Airbus sites. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. description_text:
Job Description: Company description: Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defense, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defense and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide. Our people work with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. Taking pride in our work, we draw on each other's expertise and experience to achieve excellence. Our diversity and teamwork culture propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. Founded in 2021, the Airbus Global Business Services (AGBS) unit will be contributing to Airbus’ global success and play a vital role in Airbus’ transformation journey in standardization, harmonization, digitalisation and automation of end-to-end processes (e.g.Procure to Pay) of all overhead functions. Our target is that siloed ways of working / processes will be a relic of the past within the AGBS. To drive such culture change we are looking for candidates with pioneering spirit that make data-driven decisions and take responsibility for the best outcome of their internal customers. All while embracing a spirit of problem-solving and living the Airbus values: Customer focus, integrity, respect, creativity, reliability and teamwork. Our purpose defines why we exist: ‘We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world’. Responsibilities - your mission Make a step change in your career with AIRBUS: we are looking for a motivated individual in our team to perform the role of Project Management Business Partner (PMBP) to participate in creating the Airbus future. We support key projects across the company and spread PM (Project/Programme management) culture across Airbus. In our daily business we are at the crossroads between management and operations. BCSD provides PM support and expertise to the BCSD A320 Family Development PM Office projects, in order to “perform the modifications required and guarantee their correct start of production, prepare ramp-up to full rate, in order to ensure that our products remain competitive and profitable in a very changing market environment” The main tasks and responsibilities will include: Working with the project leader & project organization on a day to day basis Raising the understanding and acceptance of PM within the project/portfolio population by coaching and/or awareness sessions; challenging project leaders where needed Applying methods and tools in accordance to PM standards to the needs of the project Supporting efficient communication and stakeholder management Integration and analysis of time, cost, resources and quality data. Risk and opportunity anticipation incl. follow-up of robust mitigation plans. Project milestone reviews preparation and follow-up. Regular projects status reporting by providing adequate indicators and analysis (KPI, Dashboard, recommendations, etc.) supporting the overall decision-making process. Deployment and use of digitalisation tools (Skywise environment) in line with BC standards and strategy to ensure an efficient monitoring & controlling process. Projects interconnection management, to secure right alignments between (among others) the aircraft development organization and the operations organization. This role may involve occasional travel for business and as such you must be able to travel Requirements - our ideal candidate will have You have the following skills and experience: Strong facilitation skills for coaching, motivating & enabling the team; Ability to listen, understand and respond in a constructive manner; Ability to negotiate, influence and to manage conflicts; Willingness and ability to handle changes on a day-to-day basis; Challenge mind-set, ability to speak up; and, interested in deploying new ways of working, Optional: Knowledge and experience in agile project management methodologies (Scrum, SAFe ...) Experience in stakeholder management, ability to engage skills of different functions of Negotiation level of English; French and/or German a plus Benefits - what’s in it for you Diverse career opportunities within Airbus European core countries or in other regions around the world. A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work. A modern office at Parque das Nações, well connected to public transportation. A motivated and fun crew to grow and build and shape the GBS together. An intense and exciting onboarding experience. description_text:
Job Description: Um die Abteilung “Sales & Program Delivery Germany” zu unterstützen, sucht die Airbus Secure Land Communications GmbH einen Head of Sales Germany (m/w/d) am Standort Berlin oder Ulm. Für diese Stelle ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. muss eine solche von den anerkannten Behörden erteilt werden. Hier genießen Sie die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt und werden Teil einer Stadt, die gleichzeitig ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt und die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet.
Unsere Hauptstadt Berlin gilt als Weltstadt der Politik, Medien und Wissenschaften und bietet daher wunderschöne Sehenswürdigkeiten, eine reiche Kultur, urbanes Flair und kulinarische Genüsse. Neben dem „Big City Life“ kommen auch Naturliebhaber auf ihre Kosten: Berlin besitzt neben ausgedehnten Waldgebieten im Westen und Südosten des Stadtgebietes viele große Parkanlagen. Benefits: Attraktive Vergütung einschließlich Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und Gewinnbeteiligung
30 Tage Urlaub, zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
Mobiles Arbeiten möglich
Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Sonderleistungen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Autoleasing, Zuschuss zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Rabatte bei örtlichen Unternehmen, Kinderbetreuung (über unseren Kooperationspartner)
Vor-Ort-Leistungen: Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und andere gesundheitsbezogene Leistungen, Kantine oder Essenszuschuss Als Head of Sales Germany (m/w/d) sind Sie eine zentrale Schlüsselfigur für unseren Erfolg. Sie verantworten nicht nur die gesamte Vertriebsstrategie für den deutschen Markt, sondern führen auch ein hochqualifiziertes Team zu neuen Erfolgen. An der Schnittstelle zwischen strategischer Planung, operativer Umsetzung und kontinuierlicher Prozessoptimierung gestalten Sie die Zukunft der ASLC GmbH aktiv mit. Ihr Ziel ist es, Marktanteile zu sichern und durch innovative Lösungsansätze sowie starke Allianzen das nachhaltige Wachstum unseres Geschäftsbereichs voranzutreiben. Ihre Mission: Strategie & Marktentwicklung: Sie entwickeln und implementieren die zukünftige Vertriebsstrategie in unserem komplexen deutschen Marktumfeld. Dabei unterstützen Sie die deutsche Geschäftsentwicklungsstrategie sowie die Produktpositionierung, um unsere Marktpräsenz im Segment "Public Safety & Security" (PSS) zu maximieren.
Umfassende Vertriebssteuerung: Sie tragen die Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales-Zyklus und die Erreichung des geplanten Auftragseingangs. Dies umfasst die operative Planung, die intensive Akquise sowie die Steuerung komplexer Angebotsphasen (inkl. Go/No-Go-Entscheidungen, Analyse von Einkaufszentren und Erstellung technischer, kommerzieller sowie Finanzierungsangebote) bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Beziehungsmanagement & Allianzen: Sie bauen und pflegen vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden auf – sowohl im B2C- als auch im B2B-Bereich (Systemintegratoren, Distributoren, Value-Added-Reseller). Zudem initiieren und entwickeln Sie strategische Allianzen mit Industriepartnern.

Durch einen regelmäßigen Austausch stellen Sie sicher, dass Vertriebsziele rechtzeitig in Folgeprozesse einfließen, und unterstützen zudem unsere Marketing- und Kommunikationsabteilung. Was Sie mitbringen: Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen oder technischen Fachbereich (z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar).
Expertise: Mehrjährige einschlägige Vertriebserfahrung im Bereich Telekommunikation und im öffentlichen Sektor; fundierte Kenntnisse im Verteidigungsbereich sind ein wertvoller Vorteil.
Erfahrung: Nachweisbare Erfolge im Vertrieb innerhalb eines komplexen, internationalen Umfelds sowie umfassende Führungserfahrung.
Kompetenzprofil: Exzellente kaufmännische und technische Kenntnisse gepaart mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Beziehungen auf allen Organisationsebenen erfolgreich aufzubauen.
Mindset: Unternehmerisches Denken, eine hohe Zielorientierung und die Fähigkeit, als inspirierender Vordenker (auch im Sinne von Marktentwicklungen) und Teamplayer zu agieren.
Sprachen & Mobilität: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch; Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Reisebereitschaft ist für Sie selbstverständlich. Bonnes connaissances des protocoles réseau et plus globalement en ingénierie réseau

title: Coordonnateur Qualité–Demandes d’enquête en service/Quality Coordinator–In-Service Investigation
description_text:
Job Description: English job description follows Description de l'emploi : Vous avez une expérience concernant les enquêtes qualité, vous avez travaillé en Qualité et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un coordonnateur qualité pour les demandes d’enquête en service pour rejoindre notre équipe Qualité basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous coordonnerez les activités globales concernant les demandes d'enquête qualité des opérateurs en fournissant une vue E2E (de bout en bout) sur les problèmes ayant une origine dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les activités de fabrication de l'A220, ainsi qu'analyserez les tendances et fournirez des recommandations pour l'amélioration de la qualité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Qualité en service. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre environnement de travail : Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé : Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10 000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis : Suivre les sujets de non-qualité E2E (« end to end ») de l'organisation du service client jusqu'à l'organisation des achats,usines et FAL (Lignes finales d’assemblage); Être responsable du lancement d'actions correctives pour les « escapes » de non-conformité en service (structure A/C, systèmes (y compris électrique et nacelles) et cabine); Renforcer le lien avec les organisations Achats, Qualité, Customer Services et participer aux réunions hebdomadaires avec les représentants (Achats, Customer Service Production/Programme/Engineering) pour effectuer des mises à jour des actions et partager des informations; Fournir régulièrement un tableau de bord de performance avec tous les KPI pertinents pour le suivi des actions et le respect des processus; Participer à une réunion technique visant à identifier la cause première, faire le lien entre les informations et les actions correctives existantes et contribuer à la boucle de rétroaction; Gérer les risques, la protection du client et la communication. Faire le compromis entre les contraintes de livraison / le risque de qualité / l'évaluation de l'ingénierie / les contraintes de service client; Communiquer régulièrement l'état des sujets au fabricant, à l'ingénierie, aux équipes de livraison et au service client pour soutenir la communication avec les clients; Minimiser l'exposition d'Airbus en phase de livraison/en service; Publier le KPI Programme Qualité sur une base hebdomadaire et mensuelle; Être le leader et reconnu par les organisations FAL, pré-FAL et Supply Chain comme la voix du client chez Airbus; Promouvoir l'état d'esprit du client. Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en ingénierie (aérospatiale, mécanique, industrielle) ou similaire, ou vous possédez une expérience professionnelle significative et pertinente; Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la structure et/ou des systèmes de l'avion, idéalement avec une expérience dans un service qualité, programme, qualité des fournisseurs ou service client; Vous êtes prêt à effectuer une analyse détaillée des données; Vous avez de l'expérience avec Salesforce, Google Suite, Skywise, etc. (atout); Vous avez de l’expérience dans la gestion de projet (atout); Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement multidisciplinaire; Vous êtes un bon joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication et un sens du détail. Vos résultats de travail sont professionnels et orientés client; Vous vous efforcez de vous approprier activement vos tâches avec une forte autonomie et responsabilité; Vous êtes bilingue (français et anglais), tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et un engagement à agir avec intégrité ; ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ********************************************************************************************* Job Description: Do you have experience with quality investigations, have you worked in Quality, and do you want to evolve and develop new skills? This position is for you! The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is looking for a Quality Coordinator for In-Service Investigation Requests to join our Quality team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada). Gestion du Changement : Arbitrer les modifications techniques et sécuriser leur introduction en ligne. Essais au Sol & Ergonomie : Piloter le centre d'essais (GTC) et intégrer les facteurs humains pour une production sécurisée et efficiente. Innovation : Soutenir le développement des futurs dérivés de l'A220 et les projets R&T. Expérience confirmée en milieu multiculturel, capable de naviguer avec aisance entre les sites de Mirabel, Mobile et l'Europe. title: VIE 2026 - Canada - Junior Technology Scouting - H/F
description_text:
Job Description: Le Volontariat International en Entreprise est un programme unique au monde sponsorisé par les Ministères français de l’Europe et des Affaires Etrangères, du Ministère de l’Economie et des Finances et du Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires et qui permet à Airbus d'offrir à de jeunes professionnels la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience rémunérée et valorisante à l'étranger, dans un métier technique ou commercial. Le programme VIE est un contrat spécifique, en vertu des critères d'éligibilité de Business France. Principaux critères d'exigibilité du VIE : Être citoyen(ne) de l'Union Européenne (plus Norvège, Islande et Liechtenstein), et candidat(e) diplômé(e) âgé(e) de 28 ans maximum (une mission V.I.E peut débuter au plus tard le jour du vingt-neuvième anniversaire) Avoir accompli les obligations militaires de son pays. Être impérativement inscrit sur le site Mon Volontariat International avant les 28 ans Pour plus d'informations : Mon Volontariat International (en anglais, en allemand, en italien et en espagnol). La durée d’un VIE est de 6 à 24 mois en fonction du lieu d’affectation. Un poste sous contrat VIE Expert en Veille et Intelligence Technologique / Technology Scouting and Intelligence Expert est à pourvoir au sein d’Airbus Canada à Mirabel. Vous rejoindrez le Tech Hub au sein d’Airbus Canada. Nous explorons les tendances technologiques à travers les zones géographiques pour soutenir les défis futurs d'Airbus, tout en détectant les bonnes entreprises (startups, PME) avec lesquelles s'associer. Missions et responsabilités : Vous serez en charge des activités principales suivantes : Faciliter et tirer parti de la veille et de l'intelligence technologique en rassemblant et en évaluant les informations dans le domaine des sciences et des technologies, soit en fonction de besoins de veille définis, soit en fonction d'opportunités externes, avec une couverture axée sur le Canada. Gestion d'un portefeuille de technologies groupées. Assurer une définition claire et solide des besoins en accord avec les parties prenantes internes. Identifier et gérer les entreprises externes. Identifier les partenaires ayant des capacités pertinentes avec le soutien d'experts en la matière. Assurer un réseau et des relations solides avec les principaux instituts de recherche et tous les acteurs clés dans le domaine technique. Préparer des rapports sur la prospection et les besoins des clients, et préparer des rapports sur les tendances technologiques. Faciliter le lancement, le suivi et la clôture des projets en coordination avec les clients internes et le support R&T. Se conformer aux politiques de gestion d'Airbus CANADA. Maintenir la connaissance de l'entreprise, de ses produits, de ses services, de ses activités, ainsi que des priorités commerciales et technologiques d'Airbus et de son écosystème R&T et Innovation. Conseiller et mettre en œuvre des cas d'utilisation de technologies ou de méthodologies spécifiques. Recueillir, rechercher et suggérer des solutions pour répondre aux exigences. Conseiller sur la méthodologie et l'approche d'implémentation. Prouver la valeur des nouvelles technologies pour établir des analyses de rentabilité (business case). Mettre à jour les directives et politiques de l'entreprise concernant l'utilisation d'une technologie ou d'une méthodologie spécifique. Faire évoluer le cadre de formation (learning framework) basé sur la technologie connue. Assurer la veille des tendances technologiques et/ou méthodologiques et aider les équipes à les appliquer dans l'environnement Airbus. Guider et soutenir la sélection des technologies et/ou méthodologies appropriées. Formuler des recommandations pour les décisions d'achat ou de développement interne Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir, de ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence. Compétences requises Vous avez les expériences et les compétences suivantes : Titulaire d'un diplôme (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de l'aérospatiale/ingénierie ou une discipline apparentée. Une expérience en veille technologique/innovation, avec un intérêt technique pour l'IA Une connaissance et une passion pour les nouvelles technologies et un sens technique pour évaluer leur pertinence. Capacité à développer de manière autonome des preuves de concept (POCs) En outre, vous êtes en mesure de démontrer les compétences suivantes : Capacité à développer la confiance et des relations ouvertes avec les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes. Autonomie Sensibilité culturelle afin d'opérer avec succès dans un environnement mondial en évolution rapide. Compétences linguistiques : Maîtrise de l'anglais et excellente communication (écrite/verbale). Manage a portfolio of grouped technologies. Ensure a clear and robust definition of needs in alignment with internal stakeholders. Identify and manage external companies. Ensure a strong network and relationships with key research institutes and all major stakeholders in the technical field. Prepare reports on scouting, client needs, and technology trends. Job Description: About our team... Airbus Helicopters is the world’s largest helicopter manufacturer and the company’s site at Oxford Airport is Britain’s civil helicopter hub. AHUK offers considerable experience in helicopter sales, bespoke completions, maintenance and spares support. Its in-house engineering capabilities include design, customisation, installation, flight-testing and certification, as well as technical support, maintenance, training and the supply of spares for civil and military applications. AHUK is the MoD’s chosen provider of helicopters and maintenance for its No.1 Helicopter Flying school (referred to as MFTS) located in RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) and RAF Valley (Anglesey). Description/Overall purpose of the Job You will be tasked with the manufacture and installation of looms and attaching equipment into aircraft under modification as part of a diverse and multi-skilled team. This will involve working closely with our in-house Part-21 design team. This manufacture of bespoke role equipment and customised optionals comes at the request of customers varying from the MOD to VVIP clients. An attention to detail, overt pride in your work and ownership of the task at hand is key to meeting the customer’s expectations to their satisfactory completion. You are also expected to maintain the safety and airworthiness and helicopters within the Installations department whilst being customised and maintained. title: Crew Compliance Specialist
description_text:
Job Description: Skywise is a leading digital services company, wholly owned by Airbus. We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. By providing interoperable digital solutions for end-to-end operations, Skywise combines aircraft manufacturer expertise and digital know-how to transform operational complexity into predictable and profitable performance, ensuring resilient and more sustainable operations. Summary: The Crew Compliance Specialist is responsible to design, support and oversee the implementation of product features that relate to Compliance of Crew Legality rules and regulations at airlines. Rules include Civil Aviation Rules, Company Rules, and Union Rules where applicable. At this time, Skywise’s N-OC (Ops & Crew) is the primary system that implements and tracks compliance to these rules in the Skywise Product suite, but other products might be involved as well. Main Responsibilities: The Crew Compliance Specialist (CCS) is part of the Customer Fulfillment team of Skywise Portfolio. This team will manage the domain specific technical support for all Skywise products that contain crew compliance features used by customers. The CCS provides expertise and technical support on Skywise Products, especially as it relates to Crew Legalities and Compliance. They will be the product expert to answer questions either from customers or from other Skywise entities. The CCS should analyze customers feedback and product occurrences to provide leadership and direction to all development activities. The CCS prioritizes the bug fixes and needed enhancements in the Product and, depending on how the product is developed/maintained, follow-up progress with the relevant development teams and their support infrastructure (both employees and contractors). The CCS provides operational expertise of the use of the product by our customers. They are responsible for ensuring the right level of verification and validation regarding operational use of the product. The CCS is also accountable for ensuring customer satisfaction following the 4 pillars : safety, security, quality and business. Analysis, definition and implementation of various features such as credit calculations that will be used in Payroll. Although our products are not Payroll systems, the applications we manage are responsible for collecting and calculating the base information that will be sent to Payroll systems for downline use. The TPM has a responsibility to understand and manage these features and relationships to ensure the system is useable in an OCC, in tandem with common Payroll systems in the Aviation industry. Work with Customer Experience team to ensure the Level 3 support regarding product expertise and relying on the L3 support dev team when necessary. Ensure Customer satisfaction regarding the product is at the expected level. Define new Product releases content by prioritizing the bug fixes and needed enhancements Internal testing and use of Product to ensure Verification and Validation activities are at the right level. Run User Acceptance Tests at operational level when needed Support the deal management (RFP, RFI and other questions that relate to the product specific domain) and delivery teams (Customer onboarding) regarding product expertise. If needed, act as product owner responsible for occurrence management dealing with the 4 pillars: Safety, Security, Quality and Business impacts. Ensure smooth and efficient communication with other internal and external stakeholders on the product. Support Customer Experience in maintaining and reviewing training materials and product documentation (release notes). Contribute to enhancements of processes and product materials, including but not limited to: Customer-Facing Documentation Freshdesk help files White papers Marketing Materials (as needed) Ability to analyze the impact of a change to existing implementations, FAR, EASA, CAA’s in general, and the cascading effect of those changes, on other aspects of an OCC, or business operations. Understanding of the overall airline crew operations, to ensure that we can analyze, define and implement various union and company rules. Participate in the process to oversee and audit customer systems to ensure compliance to requirements and ensure they are standard implementations. Qualified Experience/Skills/Training: Education: Successful completion of a Bachelors degree or diploma in computer science or technology, or technical aviation related domain, such as diplomas leading to OCC leadership jobs (or equivalent) Experience: Experience in the aviation industry is important Proven experience in maintaining project schedules, documentation, communications and meeting deadlines Experience developing under external industry standards or certifications Experience with, and understanding of Civil Aviation crew Regulations is an important baseline. Specific experience and knowledge of FAR regulations in North America is important. Experience working in a software development environment, driving feature progress and requirements gathering would be an asset Understanding of the full SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) management, is an asset Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities & Competencies: Experience in the aviation industry is critical Must work effectively with others in a team environment Proactive, problem solver with effective interpersonal and communication skills Able to effectively communicate, both verbally and written, technical aspects of architecture and integration to management, clients and staff Ability to manage through a period of growth or transition a definite asset Able to translate strategic objectives into daily activities and guide and motivate others to deliver Supplier (including contract) and partners management Excellent organizational and time management skills. Join Skywise, a wholly-owned Airbus subsidiary as a Product Manager, and take the pilot seat for our mission-critical N-Ops & Crew (N-OC) product. N-OC is the single, highly-configurable solution that empowers major airlines worldwide to master their Operations Control and Crew Management, covering everything from network scheduling to day-of-ops crew control. ​Operating within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), you will function as the key Product Manager, translating customer and market needs, aligning them to company vision and strategy resulting in compelling prioritized feature roadmaps, which you will be accountable to deliver on time and with quality. If you thrive on optimizing complex systems, driving business value, and shaping the future of airline efficiency, this is your opportunity to lead. Maximize ROI: Prioritize the Product Backlog by applying an economic view (e.g., Weighted Shortest Job First - WSJF) to ensure the team(s) focuses its efforts on the features that will deliver the greatest business value and return on investment. Translate Needs into Features: Define, document, and accept features with clear business outcomes, acceptance criteria, and Non-Functional Requirements, acting as the ultimate source for feature content. SAFe Execution & Agile Leadership Lead PI Planning: Lead the content presentation for Program Increment (PI) Planning events, presenting the vision and features to the team(s), and finalize the PI Objectives in collaboration with stakeholders. Facilitate Flow: Collaborate closely with the Release Train Engineer (RTE) and Product Owner (PO) to monitor the execution of the PI plan, actively working to anticipate and resolve cross-team dependencies and impediments that hinder feature delivery flow. Guide Product Owners: Collaborate and synchronize daily with Product Owners to elaborate features into user stories, manage the flow of work, and ensure the team backlogs reflect correct priorities. Risk Management: Identify potential risks and obstacles to successful product delivery and work proactively to address or mitigate them. description_text:
Job Description: Take off with Airbus Helicopters! Airbus Helicopters is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Release Train Engineer to join our Information Management (IM) / IT Department within the Analytics Solution domain based in Marignane or Donauwörth. Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters. The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment. You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters. To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane Role Mission:
The RTE is the Primary Facilitator and Operations Leader for the Agile Release Train (ART). Rather than managing people, you manage the Value Stream. You are responsible for the health of the "Team of Teams" ecosystem, ensuring that delivery is predictable, impediments are cleared at the team of teams level, and the ART operates as a synchronized, high-performance unit. Core Responsibilities: Operational Steering Synchronizing the "Team of Teams": You drive the rhythm of the ART. You don't just "schedule meetings"; you design the communication architecture (Sync-ups, PO Syncs, Coach Syncs) that allows 50–125+ people to move in the same direction without friction.
Driving Execution: You own the operational roadmap for the PI (Program Increment). You track progress against Program Objectives and use data-driven insights (Flow Metrics, Velocity) to identify where the "engine" is stalling.
Architecting the PI Planning: You are the lead architect of the ART’s most critical alignment event. You ensure the "Content" (from Product Management) and the "Capacity" (from the Teams) meet in a way that produces a committed, realistic plan.
Systemic Impediment Removal: While Scrum Masters handle team-level blockers, you tackle systemic issues—budgeting silos, cross-train dependencies, and infrastructure gaps—that prevent the ART from reaching its full potential. Strategic Skills & Mindset Operational Excellence: You have a "systems-thinking" mindset. You look at the whole train to find the bottleneck, rather than just optimizing individual teams.
Servant Leadership through Facilitation: You lead by creating the environment for success. You provide the guardrails and the data that allow teams to self-manage effectively.
Predictability & Transparency: You are the source of truth for the ART’s health. You ensure that Business Owners have a transparent view of progress, risks, and the actual "flow" of value. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Program Predictability Measure: How well is the ART delivering against its planned objectives?
Flow Efficiency: How much time is work spent "waiting" versus "moving"?
ART Health: The eNPS and maturity levels of the "team of teams." Your profile: Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
5-8 years’ experience in related area
Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong ability to troubleshoot organisational challenges.
Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate AGILE concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Agile Experience: Expert with agile development methodologies.
Industry Knowledge (Preferred): Understanding of the aviation or aerospace industry and its data challenges is a plus.
Language Skills: Fluency in English is essential. Knowledge of French is advantageous. Skills: SAFe Framework Expertise & Event Facilitation: Mastery in orchestrating and facilitating large-scale Lean-Agile events, specifically Program Increment (PI) Planning, Inspect & Adapt (I&A) workshops, and Scrum of Scrums across the entire Agile Release Train (ART).
Servant Leadership & Agile Coaching: Proven ability to lead without hierarchical authority, coaching Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and teams on Lean-Agile principles, while driving conflict resolution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Impediment Removal & Flow Optimization: Strong track record in identifying and clearing systemic roadblocks, managing cross-team dependencies, and optimizing the value stream using metrics like Flow Efficiency and Program Predictability.
Risk & Dependency Management: Expertise in driving proactive risk mitigation strategies, visualizing critical-path dependencies via the Program Board, and aligning technical runway risks with business priorities.
Strategic Alignment & Backlog Management: Strong collaboration skills with Product Management and Business Owners to manage the Program Backlog, apply WSJF (Weighted Shortest Job First) prioritization, and ensure execution aligns with Lean budgeting and strategic themes. 3 Reasons to join us: Our Values: Six essential values form the core of our company. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving. Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively. We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility). And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference: A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.). Assurer la sécurité à long terme, la fiabilité, la navigabilité et l'optimisation des performances des solutions/systèmes des moyens de transports actuels et nouveaux. Notre mission est d'améliorer la sécurité en contribuant à de nouvelles normes de sécurité, en assurant la conformité réglementaire et en veillant à ce que les utilisateurs finaux soient toujours protégés.
Avec plus de 650 spécialistes, nous soutenons nos clients en garantissant le niveau de sécurité et la performance de disponibilité de leurs produits (plateformes, systèmes, équipements) et services. Ceci couvre l'ensemble du processus du cycle de vie du produit/service, de la conception à la fabrication, de l'exploitation au recyclage, tant pour les clients civils que militaires. Commodity management requires a strategic and robust plan to ensure that both value and risk are managed correctly, and innovation is encouraged. The role of a commodity manager is very complex and it has to be undertaken by someone who is capable of understanding markets, the supply chain and how the business works. Lead and contribute to Procurement/ Value Creation projects & initiatives that aim at delivering synergies and savings

Set-up, negotiate and manage contractual agreements with suppliers

The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. Airbus Helicopters (AH) seeks an IT Digital Workplace Operations Specialist - Email intern for our Collaboration Services Department in Albacete, Spain. You will be part of the Digital Workplace team inside the Information Technology Directorate responsible for all the technologies people use to get work done in today’s workplace. Inside the Digital Workplace, Collaboration Services Team is taking care of applications on premises and in the cloud like email, instant messaging, web conferencing, event conferencing, telephony, IT equipment and IT services in the meeting and video conference rooms, enterprise social media tools, file sharing applications and productivity tools like Google Workspace. In your role within the Collaboration Services Team, you will contribute to the RUN, BUILD TO RUN, and Entry Into Service phases for all email-related applications, utilizing both Gmail and Microsoft Exchange on prem technologies. While our email Service Delivery Manager (SDM) currently manages these tasks, you will collaborate with him extensively. Your challenges: Digital Workplace working methodology is Kanban with the objective to focus on getting things done on the shortest cycle times as possible to improve customer satisfaction. That methodology implies high responsiveness to change as priorities are shifting very frequently, no prescribed responsibilities and high team empowerment. In that way of working, the scope of your job will be: Service Delivery & Operational Support Assist the Email SDM in monitoring the global health of email services in AH, including tracking incident backlogs, incident resolution efficiency, request catalogs, and SLA fulfillment. Support the maintenance of the CMDB, knowledge databases, and the creation of operational dashboards under the guidance of the SDM. Shadow the SDM in managing our external subcontractor performing the RUN activities for email solutions. Contribute to the "shift right approach" by participating in daily exchanges with the IT Service Desk and the email support supplier. Observe and support the Major Incident resolution and escalation processes, learning how to involve the right roles and ensure continuous process improvement. Project, Build, & Architecture Collaboration Support the Restricted Collaboration Product Manager in any RUN, BUILD, or BUILD-TO-RUN activities requested for the email scope. Collaborate with the Collaboration Services Architect by assisting in building or updating architecture dossiers and helping evaluate new features and technologies. Contribute to the strategic product and service roadmaps by researching and proposing new ideas to the Collaboration Product Managers. Assist in ensuring the proper Entry to Service of new features, helping prepare the environment for permanent improvements and new releases (in-house or vendor-developed). Cross-Team Teamwork Team up with the Google Workspace team to provide backup support, while learning how cross-functional backup structures operate. Participate in regular reviews of Restricted Collaboration routines, including Group PI Planning, weekly team meetings, and product team meetings. Documentation, Change Management, & Continuous Improvement Actively document the scope of the activity.. Work closely with the department Change Manager and SDM to secure smooth change management for end-users, VIPs, and Assistants. Translate operational requirements into user-friendly guides for end-users and detailed knowledge articles for Service Desk Agents. Identify and propose regular improvement opportunities within the scope of the email activity. Your profile: Academic Background: Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Foundational Knowledge: A strong interest in or academic exposure to IT Service Management (ITSM) or IT Product Management frameworks. Methodology: Basic understanding of ITIL concepts is highly valued. Email & Infrastructure: willing to learn knowledge about email infrastructure, such as SMTP relay protocols, email routing, email hosting, email firewalls, or ADLDS. Cloud Platforms: willing to learn Google Workspace Admin platform skills. ITSM Tools: willing to learn ServiceNow for IT operational usage. Core Competencies: Basic exposure to Component Integration, Testing, Solution Deployment, and Performance Management through university coursework or personal projects. Customer & Process Focus: Ability to assist in designing IT operations that align with customer expectations, with an interest in learning Service Level and Problem Management. Analytical & Structured: Strong practical problem-solving skills and a strong ability for document production (creating guides, reports, and knowledge articles). Interpersonal Attributes: Open-minded, self-aware, transparent, and highly receptive to constructive feedback. Communication: Negotiation-level English is required. Cross-Site Collaboration: Ability to adapt and thrive in a complex, multi-site international environment, collaborating across divisions including Donauwörth, Marignane, and Albacete. Organization structure The position is open at Albacete. You report to the local Spanish colleague of Restricted Collaboration Product and from time to time to the Head of Collaboration Services. Moreover, you will have other interactions with: Airbus & Helicopters IM Products owners. Airbus & Helicopters Digital Workplace Solution Architects and Enterprise Architects. Airbus Commercial, Defense and Space and roofs counterparts (eg. North America, China, Singapore) Airbus Helicopters IM Departments like IM Security, Network, Identity and Access Management and Hosting. Airbus Helicopters Communication, Assistants and Exec Assistants community. WHY SHOULD YOU APPLY? 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE? - Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects. - Expand your network within the aeronautical industry. - Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. - Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space.
