title: Material and Process Engineer - Materials Compliance & Sustainability
description_text:
Job Description: Join Materials, Processes & Test department - To perform Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) assessment for aerospace materials and processes. - To ensure global compliance, manage strategic material risks. - To contribute to larger Airbus sustainability objectives. Your Main Responsibilities Substance Analysis & Chemical Mapping: Evaluate and document the chemical composition of complex aerospace materials (metallic alloys, polymers, advanced composites, and coatings) and its associated regulatory risks Regulatory Compliance & Risk Mitigation: Maintain strict adherence to global environmental regulations including REACH, RoHS, AD-DSL, TSCA and specific aerospace industry restrictions. Assess the impact of sunset chemical bans on current and future manufacturing. CSRM Supply Chain Management: Identify, track, and develop mitigation strategies for Critical and Strategic Raw Materials (CSRM) to protect against supply chain vulnerabilities and geopolitical risks. Environmental Stewardship & LCA: Conduct screening Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) to quantify the carbon footprint and environmental impacts of materials from raw extraction to end-of-life. Material Circularity & Eco-Design: Collaborate with R&D and manufacturing teams to implement circular economy principles, maximizing the recyclability and reuse of aerospace alloys and composites. AI & Automation: Understanding of how to use AI for regulatory monitoring and substance characterization, supply chain risk prediction and also collaborating with IT to implement "Eco-Design" practices and efficient data management for product-related software. Who We Are Looking For Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or Chemistry. Experience: 6-8 years of experience in materials compliance, substance analysis, or environmental stewardship within a highly regulated industry (Aerospace, Defense, or Automotive preferred). Regulations & Substance management: Proficient with Environmental Regulations (from APAC,EMEA, USA,ICAO etc.), Chemical Databases, SDSs (Safety Data sheets) Authoring, Compliance data Management through Software's (CDX, IMDS, SAP etc.). Deep understanding of REACH (SVHCs) and the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities. . Sustainability Frameworks: Practical knowledge of LCA methodologies (ISO 14040/14044) and software (e.g., GaBi, Simapro) is highly desirable. Aerospace Material and Process Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge of aerospace-grade materials, surface treatments (e.g., anodizing, chromate conversion coatings)and their respective chemical risks. Strong Project Management skills in a multicultural environment. Good professional experiences in the area of metals and its application in Aircrafts is a plus. Excellent communication. The Product Support Representative plays an integral role as the primary technical interface with the customer as it pertains to deploying digital solutions and supporting their operations. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, analytical, and possesses a strong problem-solving mindset. Primary Responsibilities: Deployment of Mission+ Digital Solutions The Product Support Representative is fully responsible for all technical activities required to successfully deploy Mission+ Digital Solutions. This may include customer stakeholders management and steering activities required on the customer side. These tasks usually fall into the following main families: Data & workflow scoping phase, prerequisites, data mapping preparation, sourcing and consolidation Delivery of customer training Preparation and support for the user acceptance tests, including analysis and resolution of technical queries Support the transition to the In-Service phase, with knowledge transfer to the Support team Follow-up on any additional needs raised by the customer In Service support of Mission+ Digital Solutions Contribute to complex customer request solving, supporting L1/L2 /L3 teams. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes; and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Performs a variety of tasks ranging from repetitive to non-repetitive production assembly operations on electronic and/or mechanical assemblies and subassemblies such as modules, boards, panels, drawers, frames, and cables. Works from diagrams and drawings, makes initial layouts, and uses hand and/or power tools, jigs, and saws. Makes continuity checks on work in process and completed. May conduct quality inspections on processing line in accordance with quality specifications. May disassemble, modify, rework, reassemble, and test experimental or prototype assemblies and sub-assemblies according to specifications and under simulated conditions. The Company will provide appropriate assistance in job training to enable employees to perform all necessary job functions including the following: Work with blueprints, changes, specifications, work orders, etc. to assemble and install to quality requirements parts and assemblies. Complete required data gathering transactions to facilitate assembly progression. Setup and perform all manual and automated assembly operations, and portable machine functions required to accomplish assignments. Perform any and all required pickup, rework, fabrication, change in corporation, functional testing or check during or after final assembly and/or assembly progression Move and/or obtain correct parts, materials, tools, assemblies, etc. Use precision measuring instruments required to accomplish work assignments. Report and/or investigate job handicaps such as: errors in parts, assembly procedures, tools, sequences, etc. Perform routine minor machine maintenance as part of their daily work duties (e.g., where applicable, replacing machine filters, changing standard light bulbs on machines and equipment, maintaining lubrication/coolant levels, etc. as related to basic Total Preventative Maintenance duties). Routinely move product within the immediate manufacturing work area, including across isle, using shop assigned equipment as required, and complete transactions necessary to move product to the next operation. On an exception basis, move product to the next operation within a building. Support the continuous flow of product within the manufacturing process by training, coaching and assisting other employees. Document any discrepancies according to specification, process, and procedure. Trains to become MVP qualified. Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un.e professionnel.le en Gestion de Configuration pour rejoindre notre équipe Airbus Canada basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez avec toutes les fonctions de l’entreprise et les différents fournisseurs. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Supporter le développement et le maintien des processus touchant les changements des équipements incluant l’aspect Product identification et gestion du changement; Supporter le développement et mise en oeuvre de la vision pour la Transformation de la Gestion de Configuration en respectant les orientations stratégiques des Processus, Méthodes, Outils et Données de l’entreprise; Être force de proposition enrichissant les feuilles de route et la vision de la gestion de configuration des programmes d’Airbus Canada d'aujourd'hui et de demain; Représenter le Centre de Compétence en Gestion de la Configuration dans les forums et les ateliers d'amélioration et de transformation en cours en gestion de configuration d’Airbus Canada; Élaborer des propositions de solutions stratégiques/opportunités d’amélioration et, le cas échéant, les transmettre au superviseur de l'équipe, aux chefs de projets et au conseil de gestion de la configuration; Contribuer à la création et le maintien du plan de développement intégré. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Support Product Managers and Business Product Owners in understanding business needs and translating them into sustainable architectural choices. Participate actively in the solution lifecycle, from early design and technology choices to deployment and handover to RUN teams. Act as the primary point of contact for the domain on various IT architecture topics within the EII department. Solid background in data integration, APIs, microservices, and enterprise middleware. Good understanding of networking, security, and IAM concepts in large organizations. Soft skills & mindset : Systems thinking: ability to design solutions supporting growth, complexity, and long-term maintainability. Stakeholder management: capable of explaining architectural trade-offs and technical topics to non-IT audiences. Comfortable working in complex, regulated industrial environments. Compliance knowledge : Knowledge of Export Control regulations (ITAR / EAR) applied to technical data is a strong asset for Airbus roles. 3 Reasons to join us : Our Values : Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family. title: Ground Stations & Telecommunication Engineer (d/m/w)
description_text:
Job Description: At Airbus, our purpose is to improve life on Earth and beyond through our cutting-edge space technologies. With every technological breakthrough, we bring people closer together, we navigate new frontiers and we discover new and unexplored destinations. And we don't just take innovations to space - our space solutions and projects help solve global challenges on Earth. We are looking for a candidate to become our new Satellite Ground Engineer (d/m/f) with focus on ground stations and telecommunication for national space projects within Airbus Space Engineering, located in Friedrichshafen, Germany. You will be a member of the System Architecture & Lead Engineering Team with great team-players aside you. You will join a diverse and empowered team working on Space & Ground Systems Architectures, Secure Space Solutions, Systems Engineering, Development, Operations, Data Processing, and Performance Modelling. You will benefit from training opportunities and new ways of working (home office, digital tools, flexible working hours etc.). You will find great leadership teams whose priority is to support your development, foster team spirit and give meaning to your activity in a global Airbus environment. On top, thanks to the high diversity of jobs and competencies that we can offer in our domain, you will have opportunities to grow & prepare your longer-term development plan. We are looking for diverse people to design creative ground system solutions. As a Development Engineer (d/m/f) for ground systems with focus on ground stations and telecommunication, you will be part of a team based in Friedrichshafen supporting our integrated national space mission project teams. Your tasks include the specification of state-of-the-art transmission paths and protocols for communication between the space and ground segments. You develop innovative solutions for direct links between satellites and ground stations as well as for indirect communication via relay satellites. Additionally, you design the ground network connections for efficient data transfer from the ground stations to the ground segment. Beside the operational activities, you will contribute to our transformation plan that has the vision to become national champion for high-performance Ground-Space Mission Solutions. You will work on concrete operational tasks while capitalising return of experience for future secure space solution improvement. Join our empowered and engaged teams! Tasks & accountabilities Contribute to the definition and design of Satellite Ground Systems: use of state-of-the-art methods (Scrum, Model-Based Systems Engineering) Contribute to the requirements analysis and architecture definition for Ground Segments regarding telecommunication and ground stations Design trade-offs and interface management: evaluation and optimization of design decisions, identification of internal and external interfaces, creation of interface documents (ICD)
Specification of hardware and software elements as well as redundancy concepts
Calculation of link budgets
Support in system development, AIV (assembly, integration, verification)
Contributions to proposals and studies as well as research and development activities
Technical coordination of subcontractors and partners
Interdisciplinary collaboration: Space Segment Engineering, Performance Engineering, Operations Engineering Qualification: completed university degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Communications (Network), or equivalent qualification
Technical expertise: knowledge and practical experience in processes and standards of the space industry (e.g., ECSS, CCSDS), experience in systems engineering as well as with corresponding methods and tools
Adaptability and willingness to learn: Interest and ability to quickly familiarize oneself with new technologies
Working experience on classified projects (an advantage)
Soft Skills: good communication and presentation skills, team-oriented work style
Language Skills: fluent German and English, French language skills (a plus) Interested? Get yourself known by applying here! --------------------------------------------- Bei Airbus ist unser Ziel, das Leben auf der Erde und darüber hinaus durch unsere fortschrittlichen Raumfahrttechnologien zu verbessern. Mit jedem technologischen Durchbruch bringen wir Menschen näher zusammen, erkunden neue Grenzen und entdecken neue und unerforschte Ziele. Wir bringen Innovationen nicht nur ins All – unsere Raumfahrtlösungen und Projekte helfen, globale Herausforderungen auf der Erde zu lösen. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten, der unser neuer Entwicklungsingenieur (d/m/w) mit Fokus auf Bodenstationen und Telekommunikation für nationale Raumfahrtprojekte innerhalb von Airbus Space Engineering in Friedrichshafen, Deutschland, wird. Sie werden Teil des Teams für Systemarchitektur und Lead Engineering sein, mit großartigen Teamkollegen an Ihrer Seite. Sie werden einem vielfältigen und befähigtem Team beitreten, das an Raum- und Bodensystemarchitekturen, sicheren Raumfahrlösungen, Systemingenieurwesen, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Datenverarbeitung und Leistungsmodellierung arbeitet. Sie profitieren von Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und neuen Arbeitsweisen (Homeoffice, digitale Tools, flexible Arbeitszeiten usw.). Sie finden großartige Führungsteams, deren Priorität es ist, Ihre Entwicklung zu unterstützen, den Teamgeist zu fördern und Ihrer Tätigkeit in der globalen Airbus-Umgebung Sinn zu geben. Darüber hinaus bieten die Vielfalt der Jobs und Kompetenzen, die wir in unserem Bereich anbieten können, Ihnen Möglichkeiten zum Wachstum und zur Vorbereitung Ihres langfristigen Entwicklungsplans. Wir suchen vielfältige Menschen, um kreative Bodensegment Lösungen zu gestalten. Als Entwicklungsingenieur (d/m/w) für Satellitenbodensegmente mit Fokus auf Bodenstationen und Telekommunikation werden Sie Teil eines Teams in Friedrichshafen sein, das unsere integrierten nationalen Raumfahrtmissionsteams unterstützt. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Spezifikation modernster Übertragungswege und -protokolle für die Kommunikation zwischen Raum- und Bodensegment. Sie entwickeln innovative Lösungen für direkte Verbindungen zwischen Satelliten und Bodenstationen sowie für indirekte Kommunikation über Relaissatelliten. Zudem gestalten Sie die Netzwerkverbindungen am Boden für die effiziente Datenübertragung von den Bodenstationen zum Bodensegment. Neben den operativen Aktivitäten tragen Sie zu unserem Transformationsplan bei, der die Vision hat, nationaler Champion für leistungsstarke Satellitenbodensegmente zu werden. Sie arbeiten an konkreten operativen Aufgaben und nutzen dabei die Erfahrungswerte für die zukünftige Verbesserung sicherer Raumfahrlösungen. title: Principal Engineer – Physical Design & Structural Integrity (m/f)
description_text:
Job Description: As part of Airbus's ambition to grow a proficient and competitive Engineering organisation, we are launching a Commercial Aircraft Engineering Centre in Poland. This initiative aims to leverage Poland's talent pool and technological ecosystem, specifically in the field of Propulsion systems, while supporting our broader Engineering workload and competitiveness requirements, and reinforcing Airbus’ strategic engagement with Poland. Role Overview Join Airbus Poland Engineering center, as the Principal Engineer – Physical Design & Structural Integrity. You will be the foremost technical expert within the Kraków Center for all mechanical and structural engineering disciplines. This role provides critical support to the Technical Operations leader by ensuring that all physical designs, structural integrations, and mechanical systems are technically sound, highly optimized, and certifiable. You will lead the technical validation of stress analyses (Static, Fatigue, and Damage Tolerance) and mentor the local engineering teams to execute complex designs in compliance with Airbus CS-25 regulations. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & CS-25 Compliance Technical Validation: Act as the primary Technical Checker/Approver of engineering Center deliverables before they are submitted for DOA certification, covering: Static and dynamic stress reports. Complex Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and hand calculations. Fatigue and Damage Tolerance (F&D) assessments, ensuring the structural lifespan and safety margins meet rigorous aerospace standards. 3D physical design. Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) strategies and kinematic studies for moving mechanical systems. Lifing studies. DOA Support: Work closely with the Technical Operations leader to generate the technical artifacts (drawings, stress reports, test specifications) required for Airbus CS-25 compliance. Root Cause Analysis: Lead complex technical investigations and root-cause analyses for design non-conformances or physical testing failures. Mentorship: Elevate the technical capability of the local team (mid-level and junior engineers) through continuous mentoring in aerospace design principles and stress methodologies. The Ideal Profile Education & Experience Education: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of aircraft certification processes, specifically relating to structural substantiation under EASA/Airbus CS-25. Tool Proficiency: Expert-level knowledge of aerospace CAD systems (e.g., CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE) and industry-standard CAE/FEA solvers (e.g., NASTRAN, PATRAN, Abaqus, ANSYS). Experience: 10+ years of deep technical experience in aerospace mechanical design and structural analysis (Static & F&D). Industry Bonus: Prior experience working directly for an aero-engine manufacturer (e.g., Safran, Rolls-Royce, GE Aviation, Pratt & Whitney, MTU) is highly preferred. Soft Skills Strong mentoring, coaching, and knowledge transfer capabilities. Exceptional problem-solving oriented mindset and analytical skills. Autonomy, team spirit, and capability to guide engineers in a high-technical environment. Good communication and listening skills to interact effectively with the Technical Operations leader and global experts. title: Schulpraktikum Airbus Bremen im Monat Dezember (30.11.26-11.12.26)
description_text:
Job Description: Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Schulpraktikum und möchtest die vielseitige Arbeit bei Airbus in Bremen kennenlernen? Dann bewirb Dich! Wir freuen uns, wenn Du uns als Schulpraktikant:in (d/m/w) unterstützt. Die Stellenausschreibung gilt für Praktikumsplätze mit Start im Monat Dezember - dabei ist der Praktikumsstart immer an einem Montag. Grundsätzlich sind unsere Praktika auf zwei Wochen ausgelegt. Je nach schulischer Vorgabe ist jedoch auch ein ein- oder dreiwöchiges Praktikum möglich. Eine Bewerbung kann mindestens bis zum 28.06.26 eingereicht werden. Was erwartet Dich bei einem Schulpraktikum bei Airbus? In Deiner ersten Praktikumswoche wirst Du ein eigenes praktisches Projekt in unserer Praktikantenwerkstatt umsetzen. Egal, ob Du bereits Erfahrungen mitbringst oder zum ersten Mal Werkzeug in der Hand hältst – bei uns kannst Du Dich ausprobieren und Technik hautnah erleben. Ab der zweiten Woche entscheidest Du selbst, wo es hingehen soll. Bitte teile uns in Deinem Motivationsschreiben mit, an welchem der folgenden Schwerpunkte Du Interesse hast. Gerne kannst Du auch angeben, ob Dein Interesse im Bereich Luftfahrt, Raumfahrt oder Defence liegt: Produktion: Technik zum Anfassen. Unterstütze uns dort, wo echte Flugzeug-/Raketenteile gefertigt und montiert werden. Engineering: Von der Idee zum Flugzeug. Wirf einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der technischen Entwicklung, Konstruktion und Optimierung. IT/Finance: Das Rückgrat der Luftfahrt. Erfahre, wie moderne IT-Systeme und wirtschaftliche Prozesse Airbus auf Kurs halten. Voraussetzungen: Bei Deinem Praktikumsstart musst Du mindestens 14 Jahre alt sein. Zudem muss es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handeln. Freiwillige Praktika bieten wir am Standort Bremen leider nicht an - auch nicht in den Ferien. Bitte lade folgende Dokumente bei der Anmeldung hoch: Motivationsschreiben mit Angabe des gewünschten Schwerpunkt (s.o.) sowie Praktikumszeitraum Lebenslauf mit E-Mailadresse und gültiger Telefonnummer Kopie der letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse Bestätigung der Schule, dass es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handelt (+ Nachweis über den Versicherungsschutz der Schule) Unterschriebene Bewerbungsdokumente (Verpflichtung zur Vertraulichkeit, Einverständniserklärung Fotos, Datenschutzerklärung) Die Bewerbungsunterlagen stehen auf unserer Homepage unter „Formblatt und Datenschutzerklärung – Bremen Bewerbungsdokumente“ zum Download bereit. Nur vollständige Bewerbungen können wir anschließend schnell bearbeiten. Hinweis: Ein nachträgliches Hochladen Deiner Unterlagen ist leider nicht möglich. Solltest Du noch Dokumente nachreichen müssen, sende diese bitte an folgende E-Mail-Adresse: schuelerpraktikum.bremen@airbus.com. Alle eingehenden Bewerbungen werden vorerst von uns gesammelt und danach ausführlich geprüft. In der Regel erhältst du innerhalb von drei bis sechs Wochen eine Rückmeldung. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! title: Head of Design Services & Compliance Verification Engineer (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: As an employee of Aerostack, a Joint Venture between Airbus and an automotive company, and in line with Airbus strategy to accelerate Zero Emission Aircraft development, you will be part of a collaborative team developing PEM fuel cell stack for aeronautic applications. The jobholder will a member of the Engineering Department. Key Accountabilities: Design Service Team: Leading and driving the Design Service Team. Manage proactively the design services for the projects, provide mentorship and continuously improve engineering methods, tools and skills. V&V Strategy & TRL5+ Compliance Demonstration: Leading the qualification related activities for Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 5 or higher and ensuring the implementation of the Means of Compliance within the overall V&V activities. Proactively establish and conduct preliminary testing to identify and address potential certification roadblocks well in advance of final homologation. Data Correlation & Gate Review Documentation: Accountable for validating empirical test data against analytical models, maintaining strict requirements traceability, and compiling the definitive evidence engineering dossier required to formally pass the TRL 5 milestone and above. Key Responsibilities: Team Lead Team Mentorship & Resource & Standards: You serve as the bridge between management, project management and the design service team, assigning tasks based on individual strengths while providing technical guidance and professional development to the stack designers. You define and enforce CAD standards, manage the project pipeline to ensure deadlines are met and ensure configuration management requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary point of contact for engineers, architects, or manufacturing teams to resolve design conflicts, integrate feedback, and ensure the CAD output aligns with broader project requirements. Verification & Validation (V&V) Define the Means of Validation & Verification based on the qualification requirements defined from Airbus and standards. Test Strategy & Planning: Develop comprehensive V&V plans, test cases, and procedures for parts, components and stacks based on engineering requirements and the V-Model. Prototyping & Lab Testing: Design, set up, and coordinate V&V tests on early-stage prototypes in lab environments to industrially relevant environments (TRL 5) and above. Requirements Traceability: Ensure continuous traceability between product requirements, system specifications, and test results using requirements management tools. Steering and overseeing validation and verification activities. Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze test data, identify failure modes, and document results in clear, actionable engineering reports. Design Feedback: Work closely with design, test engineers and architects to provide feedback based on test failures, driving iterative design improvements Prepare Certification Strategy Build and develop strong relations with Airbus safety and airworthiness team as well as certification authorities to create a certification baseline for fuel cell technology Initial Scoping: Identify relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and compliance requirements (e.g. DO-160, ASR, ABD100) early in the engineering phase. Pre-Compliance Testing: Define and execute preliminary tests to identify potential certification roadblocks long before final homologation. Documentation: Build the foundational certification documentation framework that will be required to transition the technology from TRL 3 to TRL 5 and beyond. Work closely with the safety and homologation engineers as the initial point of contact for external testing houses and regulatory bodies to align on certification roadmaps for TRL5+. title: Customer Support Manager
description_text:
Job Description: 1. Mission
The Customer Support Manager (CSM) is Customer’s focal point regarding Support & Services, accountable for customer satisfaction and driving continuous improvement to guarantee global services performance for the customer and increase fleet availability, covering the entirety of the customer’s fleet. In order to carry out this mission, the CSM will:
● Coordinate support disciplines & experts, in order to bring a quick and adequate solution to customer needs in priority and/or exceptional cases
● Set up and follow up any operational action plan to deal with customer concerns, complaints and/or dissatisfaction
● Collect customer satisfaction, needs or expectations to relay the customer context for further use within AH
● Build customer satisfaction and confidence to enable business growth.
● Ensure overall performance in terms of parts availability (new and repaired) as part of the front office. 2. Main Activities
The CSM’s main activities are:
● To contribute in the definition of the key objectives of the Customer Satisfaction Roadmap for customers in their customer portfolio Develop a customer strategy that is aligned with the Customer’s expectations and shared with the other members of the Front Office Team, followed in the CRM Salesforce
● To organize regular meetings/visits with customers in their customer portfolio Listen to and exchange with the Customer to recover the customer’s priorities (such as availability, spares delivery, focal point responsiveness, maintenance duration) needed to define the customer strategy, as well as their feedback and priority issues relating to operational performance (prepare necessary reports presenting key data for the end customer), followed in the CRM Salesforce
● To provide customer with key information on support and services Communicate S&S Discipline contents to the Customer on hot topics, performance, improvement initiatives, services catalog key changes, and recommendations for mutual benefit Guide the customer by helping them to understand our products and organization better, and improving the way we work with them
● To collect, discuss and manage customer feedback and knowledge Collect customer feedback on S&S interactions since last exchange, review progress on current action plan, recover customer perceptions on latest hot topics, recover customer needs and activity forecasts at strategic and operational level, followed in the CRM Salesforce
● To listen, understand and propose any required actions on Customer priority and/or exceptional issues Understand the customer priority and/or exceptional issues that may occur and require immediate action through transverse management of S&S disciplines and ensure each of them respect their commitments through to resolution, followed in the CRM Salesforce As the customer’s preferred focal point for S&S, escalate if and where needed to secure the resolution of customer issues
● To monitor support and services performance at an individual customer level
Analyze activity levels related to Customer’s operations such as flight hours, parts consumptions, future trends and coordinate with functional specialists to provide further analysis and ensure key players provide essential reports. Assess fit gap between observed performance and customer perception to support functional specialists in identifying potential process improvements, while respecting our internal financial constraints
● To achieve booking targets and financial objectives (Down payments, Cash collection…)
● To follow-up the Overdues status and define the relevant actions with the Customer to recover the outstanding invoices.
● Contribute to customer satisfaction through monitoring of logistics KPIs (OTR/OTD, customer complaints, late orders, etc.)
● Be the voice of the customer internally and contribute to revenue generation
● Support supply chain initiatives and lead cross-functional action plans aimed at improving the level of service provided to customers
● Manage customer parts support contracts 3. Key Skills and Competencies
Customer Relationship
● Ability to set up and maintain good relationship with customer
● Ability to understand customer’s expectations, know the customer and their organization
● Ability to support the catalog of services and respond to customer’s requests
Communication and Coordination
● Ability to communicate clearly with the customer, in local language as well as in English
● Ability to integrate unprecedented and/or complex situations
● Ability to clearly communicate internally on a target and involve necessary stakeholders for target achievement
● Ability to establish sustainable external and internal AH stakeholder networks
● Ability to manage stressful situations
Analysis and Reporting
● Ability to prepare, conduct and synthesize a Customer meeting
● Ability to extract root causes from complex situations
● Ability to understand and analyze performance activity levels related to a Customer’s operations and identify non-performance levers
Technical Knowledge
● Ability to use Salesforce as the Customer Relationship Management tool
● Knowledge on aeronautics and helicopter basics
● Knowledge on AH programs and S&S basics
● Knowledge on AH technical publication basics
● Knowledge of the Material Support environment
● Knowledge of SAP, eOrdering and Web MRO This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. description_text:
Job Description: Job Description The role involves end-to-end management of complex and long lead time sales campaigns incl. business development, campaign creation and working with AH teams in France/Germany on techno-commercial offers / bid management, trials, negotiation and contract closure. The job involves professional stakeholder management locally amongst several stakeholders and management of internal Multi-Function Teams. The job holder will have to have a thorough and deep knowledge of the Indian military customers, and military-industrial eco-system. Establish regular contacts, developing confident, professional relationships with the customer, perform stakeholders mapping, in-depth knowledge of the Indian defence procurement & budgeting process, etc.
Feed customer’s requirements / feedback / perspectives, market trend and knowledge to HQ based teams and drive sales/offer process, ICTs, marketing & engineering studies, etc. Prepare and lead interactions with military customers and industrial players incl. marketing presentations, offer discussions, negotiations, etc.
Lead the whole offer process to propose the best solution to win. Lead the campaign team / ICTs including elaboration of campaign strategy, commercial offer preparation and negotiation.
Consolidate customer understanding to influence internal stakeholders. Drive the ‘Make in India’ vision.
Foster customer loyalty, accountable to represent internally the Voice of the Military Customers and Potential Customers.
Develop strong knowledge of AH’s product portfolio (platform and services) to provide product knowledge and operational credibility during discussions with external stakeholders (military customers, end users…).
While the position is primarily for India, the job may require driving military campaigns / opportunities in other countries part of Airbus Helicopters South Asia perimeter. Competency description Highly energetic, proactive, self-driven, persevering, excellent communication skills & fortitude to build and win business in the complex, long lead time and process driven Indian military business arena. Ability to work in a multi-stakeholder environment. Unimpeachable regard for Ethics & Compliance and internal company processes, values and policies. Ability to build strong professional, mutually respectful relationships with military customers, government stakeholders, understand their expectations by constantly assessing & improving the relationship by actively listening and clarifying their needs, requirements, etc. Ability to provide precise information to respond to customer needs and requirements and articulate a winning value proposition leading into future business / sales potential in order to ensure a successful and sustainable relationship.
Knowledge and understanding of the Indian Military Procurement processes (DPP, DAP, timelines…)
Ability to understand military RFIs / RFPs and prepare comprehensive responses by working with multiple internal stakeholders following due internal processes for it. Ability to clearly and exactly design & write a compelling campaign strategy and proposal, meeting the customer’s needs. Ability to take decisions within the company’s regulation frame-work (guidelines, policies) and amend proposal/contractual documentation to reflect any changes. Ability to analyse risk and plan mitigation.
Knowledge of or ability to understand industrial activities linked to the production of helicopters (development, industrialisation, in-house or externalised production, support & services…)
Ability to develop, propose and implement sales strategy in accordance with commercial objectives. Develop a sales strategy for each campaign to obtain the best commercial outcome to meet the requirement of customer and the company.
Ability to negotiate and influence using reasoned advocacy in order to gain buy-in as well as using facilitation techniques to manage situations of conflict.
Ability to implement applicable company's policies, processes and tools related thereto.
Ability to use and continuously update in-depth knowledge of the company's' products, services and solutions portfolios related to performance, economics, maintenance, design and products and / or services portfolio evolution. Ability to understand technical matters to support confident decision-making, and technically back sales people. Experience & other requirements 10+ years in the aerospace and / or military campaigns and / or complex industrial project management at senior level.
Already exposed to the international business environment. Fluency in English and Hindi. Elektroniker für Geräte und Systeme fertigen Komponenten und Geräte im Bereich der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik für unbemannte Flugsysteme an, nehmen diese in Betrieb und halten sie instand. Sie stellen Muster und Unikate her, wählen die nötigen mechanischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten aus und montieren sie zu Aufklärungs- und Überwachungssystemen oder Raumfahrtsystemen. title: Ausbildung Fachinformatiker Systemintegration (d/m/w) zum 01.09.2027
description_text:
Job Description: Deine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker Systemintegration (d/m/w) zum 01.09.2027
Starte deine Karriere bei Airbus in Ottobrunn! Bist du fasziniert davon, wie Technologie die Geschäftswelt verändert, und möchtest aktiv die Zukunft mitgestalten? Dann ist eine Ausbildung bei Airbus genau das Richtige für dich! Als Fachinformatiker/in in für Systemintegration bist du ein unverzichtbares Bindeglied in unserer IT-Infrastruktur. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme reibungslos laufen, von der Einrichtung neuer Hardware und Software bis zur Betreuung unserer Netzwerke und der Unterstützung unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen. In einer sich ständig weiterentwickelnden digitalen Welt bist du gefragt, wenn es darum geht, komplexe IT-Probleme zu lösen und innovative Lösungen zu implementieren. Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du, wie man moderne Informations- und Kommunikationssysteme plant, installiert und konfiguriert. Du tauchst tief in Themenfelder wie Netzwerkarchitekturen, Betriebssysteme, IT-Sicherheit, Cloud-Technologien und Fehleranalyse ein. Du unterstützt unser Team bei vielfältigen internationalen IT-Projekten und hilfst uns dabei, die digitale Zukunft der Luft- und Raumfahrt zu managen! Dein Standort: Airbus Ottobrunn – Wo deine Ideen fliegen! Stell dir vor: Du bist mitten in Ottobrunn, nur einen Katzensprung von München entfernt, und arbeitest an Technologien, die die Welt verändern. Bei Airbus gestaltest du die Zukunft der Luft- und Raumfahrt – und das in einem mega coolen Umfeld! Nach der Arbeit noch Energie? Kein Problem! Ob beim Sport, gemeinsame Zeit mit Freunden verbringen oder einfach nur das bunte Stadtleben von München genießen – hier findest du immer den perfekten Ausgleich. In Ottobrunn sind wir echte Experten, wenn es um High-Tech-Lösungen geht. Wir entwickeln zum Beispiel: Antriebe für Raketen und Satelliten, die ins All fliegen! Sensoren, die kleinste Details erkennen – egal ob in der Luft oder im Weltraum. Kommunikationssysteme, die dafür sorgen, dass Piloten und Bodenpersonal immer verbunden sind. Systeme zur Aufklärung und Überwachung, die uns helfen, die Welt sicherer zu machen. Kurz gesagt: Bei uns lernst du nicht nur einen Beruf, sondern bist Teil von etwas Großem. Du bist dabei, wenn wir die Technologien von morgen entwickeln – und das direkt vor den Toren Münchens! Durch die Arbeit in kleinen Teams und eine persönliche Betreuung kannst du dich stetig weiterentwickeln und deine Talente optimal einsetzen. Werde Teil unserer AIRzubi Community Bei Airbus bist du nicht allein – du wirst Teil einer großen, starken Community. Wir glauben daran, dass wir gemeinsam am besten sind. Deshalb fördern wir den Austausch untereinander, sei es in Projektteams, bei gemeinsamen Events oder in unseren vielfältigen Sport- und Freizeitgruppen. Du findest schnell Anschluss, knüpfst wichtige Kontakte und erlebst einen starken Zusammenhalt, der dich durch dein Studium begleitet. Vielfältige Praxiseinsätze: Erlebe abwechslungsreiche Ausbildungseinsätze innerhalb des Konzerns, inklusive der Option eines Auslandsaufenthalts. title: VIE 2026 -HR Transversal Management (m/f)
description_text:
Job Description: The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) is a unique international program sponsored by the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Employment, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. The VIE is a specific contract, under Business France’s eligibility criteria. VIE Main Requirements: • European Union citizens (plus Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, and Monaco), graduates up to and including 28 years old • Have fulfilled military obligations for their country, if any For more information: http://www.civiweb.com/international/default.html (in English, German, Italian and Spanish) The contract duration of VIE is between 6 to 24 months. A VIE HR Transversal Management M/F has arisen within Airbus (Commercial Aircraft) / Airbus (Tianjin) Delivery Centre Limited. in Tianjin, China. You will join the Human Resources Department. The core responsibility is to provide comprehensive, high-quality support for decision-making and daily management, while acting as an important coordinator to drive the smooth implementation of transversal HR initiatives and projects. This position requires exceptional organisational and coordination skills, proactive thinking, and a high level of confidentiality. The role will act as a bridge within internal HR Operation functions, driving process optimization and efficiency improvements within the HR Operations team. Your main tasks will include: Prepare for various meetings (including HR team meetings, business reviews, management meetings), prepare meeting materials, draft meeting minutes, and track the follow-up on action items. Follow up on action plans derived from HRBP’s communications with business units to ensure closure. Regularly extract and clean data from HR systems, provide qualitative analysis and raise any risks to different reports ( absenteeism, E&C training, completion, time management etc...). Prepare standardized HR reports, dashboards, or presentations to support decision making. Assist in organizing and facilitating the administrative support for the HR cycle campaigns. Act as a core collaborator for projects such as “Airbus Operations Center” project or other related projects. Assist in planning and coordinating HR related events, training sessions, or cultural initiatives for the team. Champion a culture of continuous improvement within the department, assisting the Head in driving other minor process optimization initiatives. Handle HR team administrative coordination, budget tracking and documentation. This role will involve some travel for business,two times each month in China, and as such you must be able to travel accordingly. Your boarding pass: IMPORTANT: Due to visa requirements, at least 2 years relevant full time non academic work experience is MANDATORY, internships and apprenticeships NOT included! You have the following skills and experience: Education: Master's degree in HR Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields. Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant HR experience. Experience in HRBP, HR Shared Services Center or Project Management. In addition you are capable to demonstrate the following skills: Project Management: proficient in project planning, execution, and monitoring. Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently and deliver under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Data Analysis: proficient in using tools for data consolidation, analysis and visualization. Job Description: Zur Unterstützung der Systemunterstützungszentrum Eurofighter (SUZ EF) sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen SSC Konstrukteur Elektrik-Installationen (d/w/m) Im Systemunterstützungszentrum Eurofighter (SUZ EF), einer Kooperation zwischen Airbus und der deutschen Luftwaffe am Airbus Standort Manching, leisten wir die operative technische und logistische Betreuung für die in Dienst gestellten Eurofighter. Die Bandbreite unserer Kompetenzen macht uns dabei zu einem universellen und einzigartigen Ansprechpartner für die Eurofighter Systembetreuung. Die Tätigkeit umfasst die Erstellung von 3D-Modellen elektrischer Kabelbündel sowie die Definition elektrischer Installations-Bauunterlagen von der Architektur, über die Detaillierungsphase, bis hin zu Fertigungsunterstützung und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen für Modifikationen am Waffensystem Eurofighter der deutschen Luftwaffe. Dabei sind die relevanten Vorschriften, Konstruktionsrichtlinien, Standards, Methoden zu berücksichtigen und CAD-Werkzeuge zu verwenden. Relevante Schnittstellen sind Systemdesign, Fertigung, Zertifizierung, Qualifizierung, Standardisierung und das Nachrüst-Management Eurofighter. Dein Standort Manching ist eine aufstrebende Gemeinde, die ein vielfältiges Freizeit- und Kulturangebot bietet. Hier können Sie Lebensqualität auf dem Land genießen und dennoch die Annehmlichkeiten der nahegelegenen Städte nutzen. description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Commercial recrute !
Nous recherchons un "Solving Leader Master"(H/F) pour rejoindre Airbus Operations SAS en CDI sur le site Louis Breguet prés de TOULOUSE, France. Dans ce rôle à forte exposition, positionné en Grading 15 au sein de l'organisation Quality Management System Wide Body (QLM), vous ne vous contenterez pas de driver et gérer des processus, vous dirigerez des équipes multifonctionnelles dans l'analyse et la résolution de problèmes complexes, en utilisant des compétences data analysis et en favorisant un esprit d'équipe collaboratif. Nous recherchons un véritable leader capable de guider des équipes multifonctionnelles et multidisciplinaires (des MFT) dans des démarches de résolution de problèmes complexes et à forts enjeux.
Un véritable levier de réussite résidera dans la capacité exceptionnelle à influencer et à piloter la dynamique d'équipe sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
En combinant une analyse fine des données (Data Analytics) et des compétences relationnelles de niveau Senior, vous ferez le pont entre l'expertise technique et l'exécution opérationnelle. Vous agirez comme un catalyseur stratégique, transformant les frictions en actions collaboratives, mesurant l'impact des solutions et élevant activement la communauté interne d'Airbus « Solving Community of Practice » Votre environnement de travail :
Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Le poste est à Toulouse centre, sur le site de St ELOI. ( sigle interne de la team : QMYE Machining Parts Quality ) Vos CHALLENGES/MISSIONS : * Diriger et animer des équipes multifonctionnelles (MFT) dédiées à l'identification, à l'analyse et à la résolution de problèmes opérationnels et techniques (9S/8D).
* Appliquer des méthodes rigoureuses d'analyse de problèmes pour comprendre les causes profondes et proposer des solutions efficaces et durables.
* Utiliser des techniques d'analyse de données pour étayer les diagnostics, mesurer l'impact des solutions et optimiser les processus.
* Faciliter la collaboration et la communication au sein de l'équipe, en garantissant une dynamique d'équipe positive et productive.
* Développer et maintenir un esprit d'équipe fort, en encourageant l'échange de connaissances et le soutien mutuel.
* Assurer le suivi des plans d'action et la mise en œuvre des solutions, en mesurant leur efficacité et en capitalisant sur les retours d'expérience.
* Participer activement à la formation et au développement des membres de l'équipe sur les méthodes de résolution de problèmes.
* Être force de proposition pour l'amélioration continue des processus de résolution au sein de l'entreprise.
*Contribuer à la communauté "Solving community of Practice", en soutenant de manière proactive vos pairs. Poste ouvert en Grading 15 - Convention collective de la Métallurgie/Accords d'Entreprise Votre profil/ Votre"Carte d'embarquement" * Parcours issu d'une formation supérieure (ingénieur, master ou équivalent) dans un domaine technique ou scientifique pertinent avec nos enjeux industriels.
* Expérience significative dans la direction d'équipes et la résolution de problèmes complexes, idéalement dans un environnement industriel ou aéronautique. Comme sur des postes tels que : Directeur de Projets Amélioration Continue ou Master Black Belt ou Responsable Lean et Méthodes de Résolution ou
Expert en excellence opérationnelle et amélioration continue dans un secteur industriel....
* Fortes compétences en analyse de problèmes et en méthodologies de résolution (ex: 8D, 5 pourquoi, Ishikawa).
* Capacité avérée à interpréter et à utiliser des données pour la prise de décision (Data analytics). Savoir-être (Qualités interpersonnelles) * Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à influencer et à fédérer des équipes multifonctionnelles.
* Sens aigu de la curiosité et forte motivation pour l'apprentissage continu et l'acquisition de nouvelles compétences.
* Démontre un esprit d'équipe et une capacité à travailler efficacement en collaboration (Team spirit & Team work).
* Compréhension des dynamiques d'équipe et capacité à les gérer pour optimiser la performance (Team Dynamics). Langues : savoir-être (Qualités interpersonnelles) : Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :
Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites.

Your true lever of success will be your outstanding ability to influence and drive team dynamics without direct authority. Combining deep data analytics with senior-level interpersonal skills, you will bridge the gap between technical expertise and operational execution. You will act as a strategic catalyst, transforming friction into collaborative action, measuring impact, and actively elevating Airbus’ internal "Solving Community of Practice." Your Working Environment
As the world capital of aeronautics and the European capital of space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in southwestern France, served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean, and close to the Pyrenees, it offers endless opportunities for outdoor activities! Apply rigorous problem-solving methodologies to thoroughly understand root causes and deliver highly effective, sustainable solutions.

Facilitate seamless collaboration and communication within the team, ensuring a positive, high-performing, and productive team dynamic.

Strong understanding of team dynamics and how to leverage them to optimize collective performance (Team Dynamics). Support the AIT Team in the definition and technical follow-up of the required test systems, in the preparation of system integration and test activities, and in the review of test reports, with especial focus on electrical power, thermal and EMC tests. Support the Quality Team in the investigation of anomalies and non-conformances, providing technical support in NRBs. Elaborate technical documentation, deliver technical presentations, and contribute to technical proposals. Support the project technical reviews (including electrical schematics and analysis), and conduct and lead the technical reviews to equipment suppliers. description_text:
Job Description: In order to support Airbus Defence and Space we are looking for a Master's Thesis Student (d/f/m) in Systems Engineering and Design for the RAFT Lunar Flight Model (Phase B2) You are looking for a master thesis? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the department designation as a Master's student (d/f/m)! Join a high-profile space mission at the forefront of European and International lunar exploration! Airbus Defence and Space, in collaboration with international partners such as ETH Zürich and Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI), is developing RAFT (Regolith Adhesion and Flow Testbed). RAFT is a critical precursor mission designed to deliver the first ground-truth in-situ dataset of lunar regolith flow behavior. This data is essential to validate the UPREB predictive models, which in turn de-risk the Mini-ROXY oxygen extraction plant—a key technology for sustainable human presence on the Moon. Your Mission: Transitioning from Prototype to Flight Hardware

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un ingénieur processus et performance pour rejoindre notre équipe au sein du département Excellence opérationnelle, Manufacturing Engineering, basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez à l'optimisation de la performance industrielle de l’A220. L'équipe pilote la feuille de route (roadmap) d'amélioration et assure le suivi de la performance industrielle transverse (aléas, efficacité, CVAT, rate readiness, etc.). Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels comme aux plus expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne dès maintenant ! ************************************************************************** Job Title: Process and Performance Engineer Job Description Do you have significant experience in industrial engineering or equivalent, have you worked in the manufacturing or aerospace sector, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This position is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft program is seeking a Process and Performance Engineer to join our team within the Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering department based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will work on optimizing the industrial performance of the A220. You will be part of the Process and Performance Engineer team responsible for continuous improvement and operational efficiency. The team leads the Improvement Roadmap and monitors transverse industrial performance (Hazards, Efficiency, CVAT, Rate readiness, etc.). The team organization is set up to promote autonomous cross-functional collaboration, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as a Process and Performance Engineer will be to lead the performance analysis, line balancing (SLB), and improvement roadmaps to optimize series production. Your work environment The headquarters of the A220 commercial aircraft program is located in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, just a stone's throw from the dynamic city of Montreal. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for young or experienced professionals, as well as families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities, making it a truly special place to live. Because we care about you: Financial Benefits: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan, and stock purchase plan. Work/Life Balance: A hybrid work policy (depending on operational needs), an on-site cafeteria, and a very competitive vacation policy. Well-being / Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), discount program, on-site medical service, access to a public shuttle service between Laval (Montmorency metro station) and Mirabel, and a carpooling application. Individual Development: Opportunities for advancement and numerous training possibilities (a catalog of more than 10,000 e-training courses available for free access to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programs, national and international mobility). At Airbus, we help you work, connect, and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we promote flexibility in our working methods to stimulate the spirit of innovation. Your challenges: Evaluate and optimize transverse industrial performance using key indicators (e.g., efficiency, production rate, cycle time, etc.); Design and maintain Standard Line Balancing (SLB) for all production configurations; Generate and publish the final balancing for each aircraft in production; Perform root cause analyses (e.g., Pareto) for hazards and bottlenecks; Propose concrete and measurable action plans to improve process efficiency; Document and manage operational constraints per workstation to optimize planning; Lead the improvement roadmap and REX (Return of Experience) initiatives with the Manufacturing Engineering MFT team; Ensure the link with upstream and downstream workstations and be the point of contact with the EAP (Autonomous Production Team). We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. description_text:

We have opened a position to be part of the team that has successfully developed more than 20 versions of the Fully Integrated Tactical Mission (FITS) for more than 16 different customers around the world. The team is multidisciplinary and highly innovative, facing key challenges in the defense sector. The jobholder will reinforce our software development unit, taking part in embedded software development projects for ISR Mission Systems in L&M (mainly C-295), UAVs, and/or Tankers platforms. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Analyze and Define: Perform the analysis of functional system requirements and define software requirements using DOORS. Design and Model: Model the Software Detailed Design for specific functionalities in UML using Rational Rose. Develop and Code: Implement and code Software Components using C++ and Python. Verify and Validate: Define Software Qualification Tests, validate requirements, and execute Unit, Component, and Integration Tests. Manage Configuration: Handle software components configuration via GIT and/or CVS, and manage problem resolution (Change Proposals/bugs) in JIRA. Act as Focal Point: Coordinate with the rest of the organization regarding assigned functionalities, providing problem analysis, support, and improvement ideas. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Educated in a Computer Science, Telecommunication, Industrial Engineering degree, or equivalent discipline. Between 2 and 5 years of proven experience in C/C++ development, Software Design with UML, Software Verification, Requirements Management, and Software Configuration/problem tracking. Experience in local network configuration and knowledge of network protocols is also required. Soft skills: Willingness to develop yourself, grow, learn, and maintain a proactive mindset. Languages: Negotiation level of English and Spanish (mandatory). Technical knowledge: Embedded systems tools, DOORS, Rational Rose, CVS/GIT, and JIRA. Specific Requirement: Be in a position to obtain Security Personal Clearance up to NATO/OCCAR SECRET. description_text:
Job Description: #DIGITAL CAMPUS - IAM IT Operation and Service Manager An opportunity for an IT Operation and Service Manager has arisen within Airbus Helicopters (Albacete, Spain) WHY JOIN US? 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast. Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. ✨THE PROJECT: SHAPING THE FUTURE - Welcome to the Digital Campus, a pioneering ecosystem dedicated to industrial digitalization and innovation. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight. Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. DESCRIPTION We are looking for an IAM IT Operations and Service Manager to join the Identity and Access Management PSL (Product Service Line) in Albacete, Spain. IAM PSL is part of IM (Information Management), in the Infrastructures & Digital Platforms department. Identity and Access Management (IAM) products enable our internal and external users to be properly identified, authenticated & authorized to access Airbus Helicopters and Airbus Group Applications. The AH IAM PSL delivers and deploys the solution, products and services with an end-to-end accountability. We will manage the products lifecycle, both developing the products and operating them, in close relationships with Airbus Group. Our Access IT products sustain Authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Encryption and digital certificates. And our Identity IT Products sustain User management (Provisionning/Deprovisionning, Privileged accounts, Recertification, …) and Directory services (Identity Directory, Metadata Synchronization, …) The IAM IT Products are mainly : PingIdentity products (PingFederate and PingID), F5 Big-IP and Microsoft PKI for Access. And Active Directory, Identity Management, OneLogin for Identity. Automation is running on Ansible; Cyber IAM is based on Oradad, PingCastle and Silvefort; Incident and Change management on Service NOW. The compliance dashboard uses Palantir Foundry. You will be welcome in a dynamic and empowered team, within an international context, where teamwork and solidarity are key values. YOUR CHALLENGES The role of an Identity and Access Management IT operator is to work with IM Airbus Helicopters organization. Your job will be to act as Access IT Operation specialist and you will be the backup of the Access Products Managers when required. The scope to be covered is the technical and functional management of the Products: F5, PingID & Pingfederate applications, PKI and password manager. Your job will be split in 4 main domains of activities: Support, Automation, Reporting and CyberIAM. You will perform these 4 domains of activities for the Mother Company mainly, but you could also cover the Customer Center. It will lead to the delivery of the following IM services: Support & RUN Operations: Performs the ITIL based support processes that include incident, problem, change, configuration, and event management. Analyses error messages, diagnoses system failures and takes corrective action in order to ensure continuity of operations, escalating to other technical teams (L3) and vendors as needed. Perform the daily check (anticipation), perform the troubleshooting, and propose, follow and perform improvement on known processes Covered all activities and operational tasks for all restricted perimeter. Technical Support & Operations Management Act as the technical backup for the F5 and Access Product Managers. Perform or lead change executions on Access Products with external administrators. Automation: Perform and maintain scripting; develop and maintain the automated tasks Monitors automated tasks, notify in case of issues and resolve automation incidents. Reporting & CyberIAM: Monitor system logs and alerts, investigating and responding to potential security incidents in a timely manner. Perform the daily request, perform the troubleshooting on Analytics Dashboard dedicated to the targeted Customer Center, and Mother Company. Communicates improvement, updates and obsolescence management of products to the Customer Centers local IT. SKILLS Master's degree level (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 0 to 3 years of experience as an IT Operator or System&Network Administrator. Ideally, experience in Identity and Access Management in an industrial context. Knowledge of the ITIL framework (ServiceNow experience is a plus). Knowledge of modern authentication & authorization concepts and protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, RADIUS, MFA). Basic understanding of networking and application delivery (F5 BIG-IP concepts: VIPs, Pools, SNAT, SSL/TLS certificate management, and HTTP traffic analysis ). Knowledge of scripting and automation languages (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible) and familiarity with Java syntax for OGNL expressions) Self-driven, motivated, constantly learning on the job and creative. Ability to act both autonomously and as a strong team player. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Team spirit and good relationship, as well as service spirit and accountability are key values for this job position Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and provide effective solutions. Fluent English, French is a plus. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (Apróx. 35 days per year in total). Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working: we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. description_text:
Job Description: Location: Getafe (Madrid), Spain Duration of the Contract: Limited contract linked to the deliverable of the demonstrator ( end of December 2028) , starting ASAP. At Airbus UpNext, we fly future technologies at speed. We aren’t interested in the status quo; we’re building a new demonstrator that will enable safe, autonomous UAS operations in the world’s most challenging environments. Your mission? To build the "Matrix" for our aircraft. You will define and lead the Simulation and Virtual Engineering ecosystem, creating high-fidelity, distributed environments where autonomy functions are born, tested, and perfected long before they ever touch the runway. Your Mission: The Master of Virtual Realities As the Simulation & Virtual Engineering Lead, you are the architect of digital continuity. You will bridge the gap between abstract models and real-time flight data, ensuring that our virtual testing is so accurate that flight tests become a mere formality. What You’ll Own: Distributed Virtual Engineering: You’ll design a scalable simulation ecosystem (SIL, HIL, Hybrid) where simulators and real hardware operate in perfect harmony using standards like HLA, DDS, or ARINC 610. LVC (Live, Virtual, Constructive): You’ll lead the charge in combining real systems with high-fidelity "constructive" entities, allowing crewed and uncrewed assets to interact in complex mission scenarios. Model-Based Mastery: Utilizing Simulink, you’ll ensure a seamless flow from system design to auto-generated embedded code—maintaining total digital continuity. The "Digital Twin" Backbone: Oversee the development of high-fidelity models for flight dynamics, propulsion, and sensors, ensuring they behave exactly like their physical counterparts. Observability & Insight: You’ll build the "Dashboard of Truth," integrating telemetry and onboard data streams using tools like Grafana and InfluxDB to provide real-time visibility into system behavior. CI/CD Simulation Toolchain: Own the infrastructure that orchestrates massive simulation workloads, ensuring every line of code is automatically validated across MIL, SIL, and PIL environments. Your Boarding Pass The Simulation Architect: Deep expertise in distributed frameworks and real-time simulation architectures. Model-Based Pro: Expert-level experience with Simulink and auto-code generation for embedded systems. Systems Thinker: Proven ability to model complex physical systems (GNC, actuators, sensors) and integrate them into RTOS-based environments. Network Savvy: Solid knowledge of IP networking, synchronization, and latency management across interconnected systems. Leadership & Vision: A background in leading multidisciplinary teams and translating high-level objectives into a concrete technical roadmap. The UpNext Mindset: An "impatience for results," a healthy skepticism for slow progress, and a burning desire to attain goals rapidly in an agile environment. Why Join the UpNext Crew?
🚀 Frontier Technology: Work at the absolute edge of UAS autonomy and simulation-driven V&V strategy. 💎 Legacy Assets: Your virtual environments will become high-value assets that shape how Airbus designs and certifies aircraft for years to come. 💡 Startup Soul, Global Muscle: Benefit from the fast-paced, "test-and-fail-fast" culture of a startup, backed by the legendary expertise of Airbus. 🤝 Elite Culture: Join a high-achieving, fun-loving team in Getafe that lives by the "Care for Each Other" value. ⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Design your own calendar with flexible hours and remote work options. ☕ The Fuel: Stay sharp with complimentary freshly ground coffee, premium beverages, and regular community bonding events. In our agile world, the technical scope will evolve as the demonstrator takes shape. We need a leader who is ready to step out of their comfort zone, take initiative, and have fun while disrupting an industry. Ready to build the virtual future of flight? Apply now. In doing so, it is actively shaping the future of the aerospace industry. Designed as a talent incubator, Airbus UpNext is a place where you can act and think like a startup while building on the strong expertise of Airbus, a place where you are empowered to test & challenge new processes and ways of working. Airbus UpNext’s demonstrators evaluate, mature and validate potential new products and services that encompass radical technological breakthroughs. title: Test Technician
description_text:
Job Description: Test Technicians are part of the Production Tests Team. Under supervision of the Production Tests Team Leader, Test Technicians are responsible for the test procedures update, and the execution and reporting of the board / equipment level tests. Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. Core activities 1.- Test procedures: For each verification test activity conducted at the board / equipment level, test procedures shall be updated describing the test objectives, test configuration and setups, instrumentation step by step description and success criteria. Test procedures are derived of Test Plan prepared by a Technical Manager. 2.- Test execution: Test technician shall have ready several jigs and tooling fixtures for test execution to be performed in collaboration with test senior technicians / test engineesr (first models until knowledge transfer has been completed)
Test execution demands high level of concentration and care for handling and operating the deliverable product. Furthermore, this work has to be done under tight schedule and, very often, customer pressure.
Some projects can ask test execution in double shift, during all campaign or partially. Therefore, temporarily, it shall be necessary to work in the evening shift / weekends.
Test technician is in charge of raising NCRs during board test execution. 3.- Test reporting: After each unit verification activity, a test report shall be submitted. Reports shall describe the most significant results, measured parameters comparisons vs requirements or allocations, and degree in which the initial objectives were accomplished. The job allocation requested is in evening shift from Monday to Friday Professional background required At least 2 years of testing and reporting in hardware, at component boards, in space, aircrafts, or military fields. Candidates must demonstrate skills in handling instrumentation (oscilloscope, logic and spectrum analyzer, multimeter, generator, etc). Job Description: Description: A vacancy for a Network & Security Engineer (CCN-STIC/ENS) has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space Military Aircraft Weapon Systems CoC in Madrid Area. University Degree level in Computer Engineering, Telecommunication, Aeronautical or Cybersecurity. Minimum 3 years of experience in administration and security of local and private network.

description_text:
