title: Airbus Protect Architecte Cybersécurité Produit (All Gender)
description_text:
Job Description: Chez Airbus Protect au sein des B.U.s Cybersecurity Consulting & Managed Services, nos équipes de près de 600 spécialistes fournissent des capacités de cybersécurité à forte valeur ajoutée aux industries de l'aérospatiale, des infrastructures critiques, des transports et au-delà. We are Airbus ! Ce qui signifie que notre ADN est enraciné dans la cybersécurité des produits critiques ; nous avons développé des compétences uniques pour accompagner nos clients dans la sécurisation de leurs systèmes d'information, de leur environnement industriel, de leurs données et de leurs propres ressources pour une plus grande cyber-résilience. Au sein de nos équipes, l’Architecte Cybersécurité Produit s’assure que les choix techniques pour les produits réalisés et commercialisés par nos clients atteignent un niveau de sécurité satisfaisant tout au long du cycle de vie de ces produits. Vous serez amenés à diffuser votre savoir-faire dans des domaines comme l’aviation, le spatial, la défense, l’automobile ou encore le ferroviaire et à faire cohabiter des fonctions critiques telles que la sûreté de fonctionnement et la Cybersécurité. Missions & Responsabilités Vos activités d’Architecte Cybersécurité Produit seront articulées autour de 4 thématiques principales : Conception Établir la stratégie des architectures de sécurité des produits en lien avec la stratégie globale métier et contribuer à la déclinaison des principes du modèle de sécurité globale Définir et appliquer des modèles de référence pour les architectures embarquées ou des systèmes critiques Contribuer à la déclinaison des exigences de sécurité tout au long du cycle de développement et de raffinement des produits. Préconisation Accompagner les projets dans le design de l’architecture, spécifier les différents paramétrages et définir les exigences techniques de sécurité pour répondre aux besoins de sécurité identifiés en amont pendant les phases d’analyse de risque. Conseiller sur le choix des solutions techniques et préconiser des architectures sécurisées pour le ou les produits étudiés; s’assurer de sa conformité réglementaire le cas échéant Définir les stratégies de tests de validation sécurité, veiller à leur déclinaison en procédure de test et évaluer les résultats des campagnes de tests. Une fois le produit mis en service, revoir régulièrement l’architecture existante, identifier les vulnérabilités et leurs impacts sur le produit en service et faire des recommandations vis-à- vis de leur traitement. Conseil ​ Assurer une veille technologique et en tenir compte dans la définition des architectures de sécurité Analyser les risques de sécurité liés à l’introduction de nouvelles fonctionnalités et technologies dans les produits Conseiller sur l’utilisation et la combinaison des briques de sécurité. Communication Contribuer à la montée en maturité en matière de sécurité des produits des architectes techniques. Collaborer avec les Concepteurs de systèmes (dont les objectifs sont de réaliser la conception et l’architecture matérielle et logicielles de calculateurs, ordinateurs et systèmes embarqués dans le produit) afin de consolider une vue globale de la sécurité Les compétences qui comptent pour nous: Vous êtes diplômé d’école d'ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la cybersécurité, OU vous avez une expérience significative en cybersécurité. Vous avez une expérience a minima de 10 ans dans la sécurité produit et avez travaillé sur des projets majeurs dans un ou plusieurs secteurs d’activité (aviation, spatial, défense, automobile ou encore le ferroviaire) Vous connaissez les bases d’autres métiers connexes aux métiers de la sécurité défensive (Gestion des risques, Audit, Développement logiciel, Pentest, Gestion de projet, Sales, etc.) Vous savez mettre en œuvre les principes de la sécurité défensive et apporter une vision critique à des mises en œuvres existantes. En particulier, vous savez mettre en avant des compétences avancées dans certaines des thématiques suivantes: Méthodes de conception, Ingénierie Système et sécurité Conception d’architecture sécurisées Cryptographie Sécurité des réseaux et protocoles de communication Des compétences dans l’un des domaines suivant sont également un plus (optionnel): Sécurité dans les systèmes d’exploitation Configuration de produits de sécurité et durcissement Gestion des identités et droits d’accès (IAM) Audit et gestion des incidents Analyse de risques Qualités : Ce que vous apporterez à votre future équipe Capable de travailler en transverse au sein de l’organisation, vous accompagnez techniquement des profils plus junior que vous. Vous avez un esprit curieux et dynamique. Vous savez vous adapter à différentes situations, et vous êtes autonome dans vos missions. Vous avez développé des compétences autour du leadership, de la confiance en soi et du partage; Vous êtes capable de fournir du support sur des standards et réglementations de sécurité et sur leur intérêt et mise en application. Vous avez une appétence pour des mises en situation de conseil à forte valeur ajoutée pour du top management et/ou pour des missions d’expertise sur des sujets techniquement complexes. Enfin, nous apportons également une importance toute particulière à votre développement technique, à l’expertise et à l’esprit d’équipe dans nos centres de compétences. Vous intégrerez donc les communautés techniques dont les objectifs sont de créer cet esprit, diffuser le savoir et faire phosphorer vos idées! En tant que profil senior nous porterons aussi une attention particulière à la transmission du savoir envers vos pairs et à la capitalisation technique, mais aussi à la valorisation de vos savoirs faire dans des contextes nationaux et internationaux (articles, publications en conférence, groupes de travail, etat de l’art, suivi de sujets de thèses, etc.). Si vous êtes force de propositions, nous nous engageons à vous accompagner dans la concrétisation de vos idées! Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment, an advanced english level is mandatory. Airbus Protect c’est aussi… Un management de proximité et à l’écoute Un parcours de carrière adapté à vos aspirations (formation, plan de développement…) Accords sur la diversité, l'inclusion et le handicap Prime d’intéressement et de participation Plan d’actionnariat salarié et d’épargne salariale Télétravail : Jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine Politique de temps de travail adaptable à l’équilibre vie pro/perso (forfait jour réduit) Congés calculés sur l’année civile, déblocage dès le 1er jour du contrat. Entretien technique avec le manager. Entretien avec le/la Chargé(e) de Recrutement. Un feedback personnalisé après le processus Votre poste sera basé à… Blagnac Le site d’Airbus Protect à Blagnac est un pôle dynamique dédié à la cybersécurité, la safety et la sustainability. Située à proximité de Toulouse, la ville de Blagnac offre une riche diversité culturelle et gastronomique, avec de nombreux restaurants, boutiques et événements locaux. Ce mélange d'innovation, de nature et de culture fait d'Airbus Protect à Blagnac un lieu de travail attrayant et inspirant. title: Telephony & Conferencing Tools Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: ACCOUNTABILITY Telephony &Video Conference Design & Architecture: Collaborate with global IT teams and business units to design and evolve complex, secure, and resilient IP telephony and video conferencing architectures for Airbus's worldwide operations. Develop and maintain technical blueprints, design documents, and standards for Unified Communications (UC) solutions. Conduct advanced capacity planning, performance analysis, and optimization for large-scale voice, video, and collaboration environments, Cisco WebEx, Google Meet and weblive by proactively optimizing capacity and performance high QoS. Administer the company’s Workspace ONE platform, develop, deploy, and enforce security policies, profiles, and configurations for iOS devices. Manage device enrollment, retirement, and remote wiping for lost or stolen devices Advanced Implementation & Deployment: Lead the installation, configuration, and migration of Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Unity Connection, Cisco Expressway (C/E), Cisco Meeting Server (CMS), Voice Gateways, and other critical UC components. Deploy and manage advanced video conferencing rooms (e.g., WebEx Room Kit, Google Meeting Hardware), cloud-based conferencing services (e.g., Webex Meetings, Google Meet, liveStream, webinar, securemeeting), and their integration with on-premise infrastructure. Implement and manage complex SIP Trunking, E.164 dial plans, and global call routing strategies across multiple geographic locations and disparate systems. Drive integration of UC systems with enterprise applications (e.g., Active Directory, contact center solutions like UCCX). Serve as the primary point of contact for all mobile device-related issues, including hardware, software, and connectivity problems. Operation, Maintenance & Incident Management: Perform expert-level administration, monitoring, and proactive maintenance of telephony and conferencing infrastructure. Manage and optimize global dial plans, user provisioning, and advanced feature configurations. Utilize advanced monitoring tools (e.g., Cisco RTMT, network analysis tools like Wireshark) to identify, diagnose, and resolve complex voice/video quality and connectivity issues. Act as a top-tier (Tier 3) escalation point for critical incidents, leading problem resolution efforts in a high-pressure, mission-critical environment. Execute regular system maintenance, including complex patching, security updates, and major version upgrades with minimal disruption to business operations. Security & Compliance: Implement and enforce stringent security measures for voice and video communications, aligning with Airbus's internal security policies, industry regulations and data privacy standards. Manage certificates, encryption, and secure communication protocols (e.g., TLS, SRTP) across the UC ecosystem Ensure all mobile devices comply with company security policies and industry regulations. Documentation, Knowledge Transfer & Training: Create and maintain comprehensive, high-quality technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Provide expert-level knowledge transfer and training to internal IT teams and key business users. Technology Evaluation & Innovation: Continuously research, evaluate, and recommend new voice and video technologies, collaboration tools, and industry best practices relevant to Airbus's evolving needs. Engage with leading UC vendors (especially Cisco) on product roadmaps, support cases, and strategic partnerships. Contribute to strategic planning for the future of Airbus's global collaboration landscape, including cloud adoption strategies (UCaaS/CCaaS). Project Management Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that support business objectives in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders. Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Create and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures and ensuring projects are delivered within financial guidelines. QUALIFICATION EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field. EXPERIENCE: 8-10+ years of progressive experience, on enterprise-level IT of a MNC company, with at least 5-7 years in a senior engineering role focused specifically on Unified Communications (UC) and video conferencing. CERTIFICATION: Highly Desirable: Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Collaboration or higher (CCIE Collaboration). Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing complex technical projects, including planning, resource allocation, budget tracking, and stakeholder communication. Contact Center: Familiarity with contact center technologies like Cisco UCCX or UCCE. Cloud Strategy: Experience with UCaaS/CCaaS evaluation and cloud migration strategies. Other relevant certification on IT service delivery management (e.g., ITIL, PMP) are a plus LANGUAGE: fluent English both in written and oral speaking KNOWLEDGE / TECHNICAL SKILLS: Cisco UC Expertise: Expert-level, hands-on experience designing, implementing, and managing the core Cisco Unified Communications suite, including: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) Cisco Unity Connection Cisco Expressway Series (C & E) for MRA and B2B Cisco Meeting Server (CMS) Voice Gateways (ISDN/SIP) and Cube/SBCs b. In-depth understanding and practical experience with voice and video protocols: SIP, H.323, RTP, SRTP, SCCP, MGCP, QoS (DiffServ, RSVP), DTMF. Collaboration Platforms: Proven experience administering and integrating large-scale cloud collaboration platforms such as Cisco Webex (Meetings, RoomOS, Control Hub, live streaming) and Google Workspace (Google Meet, Google Meeting Hardware). Mobile Device Management (MDM/UEM): Demonstrable experience administering VMware Workspace ONE, specifically for managing and securing a fleet of iOS devices in a corporate environment. Networking & Protocols: Deep understanding of IP networking, including QoS, VLANs, and the protocols essential for real-time communication (SIP, H.323, RTP, SRTP, TLS, E.164). Proficiency with network analysis tools like Wireshark. Tier 3 Support: Proven track record acting as a final escalation point (Tier 3) for resolving complex and critical incidents in a high-pressure, global enterprise environment. ABILITIES: Architectural Mindset: Ability to think strategically and translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical designs and blueprints. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Superior ability to diagnose and resolve complex, multi-faceted technical issues under pressure. Project Leadership: Capable of leading technical projects, coordinating with global teams, and driving initiatives from conception to completion. Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior management. Documentation Skills: Meticulous attention to detail in creating and maintaining high-quality technical documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures. Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional global teams, business units, and vendors to achieve common goals. title: Training Services Team : Training Compliance Assistant
description_text:
Job Description: To maintain full compliance with TCI and TCE qualification requirements through the structured management of mandatory recurrent training and quality assurance oversight, ensuring that all certifications and records meet applicable regulatory standards. Responsibilities Plan TCI/TCE biannual and annual training schedules in coordination with fleet schedulers, based on each instructor’s base month. Implement TCI Initial and Requalification training in accordance with fleet schedulers’ plans, ensuring mutual confirmation of course assignments and schedules. Manage scheduling for the Initial and Recurrent qualification checks for KMLIT-designated examiners. Communicate training schedules to instructors and provide timely updates on any changes. Manage and monitor the execution of individual instructors’ training schedules. Oversee and maintain instructors’ training records in compliance with MLIT standards, ATO requirements, and company policy. Coordinate Visa and Alien Registration processes for all foreign independent contractors in compliance with Korean Immigration Office requirements. Perform other duties as assigned by team members, the RA&C manager, or the HoTS. Coordinate with schedulers regarding instructor training requirement and scheduling matters. Support the preparation of training-related reports and documentation, as required. Contribute to the monitoring and improvement of training quality standards and internal procedures. Support administrative tasks for instructor qualification management, including data entry, record verification, and document control. Support audits, inspections, and evaluations related to instructor training qualification management. Personal Skills Detail-oriented: Accurately manage training schedules, records, and reports. Organizational Skills: Coordinate biannual and annual training schedules across multiple instructors’ calendars. Document management: Proficient in organizing, maintaining, and tracking documentation efficiently, experienced in using web-based platforms, including Google Workspace and AppSheet. Analytical Thinking: Review records and training quality data to identify issues and suggest improvements. Reliability & Accountability: Take ownership of maintaining compliance and certification requirements. title: Operational Tester (Command+ Hub)
description_text:
Job Description: Summary This position is to join the Operational Testing team in Bangkok as an operational tester for Navblue Command+ Hub product. The Operational Testing team mission is to implement and run tests at an operational level, meaning using the Navblue products as they are used in Airlines by our customers. This step of operational End to End testing is the last step before quality gate for delivery to customers. The activity will be driven by the developments done by Software Factory teams working in SAFe methodology in different Agile Release Trains. Based on Program Increment (PI) content, the Operational Testing Team will coordinate with Agile development teams to get inputs on functional changes that will need to be tested. The main responsibility of the team will be to implement and run the operational End to End tests. This position is related to the Navblue Flight Efficiency Product, being Command+ Hub product. The Operational testing team reports locally to the Head Of System Integration team in BKK and operationally to the Head of Operational maturity. Responsibilities: Coordinate with Command+ Subject Matter Experts to write operational use cases testing scenarios. Run the Operational testing scenario Update existing testing scenarios and scripts for new functionality implemented. Coordinate with the Product Manager and Subject Matter Experts to understand the scope of the new functionalities implemented. Coordinates with Release Management for different products to establish a testing planning, with the support of the HO maturity. Manage test datasets (creation, update) needed for the operational testing phase. Write and update defects found and join the different reviews to prioritize and explain seen defects. Write Operational tests results for each version/build tested, in response to a test order delivered by the Product Manager. Ensure cross team communication (escalation if inputs not received, synchronisation meeting with Product Manager or Subject Matter experts, …) Support the continuous improvement initiatives within the organization. Support adhoc project initiatives in the organization especially during non release periods. Academic/Educational Requirements Bachelor degree in aeronautical, aerospace or appropriate field with equivalent work experience Aviation/Aeronautical knowledge Required Skills/Experience 3 to 5 years’ experience working in an airline as Dispatcher Knowledge of Navblue products (N-Flight Planning) is an asset Proficiency in English spoken and written Understanding of airline operations, flight planning, or air navigation principles Passion for the aviation industry Must work effectively with others in a team environment Proactive, problem solver with effective interpersonal and communication skills Able to effectively communicate, both verbally and written Ability to manage through a period of growth or transition a definite asset Excellent organizational and time management skills. title: Électricien / Mécanicien Piste  (h/f)
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Electricien/Mécanicien Piste (h/f) pour rejoindre notre équipe Customer Line (Flight Line & Delivery Center) basée à Toulouse, France. Vous travaillerez majoritairement en extérieur, sur piste, au plus proche des avions. En tant que Mécanicien/Électricien piste, vous interviendrez sur l’avionique, les systèmes électriques et mécaniques ainsi que sur la génération, la distribution et l’utilisation des différentes énergies embarquées (mécanique, électrique, hydraulique, pneumatique…). Vous rejoindrez l'une de nos Flight Line programme (Famille A320, A330 ou A350) ou notre Centre de livraison (Airbus Delivery Center) qui est multiprogrammes. Votre environnement de travail : Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Responsabilidades: Efectuar todos los trabajos de mantenimiento asignados por su jerarquía, en los helicópteros, sus componentes, sub-componentes, sus sistemas ó tareas específicas según sea el caso. Tareas que surgen por servicio, boletines, directivas de aeronavegabilidad, instrucciones técnicas y suplementarias así como corrección de discrepancias. Efectuar todos los trabajos asignados bajo los procedimientos y documentación técnica que marcan el fabricante y las autoridades aeronáuticas aplicables siempre cubriendo las normas de seguridad y calidad especificadas. Contar con la licencia vigente expedida por la autoridad aeronáutica de: técnico de mantenimiento clase II con certificado de capacidad en Laministeria y recubrimientos aeronáuticos. Identificar las partes, herramientas y tiempo estimado para la realización de las actividades de mantenimiento, mediante el levantamiento correcto de las discrepancias. Conocer y aplicar correctamente en su totalidad las técnicas estándar emitidas por el fabricante en cada actividad que realice; torques, frenados, procedimientos de reparación, tratamientos térmicos, etc. Deberá conocer y cumplir las normas, políticas y objetivos emitidos por la autoridad aeronáutica, del fabricante y de la empresa, así como las políticas del sistema de calidad que en ella se aplican. title: C295 Customer Inspection, Configuration Control & Documentation Manager
description_text:
Job Description: Job Title: C295 Customer Inspection, Configuration Control & Documentation Manager Job Description: Customer facing role, willing to learn and improve documentation and processes. The person selected for the job position will be responsible for: contributing to investigations and root cause analysis into reported quality / quality technical issues from the business team and customer. ensuring appropriate containment and archiving, corrective and curative action is taken by the accountable function through multifunctional teams. performing Quality Inspections as per defined standards, Final Check and Attestation, Stop Points, Out of sequence work, including critical activities (when not delegated). actively participating in process improvements. preparing, reviewing and delivering Aircraft documentation to the customer. managing and reviewing Constituent Assembly Inspection Reports (CAIR) / Aircraft Inspection Report (AIR) status to follow up configuration status at aircraft level. providing visibility of aircraft conformity status for main milestones (customer acceptance manual flights, delivery, ferry). attesting Modifications as Quality profile. collecting & analysing aircraft maintenance status during the production phase. Main Accountability: Inspect, attest and conduct surveillance Conduct Problem solving Prevent Foreign Object Damage/Debris (FOD) Manage Non conformities as appropriate Be the go-to person on the shop floor for Quality issues Carry out Improvement, Prediction and Coaching as appropriate Ensure that the aircraft built status is in line with "as-defined" aircraft Detect , analyse and solve any discrepancies at aircraft level in strong coordination with internal departments Check the conformity status of the CAIRs / SAP/ Control Report integrated in the aircraft. Deliver on time and on quality the Attestation Report at every industrial milestone Collect, control and provide to the aircraft conformity managers and aircraft certifying staff the Attestation Report and associated documents at every milestone Support the Permit to Fly process Collect all the Flight Operations Transfer documentation Create aircraft documentation for delivery (Engine & Propeller Book) Control the Aircraft Modification Status Support during internal & external Audit Prepare Aircraft Ferry Flight documentation. Create the aircraft limit time components. Control the aircraft maintenance program during part 21. Control the Aircraft´s AOL (All Operators Letter) / AOT (Alert Operators Transmission) / SIL (Service Information Letter) / SB (Service Bulletin). Support to the Authority on all issues related to configuration and documentation during the Final Assembly & Flight Line process. Ensure the embodiment of new requirements received from the Authority. Provide continuous support to Customer Services for delivered aircraft. Review the conformity of the product according to company procedures and following the applicable regulation, the authorities' requests and the contract requirements. Manage KPIs. Promote quality and improve culture. Cascade and ensure lessons learned and Configuration Conformity Management & Documentation process optimization. Drumbeat and pilot the conformity and attestation teams under his/her scope. Requirements: Aeronautical Engineer (or equivalent engineering qualification) is required More than 5 years experience in Quality and/ or configuration control Fluent English Fluency in Spanish is preferred Experience in C295 quality is preferred Experience in Flight Line and Delivery Center is preferred Familiar with Aircraft Inspection concepts Familiar with Production Quality principles This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe d’une trentaine de personnes dont la mission est de concevoir, prototyper, développer et industrialiser des solutions logicielles innovantes pour le pilotage et la gestion intelligente et dynamique d’infrastructures de communications militaires (planification, pilotage et supervision dans les milieux tactiques et MILSATCOM). Mêlant des activités de développements et de démonstrations. Vous évoluerez en interactions fortes avec les différents Architectes du projet ainsi qu’avec le responsable des développements. Pour en savoir plus sur nos activités, regardez notre site : https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/connectivity Ce poste nécessitera une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessitera d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Le candidat doit avoir la nationalité française conformément à l'IGI 1300 du 9 août 2021 (§ 1.2.2.1). Votre environnement de travail : A deux pas du Château de Versailles et située à proximité de Paris, Elancourt est une ville dynamique, faisant partie de l'agglomération de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. La ville propose diverses activités culturelles et de plein air grâce à un riche réseau d'associations. Plusieurs options sont disponibles pour se rendre sur le site d'Airbus par les transports en commun. Job Description: ​In order to support Air Power Engineering, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Flight Test Safety (SMS) Manager (d/f/m) Shape the Future of Aviation Safety – Join Our Team! Are you passionate about aviation and eager to make a significant impact on the safety of flight and ground tests? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you! Our Flight and Integration Test Centre (FITC) is looking for a dedicated Flight Test Safety (SMS) Manager (d/f/m). In this pivotal role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the safety of our personnel and materials. Join our international team and work across our sites in Manching, Getafe, and Sevilla. Your location Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. Your tasks and responsibilities Proactively prevent accidents and incidents, identify potential hazards, and mitigate related risks. Implement, operate, and maintain the Safety Management System (SMS) in collaboration with various internal organizations. Serve as the direct point of contact and responsible party for UK MAA Regulatory Articles regarding Aviation Safety regulations. Manage the internal Safety Group, review and contribute to the internal SMS Manual, and support investigations. Handle Hazard and Event Reports within the FITC perimeter, ensure proper investigation and potential escalation, and conduct Predictive Hazard and Risk Assessments. Maintain and develop Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs), keep statistics to identify trends, and support internal and external audits related to DOA and FITC. Stay updated on new trends and procedures in Safety Management from external sources. Ensure constant Safety Awareness through regular Safety Messages, Safety Awareness sessions, Lessons Learned meetings, and required training for all Safety Group members. Support Airbus Group-wide Safety promotion campaigns. Desired skills and qualifications You will offer: Strong proactive and ethical attitude to improve and maintain the Safety Culture within the FITC. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team. Excellent communication skills, both written and oral. Understanding of external and internal safety regulation frameworks, including hazard identification and risk mitigation for Flight Test Operations. You benefit from: Minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a Flight Test Organization, preferably with a military aviation background, as a test pilot or with an engineering degree with first-hand experience in flight test techniques and procedures. Graduate of a recognized Test Pilot School. Understanding of technical issues for a diverse fleet of test aircraft (combat, tactical transport, and tanker aircraft). Formal SMS training or education. Engineering experience within a Design Organization. Understanding of Airbus DS internal working structures and organization. Experience in designing and publishing Safety promotion materials. Knowledge of auditing and DOA framework. Experience in flight operations within a Flight Test Department, preferably with a military background. Knowledge of Human Factors and Crew Resource Management, both in theory and practice. Experience in investigation techniques and understanding of the confidentiality of safety data. Willingness to travel for business. Negotiation-level English, German and/or Spanish is beneficial. Proficiency in MS Office and Google Suite tools. Not a 100% match? No worries! Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. Internship Job Description: We are looking for a motivated Master’s student or recent graduate to join the Business & Product Development team within Airbus Defence and Space, supporting key military aircraft platforms such as A330 MRTT, C295 and Airbus Derivatives. This trainee role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of programme management, product strategy, business development, engineering coordination and industrial execution. The candidate will contribute to the monitoring and coordination of strategic activities related to programme performance, development milestones, supplier follow-up, contract status, services readiness and customer-facing deliverables. Main activities The trainee will support the TAMD team in a broad set of business, product development and programme management activities, including: Maintain and update the bidding calendar for C295, A330 MRTT and Airbus Derivatives opportunities, ensuring key milestones, deliverables and decision points are properly tracked.
Perform data crunching and structured analysis of past offers for C295 and MRTT, extracting lessons learned, recurring patterns, cost drivers, competitive insights and improvement opportunities for future campaigns.
Support the creation of a TAMD Visual Management system, acting as a light PMO-type support to follow up key projects, actions, risks, milestones and priorities across the department.
Contribute to the TAM Transformation project, particularly the initiative focused on creating a framework to capture, assess and promote R&D projects, helping structure ideas, priorities, business cases and decision material.
Prepare and maintain R&D dossiers, including project summaries, status updates, value proposition, expected benefits, maturity level, budget assumptions and links with product roadmaps.
Support the preparation of internal governance meetings, including action tracking, presentation material, dashboards and follow-up of decisions across Business Development, Product Development, Engineering, Programmes, Services and Finance.
Help improve transparency and decision-making by organising information, consolidating inputs from different stakeholders and producing clear executive-level outputs.
Contribute to capability roadmap and product policy activities, supporting the identification of future developments, upgrades and competitiveness improvements for C295, MRTT and Airbus Derivatives. What the trainee will gain The trainee will gain direct exposure to real strategic aircraft programmes, learn how major defence platforms are managed, and contribute to high-impact activities involving customers, suppliers, engineering teams and senior management. This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential candidate who wants to develop a career in aerospace, defence, programme management, product development or business strategy. title: System Engineer  - Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA) Architect
description_text:
Job Description: New projects in Air Power impose strong demands for optimizing the computing resources that host functionality of aircraft systems, as well as the physical means of conveying their functional exchanges. This need for optimization is responded by the move from the paradigm of dedicated computers interconnected through local buses to that of computers providing partitioned resources to multiple systems interconnected through an aircraft data network, usually based on Ethernet technology and providing deterministic features. The new architectural concept leads to the advent of shared computing platforms and aircraft networks as specific aircraft systems, usually addressed under ATA 42. Moreover, the architectural concept of shared computing and networks prompts a new way of working for the development lifecycle stage, with separate roles for architecting ATA 42, architecting user systems, developing applicative software and integrating the resulting software items into the shared computing platform. When expressing architecture of both the hosting computer/network systems and the hosted user systems, MBSE techniques present an enormous potential to optimize the subsequent tasks of integrating the software items into computer nodes and functional interfaces into network elements. This challenging context justifies a new position. Tasks and Responsibilities System Architect for Shared Computing Resources (IMA) and Aircraft Data Network. Development of system architecture in line with safety, human factors, security and performance requirements: specification, traceability, integration, V&V, certification. Negotiate and implement user-systems needs onto Shared Computing Resources (IMA) and Aircraft Data Network. Run trade studies to properly size the Shared Computing Resources (IMA) and Aircraft Data Network (processing power, memory, number of units per aircraft etc…) to meet the user needs. Initiate and prepare end-to-end system architecture documentation in collaboration with a wide range of user-systems, taking benefits of Shared Resources / Integrated Modular. During the Concept Phase of any project, devise the concept for the architecture of Aircraft computing and data network infrastructure (e.g. usage of shared infrastructure versus federated approach). Support Safety specialists through the safety assessment process bearing in mind the specificities of shared computing/network resources. Skills For such purposes the following skills are required: Demonstrated experience in Systems Engineering discipline applied to Aircraft Systems within the Development Life Cycle (ARP4754B). Knowledge of Integrated Modular Avionics discipline and adaptation of the DO-297 processes to specific projects. Knowledge of MBSE Advanced level of knowledge of Systems V&V. Demonstrated experience in Certification process. A first experience in end to end development of airborne software or CEH would be a plus (DO-178C, DO.254, …). Knowledge of System Safety/Reliability Process Language Skills: English at negotiation level. Self-determination to be able to identify new opportunities of improvement and to make decisions autonomously. Knowledge in technical management: planning, scheduling, risk management. You will leverage operational insights, audits, and data to optimise internal flows, standardise work practices, and enhance process robustness across Airbus Helicopters sites. title: Technical Services Engineer Powerplant and APU
description_text:
Job Description: Main activities
The Powerplant/APU engineer with his/her peers, as a team, shall endorse the key following activities:
Powerplant and APU Engineering work scope:
● Ensure engineering technical follow-up and defect/delay analysis in collaboration with Toulouse (FHS
Headquarter), local teams.
● Develop close relationship with the local teams, align and collaborate on processes and deliverables expected
● Produce and share engineering analysis, action plan and technical follow-up within a regular time frame agreed
with the local team
● Ensure appropriate support for technical issues resolution within mid and long term timeframe and ad hoc short
term support for critical event management
● Develop close relationship with FHS HQ and their stakeholders in order to escalate critical issues to be further
investigated with Customer Support and Airbus Programs
● Contribute to the functional organization objectives and be motor in ensuring knowledge, process and methods are
capitalized
● Ensure regular reporting on his/her different scopes of activity, for achievement, performance and improvement
demonstration,
● Ensure Technical support, if required, with Local Aviation Authorities, EASA and FAA, to meet local regulations
and expectations
● Contribute to the development and implementation of industrialized processes, methods and tools to improve
efficiency and qualitatively the activities performed,
● Provide engineering assistance to the region on-site engineering team on engine/APU related defect issues when
required.
● Provide technical expertise to validate or trigger engine or APU replacement (oil consumption etc)
● Prepare engine or APU accessories work scope for engine shop visit. This includes a list of SB/VSB to be
incorporated for an engine during shop visit, and maintenance tasks based on the EMMP.
● Focal point for supporting engine or APU shop activities and technical related topics for repair shop
● Following an Engine or APU shop visit, validate that proposed work scope requested has been performed and
analyze Shop finding Reports (SFR) for corrective action performed.
● Support the yearly/bi-yearly shop performance review with FHS Repair department (technical support) and FHS
engineering
● Support validation of APU and Engine LRU standard exchanges proposed by shop (with FHS Repair department)
● Validate technical work scope with shop if deviating from the baseline, and provide sound recommendations in
order to optimize the overall cost of the repair vs the expected technical conditions,
● Focal point for technical questions related to APU and Engine delease support (Work Scope, APU reliability trend
etc), participate in nomination, collection of all shop reports and ensure completeness of shop records including
back to birth required.
● Provide follow up on health condition of engine and APU based on alerts received from OEM via Engine and
APU health monitoring
● Perform regular reliability updates on APU and Engine LRU, investigate reliability issues and coordinate with
FHS engineering, OEM.
● Issue monthly APU and Engines reports on health status, removals
● Feedback to FHS engineering with baseline adjustment by analysis or from shop advise and participate to the
yearly revision of the baseline
● Manage database administration during engine or APU induction into fleet Reliability:
● Master the reliability process and tools and leverage on the reliability team triggers to identify arising low
performance topics and properly address the recovery plan with FHS HQ.
● Manage reliability technical dossier and contact relevant stakeholders as necessary for technical alignment.
● Analyze reasons for removal on identified components (in volume, vs Guaranteed Mean Time Between
Unscheduled Removal (GMTBUR), vs worldwide fleet Mean Time Between Unscheduled Removal (MTBUR),
No Fault Found (NFF) rate)
● Perform technical investigation (using data from aircraft maintenance logs, Maintenance Information System
(MIS), aircraft service records and shop finding reports) to determine possible root cause and failure trends as
necessary with objective to define/implement available mitigation/solution or drive definition of technical fix
● Investigate reliability issues on APU & APU LRU’s and coordinate the investigation with FHS Engineering,
Airbus Support & OEM. Perform regular reliability updates.
Technical publications:
● Manage and control AD and any mandatory documents to ensure compliance with with Regulation, Airworthiness
and Quality standards
● Master the technical publication process and the documentations such as VSB, SB, SIL, TFU, AOT and OIT
issued at aircraft/component level and provide recommendation
● Support mods meetings and FHS SB Scan process preparation
● Liaise with the customer facing team to assist driving the relevant embodiment strategy which would maximize
customer and FHS benefit
D. Outputs
● Advise engineering actions to enable achievement of FHS performance indicators,
● Airworthiness Directives Control and Technical Publications and recommendations
● Reliability Dossier
● Engine/APU work scope for shop visit
● Monthly removal forecast based
● APU MTBUR vs GMTBUR figures
● Cost reduction initiatives and APU repair baseline E. Required Skills
● Minimum degree holder in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent
● Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Airline / MRO, mainly in Technical Services position
● Good knowledge of Continued Airworthiness Management
● License or Type training on commercial transport category aircraft or engine, on any Airbus fitted product, A320 /
A350 (Desirable) will be preferred.
● Good Knowledge of Engine/APU health monitoring tools.
● Superior organizational skills, flexibility managing multiple priorities, adaptability to changing deadlines and
attention to detail,
● Excellent team player with good communication and interpersonal skills
F. Organisation structure
The Jobholder reports operationally to the Powerplant and APU Manager of the Central Plateau.

Job Description: Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être l’apprentissage qu’il vous faut ! Vous rejoindrez une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante. Opter pour une ou plusieurs années en alternance est une occasion unique de combiner savoirs acquis dans le cadre de votre formation et application de ces savoirs sur le terrain dans un environnement professionnel challengeant. L’équipe Airbus vous formera et vous accompagnera dans votre évolution tout au long de votre période d’alternance. Une offre d’apprentissage intitulée « Apprenti(e) en Pilotage de l’activité Commerciale (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Defence & Space, Space Digital sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 7 personnes au sein du département Sales Performance Improvement en charge du support au pilotage opérationnel des activités de ventes au travers du suivi d'indicateurs clés et d’activités d'amélioration continue. Cet apprentissage consistera à collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes de nos campagnes de ventes afin de les soutenir dans la mise en application du processus de vente et de leur fournir un soutien opérationnel. Aussi vous participerez à la coordination des activités commerciales et au pilotage des objectifs de l’entreprise. Cet apprentissage débutera à la rentrée scolaire 2026 pour une durée de 2 ans. Tâches et responsabilités: Encadré(e) par votre tuteur(trice), vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur les activités suivantes : Prise en main de notre process de vente et de notre outil CRM (Salesforce) afin de supporter les vendeurs (Campaign Managers) pour la mise à jour et le suivi de l’activité commerciale dans le CRM. Contribuer au contrôle de la cohérence, de la fiabilité et de l’intégrité des données clients, contrats et campagnes de ventes dans nos référentiels (MS Dynamics, Salesforce): identification des anomalies et participation à la mise en œuvre d’actions correctives. Réaliser des études ponctuelles ad-hoc pour répondre aux besoins des équipes Sales, Bids, Marketing (analyse de la performance, analyse Produits…). Participer à la construction des dashboards (Salesforce) et des indicateurs clés de la performance (maturité des campagnes commerciales, prise de commande, chiffre d’affaires, atterrissages de fin de mois, profitabilité de nos offres …) afin d'orienter la stratégie liée à la planification commerciale de l'entreprise. Analyser les données commerciales et financières afin d’identifier des tendances et des axes d’optimisation de nos actions commerciales. Mener une étude orientée business sur les opportunités d’utilisation de la data et de l’IA pour améliorer la performance commerciale : analyse des besoins, benchmark des pratiques et solutions existantes, mise en œuvre de tests à partir des outils existants sur des cas d’usage concrets et formulation de recommandations opérationnelles. Compétences & Prérequis : Vous allez intégrer une formation de niveau BAC +4 dans le domaine de contrôle de gestion ou de data analyst (formation universitaire) Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes : Vous êtes intéressé(e) par les technologies spatiales et géo-spatiales et par la vente de services à l’international. Vous parlez et écrivez anglais couramment et êtes capable d'échanger au quotidien sur des problématiques professionnelles complexes avec des interlocuteurs internationaux. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d'analyse de données quantitatives et qualitatives, vos qualités relationnelles et vous faites preuve de curiosité. Capacité à traduire un besoin Business en solution data/IA, curiosité technologique et veille sur les innovations IA. Compétences informatiques : Bonne connaissance de MS Office (maîtrise d'Excel) et de Google Suite. Une expérience dans l'utilisation de langages / technologies telles que : Salesforce, MS Dynamics, Power BI est un plus. Vous pourrez, selon les offres proposées, être amené(e) à vous déplacer. Notre processus de sélection L’étude des candidatures est réalisée par un recruteur. Si votre candidature est validée par le recruteur, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo différé. Cet entretien vidéo sera visionné par le recruteur. Si votre candidature est présélectionnée à l’issue de cette étape, elle sera transmise au/à la manager du poste. Le/la manager (et/ou tuteur(trice)) organisera des entretiens avec les candidat(e)s présélectionné(e) avant de choisir le/la candidat(e) final(e) retenu(e) sur le poste. Avantages liés à l’entreprise Notre engagement en faveur du bien-être de nos employés s'étend à la fois à leur vie professionnelle et à leur vie personnelle. Qu'il s'agisse de rémunérations compétitives ou de régimes de soins de santé complets, nous offrons à nos employé(e)s des avantages et des privilèges en fonction de nos implantations dans le monde - certains sont spécifiques à chaque pays. En outre, nous offrons diverses possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnels, afin de garantir l'évolution constante de vos compétences et de votre expertise. Pour en savoir plus, nous vous invitons à consulter notre site : https://www.airbus.com/en/careers/life-at-airbus/reward-and-benefits Information complémentaire Dans l'éventualité où notre offre d'alternance retiendrait votre intérêt, veuillez préparer les informations suivantes, qui vous seront demandées au moment de votre candidature : 1. Code RNCP (Répertoire national des certifications professionnelles) de la formation visée, 2. Durée de la formation visée, 3. Nature du contrat envisagé (contrat d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation) par l’école. title: Structure & Cabin System Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: Job Description
A. Identification
B. Accountabilities
The Jobholder is responsible for the oversight, delivery and performance of the Structure & Cabin System activities
provided across all the contracts under Airbus Flight Hour Services scope (FHS) managed by the Central Plateau.
In his function, the job holder will be responsible for maintaining the fleet under his supervision to the highest
Operational Reliability, in line with applicable airworthiness requirements such as EASA and NAA and in accordance
with Airbus Technical Standards and FHS Financial interests.
The Structure & Cabin Systems engineering team is responsible for the following activities:
● Structure & Cabin Systems mid and long term engineering support
● Technical publications and embodiment policy management
● Structural Parts & Cabin Components/systems reliability analysis and monitoring
In addition the job holder shall
● Manage the technical interface with customer facing team and liaise with the FHS operational holder administrating
the contractual set-up from Toulouse HQ.
● Ensure Internal Customer satisfaction acting on relationship, collaboration, responsiveness and performance,
● Achieve compliance with Regulation, Airworthiness and Quality standards,
● Propose additional values to support Airbus Services (Digital Tool, Methodology, MRO Standards....)
C. Dimensions
● There is no team or budget responsibility linked to this position.
D. Main activities The Structure/Cabin Systems engineer with his/her peers, as a team, shall endorse the key
following activities:
Structure & Cabin Systems Engineering work scope:
● Ensure engineering technical follow-up and defect/delay analysis in collaboration with
Toulouse (FHS Headquarter) and local teams.
● Develop close relationship with the customer facing teams, align and collaborate on
processes and deliverables expected
● Produce and share engineering analysis, action plan and technical follow-up within a regular
time frame agreed with the local team
● Ensure appropriate support for technical issues resolution within mid and long term
timeframe and ad hoc short term support for critical event management
● Develop close relationship with FHS HQ and their stakeholders in order to escalate critical
issues to be further investigated with Customer Support and Airbus Programs
● Contribute to the functional organization objectives and be motor in ensuring knowledge,
process and methods are capitalized
● Ensure regular reporting on his/her different scopes of activity, for achievement, performance
and improvement demonstration,
● Ensure Technical support, if required, with Local Aviation Authorities, EASA and FAA, to
meet local regulations and expectation ● Contribute to the development and implementation of industrialized processes, methods and
tools to improve efficiency and qualitatively the activities performed
● Provide engineering assistance to the regional on-site engineering team on Structures/Cabin
Systems related damage/defect issues when required.
● Coordinate with TC Holder to obtain repair solutions for damages out of designated ICA viz.
SRM,AMM & CMM & ensure repair solution classification as major or minor with associated
follow up actions
● Provide Technical Support to maintenance in performing Structural Assessment, Repair &
Modifications as well as desired clarifications during Inspection findings & alternate repair
material / fastener requests.
● Provide Technical Support to manage definition of structural events in designated FHS
Digital platform (If applicable) & manage associated CAT B & CAT C repair/inspection
requirements
● Maintain Structural Damage Database in designated FHS Digital platform (If applicable) with
a view to ensure efficient retrieval for reference or End Of Lease handover
● Analyse impact of Cabin Modifications on Layout & Configuration as well as provide
technical support in producing LOPA/EED post such modifications
● Manage the Weight and Balance (W&B) changes on the Aircraft in-service by monitoring the
mass and Center of Gravity (CG) of each Aircraft (A/C) introduced by modifications
● Provide Support towards Weight and Balance Schedule (WBS) preparation
● Provide technical support towards managing Landing Gear configuration including life limited
parts , repair & overhaul of Landing Gears & its subcomponents
Reliability:
● Master the reliability process and tools and leverage on the reliability team triggers to identify
arising low performance topics and properly address the recovery plan with FHS HQ.
● Manage reliability technical dossier and contact relevant stakeholders as necessary for
technical alignment.
● Analyze reasons for removal on identified components (in volume, vs Guaranteed Mean
Time Between Unscheduled Removal (GMTBUR), vs worldwide fleet Mean Time Between
Unscheduled Removal (MTBUR), No Fault Found (NFF) rate)
● Perform technical investigation (using data from aircraft maintenance logs, Maintenance
Information System (MIS), aircraft service records and shop finding reports) to determine
possible root cause and failure trends as necessary with objective to define/implement
available mitigation/solution or drive definition of technical fix
● Investigate Reliability Issues on Structures ATA, Cabin Systems & Cabin Systems LRU’s and
coordinate the investigation with FHS Engineering, Airbus Support & OEM. Perform regular
reliability updates.
Technical publications:
● Manage and control AD and any mandatory documents to ensure compliance with
Regulation, Airworthiness and Quality standards
● Master the technical publication process and the documentations such as VSB, SB, SIL,
TFU, AOT and OIT issued at aircraft/component level and provide recommendation
● Support mods meetings and FHS SB Scan process preparation
● Liaise with the customer facing team to assist driving the relevant embodiment strategy
which would maximize customer and FHS benefit E. Outputs
● Advise engineering actions to enable achievement of FHS performance indicators
● Airworthiness Directives Control and Technical publications and recommendations
● Reliability Dossier
● Structural Database Management
● Manage Weight Growth Register
● Cabin Layout Management (LOPA/EED) F. Required Skills
● Minimum degree holder in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent
● Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Airline / MRO, mainly in Technical Services
position
● Good knowledge of Continued Airworthiness Management
● Structural Damage Assessment & Repair Training preferably with composite parts coverage
(Essential)
● License or Type training on commercial transport category aircraft, preferably on any Airbus
product, A320 / A350 (Desirable)
● Superior organizational skills, flexibility managing multiple priorities, adaptability to changing
deadlines and attention to detail,
● Excellent team player with good communication and interpersonal skills G. Organisation structure
The job holder will report operationally to the Structure & Cabin Systems Manager of the
Central Plateau. title: Werkstudent (d/m/w) für Datenmanagement und Reporting
description_text:
Job Description: Zur Unterstützung im Performance Management & Controlling , sucht Airbus Aerostructures einen Werkstudent im Manufacturing Engineering für Datenmanagement und Reporting (d/m/w) Du bist Vollzeitstudent (d/m/w), auf der Suche nach einer Werkstudentenstelle? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns, wenn du uns in der Performance Management & Controlling als Werkstudent (d/m/w) mit ca. 18 Stunden pro Woche unterstützt! Standort: Stade
Start: Ab sofort Dauer: 12Monate Bei uns erhältst du ein tarifliches Entgelt je nach Tätigkeit von mindestens 18,53 € pro Stunde. Hinzu kommen Sonderzahlungen wie beispielsweise Urlaubsgeld. Dein Standort
Du arbeitest am Standort Stade. Erlebe in deiner Freizeit das besondere Flair südlich der Elbe, in der Nähe der Weltstadtkultur Hamburgs. Deine Vorteile Attraktive Vergütung und ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance bei einer 18-Stunden-Woche (Gleitzeit).
Eine Abschlussarbeit ist im Anschluss nach Rücksprache mit dem Fachbereich möglich.
Mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache mit dem Fachbereich.
Internationales Umfeld mit der Möglichkeit, Kontakte in die ganze Welt zu knüpfen.
Arbeit mit modernen/abwechslungsreichen Technologien.
Wir bei Airbus sehen dich als vollwertiges Teammitglied und du bist nicht zum Kaffee kochen eingestellt worden, sondern stehst im engen Austausch mit den Schnittstellen und bist Teil unserer wöchentlichen Teamrunden.
Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an der Generation Airbus Community zur Erweiterung des eigenen Netzwerks. Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Erfassung, Verarbeitung und Aufbereitung von Daten für das Mitarbeiter Controlling und das Projektmanagement.
Unterstützung bei der Aufbereitung von Daten für die Balanced Scorecard und analyse und Konsolidierung von Plan-/Ist-Abweichungen.
Design, Erstellung und Implementierung von Datenmodellen und Reports für das Ressourcenmanagement, Projektmanagement und Controlling.
Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften bei der Implementierung und Nutzung von Reports und Formularen, kontinuierliches Erfassen von Kundenrückmeldungen und Implementierung der vorgeschlagenen Verbesserungen.
Dokumentation von Prozessen und IT-Tools sowie Erstellung und Pflege von Handbüchern. Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen Immatrikulierter Vollzeitstudent (d/m/w) in einem relevanten Studiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Businessmanagement / Projektmanagement / Controlling).
Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Google Suite (Sheets, App Skript, Slides, Sites), MS-Excel und Web-Design. Idealerweise mit fortgeschrittenen Kenntnissen.

description_text:
Job Description: A vacancy has arisen for a "Lab Test Means Integration Engineer” within Airbus Defence & Space to be based at Getafe site in Spain. The successful candidate will join the department and will be integrated into a multidisciplinary team, covering the Design and Build, and Integration of the Laboratory Test Means used by all programs of Defense and Space. Laboratory Test Means Integration Engineer is an essential role that deals with: Technical challenges Adaptation to project priorities changes Agility in resolving technical blocking points ensuring achievement of requirements Monitor and stick to schedule adherence Control quality and costs. We invite you to join a multi-skilled and highly engaged team of Engineers working on a diverse and wide range of projects. Come and boost your career with us. Opportunities to work directly with aircraft systems· Opportunities to develop cross-product knowledge (Multiple Platforms) Opportunities in technological activities (Demos Design of Incremental Developments) Opportunities to travel (Transnational programs) The main activities of a Lab Test Means Integration Engineer are related with delivering technical solutions in integration and support of design, manufacturing and maintenance of test assets: Electrical / Electronic design of Test Benches from System Architecture. Interfacing with external partners and suppliers and communicating with corresponding stakeholders in design reviews, test reports and Project follow-up meetings. Problem Report solving and Change Request (modification) implementation. HW/SW integration for test benches. Test facilities management and maintenance. On Site Acceptance test with customers (Internal or External). Contribute to test bench validation activities Associated competencies to main activities are: · Systems requirements challenging. · Criteria for systems segregation· Definition of systems component position· Components selection, specification and practical application. · Selection of Manufacturing Technologies· Assembly and Maintainability instructions· Production and Service Support concurring. · Documents revision & edition· KPI Generation, Documentation Plan & Status Report. · Design Manual and Design Principles contributing. · Design & Product improvement activities· Support cross-program configuration control and cross-functional procedures Required Competences & Skills: - Degree in Aeronautical,Telecommunications, Automation & Electronics Engineering or equivalent. - Knowledge & high experience in Autocad, Altium designer or other electrical /electronic tools - Abilities to accept delegation. - Problem solving and decision making. - Open minded and active to new challenges. - Motivated, proactive and team dynamic player. - Committed in their own development to learn new skills - Good knowledge of avionic systems; experience with mission systems, data links, or sensors is a plus - Interest in complex systems and continuous learning in test and systems engineering - Experience in software testing is beneficial - Eligibility for security clearance by the relevant authorities is required - Fluent in Writing and Spoken English (B2 level or higher) Desired Competencies & Skills: Knowledge of aircraft systems.
Knowledge and/or experience in work linked to Aeronautical projects.
Knowledge of Airbus processes & procedures (SAP, DMS). Synthesize and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders. Evaluate potential plugin or architectural solutions with strict consideration for the overall MBSE ecosystem. Design, write, debug, document, and maintain Java-based plugins for Cameo Systems Modeler. description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for an Industrial System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Operations, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the ME - Transversal Team, a key part of the Manufacturing Engineering organization at the Airbus Getafe Plant. Our vision is clear: "to secure the industrial system today and to create the sustainable industrial solution of the future." The Getafe Plant is a center of excellence specializing in the structural assembly and equipping of Horizontal Tail Planes (HTPs) for the A320, A330, and A350 families, as well as the S19 section for the A350, utilizing advanced automated and robotic methods and dry carbon fiber manufacturing. In this role, your core mission will be to predict and improve our Industrial Performance by developing Lean Industrial System Designs, optimizing flows, and building advanced simulation models to translate conceptual ideas into highly competitive, real-world shopfloor scenarios. RESPONSIBILITIES
The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Lead and conduct Industrial System Design and Modelling projects from initial concept to deployment, optimizing flows and ensuring the best industrial footprint for plant activities. Develop and manage Industrial Line Flow Simulations and Digital Twins using advanced 3D software (e.g., 3DExperience) to anticipate, replicate, and optimize assembly line behavior. Analyze and optimize the industrial performance of current and future manufacturing lines through time-value calculations, standard line balancing, and Value Stream Analysis deployment. Drive the Machine Connectivity strategy at the plant level, collaborating closely with Maintenance, Operations, and central teams to define strategies, secure budgets, and improve machine availability. Support and deploy Data Analytics projects and innovation technologies, managing data to enable predictive decision-making, pattern detection, and early breakdown warnings. Collaborate with Industrial Architects and multidisciplinary teams to translate conceptual workflows into real shopfloor realities, factoring in surfaces, logistics, lead times, and station-level ergonomics. SKILLS
Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: University Degree in Engineering (Industrial, Aeronautical, or a related discipline). Experience: Proven experience in Manufacturing Engineering, preferably within complex industrial, automated, or aerospace environments. Soft skills: High passion, energy, and motivation for continuous improvement. Strong teamwork spirit, creativity, integrity, reliability, and the leadership potential to manage transversal projects. Languages: Negotiation level in English is a must. Capitalization of another European language is valuable. Technical knowledge: Strong proficiency in 3D environments (such as 3DExperience) for layouts, line simulation, and logistics analysis. Knowledge of flow simulation methodologies and data management. Valuable / Nice to have: Knowledge of AnyLogic software is a strong plus. Experience in digital twin deployment, machine connectivity (IoT), or advanced data analytics. within aircraft systems to the design specifications through attestation in the Airbus Test System (ESAO). Initiate actions to isolate, document and ultimately eliminate any deviations detected. Airbus is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner (per DoDI 1322.29). This 180-day program allows transitioning service members to leverage their military technical expertise in a high-precision aerospace environment. SkillBridge Eligibility: Active-duty service member within 180 days of separation. Written Commander (O-4 or above) authorization. Must have current work authorization for U.S. positions. Meet the Team: The team at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facilities help assemble the finest aircraft in the world, along with three production lines for the A220 and A320 Family aircraft. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your working environment: Mobile, AL U.S. Assembly Facility
On ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. Your Challenges: ​Perform Ground Tests Prepare the aircraft and workstation surroundings for ground tests on various avionics and electrical systems, in a safe environment. Perform function tests on all systems (flight controls, navigation, passenger entertainment, etc.) in parallel to the assembly of the aircraft from beginning to Flight Testing. Organize documentation of any non-conformity in the SAP NC system and initiate associated retests (Repeat Test Instruction) after finalization of rework. Collaborate with Ground Test Design, Engineering-, Quality- and Shop Floor departments. Perform Troubleshooting (T/S) Perform troubleshooting on test systems and on aircraft systems. Prepare and coordinate troubleshooting and distinguish error types. Clarify problems with the engineering department Ensure the safety of people and the aircraft all along the process, until the test closes up. Execute ground test following released documents and their associated work orders based on quality, cost and time. And enters, records the values plotted during the test when measurements are required inside released documents. Support improvement measures Identify problems internally in order to continuously improve the “On Time On Quality” production process. Perform and check operational tests and attest the conformity of the aircraft or a major constituent assembly in accordance with released documentation (e.g. Ground Test Instructions (GTIs), Repeat Test Instructions (RTIs), Retest Sheet, Work Order (WO) ). Perform upload of software equipment on/off aircraft and already installed on aircraft if needed. Extract electrical schematics for troubleshooting and perform specific tests to identify root cause failure. Launch Practical Problem Solving (PPS) for continuous improvements. GTP performs root cause analysis, if the test result is not compliant with released documents. Investigation: Test tool failure, A/C equipment failure or A/C installation discrepancy. Declaration and follow up of non conformity (e.g. NC, design deviation, ground test user request,..) for rework or certification, according to the good procedure. Minimum 5+ years preferably as an Aircraft Avionics Technician with a focus on aircraft systems (electrical preferred) or experienced Quality Inspector in avionics systems in international aviation. Minimum 3+ years of experience in troubleshooting on aircraft systems. Experience in A320 Family type rating is beneficial. Preferred Experience: Experienced in Quality Inspector on avionics systems. Speaking: able to engage in conversations in person and via electronic means and deliver information to groups of varying size with or without amplification. Equipment Operation: Able to operate a wide range of personal and office electronic equipment. Working on jigs at the fuselage at a height of 15 feet. Able to work on hydraulic lifts sometimes at a height of up to 40 feet. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Aerosystems is looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering department based in Kinston, NC. The Industrial Maintenance organization provides corrective and preventative maintenance across a broad range of installed assets and hand tools within the Kinston Plant. The assets include mechanical and electrical CNC machinery, conventional production machinery, Jigs and Tools, industrial autoclaves and automated guided vehicles . Asset age ranges from new equipment, up to 15 years old. The Industrial Maintenance strategy requires enhanced technical support to develop the internal competence to deliver comprehensive asset care. Reporting to the Ho J&T, Robotics, Des, Acq & Maint, the Reliability Engineer will be responsible for ensuring legislative compliance and for leading improvements in asset safety, reliability and availability. Meet the Team: Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment: The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programs; and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Define the maintenance strategy for the new technologies within the new Airbus Aerostructures in the Kinston Plant Create a spare parts strategy for our most critical assets within the Airbus Aerostructures in the Kinston Plant Protect the safety of maintenance personnel and asset users. Support in deploying maintenance strategies and tactics to deliver cost effective asset safety and reliability aligned to customer needs. Manage effective asset performance measurement. Support engagement through involvement, improvement, communication and development within the Industrial Maintenance team. Provide effective communications with customers and key stakeholders. Develop and deploy the maintenance plan for new and existing asset introduction. Main Activities Ensure ‘best in class’ safety systems and legislative compliance are realized and fundamental to all plans. Maintain a ‘safety first’ culture in the maintenance engineering team and be a ‘champion for safety’. Provide safe assets through proactive maintenance and adoption of latest, suitable best practice technologies. Contribute to the management of change utilizing the best available and appropriate technology whilst ensuring legislative compliance. Maintain compliance with Airbus procedures and practices e.g. Maintenance Procedure (FU.IN.07), Airbus Operating System, Ethics and Compliance and Shape. Support in developing, deploying and maintaining the Maintenance Plan for all assets in scope. Lead Total Cost of Ownership at the earliest stage of asset change or acquisition to provide sufficient maintenance budget. Support cost savings through employee engagement and technical input into improvement ideas. Develop cost of maintenance reduction projects balanced with asset reliability and safety. Prepare business cases to support improvement projects and risk reduction projects. Develop and produce effective and timely asset performance metrics. Develop tailored improvement plans for each asset group to deliver improved reliability and availability. Project manage simple, low cost refurbishment projects. Provide technical maintenance support for large refurbishment projects, asset acquisition projects and asset change projects. Seek technological improvements to transition from a reactive to a proactive maintenance provision. Contribute to the development of robust predictive instruments and proactive maintenance practices. Support management component obsolescence to ensure asset availability. Maintain the standard of Asset Care Plans including criticality and risk identification. Working with the commercial team, supporting the technical aspects of contracted maintenance services. Support significant and or complex asset recovery plans. Lead technical problem solving and lessons learned activity. Embed and maintain a culture of structured root cause analysis to minimize the re-occurrence of breakdowns. Deploy maintenance tools and methodologies to maximize reliability (e.g. Condition Based Maintenance, Preventative Maintenance, Reliability Centered Maintenance, and Autonomous Maintenance). Customer satisfaction and service level achieved. Proactive way of working via governance, controls and continuous improvement.
