And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change? Ready to make a tangible impact on aerospace manufacturing? Join our Wing Plant Engineering Team (PET) in Broughton. You will be at the heart of delivering critical wing components, providing reactive engineering support to the Plant and Supply Chain. In this fast-moving environment, you will manage concessions and technical solutions to ensure wings are delivered to the Final Assembly Lines on time and to the highest quality. HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM Lead and Approve Design Solutions: You will guide and formally approve design solutions, primarily addressing manufacturing non-conformances (NCs) and concessions to meet technical and airworthiness standards. Support Industrial Delivery: You will work directly with the product in a reactive capacity, collaborating with Manufacturing Engineering to provide high-quality solutions for the industrial system. Drive Continuous Improvement: You will lead initiatives to boost team efficiency by refining methods and processes, ensuring a robust lessons learned and feedback process is maintained. Provide Technical Leadership: You will act as a technical focal point, providing governance and mentoring engineering team members to ensure robust knowledge transfer. ABOUT YOU Design Signatory Authority: You must hold an industry-recognised design signatory delegation (specifically T200 concession design signatory) or have the capability to achieve this within a short timeframe. Manufacturing Environment Expertise: You possess sound engineering knowledge of manufacturing processes, structural design techniques, and the management of Non-Conformances. Technical Problem-Solving: You excel at translating complex manufacturing issues into well-defined technical solutions that support airworthiness certification. Design Toolset Proficiency: You have experience using toolsets such as CATIA V5, ICC, ECM, Sollings, or PASS. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions. HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request. Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process – you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. Examples may include (but not exclusive to) accessible facilities; auxiliary aids; room layout, etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence. As a Disability Confident Employer, Airbus UK will offer an interview to any applicant that considers themselves to have a disability or long-term condition under the Equality Act 2010 and meets the minimum criteria of the role (as set out in the job advert). To ‘opt in’, just select the option during your application submission and your application will be considered accordingly. title: Lead Technology Analyst - SAP Signavio
description_text:
Job Description: Role : Lead Technology Analyst, Signavio Job Description The AIRBUS ERP Platform team is seeking a highly skilled and experienced SAP Signavio Expert (Signavio) to join our ERP Center of Excellence (COE). This role is crucial for driving our S/4HANA business transformation, ensuring seamless alignment between business processes and IT architecture, and reducing structural complexity across our SAP ecosystem. The primary focus of this role will be the expert administration, utilization, and strategic rollout of the SAP Signavio suite. Focusing on the modules Signavio Process Collaboration Hub, Signavio Process Modeler and Signavio Process Governance. Job Responsibilities ● Tool Administration & Strategy: Administration, configuration, and strategic utilization of SAP Signavio & LeanIX across the Airbus ERP landscape. ● S/4HANA Transformation: Drive the mapping, analysis, and optimization of business processes using Signavio to actively support large-scale S/4HANA transformation projects. ● SAP Activate Methodology: Apply the SAP Activate methodology to guide process discovery, facilitate fit-to-standard workshops, and manage the overall process transformation lifecycle. ● Architectural Alignment: Understand and support the integration between business process modeling (Signavio) and the IT architecture repository (e.g., LeanIX) to establish a unified "single source of truth" for the enterprise landscape, focusing on the Signavio side of the toolchain. ● Governance & Standardization: Define, establish, and enforce global governance models, blueprints, and best practices for process modeling (BPMN) and Signavio tool usage within the COE. ● Ecosystem Scouting: Continuously scout the SAP ecosystem to align Airbus process strategies with the latest SAP product roadmaps and industry trends. Maintain a strong understanding of the Signavio, LeanIX, and SAP Cloud ALM toolchain and its application in large-scale business transformation. Job QualificationsEducation ● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. Experience ● Minimum of 9+ years of experience in business process modeling or large-scale business transformation projects. ● Extensive hands-on experience in the usage and administration of SAP Signavio. ● Proven track record in executing S/4HANA transformation projects from a business process, capability, and architectural perspective. ● Demonstrable experience working within complex, global, and highly integrated enterprise environments. ● Experience with LeanIX is a plus. Technical Skills ● Expert proficiency in the SAP Signavio suite (Collaboration Hub, Process Governance, Process Modeler). ● Deep understanding of the SAP Activate methodology and its practical application in S/4HANA implementations (e.g., Value Assurance, Fit-to-Standard). ● Strong knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) and strict adherence to Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN 2.0) standards. ● Strong understanding of the integrated toolchain of SAP Signavio, LeanIX, and SAP Cloud ALM and its role in an end-to-end business transformation. ● Familiarity with SAP solution landscapes, Cloud architectures, and the integration points between enterprise architecture and ALM tools (e.g., SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud ALM). Soft Skills ● Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities with a holistic view of the enterprise. ● Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and IT technical teams. ● Ability to explain complex architectural and process concepts to an audience with a low technical skill level, steering diverse teams toward a unified transformation vision using expert knowledge, empathy, and collaborative negotiation skills. ● Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. ● High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. ● Fluent in English (written and spoken). Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Aerosystems is looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering department based in Kinston, NC. The Industrial Maintenance organization provides corrective and preventative maintenance across a broad range of installed assets and hand tools within the Kinston Plant. The assets include mechanical and electrical CNC machinery, conventional production machinery, Jigs and Tools, industrial autoclaves and automated guided vehicles . Asset age ranges from new equipment, up to 15 years old. The Industrial Maintenance strategy requires enhanced technical support to develop the internal competence to deliver comprehensive asset care. Reporting to the Ho J&T, Robotics, Des, Acq & Maint, the Reliability Engineer will be responsible for ensuring legislative compliance and for leading improvements in asset safety, reliability and availability. Meet the Team: Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment: The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programs; and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Define the maintenance strategy for the new technologies within the new Airbus Aerostructures in the Kinston Plant Create a spare parts strategy for our most critical assets within the Airbus Aerostructures in the Kinston Plant Protect the safety of maintenance personnel and asset users. Support in deploying maintenance strategies and tactics to deliver cost effective asset safety and reliability aligned to customer needs. Manage effective asset performance measurement. Support engagement through involvement, improvement, communication and development within the Industrial Maintenance team. Provide effective communications with customers and key stakeholders. Develop and deploy the maintenance plan for new and existing asset introduction. Main Activities Ensure ‘best in class’ safety systems and legislative compliance are realized and fundamental to all plans. Maintain a ‘safety first’ culture in the maintenance engineering team and be a ‘champion for safety’. Provide safe assets through proactive maintenance and adoption of latest, suitable best practice technologies. Contribute to the management of change utilizing the best available and appropriate technology whilst ensuring legislative compliance. Maintain compliance with Airbus procedures and practices e.g. Maintenance Procedure (FU.IN.07), Airbus Operating System, Ethics and Compliance and Shape. Support in developing, deploying and maintaining the Maintenance Plan for all assets in scope. Lead Total Cost of Ownership at the earliest stage of asset change or acquisition to provide sufficient maintenance budget. Support cost savings through employee engagement and technical input into improvement ideas. Develop cost of maintenance reduction projects balanced with asset reliability and safety. Prepare business cases to support improvement projects and risk reduction projects. Develop and produce effective and timely asset performance metrics. Develop tailored improvement plans for each asset group to deliver improved reliability and availability. Project manage simple, low cost refurbishment projects. Provide technical maintenance support for large refurbishment projects, asset acquisition projects and asset change projects. Seek technological improvements to transition from a reactive to a proactive maintenance provision. Contribute to the development of robust predictive instruments and proactive maintenance practices. Support management component obsolescence to ensure asset availability. Maintain the standard of Asset Care Plans including criticality and risk identification. Working with the commercial team, supporting the technical aspects of contracted maintenance services. Support significant and or complex asset recovery plans. Lead technical problem solving and lessons learned activity. Embed and maintain a culture of structured root cause analysis to minimize the re-occurrence of breakdowns. Deploy maintenance tools and methodologies to maximize reliability (e.g. Condition Based Maintenance, Preventative Maintenance, Reliability Centered Maintenance, and Autonomous Maintenance). Be the champion for Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Contribute actively to the overall management of the Industrial Maintenance business. Outputs Compliance to FU.IN.07 process Asset reliability meets required Technical Availability Successful implementation of strategy and improvement projects. Customer satisfaction and service level achieved. Proactive way of working via governance, controls and continuous improvement. title: ALT 2026 - Apprenti en data science (h/f)
description_text:
Job Description: Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être l’apprentissage qu’il vous faut ! Vous rejoindrez une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante. Opter pour une ou plusieurs années en alternance est une occasion unique de combiner savoirs acquis dans le cadre de votre formation et application de ces savoirs sur le terrain dans un environnement professionnel challengeant. L’équipe Airbus vous formera et vous accompagnera dans votre évolution tout au long de votre période d’alternance. Une offre d’apprentissage intitulée « Apprenti en data science (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Helicopters sur son site de Marignane. Au sein de la direction “Support & Services”, l'organisation “Material Support Logistic” vise à fournir des solutions de rechange, sûres et durables afin d’améliorer la réalisation des missions de nos clients. Et si vous veniez apporter vos talents dans un des secteurs les plus importants pour nos clients et nous aider à concrétiser cette ambition?! Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 12 personnes “Global Forecast” chargée d’estimer les besoins en pièces de rechanges neuves et réparées, des clients opérants la flotte mondiale d’hélicoptères. Cet apprentissage débutera à la rentrée scolaire 2026 pour une durée de 2 ans et consistera à supporter et améliorer les activités du service en apportant les méthodes analytiques les plus avancées Tâches et responsabilités: Encadré(e) par votre tuteur(trice), vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur les activités suivantes : Extraction et intégration de données structurées et non structurées provenant de diverses sources Analyse des historiques de commandes clients, études de corrélation et détection d’anomalies Conceptions d’algorithmes de prévisions basés sur des modèles statistiques, d'apprentissage automatique ou d'IA Création des protocoles de sélection et de surveillance pour s'assurer que les modèles s'adaptent à l'évolution des profils de consommation des pièces. Conception et déploiement de dashboards interactifs pour la visualisation des données et l'aide à la décision Présenter et partager vos résultats et recommandations à l'équipe pour transformer vos modèles en actions concrètes. Compétences & Prérequis : Vous allez intégrer une formation de niveau BAC +5 dans le domaine de la data science pour un apprentissage d’une durée de 2 ans. Vous avez les connaissances et compétences techniques suivantes : Mathématiques appliquées, probabilités et statistiques Big data et machine learning Développement en Python, SQL, la connaissance de PySpark est un plus Compétence et prérequis: Curieux, flexible et créatif Esprit d’équipe et capacité à collaborer Écoute active et communication adaptée à son audience Compétences linguistiques : Anglais : avancé Français : avancé Vous pourrez, selon les offres proposées, être amené(e) à vous déplacer. Cet entretien vidéo sera visionné par le recruteur. Si votre candidature est présélectionnée à l’issue de cette étape, elle sera transmise au/à la manager du poste. Le/la manager (et/ou tuteur(trice) organisera des entretiens avec les candidat(e)s présélectionné(e) avant de choisir le/la candidat(e) final(e) retenu(e) sur le poste. The role ensures high strength-to-weight ratios while prioritizing structural integrity and occupant safety. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world. Job Description: Join our IT Operations Team in Copenhagen: Be the Front Runner for Technical Excellence. Are you an extremely structured IT professional who takes pride in setting the gold standard for others? We are looking for an IT Application Manager for Non-SAP Systems to join our team in Ørestad. In this role, you won't just manage systems from a distance; you will lead by example. We need a front runner who inspires the team through best-in-class documentation and a proactive, hands-on approach to ownership. Working in the same department as our SAP Application Management team, you will be the anchor that ensures our specialized non-SAP landscape is as robust and disciplined as our core ERP. What the job is… As our IT Application Manager for Non-SAP systems, you are the driving force for a portfolio of systems vital to our global operations. You will take full end-to-end responsibility, ensuring these systems are technically optimized, financially sound, and compliant. We are looking for someone who doesn't just follow existing processes but defines what "good" looks like for the entire team. Your portfolio will include, but is not limited to: Airsupply, Autostore, Cert Print / Cert Scan, and Virtual Storage Machines. Your main responsibilities include: Active Application Ownership: Taking full responsibility for the technical health, functional logic, and roadmap of our non-SAP application landscape. The Yearly Operational Cycle: Orchestrating the "heartbeat" of the applications—from managing the yearly cycle of NON-SAP solutions for certificate renewals and system audits to performance reviews, ensuring no critical operational milestones are missed. Budget & Partner Leadership: Holding the reins on the application budget and acting as the primary lead for external partners, specifically driving performance and value with vendors. The SAP Handshake: Collaborating closely with your colleagues in the SAP Application Management team and SAP Integration & Basis team to ensure seamless data-consistency and technical alignment with our S/4HANA platform. title: Cross Plant Manufacturing Engineering
description_text:
Job Description: CONTEXT OF THE POSITION… This position aims to become a central force at the Final Assembly Line. As the key on-site representative for all Airbus manufacturing plants, you will act as a critical bridge between the plants and the assembly line. You'll take on the vital role of managing and executing Outstanding Work (OSW) and Non-Conformity (NC) reworks, using your expertise in technical analysis and cross-functional collaboration. Your work will directly impact the on-time and on-quality delivery of aircraft, making you an indispensable part of the final production process. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES [List key tasks and responsibilities here in bullet points] Serve as the primary on-site representative for all Airbus MCA plants at the Final Assembly Line (FAL). Act as the central point of contact between FAL customers and the manufacturing plants/subcontracted suppliers, ensuring the on-time escalation of all blocking issues to H/O XP Manufacturing Engineering and other relevant stakeholders. Manage all Outstanding Work (OSW), and secure the proper execution of plant work orders. Ensure a seamless section handover by analyzing all drawings, tooling, competency qualifications, and parts ordering information required for on-site work, including S01, S03, QSRs, DQNs, and modifications. Provide immediate technical disposition and analysis on all ATAs for all NC/ALB/QLB that occur at the FAL with plant responsibility, support complex constraints on FAL critical path (e.g., Junction/ Power-on / Hydraulic release/ Fuel test etc.), Provide hands-on technical support to the production shopfloor, with a focus on resolving complex constraints on the FAL critical path (e.g., Junctions, Power-on, Hydraulic release, Fuel tests, etc.). Take charge of Manufacturing Engineering disposition and collaborate with cross-functional teams (including FAL ME, design offices, and suppliers) to carry out technical investigations and achieve final closure of all issues. Drive continuous improvement by actively participating in process optimization initiatives, such as identifying and correcting OS findings, participating in SQCDP meetings, and contributing to internal projects. Facilitate knowledge transfer and technical exchange among team members. Promote a culture of continuous learning and share lessons learned to improve overall operational efficiency and compliance. This role requires a normal day & late shift work, in case of industrial crisis, it may require work in the night shifts when necessary. QUALIFICATION Education: Aeronautics education. Engineer equivalent degree. Experience: 3~5 years’ in Aviation industry, with experience in multi-functional teams & subcontracted activities management. REQUIRED SKILLS Technical Skills: Required skill 1: Aircraft specifications & 2D drawing Required skill 2: tools such as SAP, ACPnG, @AirNav, CIRCE, IBM... LANGUAGE: fluent English both in written and oral speaking, French and/or German knowledge would be a plus. title: PWP Stress Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for a PWP Stress Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the PWP Mechanical Analysis Team. Our department is in charge of participating in the design of the ADS platform PWP through modeling, loads evaluation (static, fatigue, dynamic, thermal), and structure/system definition and validation. We develop static, thermal, and dynamic models of the PWP structure design to integrate engines across our different platforms. The team evaluates structural stresses derived from loads, supporting the design from the pre-design phase to in-service support, including main design reviews, certification, and prototype testing. To perform these activities, our multidisciplinary team is permanently in contact with Flight Physics, Design, and System Integration departments, as well as each program's Chief Engineering office. The jobholder will reinforce our stress analysis area to support complex system implementation in these programs. Gestion de la Performance : Assurer le respect des budgets et des calendriers des programmes. Garantir la conformité des livrables d’ingénierie (définition, solutions techniques, rapports de certification) et gérer le traitement des dérogations. Définir, conjointement avec la Qualité, les plans d’action pour garantir la navigabilité des produits livrés en écart de définition.

Soutenir les initiatives globales d'Airbus en matière de développement durable. title: Flight Control Testing - FTI
description_text:
Job Description: A position of Flight Control Testing - FTI (Flight Test Instrumentation) has just opened within Airbus Commercial Aircraft in Toulouse. You will join a team within the Flight and Integration Tests center, working in a close-knit binôme with the FTI Leader in charge of Flight Control (ATA 27) system integration testing for all Programmes.
As an operational key player, you will assist the FTI Leader in executing the testing strategy, ensuring the high-quality instrumentation and data integrity required for safe and efficient flight test campaigns. You will contribute to the laboratory, simulator, and flight test environment, focusing on the practical execution and technical reliability of our measurement chains. Your main tasks & responsibilities:
As the Flight Control Testing FTI, you are the operational right-hand of the FTI Leader. You provide the technical groundwork and daily support required to turn the testing roadmap into reality. Before Handover to Flight Test: Instrumentation Needs: Define the Measurement Parameter List (MPL) with technical specifications (accuracy, bandwidth, location) and draft the GTRs (Ground Test Requests) to secure necessary slots. Performs GTRs in Plant (sections) & in FAL (Stade, Bremen, Finkenwerder, Getafe, Broughton…) Sensor Validation & Follow-up: Validate measurement points (location, installation plans, etc.), particularly for actuator force sensors in collaboration with Loads, Stress & Vibrations testing team and the Design Office. Follow up on the planning and execution of pedal position and force sensor calibrations on the aircraft. Data Management: Maintain a live contact list of key stakeholders. Create and update a comprehensive database of calibration coefficients for each parameter and track their status. Preparation Protocols: Establish work protocols for "Work Order checks" to validate proper parameter function and for tracking instrumented actuator serial numbers (S/N) via tools like Amasis / IBIS. Initial Analysis: Analyze GTRs for tapping, flutter, and first taxi tests. Before First Flight: Parameter Validation: Issue the Validation Technical Note (NT) for all parameters. Ground Analysis: Exploit data from ground and taxi tests to identify signal loss, especially due to vibrations. Final Checks: Identify the location and S/N of instrumented actuators just before the first flight. Set up automated surveillance to analyze data during final ground tests and first taxiing runs. During and After Flight Tests: Real-Time Analysis: During the first flights, analyze the performance of all parameters to detect any issues like signal loss, calculator handovers, or zero drifts. Operational Maintenance: Ensure the operational readiness of all parameters. This includes setting up automated fault detection tools, analyzing issues within 48 hours of reception, and creating CRIEVS / CARL WO SNAG (in-house issue reports). Issue Resolution: Manage the resolution process with specific deadlines for coefficient changes (t0 + 7 days) and repairs (t0 + 10 weeks). Follow-up & Reporting: Manage a validation table to track parameter status "flight by flight." Archive all analysis reports and apply/analyze new Work Orders. Stakeholder Support: Be a primary point of contact for users, providing timely answers to questions and conducting specific studies when requested. Your boarding pass: If you are a hands-on, rigorous engineer with a strong appetite for "putting your hands in the aircraft," we are looking for you! You are the reliable partner the FTI Leader relies on to ensure that every sensor is operational and every data stream is clean. You value precision, you enjoy field work, and you are eager to learn from the complex system of Flight Controls. Your reactivity and capacity to report issues clearly and concisely are key assets for this team. About you: Operational Reliability: You are highly reliable and meticulous in your work. You understand that the accuracy of a single sensor is critical for the safety of the entire flight test. Collaboration & Support: You thrive in a binôme environment. You communicate fluidly with the FTI Leader, providing constant feedback and alerting them to risks or issues as soon as they arise. Reactivity: You are quick to respond to requests during test campaigns, managing pressure without losing sight of quality requirements. Technical Curiosity: You have a strong desire to understand the "how" and "why" behind instrumentation failures and enjoy finding practical solutions. About your technical skills: Instrumentation Fundamentals: Solid knowledge of FTI systems, including sensors, data acquisition, and signal processing. System Familiarity: Basic understanding of aircraft systems, with a particular interest in Flight Controls (ATA 27). Data & Tools: Proficiency in data analysis and handling telemetry data. Scripting: Strong scripting skills (Python, MATLAB, or similar) to support daily automation and data processing tasks is a plus. Methods: Rigorous application of work protocols and ability to follow technical documentation (GTRs, installation plans). Languages: Advanced level in French and English. title: #DIGITAL CAMPUS - End to end monitoring support
description_text:
Job Description: #DIGITAL CAMPUS - End to end monitoring support An opportunity for an End to end monitoring support has arisen within Airbus Helicopters (Albacete, Spain) WHY JOIN US? 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast. Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. ✨THE PROJECT: SHAPING THE FUTURE - Welcome to the Digital Campus, a pioneering ecosystem dedicated to industrial digitalization and innovation. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight. Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. DESCRIPTION Your main missions are focused on the operational maintenance, administration, and integration of the core observability and testing tool stack, ensuring system reliability and performance from an IT Operations perspective. The specialist acts as the subject matter expert (SME) and supervisor for all managed tools, handling configuration, health, and end-user support. He is responsible for the health, stability, and connectivity of the entire tool ecosystem The job position is located at Albacete, main plant of the Airbus Helicopters group in Spain. What can you expect from us? The Airbus Helicopters Group embraces the challenges of digitalization. Today, the Information Management (IM) directorate is contributing to its transformation, which is one of the key company objectives. Within the IM "Digital Platforms" domain, you belong to the service “Hosting & Cloud Services”, in the team “DataCenters & Resilience”. IM Hosting & Cloud Services plays a key role in the digitalization of our business. We achieve this by providing secure and resilient solutions for hosting Airbus Helicopters applications and data, both in the cloud and on-premises. YOUR CHALLENGES System Administration & Tool Health Supervision: Supervision & health: Technically supervise all managed tools, monitoring their health, performance, and resource consumption (CPU, Memory, Storage, Network Flows). Maintenance: Plan and execute regular patching, configuration changes, and version upgrades for their components (server nodes, agents, extensions, etc). Security & access: Manage user access, roles, and permissions across all platforms, ensuring adherence to IT security policies and licensing compliance. Capacity Management: Monitor and manage license utilization and capacity planning for all tools. Global Vision & Tool Interface Management Tool integration: Design, implement, and maintain the interfaces and integrations between all key monitoring, testing, and operations tools (e.g., integrating application alerts with infrastructure events; linking monitoring datas to performance tests). Data correlation: Implement procedures and tools for cross-tool data correlation, enabling the Operations team to trace an issue from an infrastructure alert to application impact and back to corresponding test cases. Reporting: Standardize metrics and build unified dashboards and reports that provide a Global Vision of system health and quality for IT Operations and leadership in relationship with internal customers Monitoring & Observability Management Application observability: Administer and optimize the deployment and configuration. Manage monitoring rules, baselines, and synthetic/real user monitoring configurations to ensure comprehensive application observability. Infrastructure monitoring: Supervise the environment, ensuring complete coverage of servers, network devices, and databases. Manage host enrollment, template development, and ensure critical infrastructure alerts are routed appropriately. Alerting & notification: Configure, tune, and manage alerting thresholds and notification channels within all tools to minimize alert noise while ensuring prompt response to critical events. Technical Support & Collaboration Support: Insure Level 2/3 Support and serve as the internal SME and technical escalation point for complex issues related to the operation or configuration of the managed tools. Troubleshooting: Assist SRE, DevOps, and Development teams in using the monitoring data to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) during critical incidents. QA support: Provide operational support to QA and performance engineering teams for executing tests, ensuring the environments are stable and configured correctly. Documentation & Training Documentation: Create and maintain up to date detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, architectural diagrams, and configuration documentation for all tools and their interfaces. Knowledge transfer: Conduct internal workshops and training sessions to educate operations staff and key stakeholders on the effective utilization and new features of the managed tool stack. SKILLS Master's degree level (or equivalent) in Information Technology or related field Experience with observability tools (monitoring, testing, alerting) proven General knowledge on IT infrastructure (network, technical infrastructure) and ITIL concepts Knowledge in scripting languages to develop automation Proficiency in creating and managing technical documentation. Proven production environment management; strong troubleshooting skills Curious, open-minded, collaborative team player with strong communication skills Autonomous, organized, delivery/customer-oriented, technology enthusiast and crisis facing robustness Experience working on projects with international teams and stakeholders Fluent English WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working: we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. title: Airbus Atlantic - Planificateur de production (All Gender)
description_text:
Job Description: Et si VOTRE aventure avec NOUS commençait ?! Nous vous proposons de travailler chez Airbus Atlantic, champion mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers Première Classe et Classe Affaires. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable. Membre du service Production Control & Logistic de l'usine Airbus Atlantic Saint-Nazaire, sous la responsabilité directe du Responsable PC&L du site, vous êtes en charge de la planification de lignes de production du site. Votre mission Votre futur poste, intermédiaire entre les clients de l'usine Airbus Atlantic Saint-Nazaire et les unités de production de pièces élémentaires, est clé. Vous fournissez un Plan de Production optimisé et réaliste, en tenant compte des dates des besoins du client, du calendrier de production réel et de la capacité disponible (main-d'œuvre, machine, matériel) et d'un certain nombre de contraintes principalement la tenue des délais et le niveau de stocks. Vous participerez également à l'optimisation de la fonction planification afin de la rendre plus simple et industrielle. Cette position vous permettra de collaborer avec différentes interfaces : l'unité de production (Production, PC&L, Manuf. Eng), la maintenance, les achats, le programme, les services Supply Chain. Dans ce cadre vos missions principales consisteront à : - Évaluer les programmes et les exigences de production pour les 18 prochains mois, y compris les plans de retour. - Définir des scénarios de production associés en fonction du calendrier de l'usine et de toutes les ressources disponibles - Préparer et animer la réunion MPS (Master planning Scheduling) monthly en impliquant toutes les parties prenantes et obtenir l'engagement de chacun sur le Plan de Production et challenger les participants à en sécuriser sa réalisation - Construire, mettre à jour et analyser les KPI (Key Performance Indicator) mesurant la bonne exécution du Plan de Production, définir le plan d'amélioration et les actions associées en cas de dérive - Officialiser le scénario de production choisi et communiquer le plan à toutes les parties prenantes - Etre garant que le Plan de Production soit respecté - Surveiller les paramètres ERP (Enterprise Ressource Planning) influant sur la planification et alerter en cas de dérive (taille de lot, délai de sécurité,...) - Animer ou contribuer à des projets d'optimisation des processus et outils de la planification, en lien avec la fonction centrale PC&L Parlons de vous ! Vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience à un poste équivalent ou nécessitant des compétences similaires Vous avez une excellente maîtrise des outils bureautiques ainsi que les outils informatiques métiers (SAP). Une certification CPIM (Certified in Production and Inventory Management) est un plus. Doté(e) de très bonnes qualités relationnelles, vos points forts pour répondre aux enjeux du poste sont une très forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse, rigueur et sens des responsabilités, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe. Vous êtes autonome, et organisé. Cet emploi exige une connaissance des risques de conformité potentiels et un engagement à agir avec intégrité, comme base de la réussite, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de la société. Parlons de nous !
Saint-Nazaire Ville : Le site de Saint-Nazaire, centre d’excellence des pièces élémentaires complexes est spécialisé, entre autres, dans l’usinage de rails et de lisses, l’étirage et l’usinage mécanique de panneaux de fuselages 3D, la production des cadres structures, l’usinage 5 axes de pièces complexes de grandes dimensions, le cintrage et le soudage de tuyauteries et le traitement de surfaces / peinture. Grâce à son activité de livraison en cycles courts (Fil Rouge), le site de Saint-Nazaire est capable de répondre en urgence aux besoins de production de ses clients. Pour en savoir plus : vidéo Environnement & Conditions de travail : Airbus Atlantic c’est aussi : Prendre part à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie pour construire l’avion de demain, en lien avec les enjeux environnementaux. Un environnement qui valorise la proximité et la dimension humaine, au sein d’un collectif engagé et solidaire. L’opportunité d’apprendre et d’évoluer tout au long de votre parcours, en étant accompagné dans votre développement pour une carrière sur-mesure. Avoir la liberté d’entreprendre et de laisser libre court à vos initiatives. Ses conditions de travail attractives et ses avantages : restaurant d’entreprise sur site, CSE (avantages loisirs & famille), parking entreprise, mutuelle d’entreprise (famille). Sa politique de diversité et d'inclusion : Airbus Atlantic s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances pour tous. Son plan d'actionnariat salarié et son plan d’épargne salariale. Notre processus de recrutement : Nous avons à cœur de mieux vous connaître et de comprendre ce qui vous motive à nous rejoindre. Aussi, notre process de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes après analyse de votre candidature : Entretien vidéo différé via la plateforme Hirevue. Entretien avec le Manager Recruteur. Entretien avec le Recruteur qui sera complété par un questionnaire de personnalité. description_text:
Job Description: Description: Airbus started its digital journey. The objective being to transform the company and to prepare it for the future. This transformation includes new global governance, new ways of working and the implementation of digital business services and platforms. Skywise is an Airbus digital services company operated under Airbus India roof in Bangalore. Skywise is a leading flight operations specialist, operating as a wholly owned Airbus subsidiary. We provide comprehensive ground and onboard solutions designed to increase productivity for aircraft operators worldwide. We combine deep industry knowledge with an agile development culture to drive innovation in operational efficiency and sustainable aviation. As a Software Engineering Manager (Backend chapter Leader) you will be responsible for driving technical direction and engineering excellence of our backend discipline within the dynamic Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment. Operating in a matrix structure, you will set the standard for code quality by defining robust design patterns and championing Non Functional requirements to ensure our software remains sustainable and scalable. You will balance the technical leadership with people management, empowering your chapter members distributed across various Scrum teams to deliver high-performing, secure, reliable and robust solutions. This job offer is for a position based at the Airbus office in Bangalore. Qualification & Experience: We seek out curious minds. We value attention to detail, and we care deeply about outcomes. We’re looking above all for passionate people, eager to learn, willing to share, establishing innovative ways of working and influencing culture change, building high performance teams with deep technical knowledge. Are you ready to share this exciting challenge with us? Standards and best practices: Lead the global “Community of practice” for backed engineering. Collaborate with the chapter leaders across the globe to have standard guidelines to deliver robust, reliable, scalable, secure customer products. Enforce coding and testing standards, security best practices, code review guidelines and testing protocols to ensure craftsmanship and consistency across all squads. Balance feature delivery with long term technical health, advocating for the strategic reduction of technical debt and modernization of legacy systems. Drive initiatives to improve high availability, observability (logging, tracing, metrics) and reliability of backend services. Growth and mentorship: Drive performance review and career development conversations. Mentor engineers from junior to senior levels, helping them navigate technical and organization challenges. System Design: Strong grasp of microservices architecture, REST APIs, ASP.NET Web API, AWS cloud-native principles. Ability to understand and review scalable systems design that can handle complex business logic. Strong AWS experience to be able to lead the AWS chapter globally in the software factory for Skywise - also lead topics like FinOps, explore upcoming AWS features and suggest the improvements for our products Management experience: 3+ years of experience directly managing engineers, including performance management, hiring, handling difficult conversations, conflict management. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Aerosystems Kinston is looking for a Production Scheduler Advanced to join our team based in Kinston, NC. The Production Scheduler prepares feasible production schedule scenarios for assembly and in-house parts and associated materials for the weekly Master Production Schedule routines. Takes into account customer need dates, actual production schedule, production status, backlog, outstanding work and available capacity (manpower, machine, material) and any technical & quality topics to be consistent with the Master Production Schedule process.
Checks MRP results on Planned Orders and Work Orders, and manages Work Order creation. Inputs: MPS planning, need dates, industrial capabilities (machines, tools, workshop facilities, maintenance plans and local objectives...),
manpower, component availability and stock strategy, manufacturing engineering input and quality input. Outputs: Weekly Production Schedule, dashboards (workload/manpower balance, Work in Progress analysis, planning adherence, KPIs and associated documentation), work order creation. Meet the Team:
Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes; and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: 1. Short-Term Planning & Routine Management
The role focuses on leading and animating weekly short-term operational routines. This involves analyzing current production status and controlling resource capacity—including manpower (operators and office staff), machinery, and materials. A key responsibility is preparing and leading the Weekly Master Production (MPS) meetings, where the scheduler must challenge stakeholders to ensure firm commitments and prevent constant planning postponements. 2. Schedule Optimization & Recovery
This activity involves elaborating detailed Production Schedules and designing recovery plans when deviations occur. The scheduler assesses impacts on capacity requirements (workforce, strategic tooling, and jigs), delivery dates, and production buffers. This also includes validating and officializing the short-term planning impacts on the Industrial System (5M) and ensuring that all production partners are aligned with the validated schedule. 3. Execution, System Integrity & KPI Tracking
The role ensures the transition from planning to action by implementing decided schedules into the production system. This involves:
 Authorization: Converting and releasing work orders based on MPS decisions.
 System Maintenance: Checking MRP parameters, results, and messages, while updating the official IT planning tools alongside dedicated stakeholders.
 Performance Analysis: Building and analyzing KPIs to measure execution and delivery performance, then defining subsequent improvement plans and corrective actions. Additional Responsibilities: Other duties as assigned: ● Promote a customer-focused mindset within the plant organization.
● Collaborate closely with all site functions (Program, Manufacturing engineering, materials logistics, quality, and production teams) to
implement strategy changes effectively.
● Synthesize complex planning scenarios and present clear, concise updates to multiple levels of management

The PIMCC team is a highly dynamic, international, and multicultural group. Soft skills: High autonomy, negotiation skills with the ability to influence, and a constructive approach to conflict management in a stakeholder-heavy environment. Languages: Negotiation level in English. Knowledge of German is a definitive advantage due to the supplier base in Germany and Austria. Job Description: A vacancy for A/C Security Architect (d/f/m) has arisen within the Defence and Strategic Programmes team of Airbus Cybersecurity in Spain. We provide products, development, concepts, and cybersecurity engineering to internal and external customers in Airbus. As a European specialist, Airbus shields customers, agencies, and critical infrastructures from cyber threats. We are looking for experienced A/C Security Architect with proven experience in the defence and aerospace domains. In the role of A/C Security Architect the main responsibilities are: 1. Leadership and management of product security aspects throughout the entire lifecycle. 2. Promotion of the "Security-by-Design" approach among various project stakeholders. 3. Proactive contribution to architecture design to mitigate risks. 4. Security Risk Analysis (SRA) using methodologies such as MAGERIT, PILAR, NIST, EBIOS, or EUROCAE ED202A/203B. 5. Design of detailed security architectures (High-Level and Low-Level Design) for subsystems and components. 6. Ensuring regulatory compliance (CC/CEM, CCN-STIC). 7. Development of Security Operating Procedures (SecOps) for product maintenance. 8, Security Focal Point for customer liaison and communication. 9. As an integral part of their duties, the candidate must fulfill responsibilities regarding Occupational Health and Safety (OHS), Quality, and Environment. This includes strict compliance with all health and safety regulations and procedures established by the company and current legislation; participating in OHS training; correctly using personal protective equipment (PPE); and reporting any unsafe conditions. Furthermore, they must ensure all activities align with quality standards, contributing to continuous improvement, maintaining accurate records, and participating in quality audits. They shall also engage in sustainability initiatives, promoting efficient resource use and waste reduction, and reporting environmental incidents to guarantee a safe, sustainable, and high-quality work environment. 10. As an AIRBUS SLC employee, the candidate is required to know and comply with established internal policies and procedures, both at the Airbus Group level and specific AIRBUS SLC procedures, committing to: a) Comply with AIRBUS SLC policies, codes, and standards.
b) Understand and fulfill assigned roles and responsibilities regarding Information Security, Privacy, and Confidentiality.
c) Undergo training, awareness, and capacity building with periodic updates on entity policies and procedures relevant to their position. Act with due diligence to prevent security incidents. Risk Methodologies: Expert proficiency in at least two of the following methodologies: MAGERIT, PILAR, NIST, EBIOS, or EUROCAE ED202A/203B.
Security Clearance: Mandatory NATO/National Security Clearance.
Languages: English C1 (Advanced) for technical and business-level liaison. Critical Knowledge Key Technical Expertise: High-Level and Low-Level Security Architectures (HLD/LLD).
Pentesting Fundamentals: Strong understanding of penetration testing to validate architectural designs.

Security-by-Design Advocacy: Proficiency in evangelizing and integrating security principles into the early stages of engineering development.

Their mission will be to ensure that AI systems are fast, accurate, and capable of serving multiple simultaneous users, laying the groundwork for future evolution toward training and fine-tuning open models. We are looking for an ML Engineer with a hybrid focus on applied Artificial Intelligence and high-performance system optimization. We are not just looking for someone who uses models, but for an expert capable of "squeezing the maximum potential" out of hardware (GPUs) to deliver high-quality responses with the lowest possible latency. Key Responsibilities Model Serving Optimization: Design and manage the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), optimizing memory usage and responsiveness for high-demand environments. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) System Architecture: Design and refine workflows that enable AI to accurately query private information, managing everything from document ingestion to intelligent data retrieval. Multi-GPU High-Performance Management: Configure and optimize workload distribution across multiple GPUs to maximize processing speed and user concurrency. Quality and Accuracy Assurance: Implement evaluation methodologies to reduce hallucinations, improve response relevance, and ensure the AI is a reliable tool for the end user. Data Pipeline Development: Create efficient processes for transforming complex documents (PDF, OCR, etc.) into formats optimized for AI learning and querying. Service and API Exposure: Develop standardized and secure communication interfaces to integrate AI capabilities with other applications and user platforms. Technological Evolution: Research and prepare the infrastructure for future phases involving training, quantization, and model adaptation to specific needs. Requirements Solid experience (3+ years) in Machine Learning Engineering, Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Applied AI. Degree in Computer, Telecomunications, Maths or Software Engineering. Hands-on experience in the deployment and productionization of Large Language Models (LLMs). Advanced proficiency in Python. Proven experience building information retrieval architectures (RAG systems) and vector databases. Demonstrated ability to optimize computing resources (GPU/CPU/Memory) to enhance AI system performance. B2 level in English. Preferred Qualifications Military Avionics and embedded/Real Time Software knowledge is desirable. Experience working with large-scale models. Knowledge of model optimization techniques (quantization, model weight reduction). title: Spécialiste des pièces - Activités de maintenance / Material Maintenance Specialist
description_text:
Job Description: Spécialiste des pièces - Activités de maintenance / Material Maintenance Specialist ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous avez une connaissance accrue des environnements de maintenance et des enjeux rencontrés lors de ces activités, vous avez travaillé dans le domaine de l'aéronautique et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Spécialiste des pièces reliées aux activités de maintenance pour rejoindre notre équipe Opérations en Service basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous contribuerez au suivi des pièces requises afin de compléter l'ensemble des activités dans les délais prévu. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Gestion de la Configuration, Ingénierie de l'Approvisionnement et Anticipation de Matériel basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada) chargée de l’anticipation du matériel, la gestion de la configuration et de l’approvisionnement de matériel lors d'événements critiques. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant que Spécialiste des pièces reliées aux activités de maintenance sera: d’évaluer les requis potentiels de pièces reliées aux besoins associés aux activités de maintenance ; de travailler de concert avec une équipe de soutien au sein de l'ingénierie en service et du soutien/service technique, ainsi qu'avec les représentants sur le terrain et l'équipe de distribution des pièces ; de faires des analyses approfondies de pièces requises, selon les effectivités et les interchangeabilités ; de compiler, dans une base de données, les informations pertinentes afin de soumettre les requis à notre compagnie affiliée Satair afin de les faire mettre en inventaire. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel et application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Contribuer à définir les projets d'amélioration en lien avec les enjeux soulevés dans les activités courantes; Suivre et collaborer avec les chefs de sections dans l'organisation et les activités à complétés pour les les projets d`amélioration; Proposer des activités d'ajustement au besoin en lien avec les gouvernances en place; Investigation sur les causes et piste de solution pour les gouvernances qui ne rencontrent pas les objectifs établis; Développer des synergies avec les équipes de Satair et de certains fournisseurs; Assurer l'alignement des priorités de l'équipe avec celles de l`organisation; Proposer des outils de gouvernance à long terme; Contribuer au développement de plan stratégique de l`équipe à long terme. Votre profil: Vous détenez un minimum de dix (10) ans d'expérience dans un environnement de maintenance et une connaissance accrue des enjeux rencontrés lors de ces visites; Vous êtes à l'aise d'utiliser divers manuels de maintenance tels que l'AMP, IPDP et le ASRP; Vous avez des aptitudes dans SAP, Catia et Enovia (un atout); Vous êtes à l'aise dans des écosystèmes complexes; Vous avez une expérience chez Airbus et/ou sur l'A220 et/ou en service à la clientèle (un fort atout); Vous êtes structuré dans le suivi de vos activités et avez de l'expérience dans l'intégration de nouvelles méthodes de travail; Vous avez la capacité de travailler dans un environnement dynamique de projet transversal; Vous démontrez une forte capacité à gérer vos priorités et à surmonter les revers; Vous favorisez le travail d'équipe et agissez avec leadership; Vous êtes axé sur le client et vous vous comportez avec intégrité en tout temps sans compromis; Vous avez d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication (français et anglais) et traitez les gens avec respect; Vous faites preuve d'innovation, d'engagement et de persévérance; Vous vous souciez du développement des personnes et valorisez la contribution de chacun. Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* Job description : Do you have high experience on aircraft maintenance activities, have you worked in the aviation industry and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for a Material Maintenance Specialist to join our In Service Operation team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will contribute to return the aircraft into service as planned by the customer. You will be part of the Configuration Management and Supply Engineering & Material Anticipation team responsible for material anticipation, configuration management and material supply during critical events. The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as Material Maintenance Specialist will be to: Evaluate part requirements to complete maintenance activities; Collaborate with a multidisciplinary teams to find the best solution for each part; Carry out in-depth analyses of required parts, according to effectiveness and interchangeability; Compile relevant information from maintenance activities to propose additional inventory to support the business activities. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. title: Fuel System Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Fuel System Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and integration of cutting-edge fuel systems for Airbus aircraft. This role involves ensuring the safety, performance, and certification of fuel systems in accordance with industry standards and regulations. Job Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, and analyze aircraft fuel systems and their components (e.g., tanks, pumps, valves, lines, sensors) from conceptualization through detailed design.
* Perform system-level and component-level analyses, including hydraulic, thermal, and structural assessments, to ensure fuel system performance and integrity.
* Develop and review technical specifications, requirements documents, and design documentation for fuel systems.
* Conduct trade studies and feasibility analyses to evaluate different fuel system architectures and technologies.
* Support the integration of fuel systems with other aircraft systems
* Participate in testing and validation activities, including ground tests and flight tests, to verify fuel system functionality and performance.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to fuel system design
* Ensure compliance with relevant airworthiness regulations (e.g., EASA, FAA) and company standards.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including design, stress, manufacturing, and airworthiness departments.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience (typically 3-7 years) in aircraft fuel system design, development & analysis
* Strong understanding of fuel system principles, components, and architectures.
* Good knowledge in typical system engineering tools (such as DOORS)
* Experience with analysis tools for hydraulic and thermal simulations
* Knowledge of fuel types, fuel management systems, and inerting systems. * Knowledge of C, Python is an added advantage

description_text:

At Airbus, our purpose is to “pioneer sustainable aviation for a safe & united world”. To do so, we have the ambition to develop the world’s first zero-emission commercial aircraft by 2035. As part of Airbus and to accelerate the development of a Zero Emissions Aviation, you will drive the development of the liquid hydrogen system components on all levels. Reporting de Performance : Rapporter rigoureusement la tenue des objectifs de coûts annuels fixés dans les lettres d'objectifs.
​ 2. Stratégie Industrielle et Lean Management Gouvernance Lean : Déployer une organisation la plus agile possible, basée sur la responsabilisation des équipes multifonctionnelles (MFT).
Standard d'Excellence : Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle via les standards de l'AAOS (Airbus Atlantic Operating System) pour sécuriser la robustesse à long terme.
Vision Stratégique : Établir la planification stratégique et tactique à 5 ans pour traiter les défis industriels futurs.
Amélioration Produit : Préparer la stratégie d'évolution des futurs produits pour optimiser la fabrication, le poids et la compétitivité globale de l'usine. 3. Livraison et Qualité Objectifs Opérationnels : Garantir les livraisons en respectant les standards de Qualité, Temps et Coûts (SQCDP).

Leadership : Capacité démontrée à diriger plusieurs niveaux hiérarchiques, résistance à la pression et agilité managériale.
Langues : Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais impérative. Conditions de travail Terrain : Temps partagé entre le bureau et le plancher de production (port des EPI obligatoire).

Airbus relies on a talented and diverse network of Export Control professionals in all three Divisions across the regions who will also support the relevant investigations. Your working environment: Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you: Financial rewards: Agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement. Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères. Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g Vos futures missions : En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers la sécurité des vols et la perception de l'environnement. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département Situational Awareness and Mission Management, en charge des fonctions de perception (terrain, météo, menaces, trafic), d'amélioration de la vision, ainsi que des liaisons de données et des systèmes de gestion de mission pour l'ensemble des plateformes (e-)VTOL. Votre mission consistera à piloter l'ingénierie système et l'intégration au niveau hélicoptère des systèmes de surveillance du trafic (ACAS/ADS-B) et de perception de l'environnement pour les aéronefs civils et militaires. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Responsabilité du Design : Assurer la conception système des solutions de surveillance et de connaissance de l'environnement (Situational Awareness). Ingénierie des Exigences : Définir et gérer les exigences techniques de bout en bout. Pilotage de Projet : Garantir la planification au niveau équipement et hélicoptère pour les phases de développement et de qualification. Gestion des Fournisseurs : Évaluer les offres, piloter les partenaires externes durant le développement et gérer les relations technico-contractuelles. Validation et Essais : Soutenir les tests sur banc d'intégration (Rig), les essais au sol et en vol, et garantir la qualification/certification des fonctions associées. Stratégie et Innovation : Contribuer aux activités de Recherche et Technologie (R&T), réaliser des benchmarks technologiques et participer à la stratégie produit des systèmes de mission. Votre profil : Formation : Diplôme universitaire (Master/Ingénieur) en Physique, Génie Électrique, Aéronautique ou domaine similaire. Expérience : Expérience confirmée dans la conception, le développement ou l'intégration de systèmes de surveillance ou de perception pour aéronefs. description_text:
Job Description: Job Description Organizational Leadership: Disciplinary and functional accountability for the Quality perimeter (PA, QA, Inspection training and escalations); fostering a high-performance and inclusive team culture.
QMS Governance: Ownership and continuous improvement of the QMS in line with EN9100, corporate strategy, and regulatory requirements.
Strategic Partnership: Acting as a core member of the management team to align Quality with business success and "First Time Right" objectives.
Product & Project Integrity: Ensuring end-to-end quality across the lifecycle, with a specific focus on transitioning towards small series production and high quality space products.
Risk & Deviation Management: Leading proactive risk identification and ensuring robust resolution of non-conformances and customer complaints.
Independent Voice: Serving as the sovereign authority for Quality matters towards internal stakeholders and international customers/agencies including the shareholder (Airbus DS/SpS/SpP).

Operational Efficiency: Optimizing the value chain by eliminating non-value-added activities and ensuring effective resource planning for project demands.
Continuous Improvement: Driving innovation in quality methodologies (e.g., Lean, Root Cause Analysis) and executing annual management reviews and audits.
Stakeholder Communication: Managing complex interfaces in a bilingual environment (German & English required). Skills Master’s degree/Diploma in Engineering (Aerospace, Electronics, Mechanical), Physics, Industrial Engineering or similar education.
Modern Leadership & Diplomacy: Proven ability to lead large teams with a diplomatic yet firm authority; acting as the "Independent Voice of Quality" across all hierarchical levels.
End-to-End Business Acumen: Integrating quality as strategic partner throughout whole value chain and supporting functions to ensure profitability and “Design-to-Quality”.
Industrial Transformation: Expert-level knowledge of Lean Principles and the ability to transition processes from artisan-style manufacturing to efficient small series production.
Strategic Supply Chain Oversight: Experience in managing international subcontractors, ensuring compliance (EN9100/ECSS) and quality stability across external value chains.
Pragmatic Problem Solving: A hands-on approach that balances rigorous "Zero-Defect" requirements with business pragmatism and cost-containment goals.
Tech-Forward Mindset: Openness to integrating AI-driven analytics, digital quality tools, and Industry 4.0 methodologies to optimize quality gates and data transparency.

Communication Mastery: Exceptional stakeholder management and presentation skills with full professional fluency in German and English. Solides compétences en gestion de projet, organisation et sens aigu du service client. Excellentes qualités de communication et de négociation en Français et en Anglais (B2/C1). ​ 💎 Notre entreprise Boostez votre carrière : Un accompagnement sur-mesure et mobilité interne boostée. Équilibre vie pro/vie perso : Bénéficiez de 6 semaines de congés payés, de RTT et de la possibilité de télétravailler (selon l'éligibilité du poste). Package attractif : Plan d’épargne salariale, actionnariat salarié et une mutuelle individuelle ou familiale. Engagement au quotidien : incitation financière à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage, transports) et opportunité de participer à des projets caritatifs et sociaux stimulants. Qualité de vie : Restaurant d’entreprise et un CSE dynamique (loisirs, culture, vacances). Le site de Méaulte accueille également le lycée Airbus Atlantic Henry Potez, lycée professionnel privé appartenant à Airbus Atlantic, localisé au sein d’IndustriLab. Le lycée bénéficie d’une infrastructure de haut niveau et des synergies offertes par cette plateforme régionale d’innovation jouxtant le site de Méaulte.

Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du Bureau d'Études (Design Office) en agissant comme garant de l'adhérence aux processus. title: Team Leader AIT
description_text:
Job Description: Team leader Assembly, Integration & Testing We are looking for a Team Leader to lead the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) departments. In this role, you will report to the Head of AIT. You will manage a team of approximately 10–15 employees, both hierarchically and operationally. Company description
Airbus Netherlands makes a vital contribution to the international Space industry in our current operational areas of Solar Arrays, Launcher Structures, Instruments & Systems. In these fields we belong to the World top and seek to maintain the same level with future products and services. Our focus is to be a reliable partner that contributes to the success of our clients’ missions in a solution-driven and targeted manner. Airbus Netherlands designs and builds structures for European launchers serving the commercial and institutional satellite markets. The combination of our long heritage and continually expanding expertise has equipped us with the capability to meet the rapidly changing demands in this field. The company also plays a crucial role on a variety of missions funded by ESA, NASA and commercial institutions to design and develop Solar Arrays used to power satellites, spacecraft and their payloads. Key responsibilities:
Operational Planning Assign team members to projects and workstations based on capacity planning and available resources. Identify and anticipate workload bottlenecks and capacity constraints. Plan, organize, and oversee the execution of team activities. Ensure optimal and flexible deployment of people, tools, and facilities. Support efficient utilization of test and production facilities (internal and external use). Lead and Role out process and improvements Team Leadership & Development Manage the team effectively, including people, processes, and resources. Support the professional development of employees to ensure high-quality and flexible employability. Facilitate knowledge sharing, knowledge transfer, and required certifications. Act as a working supervisor when needed. Coordinate (international) working groups for onsite customer support activities. Technical Facilities & Safety Ensure proper maintenance of tools, cleanrooms, and production equipment. Support the availability, development, and management of technical facilities. Identify and escalate building- and safety-related issues, ensuring proper follow-up. Stakeholder Management & Improvement Advise the Head of AIT on management and knowledge-area topics and support implementation within the team. Contribute to departmental plans, annual investment plans, and budgets, including monitoring and reporting deviations. Co-responsible for executing approved investment proposals. Contribute to business development and acquisition activities within the knowledge area. Translate developments in the field into team activities and processes. Drive continuous improvement within the area of responsibility. Profile of our ideal candidate: Hands-on experience in a technical environment. Strong understanding of technical systems, processes, and/or infrastructure. Strong focus on quality, LEAN and continuous improvement in all aspects of work. Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, developers, and technicians. Strong conflict resolution and problem-solving skills. Ability to inspire and guide individuals towards common goals, in line with Airbus values. Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information and actively listen to others. Strong team player with awareness of own and others’ emotions (emotional intelligence). Open to change and able to adapt to new situations and evolving environments. Requirements: MBO/ HBO Bachelor degree (technical background preferred) 2–5+ years of experience as a team leader, supervisor, or project lead in a technical environment Must be able to communicate effectively in English and Dutch (verbal and written) Available 40 hours per week. Residency in the Netherlands What's in it for you?
We offer a challenging job in a dynamic and international working environment, with extensive opportunities for personal development and attractive working conditions such as: competitive salary including participation PME pension fund 27 holidays + 13 ADV days per year based on full time employment easily accessible head office near Leiden Central Station assembly facility is close to the head office commuting allowance or public transport allowance bicycle plan and company fitness plan Are you ready for this challenge?
