Start: July 2026 / as soon as possible
Duration: minimum 1 year, preferably 2 years Definition working student
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis. This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week. Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment. Your location
Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. Your benefits Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime). International environment with the opportunity to network globally. Work with modern/diversified technologies. description_text:
Job Description: Program Description Airbus Defence & Space is working on a new satellite based communication system. The constellation of satellites will offer connectivity to the customer, allowing connecting elements through satellite RF and optical links. In order to actively monitor and control the Mission configuration for the communication chain a set of new tools is under development at Airbus DS. Such tools will allow actively managing the overall communication chain, including Space and Ground assets, in order to reach the needed coverage and performances. The Software will be partly developed internally within the team and will be partly subcontracted to internal and external Subcontractors. The application to be developed consists of a set of SW Modules which allow the simulation, commanding and monitoring of a cutting-edge Payload, as well as the overall traffic configuration. Support the definition of the Software Architecture, ensuring robustness and compatibility with already existing software modules and eventually AI engines, where needed. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. title: Ensia - Responsable de Infraestructura IT / IT Infrastructure Manager
description_text:
Job Description: Resumen de la posición: Contrato: Temporal (6 meses + 6 meses) Fecha de inicio: Lo antes posible. Ubicación: Getafe. Remuneración: En función del perfil y/o experiencia + beneficios sociales de Testia. Reports to: Head of Digital Operations & Quality Indispensable adjuntar CV en inglés Contexto: Buscamos un perfil sólido y experimentado para ocupar el puesto de Manager de Infraestructura IT . Este rol clave es responsable de definir la estrategia, el mantenimiento y la evolución de toda la infraestructura informática mundial de la empresa. Se encargará de la arquitectura de la infraestructura y acompañará al equipo para garantizar una gestión autónoma de las operaciones.
Además de este rol, intervendrá como adjunto y sustituto del director de Operaciones Digitales (IT/IS). Desempeñará un papel de mentor con el equipo para fomentar su crecimiento profesional, asegurando al mismo tiempo la continuidad, seguridad y eficacia de nuestro entorno digital. Responsabilidades y objetivos del puesto: A. Gestión de la infraestructura mundial y de los activos IT. Responsable del ciclo de vida completo y la disponibilidad operativa de todos los activos informáticos físicos y virtuales: Estrategia:
Establecer la estrategia, diseñar la arquitectura y definir las especificaciones informáticas para garantizar el soporte y la robustez de la infraestructura, gestionando la relación con los proveedores externos clave. Ciclo de vida de los equipos:
Gestionar el ciclo de vida completo (desde la definición hasta el desmantelamiento) de ordenadores, teléfonos, impresoras y dispositivos industriales. Garantizar la masterización/remasterización de PC, gestión de drivers y actualizaciones de SO (ej. WSUS). Arquitectura y operaciones de red:
Diseñar y configurar toda la topología de red. Gestionar contratos de ISP, VPN, NAC y configuraciones de firewall. Supervisar el rendimiento de la red y organizar operaciones de mantenimiento. Gestión de servidores y almacenamiento:
Supervisar el alojamiento de servidores, gestión de hardware, actualizaciones de SO y soluciones de almacenamiento en red. Garantizar la implementación y prueba de procedimientos de Backup & Restore robustos. Virtualización:
Gestionar el aprovisionamiento y mantenimiento de escritorios virtuales y entornos VDI. B. Adjunto en la gestión de operaciones digitales - IT/IS Asegurar el relevo estratégico del director de Operaciones Digitales, garantizando la continuidad de la gobernanza y las operaciones: Planificación estratégica:
Contribuir al desarrollo y ejecución de la hoja de ruta (roadmap) IT/IS mediante análisis comparativos y vigilancia tecnológica. Gobernanza operativa:
Supervisar las operaciones diarias y el liderazgo de los equipos, incluyendo planificación presupuestaria, gestión financiera y asignación de recursos. Gestión de riesgos y contratos:
Realizar análisis de riesgos y gestionar contratos/proveedores. Gestión de servicios:
Supervisar la estructura de Helpdesk y la gestión de incidentes. Definir y seguir los indicadores de rendimiento (KPI) y acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLA). Sistemas, aplicaciones y datos:
Coordinar el mantenimiento y optimización de aplicaciones, el sistema ERP y las licencias de software. Continuidad de actividad:
Garantizar la operatividad de los planes de continuidad de negocio (BCP) y de recuperación ante desastres (DRP). Lo que buscamos Con formación de Grado o Máster en Informática, cuenta con más de 5 años de experiencia en gestión de infraestructuras y en un rol de liderazgo senior. Experiencia técnica: Sólidos conocimientos en topología de red, administración de servidores (Windows/Linux), virtualización, bases de datos, scripting, normas de ciberseguridad y gestión del ciclo de vida del hardware. Visión estratégica: Capacidad demostrada para gestionar presupuestos, indicadores de rendimiento (KPI) y hojas de ruta estratégicas. (La experiencia con ITIL o marcos ITSM similares será un plus) Alto nivel de Inglés y español, B2/C1. (El dominio del francés o alemán será un plus.) Competencias IT: SQL, Crystal Reports, Web Services, Linux y Windows. Nociones de bases de datos y su administración. Nociones de lenguajes web (ej. PHP, Python…) y scripts. Despliegue de aplicaciones en infraestructuras virtualizadas y cloud (VMWare, Docker, Kubernetes). El conocimiento de la norma ISO 27001 será un plus. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Job Summary: Contract: Temporary (6 months + 6 months) Start Date: As soon as possible. Location: Getafe. Compensation: Based on profile and/or experience + Testia employee benefits. Reports to: Head of Digital Operations & Quality You must attach your resume in English Context: We are seeking an experienced professional to fill the position of IT Infrastructure Manager. This key role is responsible for defining the strategy, maintenance, and evolution of the company’s entire global IT infrastructure. The manager will oversee the infrastructure architecture and support the team to ensure autonomous management of operations.
This role will serve as the deputy and substitute for the Director of Digital Operations (IT/IS). You will act as a mentor to the team to foster their professional growth, while ensuring the continuity, security, and efficiency of our digital environment. Job Responsibilities and Objectives: A. Management of global infrastructure and IT assets. Responsible for the full lifecycle and operational availability of all physical and virtual IT assets: Strategy:
Establish the strategy, design the architecture, and define IT specifications to ensure the support and robustness of the infrastructure, while managing relationships with key external vendors. Equipment Lifecycle:
Manage the full lifecycle (from definition to decommissioning) of computers, phones, printers, and industrial devices. Ensure PC imaging/reimaging, driver management, and OS updates (e.g., WSUS). Network architecture and operations:
Design and configure the entire network topology. Manage ISP contracts, VPNs, NAC, and firewall configurations. Monitor network performance and organize maintenance operations. Server and Storage Management:
Oversee server hosting, hardware management, OS updates, and network storage solutions. Ensure the implementation and testing of robust backup and restore procedures. Virtualization:
Manage the provisioning and maintenance of virtual desktops and VDI environments. B. Deputy Director of Digital Operations - IT/IS Serve as the strategic backup for the Director of Digital Operations, ensuring continuity in governance and operations: Strategic Planning:
Contribute to the development and execution of the IT/IS roadmap through benchmarking and technology monitoring. Operational Governance:
Oversee daily operations and team leadership, including budget planning, financial management, and resource allocation. Risk and Contract Management:
Conduct risk analyses and manage contracts/vendors. Service Management:
Oversee the Helpdesk structure and incident management. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs). Systems, Applications, and Data:
Coordinate the maintenance and optimization of applications, the ERP system, and software licenses. Business Continuity:
Ensure the operational readiness of business continuity plans (BCPs) and disaster recovery plans (DRPs). What We're Looking For Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science. More than 5 years of experience in infrastructure management and in a senior leadership role. Solid knowledge of network topology, server administration (Windows/Linux), virtualization, databases, scripting, cybersecurity standards, and hardware lifecycle management. Proven ability to manage budgets, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic roadmaps. (Experience with ITIL or similar ITSM frameworks is a plus.) Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. (Proficiency in French, or German is a plus.) IT Skills: SQL, Crystal Reports, Web Services, Linux, and Windows. Basic knowledge of databases and database administration. Basic knowledge of web languages (e.g., PHP, Python) and scripting. Deployment of applications on virtualized and cloud infrastructures (VMWare, Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of the ISO 27001 standard is a plus. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Recruitment Process Interested candidates have to submit their resume in English. description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for an Industrial Means Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). As a member of the Industrial Means team within the Manufacturing Engineering department, you will work with a team of engineers across multiple disciplines to design, build and deliver critical production assets required to manufacture and assembly launcher components or partial/entire satellites. Accountabilities Your main responsibilities will include: To manage industrial means packages (tooling, MGSE, machines or autonomous systems) for entire programs, delivering them in time, cost and quality. The jobholder should be able to analyse project performance and to identify potential improvements.
The jobholder is technically responsible for the design, coordination and execution of the tooling and MGSE required for the manufacturing, machining, assembly, test, ground operations and transport of launchers and satellite products developed by Space Systems Spain.
To attend to customer meetings (ESA, Ariane, etc.) and to local or international suppliers, therefore occasional travels could be requested.
To ensure internal and external stakeholders’ needs are fulfilled, taking into consideration inputs from different departments such us Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Health and Safety, Engineering, Quality and Logistics.
To ensure proper adaptation to ramp-up profile and sequence of real serial parts in terms of % of operations, takt adherence target, etc.
Ensure all maintenance activities are known and ready in advance before entry into service of the industrial means delivered to production.
Support maintenance and production departments with technical expertise to ensure the reliability of the means.
To deliver safe (safety first) and ergonomic means to production or to the customer (MGSE).
To support all the program activities including master and detailed planning, proposals, CapEx, budgets, etc. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company´s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Tasks Your main tasks will include: To manage call for tenders, taking into account all internal and external stakeholders, and all requirements including but not limited to technical, financial, quality, supply chain and strategic aspects.
To create technical specifications for different industrial means ranging from simple tools to complex autonomous systems
Evaluation of supplier’ proposals and down selection based in technical and economical aspects. To manage the different milestones of the means acquisition (KOM, PDR, CDR, CISS, CIPS and FA). Through design analysis, stress analysis, FMAs, verifications and tests to ensure the means are delivered with the required quality.
Use of CAD to create concepts, analysis for GD&T to ensure correct functionalities.
To manage suppliers to ensure OT, OQ, OC delivery of the assets.
To analyse from an H&S and ergonomics point of view the proposed solutions by the suppliers.
Steer trouble shooting, failure analysis and analytical thinking when required.
To develop brainstorming session to solve complex requirements
To give workshop support on the first uses of the delivered means.
To setup and commission new manufacturing/assembly stations ensuring all the stakeholders requirements are meet.
To perform modifications on exiting means taking into consideration all the required constraints and new requirements. Required skills We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience: Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in engineering.
At least 5-10 years of experience in engineering, manufacturing and tooling area.
Design for manufacturing.
Experience on a tooling supplier is a must
Proven knowledge of tooling manufacturing processes
Tolerances analysis (GD&T).
Knowledge of stress analysis is a must and thermal is desirable.
Automation skills would be desirable.
Metrology skills would be desirable (CMM and Laser tracker basics). Alignment and verification principles.
Health and safety knowledge as well as ergonomics principles.
Knowledge on CE directives applicable to industrial means.
Project management skills
English and Spanish must be negotiation level.
High knowledge of CATIA.
Experience designing mass efficient structures.
Experience working at a production facility
Experience managing large assembly models and drawings.
Dynamic and enthusiastic, with a proactive attitude.
Willingness to improve processes and procedures to increase quality in our scopes.
Able to work under pressure and adaptability in a changing environment.
Additional requirements
Willing to travel nationally as necessary, up to 20% (once a week/month).
Willing to travel to other countries to visit customers and/or suppliers
Work schedule may vary depending on site operational needs which may require extended hours, and flexibility is required. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance. Collective transport service in some sites. Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Aerosystems Kinston is looking for a Program Management Analyst to join our team based in Kinston, NC. The Program Data Analyst supports program execution within the Aero Systems division by collecting, analyzing, and reporting program data to ensure performance, schedule adherence, and process efficiency. This role partners closely with Program Managers and cross-functional teams to track milestones, identify risks, improve workflows, and communicate actionable insights in a fast-paced aerospace environment. Meet the Team:
Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program.
Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Create clear, concise reports and visual presentations for internal stakeholders and management. Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks in program workflows and recommend data-driven solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Project Tracking: Assist Program Managers in tracking milestones, action items, and deliverables to ensure all project phases meet strict aerospace schedules and deadlines. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional departments to ensure data integrity, consistency, and effective communication across the Aero Systems division. ERP & SAP Data Extraction: Extract, review, and interpret data from SAP, including non-conformance records, and organize findings effectively in Excel for reporting and analysis. Presentation Development: Create and update basic PowerPoint presentations to clearly communicate program status, trends, and data insights. Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Job Description: Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain? AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover II 2026/2027 - Starting date 5th October 2026 until 1st October. We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating. The selection process will be during April 2026 until July 2026. What does this internship consists in? Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future. You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background. The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. Internship Job Description: ​ At AIRBUS, different solutions are being studied to address the problems related to the appearance of electric arcs. One of the most cutting-edge developments is based on the use of sensors that monitor the aircraft's wiring and, through the use of algorithms, determine the existence of the electric arc. One of the key activities for the validation of these electric arc detectors is the evaluation of the electromagnetic noise present in the aircraft wiring, and the study of its impact on the design of the solution. This internship consists of the characterization of electromagnetic noise in test bench environments, for the detection of electric arcs in hybrid aviation using artificial intelligence. You will use Matlab/Simulink, DOORS, NShow. Required skills and mindset #AirbusDiversity As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience: Level B2 English and B2 Spanish Bachelor degree in Electrical and Electronic engineering, Industrial, Aeronautical and Telecommunications. In addition, as a secondary role (expected 50% of time), the person will support the sales of services for Airbus Defense and Space, Air Power Services. Build and nurture trusted relationships with key influencers within assigned accounts. Develop and support business strategies for opportunities with selected accounts, in full cooperation with Airbus Defence and Space Indonesia and Airbus Indonesia. Analyze and understand customer and MNO needs for both business-critical (enterprise) and mission-critical (public safety, defense) segments to build a sustainable sales funnel. Maintain a deep understanding of the PSS portfolio and capabilities to ensure optimal market positioning. Lead strategic initiatives with 3rd parties and Systems Integrators to enhance business solutions and address market gaps. Develop and manage channel partners effectively. Proactively engage necessary PSS internal teams to support new business development and build extensive, long-lasting business relationships with customer accounts. Develop market capture plans in line with PSS methodology and processes. Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche des planificatrices/planificateurs de travaux et de matières pour rejoindre notre équipe de Planification des Matières et Travaux (PMT) basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous mettrez à profit vos compétences en étant au cœur des opérations de la Ligne Finale d’Assemblage (FAL). Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Planification Travaux et Matières chargée de mettre en place des plans de productions quotidiens, d’exécuter des suivis auprès des différentes équipes (production et fournisseurs) et assurer une livraison des pièces sur la ligne au bon moment. Votre rôle en tant que planificatrice/planificateur des travaux et des matières sera de rallier l’équipe multifonctionnelle sur un plan commun en priorisant et coordonnant les différents travaux et livraison de pièces. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Construire un plan de charge de l'atelier pour la section de production cadencé; Planifier et coordonner les travaux de différents intervenants; Exécuter des suivis serrés avec les différentes parties prenantes afin de s'assurer du respect du plan de production (approvisionnement, production, fournisseurs sur site, etc.) ; Être au centre des activités de production en étant le coeur de la planification et du suivi des travaux ; Définir et exécuter des flux de matériaux allégés et fiables du quai au point d'utilisation en étroite collaboration avec la fonction Logistique-Approvisionnement ; Définir et mettre en œuvre la gestion des stocks dans le cadre d'une stratégie globale d'amélioration du fonds de roulement ; Développer des solutions pour aligner l'offre et la demande afin de réaliser la stratégie de gestion des stocks. The A220 commercial aircraft Program is looking for Work & Material Planners to join our Work & Material Planning (W&MP) team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will be the heart of the operation of the Final Assembly Line (FAL). Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. title: Engineer - Aerothermal
description_text:
Job Description: Team: Structures – Thermal Solutions As part of the Structural Analysis group within the Structures department, the Thermal Solutions team plays a vital role in ensuring aircraft integrity through the thermal assessment of structures and assemblies . The team extends competencies in the area of Thermal and Multiphysics analysis using FE/FV and CFD based methods. The primary responsibility of this role is to conduct thermal analysis on aircraft structures under both normal operating and system failure conditions. Additionally, the job holder will utilize CFD-based multiphysics approaches to perform comprehensive thermal evaluations. Role: Providing structural thermal analysis support to evaluate the impact of thermal loads on aircraft design and structural integrity. Technical skills required: Understanding of Aircraft structure and systems. Profound Thermodynamics, Fluid Dynamics, Heat Transfer, Material properties, Refrigerants and Cooling Systems understanding. Strong experience of Thermal simulation. Understanding of aero-thermal environments and systems affecting the temperature of aircraft components. Strong Hands-on Experience in numerical modelling, 1D analysis (Amesim), NX11, Simcenter 3D, TMG and CFD (Star CCM+, FLUENT) methods and tools. Understanding of temperature mapping, effect and theories. Ability to learn new tools and processes to ensure the project deliveries. Ability to work in collaboration with a team to ensure the quality of the deliverable is must, as the project deliveries may directly contribute towards the certification of the aircraft. Exposure of operability and in-service aspects. Awareness of methods & tools development process & automation. Tools: NX11, Simcenter 3D, NX-IDEAS, TMG, Star CCM+, FLUENT, CATIA Programming language: Basics knowledge of programming using any language e.g. C, Python, Fortran, JAVA etc… is beneficial Soft Skills: Teamwork Excellent communication skills Willingness to learn new skills, self-development Problem-solving orientation Ability to work in a transverse environment with multiple stakeholders Departments Allowed: Aerospace/Mechanical/ Civil /Automobile Job Location: Bengaluru This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. description_text:
Job Description: Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain?
AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain- #Discover II 2026/2027 Starting date 5 th October 2026 until 1st October. We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.
The selection process will be during April 2026 until July 2026.
What does this internship consists in? Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future. You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background. The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.
Internship Job Description: Within the dynamic environment of the Air Power Business Unit Portfolio, you will take on a fully transversal role. You will help us transform the way we handle portfolio management data and reporting. Tasks to be carried out by the student: -Support the digitalization of current portfolio management tools within Air Power, You will specifically focus on enhancing and modernizing the following key assets: CHORD: Developing scripts and automations to optimize its current functionality and data handling within the R&D projects portfolio. Integrated Product Roadmap: Evolve the current IPR structure by streamlining its data flows and ensuring accurate, real-time integration with R&D Project Progress reporting. All-In-One Project Progress Reporting: Transforming the current reporting structure into a fully digital, efficient, and interconnected R&D projects tracking system. - Design and develop software solutions to ensure seamless interconnectivity between different portfolio management applications.
- Assist in Portfolio Data Analytics, extracting meaningful insights from complex datasets.

System Validation Implement a pilot case study (e.g., APU or landing gear failures) to demonstrate AI + RAG capabilities. Validate accuracy and usability with Airbus engineers. title: ATR - Ref - DOA Independant Monitoring Function Manager
description_text:
Job Description: About us ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo. From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way. If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR! Our leadership profile People Centric, Entrepreneurial, Inspiring, Exemplary, Innovative, Humble. At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages! We are looking for a DOA Ref – IMF (Independent Monitoring Function) Manager to come onboard in our “Quality Engineering” Departement in Sandrine’s team. Your mission The Independent Monitoring Function (IMF) team is in charge of the independent surveillance required by the Part 21 21.A.239 (e) within the framework of the Design Management System (DMS). The IMF team's core missions include: 1- Verifying compliance of the Design Management System (DMS) with Part 21 to ensure requirements are implemented through ATR directives/procedures and applied to design partners and subcontractors. 2- Surveillance of design suppliers with DOA (Design Organization Approval) delegation. While the suppliers surveillance is delegated to the "Supplier Quality" team, assessments defined in the DOA audit plan will be conducted under IMF coordination to verify compliance with Part 21 requirements and design organization interface documents. Within the IMF team, you will act as an interface between ATR Engineering and EASA (responsible for ATR DOA oversight). You will support the Chief of Independent Monitoring Function in the following activities: Preparing, conducting, following up, and closing internal DOA audits. Performing regulatory watch. Maintaining the DOA CCL (Compliance CheckList). Managing and monitoring DOA signature delegations. Managing and analyzing changes to the DMS. Maintaining the Design Organisation Handbook (DOH). Participating in EASA audits and ATR/EASA meetings with prior preparation. Leading training sessions to promote and maintain necessary regulatory and DOH knowledge within the Engineering department. About You Field of Study: Engineering, Quality, Safety, Compliance. Experience: 5 to 10 years in the aerospace industry. Minimum 5 years of experience in Engineering / Quality. 2 to 4 years of experience in Part 21J management. Interface experience with authorities (EASA; local authorities are a minimum). Technical Skills: PART21J management and training, approval management. Safety Management Systems (SMS). Regulations, general aircraft physics, and engineering. title: Coordinateur - Technicien Opérations Télécommunications & Réseaux (h/f)
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Cordinateur équipe Technicien Opérations IT/système & Réseaux (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département de Services de Connectivité basé à Toulouse, France. Vos missions : Vous ferez partie d'une équipe technique spécialisée dans les télécommunications. Au sein du Centre de Supervision du Réseau (NOC - Network Operation Center), vous serez impliqué(e) dans le support client et la maintenance des infrastructures visant à garantir la disponibilité des services de communication pour des clients gouvernementaux, militaires et institutionnels. Vos responsabilités : 1. Coordination et pilotage de l'activité : Planifier et animer les revues hebdomadaires de suivi des incidents (tickets) et piloter les plans d'actions associés.
Gérer le planning de l'équipe (rotations, astreintes de nuit et week-end) et suivre la charge de travail.
Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPI - Key Performance Indicators) pour garantir la qualité de service.
Assister le management dans la préparation des réponses aux appels d'offres et l'élaboration des coûts opérationnels. 2. Support technique et gestion des incidents : Assurer la gestion des incidents impactant les infrastructures centrales et locales des clients.
Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients avec une communication claire et pertinente.
Garantir l'exhaustivité et la cohérence des données techniques et du suivi des interventions. 3. Management et développement des compétences : Évaluer l'autonomie des collaborateurs et mettre en place des plans de montée en compétences (coaching, formations).
Participer activement au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
Organiser la polyvalence de l'équipe (plan de back-up) sur l'ensemble des technologies supportées. 4. Expertise technique opérationnelle : Réaliser les mêmes tâches opérationnelles que les membres de l'équipe pour assurer la continuité de service.
Répondre aux sollicitations techniques liées aux projets internes et aux besoins spécifiques des clients. Votre profil : OBLIGATOIRE : Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues (niveau Défense).
Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1). Compétences et expérience attendues : Expérience : Minimum 10 ans d'expérience en tant que technicien informatique, systèmes et réseaux, idéalement dans l'exploitation et la maintenance.
Compétences : Connaissances générales en Informatique, Systèmes, Réseaux et Télécommunications.
Expertise Technique :
Maîtrise des environnements Windows et Linux.
Gestion de réseaux : routage, VPN (Réseaux Privés Virtuels), VLAN (Réseaux Locaux Virtuels), Wi-Fi et VoIP (Voix sur IP).
Connaissances en protocoles TCP/IP et bases de données (SQL, PHP, MySQL).
La certification CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) est un atout majeur.
Savoir-être : Esprit d'équipe, approche systémique pour la résolution de problèmes, curiosité technique et bon relationnel.
Langues : Français courant (niveau négociation) et Anglais intermédiaire.
Optionnel : Les connaissances complémentaires en systèmes de radiofréquences (RF), terminaux satellites (VSAT), électricité ou services de connectivité par satellite (type OneWeb ou Starlink) seront fortement appréciées. Votre environnement de travail : Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10 000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns, wenn du uns im Kompetenzzentrum für Mikrowellensysteme als Masterand (d/m/w) unterstützt! Standort: Immenstaad Start: 01.07.2026 Dauer: 6 Monate (in Anlehnung an die Vorgaben der jeweiligen Universität) Dein Standort Am Airbus-Standort in Friedrichshafen arbeitest du dort an Innovationen, wo andere Urlaub machen. Genieße den Panoramablick auf den Bodensee, während du in unserer Kantine zu Mittag isst. Und nach der Arbeit schließt du dich einer unserer vielen Betriebssportgruppen an, um zu laufen, zu segeln oder Ski zu fahren. Deine Vorteile Attraktive Vergütung und ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance bei einer 35-Stunden-Woche (Gleitzeit). Internationales Umfeld mit der Möglichkeit, Kontakte in die ganze Welt zu knüpfen. Arbeit mit modernen/abwechslungsreichen Technologien. Wir bei Airbus sehen dich als vollwertiges Teammitglied und du bist nicht zum Kaffee kochen eingestellt worden, sondern stehst im engen Austausch mit den Schnittstellen und bist Teil unserer wöchentlichen Teamrunden. Bei der Radarmessung entstehen große Datenmengen, die mittels digitaler Signalverarbeitung On-Board reduziert werden. Zudem sind Radio Frequency Interferences (RFI) ein zunehmendes Problem, entweder durch vorhandene Strahlung anderer Anwendungen im Frequenzband oder durch gezielte Störer. Im Rahmen der Abschlussarbeit sollen innovative Algorithmen zur Datenreduktion und Störer Vermeidung untersucht werden, sowohl hinsichtlich ihrer Effektivität als auch ihrer Implementierbarkeit in der On-Board Hardware, die auf modernen FPGA/SoC basiert. Die Aufgabe lässt sich grob in folgenden Aktivitäten gliedern: Einarbeitung in die Thematik. Evaluierung existierenden Methoden und Algorithmen in Bezug auf Effektivität und Implementierung. Team interne Erörterung der Zwischenergebnisse und Auswahl favorisierter Konzepte. Konzeptionelle Ausarbeitung. Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen Eingeschriebener Vollzeitstudent (d/m/w) im Bereich Nachrichtentechnik/Signalverarbeitung oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung. title: Senior Human Factors Specialist (m/f) / Spécialiste Facteurs Humains Senior (f/h)
description_text:
Job Description: Nous recherchons pour notre activité Airbus Aircraft un(e) Spécialiste Facteurs Humains Senior (f/h) pour rejoindre son équipe de conception
de cockpits d'avion, basée à Toulouse, France. La mission de l’équipe est de contribuer à la sécurité et à l'efficacité opérationnelle de nos clients, en veillant à intégrer la performance humaine et les limitations dans ses activités de recherche, de développement, de certification, de production et de support client pour ses produits, services et processus. La sécurité et les êtres humains sont au cœur de notre mission, avec pour objectif de minimiser la charge de travail et les risques d'erreur pour l'équipage, de produire des réponses efficaces face aux situations normales et anormales, et d'améliorer la performance des tâches du pilote. La sécurité, le bien-être et la satisfaction au travail sont également des préoccupations majeures. Vous évoluerez au sein d'un département d'environ 30 spécialistes et experts en facteurs humains, aux profils très diversifiés en termes de nationalités (environ 10 nationalités différentes), d'éducation et d'expérience professionnelle, d'âge et de genre. Ils sont tous hautement qualifiés dans une ou plusieurs discipline(s) des facteurs humains, telles que l'ergonomie cognitive, les neurosciences, la linguistique ou l'ergonomie physique. Notre département couvre une grande variété de projets, depuis des évolutions légères sur des produits existants jusqu’à de grands projets de recherche et technologie (RnT) pour préparer la prochaine génération de cockpits. Votre environnement de travail :
Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services. Bien-être / santé: Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est
possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos challenges: Apporter une expertise des facteurs humains sur des agencements, des fonctions, des technologies et des opérations de cockpit critiques et complexes en travaillant au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire composée de pilotes, de concepteurs, de représentants de centres de formation, de spécialistes de la sécurité et de divers experts du bureau de conception. Analyser les besoins et les facteurs influençant la performance humaine, élaborer des recommandations à prendre en compte dans la conception des flottes existantes ou des produits futurs, et assurer les évaluations des facteurs humains impliqués. Participer à l'éléboration des stratégies de certification (en devenant potentiellement DCS Facteurs Humains). Expert knowledge of global fuel specifications including ASTM D1655 (Jet A/A-1), ASTM D7566 (SAF), and Def Stan 91-091. Should have knowledge on Fuel System Engineers on topics relevant to fuel properties e.g. Properties affecting the gravity ceiling for different fuels Defining the 'Worst-Case' test fluid formulations to ensure aerodynamic and fuel system performance margins are validated under extreme density/viscosity scenarios. What fuel properties are important to include in an interface document with the Engine Producer Effect of fuel properties on microbiological contamination formation Understand the differences between all common fuel specifications and where/when these would be used. description_text:
Job Description: Description de l'emploi pour publication externe Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Test Specialist Display (F/H) pour rejoindre notre équipe Flight Management & Indicating basée à Toulouse, France. Vous rejoindrez la partie du pôle Display. Le système d’affichage (Display) est l’interface centrale entre l’équipage et l’ensemble des systèmes avion. Il a pour mission de présenter aux pilotes toutes les informations nécessaires à l’exécution de leur mission. Être testeur Display implique donc non seulement d’effectuer les opérations pilotes mais également de posséder une vision globale des systèmes avion en plus d’une expertise pointue sur l’architecture des systèmes d’affichage. Outre les nombreuses évolutions des systèmes avion dans le cadre des programmes en cours, des projets R&T innovants et stimulants sont menés sur les systèmes d’affichage afin de préparer les avions autonomes et durables de demain. Capitale mondiale de l’aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Cela inclut les essais en laboratoire sur bancs et simulateurs, ainsi que l’analyse des essais en vol. Piloter une équipe de sous-traitants en charge de réaliser avec vous les activités de test. Mettre en œuvre de nouvelles méthodes de test telles que les essais virtuels, l’automatisation des tests en s’appuyant sur des outils innovants (comme JIRA pour la rédaction des procédures et le suivi des anomalies). Vous avez un fort intérêt pour les sujets techniques, tout en disposant de compétences en gestion de projet et coordination. Vous êtes engagé(e), curieux(se), et créatif(ve). description_text:
Job Description: About us ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo. From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way. If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR! Our leadership profile: People Centric, Entrepreneurial, Inspiring, Exemplary, Innovative, Humble At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages! We are looking for a Supply Chain Quality Specialist to come onboard in our Quality Directorate in Julien’s team ! Your mission: Ensure the conformity of purchased products to ATR requirements, with a strong focus on the analysis and resolution of 0 Hours non-conformities.
The role supports On Quality and On Cost delivery by driving a “Right First Time” approach at supplier level, contributing directly to the reduction of quality escapes detected at ATR Final Assembly Line (FAL).
The Supplier Quality Specialist is accountable for managing supplier-related quality issues impacting FAL operations, and for driving corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence. Your activities: Manage supplier escapes detected at FAL level (0hours), including notification, containment, root cause analysis and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions.
Act as the quality focal point for supplier-related product non-conformities affecting ATR Final Assembly Line.
Review supplier 0hours on a daily basis and define appropriate actions & dispositions.
Drive and manage Supplier Corrective Action Request (CAR), ensuring robustness, effectiveness and non-recurrence.
Monitor and control supplier quality performance using relevant KPIs (e.g. Item Escape Rate, Recurrence rate).
Organise and lead supplier quality and performance review meetings.
Support Procurement and Supply Chain teams by providing quality input during quotation phases and technical assessments. Analyse quality failures and product non-conformities (0 hours) to identify root causes and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Contribute to continuous improvement by optimising processes, improving quality standards and reducing non-quality costs.
Ensure accurate quality reporting and escalation of risks when required. About you: Master’s degree in Quality, Engineering, Operations, or a related technical discipline.
Solid experience in supplier quality management within an aerospace environment (Part 21G).
Proven expertise in quality tools and root cause analysis methodologies (8D, Ishikawa, 5 Whys).
Good practical knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies (PDCA).
Sound technical understanding of aircraft systems, particularly hydromechanical, mechanical and powerplant systems.
Proficient in IT tools, including MS Office and SAP.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to manage complex situations and operate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Autonomous, proactive, detail-oriented, with a problem-solving mindset.
Assertive and diplomatic approach in supplier and internal interfaces.
Willingness to travel internationally as required.
Fluent in English. Our Recruitment Process Julien will contact you
Innovative and digital assessment

Career paths enabling employees to develop their skills and build a professional project
Wide choice of development programs for soft and hard skills

This role involves conceptual design, detailed engineering, analysis, and verification using simulation tools. Job Responsibilities** * Design and develop electrical power distribution systems, wiring harnesses, and lighting systems for various aerospace applications, adhering to industry standards and company specifications.
* Perform detailed electrical load analysis, power budget calculations, and fault tree analysis to ensure system integrity and reliability.

* Generate electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness designs, and detailed component specifications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design, avionics, software, and manufacturing, to ensure seamless integration of electrical and lighting systems.
* Support the definition of test procedures and participate in the testing and validation of electrical and lighting systems, both in simulation and on physical prototypes.
* Identify and resolve technical issues and discrepancies during the design, development, and integration phases.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of electrical design processes, tools, and methodologies.
* Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Job Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience (typically 4+ years) in electrical system design and development, preferably within the aerospace or defense industry.
* Demonstrated proficiency in electrical design tools and software, including CAD tools for schematics and harness design (e.g., CATIA V5/V6 Electrical, SEE Electrical).
* Strong expertise in electrical simulation software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, SPICE, PLECS, or similar) for power electronics, circuit analysis, or system-level simulation.
* Solid understanding of aerospace electrical standards, regulations, and best practices (e.g., MIL-STD, RTCA DO-160, ARP).
* Experience with lighting system design principles, including photometric analysis and control systems, is a plus.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment and communicate complex technical information clearly.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Spanish language skills are a plus. title: Schulpraktikum Airbus Bremen im Monat November (02.11.26 - 27.11.26)
description_text:
Job Description: Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Schulpraktikum und möchtest die vielseitige Arbeit bei Airbus in Bremen kennenlernen? Dann bewirb Dich! Wir freuen uns, wenn Du uns als Schulpraktikant:in (d/m/w) unterstützt. Die Stellenausschreibung gilt für Praktikumsplätze mit Start im Monat November - dabei ist der Praktikumsstart immer an einem Montag. Grundsätzlich sind unsere Praktika auf zwei Wochen ausgelegt. Je nach schulischer Vorgabe ist jedoch auch ein ein- oder dreiwöchiges Praktikum möglich. Eine Bewerbung kann mindestens bis zum 24.05.26 eingereicht werden. Was erwartet Dich bei einem Schulpraktikum bei Airbus? In Deiner ersten Praktikumswoche wirst Du ein eigenes praktisches Projekt in unserer Praktikantenwerkstatt umsetzen. Egal, ob Du bereits Erfahrungen mitbringst oder zum ersten Mal Werkzeug in der Hand hältst – bei uns kannst Du Dich ausprobieren und Technik hautnah erleben. Ab der zweiten Woche entscheidest Du selbst, wo es hingehen soll. Bitte teile uns in Deinem Motivationsschreiben mit, an welchem der folgenden Schwerpunkte Du Interesse hast. Gerne kannst Du auch angeben, ob Dein Interesse im Bereich Luftfahrt, Raumfahrt oder Defence liegt: Produktion: Technik zum Anfassen. Unterstütze uns dort, wo echte Flugzeug-/Raketenteile gefertigt und montiert werden. Engineering: Von der Idee zum Flugzeug. Wirf einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der technischen Entwicklung, Konstruktion und Optimierung. IT/Finance: Das Rückgrat der Luftfahrt. description_text:
Job Description: ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous avez une expérience en Service à la Clientèle, vous avez travaillé dans l’ingénierie aéronautique et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche le gestionnaire des équipes ingénierie structure pour la flotte A220 en service (f/m) pour rejoindre notre équipe Service à la Clientèle basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous serez en première ligne pour supporter nos clients A220. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Ingénierie en Service dont le rôle est de supporter la flotte mondiale d’A220, en répondant aux questions techniques des opérateurs sur les sujets structure, et en développant les solutions techniques (conception de réparations structure) livrées aux clients dans les délais demandés. C’est un environnement très dynamique, avec un enjeu important dû à l’impact direct sur le temps d’immobilisation des avions de nos clients. En tant que gestionnaire de cette équipe, vous aurez une trentaine de personnes vous rapportant (dont deux sous-équipes avec des gestionnaires en place), en plus du lien fonctionnel avec une équipe à Toulouse et une équipe en Australie, ainsi que des sous-traitants. La taille de cette équipe est en augmentation constante pour permettre de couvrir la croissance de la flotte et l’activité 24/7 pour les activités opérationnelles. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant que gestionnaire de cette équipe sera de : Vous assurer de la gestion opérationnelle optimisée des demandes clients, travaillant avec l’équipe sur l’amélioration continue; Travailler étroitement avec les clients sur les plans d’amélioration de la performance Assurer le développement de votre équipe de concepteurs réparations et de gestionnaires des flux de demandes clients Participer à la définition de la stratégie du département, notamment pour l’harmonisation avec Airbus Europe Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette gratuite entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Assurer un support performant aux opérateurs de l'A220 pour tous dommages structurels qu'ils rapportent, 24/7/365; Gérer une équipe de gestionnaires des flux des demandes entrantes et de deux équipes d'ingénieurs concepteurs de réparation à Mirabel; Coordonner opérationnellement des équipes A220 à Toulouse et en Australie (plateaux off-shore), ainsi que des sous/traitants; Définir les priorités avec l’équipe pour les activités opérationnelles, d’amélioration continue, et de développement long-terme; Améliorer l'efficacité (process, organisation, outils, ...) de l’équipe; Assurer la livraison en temps et au niveau de qualité requis des livrables de votre équipe; Être le point focal pour les opérateurs de l'A220 pour toutes questions concernant leurs avions, revues de performance régulières, ou tout autre besoin de communication qu'ils pourraient avoir concernant l'activité Ingénierie en Service Structure A220. Les livrables principaux de votre équipe sont: Distribution optimisée et suivi de toutes les demandes entrantes pour l'Ingénierie en Service Structure en fonction de la charge et des priorités; Document engineering définissant les réparations spécifiques à effectuer par l’opérateur pour son avion; Réparations génériques applicables à la flotte (à intégrer dans les publications pour les clients). Vous serez aussi amené à travailler sur l'harmonisation avec Airbus Commercial sur les activités de définition de réparations et les projets de Services aux Clients où votre service a un impact sur la satisfaction client. Vous serez un des contributeurs principaux aux projets d'anticipation visant à augmenter l'autonomie des clients pour leurs réparations. Votre profil: Vous détenez un diplôme en génie mécanique ou aéronautique avec une expérience pertinente d'au moins dix (10) ans dans l'industrie aérospatiale, dont minimum cinq (5) en gestion d’équipe; Vous êtes une personne dynamique avec de l'initiative, un sens aigu des responsabilités, orienté client et un avec un bon jugement; Vous êtes organisé, capable de gérer votre temps et de prioriser les tâches efficacement, tout en travaillant dans des délais serrés, démontrant la capacité à balancer l’activité opérationnelle très dynamique (temps de réponse très courts de quelques heures) et les activités long-terme; Vous faites preuve de résilience et avez une bonne résistance à la pression, et ne la transmettez pas à vos équipes; Vous avez un style de management collaboratif, démontrant un excellent leadership et de bonnes relations interpersonnelles; Vous avez de solides compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais, et une bonne connaissance du français est un atout; Avoir une connaissance des systèmes d'ingénierie, de dessin et de contrôle de configuration A220 est un atout; Avoir une connaissance détaillée de l'exploitation, de l'ingénierie et de la maintenance des compagnies aériennes est un atout; Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels occasionnels (dans le monde entier). Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* Job description : Do you have Customer Services experience, have you worked in aeronautical engineering and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for the new manager of the airframe engineering design team for the in service A220 fleet (f/m) to join our Customer Services team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will be at the front line to support our A220 customers. It is a very dynamic environment, with important stakes due to the direct impact on customers’ aircrafts’ downtime. Your role as manager of this team will be to : Ensure an optimised operational support to our customers, by working with your team on continuous improvements; Work closely with customers on performance improvement plans Drive the development of your team of repair designers et workflow managers Participate to the department strategy definition and implementation, amongst others in the frame of the harmonisation with Airbus Europe Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy. Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, free shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. Your challenges: Provide a high-performance support to our A220 operators, for all structural damage they report, 24/7/365; Manage a team of customer request workflow managers, and two teams of repair designers for the in-service A220 fleet; Operational coordination of the Toulouse and Australia off-shore plateaux, as well as subcontractors; Define priorities with the team to balance operational activities, continuous improvement, and long term development; Improve efficiency (process, tools and organisational improvements) of the team; Ensure timely delivery of engineering deliverables by your team, with the right level of quality; Be the main point of contact for A220 operators with regards to questions, presentations, reports or other needs of communication they may have with respect to In Service Engineering Airframe activities. description_text:
Job Description: Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum und möchtest die Arbeit eines Entwicklers für Digital- und Hochfrequenzbaugruppen (d/m/w) kennenlernen? Gerne kannst du Teil unseres Teams werden! Du wirst unter anderem vertiefte Einblicke in die Funktionsweise eines High-Speed Modulators erhalten. Der Modulator, in Verbindung mit einem HF-Verstärker (SSPA, TWTA) ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil eines Satelliten. Er ist für die schnelle Übertragung von Nutzdaten aus dem Massenspeicher zur Bodenstation zuständig. Diese Daten werden z.B. mit Optischen- oder Radargeräten erfasst. Deine Aufgaben Die nächste Generation von High-Speed-Modulatoren wird mit einem optischen Dateninterface ausgestattet sein, welches einen höheren Datendurchsatz zwischen Massenspeicher und Modulator ermöglicht. Im Rahmen des Praktikums wird ein Emulator entwickelt, aufgebaut und getestet, der zur Prüfung und Charakterisierung dieser Schnittstelle dienen soll. Die Hauptkomponenten des Emulators umfassen ein FPGA-Board, einen Mikrocontroller mit Touchscreen sowie einen optischen Transceiver. Mikrocontroller und / oder VHDL Programmierung inkl. Ansteuerung eines einfachen Touchscreens

description_text:
Job Description: Electronic Warfare Systems Engineer
---
JOB SUMMARY We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Electronic Warfare (EW) Systems Engineer to join our dynamic team at Airbus Defence and Space SAU. This role involves the design, development, integration, and testing of advanced electronic warfare systems for various defense applications, contributing to the protection and operational effectiveness of our platforms.
---
RESPONSIBILITIES * Lead and participate in the full lifecycle of EW system development, from concept definition and requirements analysis to design, integration, verification, and validation.
* Develop detailed system architectures, specifications, and interface control documents for EW systems and subsystems.
* Perform trade studies and analyses to evaluate various EW technologies, techniques, and system configurations.
* Conduct performance analysis, simulation, and modeling of EW systems to assess effectiveness and optimize design.
* Collaborate with hardware and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of EW components and functionalities.
* Participate in system-level testing, including ground testing, flight testing, and operational evaluation, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Generate technical documentation, reports, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
* Stay abreast of emerging EW technologies, threats, and industry trends to inform future system development.
* Contribute to proposals and bids for new EW programs and projects.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers within the EW domain.
---
SKILLS * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Electronic Warfare systems engineering, preferably within the aerospace or defense industry.
* Strong understanding of EW principles, including Electronic Support Measures (ESM), Electronic Countermeasures (ECM), Electronic Protection (EP), and Signals Intelligence (SIGINT).
* Proficiency in radar theory, RF propagation, antenna design, and digital signal processing (DSP) concepts.
* Experience with EW system architectures, sensor technologies, and data fusion techniques.
* Familiarity with relevant industry standards and military specifications (e.g., MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810).
* Hands-on experience with laboratory test equipment (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes) and simulation tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team.
* Proficiency in English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Job Description: Are you ready to drive digital transformation and customer-centric improvements in a global aviation environment? Satair, an Airbus Services Company, is seeking an enthusiastic Process & Performance Manager/Project Manager to join our global Transformation, Process & Performance Management team within Customer Resolution Services (CRS). title: Embedded Platform Support Software Architect
description_text:
Job Description: Inside of TADY’s CoC (Systems Centre of Competence), Highly Integrated Systems (HIS) is a newly created organization (Domain) with specific responsibilities in Multisystem Architectures, Airborne Computing Platforms, IMA and Modular Integration, HW/SW Certification and Infrastructure and Digitalization, acting as Multisystem and IMA Design Office and providing transversal support and services to the whole System’s CoC. This organization has been created to evolve and prepare the CoC’s organization to the new challenges and paradigms in the Systems design, to attend current and future customer needs and to foster reuse, common strategies alignment, economy of scale, multisystem architectures and digitalization. The aim is to deliver cross-functional strategies, artefacts and support for the design, development and certification of AirPower systems by centralizing competencies, expertise and activities to act as Multisystem Design Office. HIS and specifically the Computing Platforms and Software Integration Group (TADYS2), is looking for an Embedded Platform Support Software Architect. Tasks and Responsibilities: As part of the Computing Platforms and Software Integration Group (TADYS2), the Embedded Platform Support Software Architect will play a key role in driving the CoC embedded software standardization strategy. This includes providing a common API and standardized access to embedded computer platform support software (The Real Time Operating System (RTOS),Boarding Support Package (BSP), low-level I/O and peripherals drivers, and middleware such as network stacks) for the different Design Offices within the CoC. Additionally, the role involves delivering common embedded software support services, including I/O scheduling and Interface Control Document (ICD) and signals management. The Embedded Platform Support Software Architect shall also participate in the design, implementation, and verification of the embeddable solution supporting this communalization strategy, known as the Platform Abstraction Layer (PAL), along with its associated tool ecosystem. In this scenario the specific duties and responsibilities of the Embedded Platform Support Software Architect include: Requirements Management: Lead the creation and maintenance of the Software Requirements Specification (SRS) for the Platform Abstraction Layer (PAL). Design & Development: Design, develop, and perform the Verification and Validation (V&V) of the PAL components, ensuring strict adherence to RTCA DO-178C objectives up to Design Assurance Level A (DAL-A). Platform Integration: Contribute to hardware/software integration projects and support the integration of third-party platform software, including low-level drivers, RTOS Board Support Packages (BSPs), and middleware (e.g., Ethernet certification stacks, graphics drivers). Architecture Evolution: Design and implementation of new capabilities, features, and services for the PAL, such as secure mathematical functions, robust file system services, time and logging services. Certification Activities: Share responsibility for the platform software and PAL certification process, interfacing directly with certification authorities to demonstrate compliance with RTCA DO-178C guidelines up to DAL-A criticality. Technology Assessment: Support the CoC communalization strategy by de-risking, performing trade-off analyses, and evaluating specific processors, RTOS options, and performance metrics through technical benchmarking and rapid prototyping on reference boards or Model A equipment. Computing Platforms Bring-up: Collaborate in the evaluation and board bring-up of new target computing platforms, with a special focus on emerging multicore architectures. Furthermore, TADYS2 is responsible for provisioning the necessary infrastructure and configurations to the design offices, enabling them to effectively design and implement software for specific systems or ATA chapters. As part of this platform integration support, the Architect shall: Establish base development environments, including foundational RTOS partitioning and the initial partitioned software architecture. Allocate initial platform resources (partitions, execution timing, memory boundaries, and processor peripherals…etc.) and configure both the physical and logical platform architecture. Core Skills: To successfully fulfill these duties, the Embedded Platform Support Software Architect must possess the following qualifications and skills: C Programming: Advanced proficiency in real-time embedded systems programming, primarily in C. Familiarity with GNU toolchains, make/Makefiles, and legacy/modern C compilers (GCC, Clang/LLVM, Diab). Computer Architecture: Strong theoretical and practical background in computing platforms (ARM, PowerPC, x86) and System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures. Deep understanding of microcontrollers, microprocessors, and core architectural concepts (MMUs, caches, memory hierarchies, pipelining). Avionics & Electronics: Solid foundation in electronics and hardware interface definitions (electrical levels, communication protocols). Expert knowledge of avionics data buses and protocols, including legacy digital data-buses such as ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553B, CAN bus and recent or new digital network paradigms such as AFDX, TSN as well as analog and discrete I/O. Peripherals interface and programming: Extensive experience interfacing with low-speed peripherals (UART, RS422/RS485, SPI, I2C) and a strong grasp of high-speed interconnects (PCIe) and Direct Memory Access (DMA) in modern processors. Scripting and Python: Proficiency in Python to develop and maintain automated scripts and internal tools supporting hardware setup, continuous integration, and software builds. Data Structuring Technologies: Solid understanding of data serialization languages (JSON, XML). Strong background in data structuring technologies used for both communication protocols and platform configuration management. RTOS & ARINC-653: Advanced knowledge of Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) in avionics and safety-critical environments. Deep understanding of the ARINC-653 specification and hands-on experience with specific COTS partitioned RTOS solutions (e.g., Wind River VxWorks 653, Wind River Helix Virtualization Platform, Sysgo PikeOS, Green Hills Integrity, DEOS DDC-I). Low-Level Software Integration: Proven experience integrating platform support software components, including BSPs, bootloaders, peripheral/SoC drivers, and/or middleware (certifiable Ethernet stacks, storage, and file system drivers…etc.). Avionics Software Certification Standards: In-depth knowledge of embedded critical software certification standards, specifically for embedded software RTCA DO-178C and tool qualification RTCA DO-330. Language Skills: English at negotiation level. Soft Skills: Proactivity, autonomy, strong teamwork, and an analytical problem-solving mindset. Additional valuable skills: Embedded Linux: Background in Linux for embedded systems (mission or safety-critical) and general knowledge of driver development and integration and proven experience developing applications and/or platform software for a Linux system. Modelling: Familiarity with UML software modeling and hands-on experience with standard SysML design tools (e.g., Cameo Systems Modeler, IBM Rhapsody). Specific Tools: Deep understanding of Safety-Critical Software Analysis, including static analysis tools (MathWorks Polyspace, SciTools Understand) and Structural Code Coverage tools (LDRA). Experience with automated documentation generators like Doxygen. Performance Profiling: Familiarity with processor Performance Monitor Counters (PMC) and Hardware Event Monitors (HEM) for performance profiling. Understanding of multicore processor architectures, specifically regarding resource contention, interference channels, and mitigations. Agile Environment: Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborative corporate tools (Jira, Confluence). WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total) Attractive salary and compensation package Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance (40% remote work) Collective transport service in some sites Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan... On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment Special rates in products & benefits WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT US? AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover II 2026/2027 - Starting date 5th October 2026 until 1st October 2027.
