Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.
The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. Internship Job Description: For Spain perimeter we will focus on the following ones: EMH / Electromagnetics Hazards and Lightning and Electrostatic protection Safety and Reliability of the A/C Software quality assurance of systems / equipments Configuration Management (ensure the right process and traceability for all the modifications carried out in each aircraft delivered) Manufacturing Engineering (Industrialization - Provide engineering assessment & monitor in the system development to ensure the right maturity at the delivery of the aircraft and in service operation). A more detailed description of the tasks to be involved within the department of Electromagnetic Hazards (EMH): you will sketch the sizing of the MBN (Metallic Bonding Network). (Lightning current flow and spurious fault current due to equipment failure) As the A/C is made of Carbon material (CFRP), a bonding network is needed. This bonding network has several functions, the most important being a path for fault currents. Sizing the MBN requires a knowledge of the electrical loads of the A/C, but also how the electrical protection of generators works. In this case you will make use of multiphysics: electrical equations to calculate the power that needs to be dissipated and thermal equations for ensuring the CFRP is not damaged when dissipating that power. You may also participate in tests to validate the developed model with the opportunity to improve it. The main knowledge that the apprentice will take can be summarized: Basic knowledge of the structural components of the different aircraft parts. More in depth knowledge will be tail cone, wing and belly fairing. Understand the main architecture of the systems and its functions / interfaces (mainly Electric generation, external lights of the a/c, Bleed & pneumatic and inertization of the fuel tanks). Engineering organization and technical interfaces with other areas (i.e. chief engineering, manufacturing & quality, in service or maintenance areas) Projects / areas of the practice Main programs will be: A350; Single aisle; Long Range; Wide body; Future projects Apprentice will be provided with access to documentation related to system general disciplines, as well as specific tools that are required for analysis & modeling for deliverables that department need to compile. Required skills #AirbusDiversity
As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience: Aeronautical Engineering Degree Knowledge on aircraft structural components (aeronautical parts and architecture) and materials Aircraft systems Modeling tools such as Mathlab or Mathematica and graphic CATIA or other 3d model. It will be valued to be skilled in Python and other programming languages, as well as in Google's AI (Gemini) Advanced level of English and Spanish (C1 level). description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for an Energy & Sustainability Manager has arisen within Airbus Defense and Space, Sevilla. The selected candidate will join the TFS & Energy Spain Team within the Facility Management Real Estate (FMRE) organization. FMRE has evolved into a strategic partner that ensures business continuity through safe, efficient, and sustainable solutions. Our mission is to provide the best workplace experience while driving the company’s environmental commitment, directly contributing to our High 5+ and SBTi (Science Based Targets initiative) goals. The team is focused on reinforcing our industrial sites in Illescas and Getafe to lead the transition towards a low-carbon footprint. You will bridge technical energy management with high-level sustainability roadmaps, ensuring full operational support for production rates. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Implement the FMRE sustainability roadmap at the site level, focusing on decarbonization, energy reduction, and resource efficiency. Lead the Energy Management System (ISO 50001), ensuring compliance, auditing, and continuous improvement for the assigned plants. Manage "turnkey" efficiency projects (CAPEX/OPEX), from technical assessment and financial planning to final execution. Oversee the energy billing process, supply contracts, and assigned budgets to ensure cost-optimization. Drive digitalization by using tools (e.g., BMS, eSight) for real-time data analysis and identifying optimization opportunities. Coordinate with key stakeholders (Production, FALs) to balance operational needs with energy-saving targets and sustainability governance. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to meeting you: Education: Engineering degree (Master level preferred - EQF7 / MECES 3). Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in Energy Management and Sustainability within industrial environments. Soft skills: Strong communication and negotiation abilities, analytical mindset, and a proactive approach toward customer satisfaction and innovation. Languages: Advanced level of English and Spanish is required (C1). Valuable: Availability to travel occasionally to other Airbus sites in Spain and flexibility to support broader FMRE functions when business needs require. title: #Discover II 2026-2027 / Satellite Functional Validation Infrastructure Engineer Internship
description_text:
Job Description: Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain?
AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover II 2026/2027 -
Starting date 5th October 2026 until 1st October.
We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.
The selection process will be during April 2026 until July 2026. What does this internship consists in?
Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.
The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.
Internship Job Description:
The Mission:
Are you ready to see your code and configurations interact with hardware destined for space? We are offering a unique internship opportunity to join our team in the high-tech world of spacecraft development. You will help build and maintain the "digital backbone" used to prove a satellite is flight-ready. This is a great and unique possibility to work with real satellite hardware on prestigious ESA (European Space Agency) missions.
Your Role & Learning Journey:
As an intern, you will support our senior engineers in the setup and maintenance of the entire validation ecosystem. You will gain hands-on experience with:
Hybrid Test Benches: Helping to integrate NSVF (Numerical Software Validation Facilities) with real-time simulators and physical avionics.
SCOE & CCS: Supporting the installation and health-checking of Special Check-Out Equipment and Central Checkout Systems.
Aerospace Protocols: Learning how to monitor and troubleshoot data traffic across MIL-STD-1553, CAN bus, and SpaceWire interfaces.
Mission Networking: Assisting in the configuration of secure network links for System Validation Tests (SVTs), connecting the satellite in our cleanroom to remote Ground Station Control Centers.
Virtualization: Deploying and testing virtualized environments used to run "Digital Twins" of the spacecraft.
What We Are Looking For:
Education: Currently enrolled in the final year of a University Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
IT Foundations: A solid understanding of Linux/Unix environments and TCP/IP networking (VLANs, Subnetting).
Technical Curiosity: An interest in how software communicates with hardware at a low level (drivers, bus protocols).
Scripting Skills: Basic knowledge of Python or Bash for automating simple tasks.
Team Spirit: A proactive, team-working spirit is essential for our multi-disciplinary environment.
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required for technical documentation and international collaboration.
Required skills #AirbusDiversity
As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
- Level B2 English.
Skills valued:
- Analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Team spirit and great collaboration skills.
- Ability to work in complex and international environments.
What We Offer:
Direct exposure to high-fidelity satellite simulators and flight hardware.
A collaborative and supportive learning environment within the aerospace industry.
The chance to contribute to the success of complex space missions from inside the cleanroom.
Why should you apply?
- Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.
- Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.
- Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.
- Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space.
For any inquiries concerning this selection process, please contact us at randstad-airbus@randstad.es Are you interested? Apply and make it fly!

title: Head of Airbus Tech Hub Netherlands
description_text:
Job Description: Head of Airbus Tech Hub Netherlands We are looking for a Head of Airbus Tech Hub Netherlands who will contribute from a Dutch perspective to accelerating the transition towards decarbonization of the aviation sector with a strong focus on technological advancement. In this role, you will support and help shape national and international strategic initiatives and roadmaps, such as Flying Vision Accelerator, projects on decarbonization technologies and industrial related roadmaps. You will work closely with industry partners, knowledge institutes and government, translating insights from technology, market and policy developments into concrete actions, roadmaps and project outputs. You will be part of the Tech Hub NL team linked to a global network of Tech Hubs, contributing to long-term vision development, multi-stakeholder collaboration and innovation programs that support the decarbonization of aviation with the Dutch ecosystem. You will be working in a high-tech and fast paced environment pioneering sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. You will lead our Tech Hub team in the Netherlands. You will functionally report to the global Tech Hub organization that is part of Airbus Group Technology and locally to the Managing Director of the Airbus NL. You will liaise with the Airbus organizations and with partners and government institutions to initiate and shape research and innovation initiatives for the Airbus technology domains. You will oversee the progress of projects in our portfolio and report on those. You will work closely with our Communications and Public Affairs staff of Airbus NL to bolster support, promote and develop the Tech Hub footprint and create new opportunities. Company description: Airbus is the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe, providing products, services and solutions for the commercial aircraft, helicopter, defence and space sectors. In The Netherlands, Airbus has multiple production and office sites, with over 250 FTE of staff combined. Although the majority of these employees focus on delivery of hardware to the space industry (e.g. satellite solar arrays and launcher structures), Airbus Netherlands operates as a cross-divisional entity and supports to strengthen the connection between Dutch players and the various Airbus divisions. In April 2024, Airbus opened the Airbus Tech Hub in the Netherlands, a platform to catalyse breakthroughs in aerospace research, technology and innovation with the local ecosystem. The Airbus Tech Hub NL connects the global Airbus Research & Technology (research and innovation) needs with the excellence and the ambitions in the Netherlands and aims to grow the Dutch contribution to the future success of Airbus: more Airbus in NL, more NL in Airbus. Today, a team with enthusiastic innovators form the Tech Hub team at Airbus NL, focusing on the following themes: Future Energy Technologies, Cabin of the Future, Aircraft Operations, Composites and Industrialised systems, Connectivity, Quantum and MRO. Since the launch of the hub, the team has already established a significant portfolio of research and innovation projects. As a leading Aerospace company Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. Our dynamic team has the privilege of working on the future of the company and of the Aerospace sector as a whole, at the forefront of aerospace technology. We welcome those who share that passion. Mission: To bring together and foster collaboration of aerospace professionals, researchers and innovators in the local ecosystem, connected to Airbus centrally. This will be done through partnerships with local industries, universities and research centres and extended to support opportunities with SMEs and startups. Grow the engagement of Airbus in NL through defining and developing new technology cooperative programmes. For Airbus Commercial, Helicopters, and Defence & Space Research and Innovation Programmes: Maintain and develop the Airbus research and innovation strategy in country; Provide regular updates and adhere to the global group roadmap architecture; Provide visibility across all research and innovation initiatives; Facilitate and develop research and innovation partnerships; Capture of local funding opportunities and being in charge of related reporting obligations; and Align with current group organisations: research and innovation partnerships, Roadmap community, intellectual property and export control policies. For Airbus Commercial research and innovation Programme: Represent research and innovation programme in the country; Ensure alignment of local projects with research and innovation programme, centres of competence and relevant business units; Participate and contribute to the research and innovation Global Community and Network; and Contribute to the governance of the research and innovation Global Footprint. For Airbus in-Country: Responsible for alignment between local needs and research and innovation global footprint strategy; and Act as a research and innovation focal point to other in-country Airbus functions (eg. Procurement, Engineering Centers, Divisions, Commercial,..) For Airbus Tech Hub the Netherlands: To be the official spokesperson for research and innovation in the country working with Communications To support operational governance for the Tech Hub in the Netherlands including SQCDP governance and overall portfolio management To manage the teams in the Tech Hub the Netherlands to comply with the research and innovation governance To support scouting activities from Central Innovation for the Netherlands To support Technology & Engineering to identify problem statements and opportunities in the research and innovation that aligns with our company's needs and support its growth. Support in-country Commercial or offset obligations in close collaboration with the research and innovation programmes of the respective divisions (where applicable). Liaise with the Dutch innovation ecosystem to further develop the ambitions of the Tech Hub. Grow the engagement of Airbus in NL through defining and developing new technology cooperative programmes. Other duties reasonably determined from time to time by the Company Profile of our ideal candidate: Inspiring and guiding individual towards a common goal leading by Airbus values. Effectively conveying information and understanding others. Strong interpersonal skills working cooperatively with others towards a shared goal and reaching mutually beneficial agreements with others. Creative networker and experience in the relevant Dutch Aerospace ecosystem. Good team player, understanding and managing your own and others' emotions. Being open to change and able to adjust to new situations. Strong execution skills with a strong drive to add value to the business direction and persisting in the face of obstacles and setbacks. Highly analytical and structured, skilled in identifying and resolving issues effectively. Ability to work in remote / matrix teams, and successfully navigate in matrix organisations. Ability to establish a deep and mutually respectful relationship with partners. Ability to handle complex partnership structure working cross consortiums and with government organizations. Strong project management skills. Highly competent technical capabilities across the entire aircraft production lifecycle. Ability to work in an international environment - occasional late hours. Requirements: Masters / Doctorate in Aerospace / Engineering with experience in aerospace industrial and/or research domain. Experience working in a research and/or innovation environment in the Netherlands. Strong understanding of Airbus technology roadmaps (a plus) Experience in the aerospace industry in the Netherlands with network and knowledge of global and local aviation technological developments. Partnership development and innovation knowledge is preferred. Experience in negotiating contracts and handling conflicts. Familiar with governance of local government funding for technology - to secure the fund and and ensure governance. Must be able to communicate effectively in English and Dutch (verbal and written) Available 40 hours per week. Residency in the Netherlands. What's in it for you? We offer a challenging job in a dynamic and international working environment, with extensive opportunities for personal development and attractive working conditions such as: competitive salary including participation PME pension fund 27 holidays + 13 ADV days per year based on full time employment flexibility in working hours and work location easily accessible head office near Leiden Central Station structures assembly facility is close to the head office commuting allowance or public transport allowance bicycle plan and company fitness plan Are you ready for this challenge? Satellite Ground System Engineer Mission Control (d/m/w)
description_text:
Job Description: At Airbus, our purpose is to improve life on Earth and beyond through our cutting-edge space technologies. With every technological breakthrough, we bring people closer together, we navigate new frontiers and we discover new and unexplored destinations. And we don't just take innovations to space - our space solutions and projects help solve global challenges on Earth. We are looking for a candidate to become our new Satellite Ground System Engineer (d/m/f) with focus on Mission Control for national space projects within Airbus Space Engineering, located in Friedrichshafen, Germany. You will be a member of the System Architecture & Lead Engineering Team with great team-players aside you. You will join a diverse and empowered team working on Space & Ground Systems Architectures, Secure Space Solutions, Systems Engineering, Development, Operations, Data Processing, and Performance Modelling. You will benefit from training opportunities and new ways of working (home office, digital tools, flexible working hours etc.). You will find great leadership teams whose priority is to support your development, foster team spirit and give meaning to your activity in a global Airbus environment. On top, thanks to the high diversity of jobs and competencies that we can offer in our domain, you will have opportunities to grow & prepare your longer-term development plan. We are looking for diverse people to design creative ground system solutions. As a System Engineer (d/m/f) for ground systems, you will be part of a team based in Friedrichshafen supporting our integrated national space mission project teams. You will define the architecture for the control and monitoring of satellites, specify and integrate hardware and software components, and configure the mission control components. Beside the operational activities, you will contribute to our transformation plan that has the vision to become national champion for high-performance Ground-Space Mission Solutions. You will work on concrete operational tasks while capitalising return of experience for future secure space solution improvement. Join our empowered and engaged teams! Tasks & accountabilities Definition and design of Satellite Ground Systems: use of state-of-the-art methods (Scrum, Model-Based Systems Engineering) Requirements analysis and architecture definition for Ground Segments regarding: satellite monitoring and control, interfaces to ground stations, mission planning systems Design trade-offs and interface management: evaluation and optimization of design decisions, identification of internal and external interfaces, creation of interface documents (ICD) Specification of hardware and software elements as well as redundancy concepts Support in defining ground segment operating concepts and training of satellite operators Cost estimates for Ground Segment development and operation Support in system development, AIV (assembly, integration, verification) Contributions to proposals and studies as well as research and development activities Technical management for the procurement of software components Interdisciplinary collaboration: Space Segment Engineering, Performance Engineering, Operations Engineering Qualifikation: Education and professional experience: completed university degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Communications (Network), or equivalent qualification, more than 5 years of professional experience in relevant fields Technical expertise: knowledge and practical experience in processes and standards of the space industry (e.g., ECSS, CCSDS), experience in systems engineering as well as with corresponding methods and tools Adaptability and willingness to learn: Interest and ability to quickly familiarize oneself with new technologies Project experience: experience working on classified projects (an advantage), experience in managing technical stakeholders (an advantage) Soft Skills: good communication and presentation skills, team-oriented work style Language Skills: fluent German and English, French language skills (a plus) Interested? Mit jedem technologischen Durchbruch bringen wir Menschen näher zusammen, erkunden neue Grenzen und entdecken neue und unerforschte Ziele. Wir bringen Innovationen nicht nur ins All – unsere Raumfahrtlösungen und Projekte helfen, globale Herausforderungen auf der Erde zu lösen. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten, der unser neuer Satellite Ground System Engineer (d/m/w) mit Schwerpunkt Mission Control für nationale Raumfahrtprojekte innerhalb von Airbus Space Engineering in Friedrichshafen, Deutschland, wird. Sie werden Teil des Teams für Systemarchitektur und Lead Engineering sein, mit großartigen Teamkollegen an Ihrer Seite. Sie werden einem vielfältigen und befähigtem Team beitreten, das an Raum- und Bodensystemarchitekturen, sicheren Raumfahrlösungen, Systemingenieurwesen, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Datenverarbeitung und Leistungsmodellierung arbeitet. title: Phd Student on “Logistics Optimization: A Human-Centric Approach” (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Operations is looking for a PhD Student on “Logistics Optimization: A Human-Centric Approach” (d/f/m) Are you looking for a PhD in industry in collaboration with a university? Would you like to discover how combinatorial optimization and human centric decision making applies to industrial systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you joining us as a PhD student (d/f/m) at Airbus Central R&T (35 hours/week, flexi-time). Location: Hamburg Start: as soon as possible Duration: 36 months This PhD proposal aims to redefine industrial logistics optimization by focusing on human factors and the specific requirements of industrial architects, moving beyond traditional cost-centric Key Performance Indicators.. Unlike conventional optimization, industrial architects might perceive "optimal" differently, where alongside quantitative metrics, additional requirements such as resilience/ robustness, operational flow, adaptability, and safety, play a central role. The human factors-driven perspective is central, recognizing humans not just as operators but as integral to system design and performance. This addresses a significant research gap in systematically integrating human-related factors into logistics optimization models. You will develop a multi-objective optimization model that balances traditional KPIs with quantified human factors. This will lead to a framework for designing industrial logistics systems that are not only efficient but also human-centric, resilient, and sustainable, providing valuable guidance for future industrial environments. Your location
You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. Your benefits Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime). title: VIE 2026 - Japan - HRBP & Global Mobility Specialist - H/F
description_text:
Job Description: Le Volontariat International en Entreprise (V.I.E) est un programme international unique soutenu par le Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires Étrangères, le Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances, et le Ministère de la Transition Écologique. Airbus propose ainsi aux jeunes professionnels l'opportunité d'acquérir une expérience de travail rémunérée à l'étranger dans une fonction technique ou commerciale. Le V.I.E est un contrat spécifique, soumis aux critères d'éligibilité de Business France. Principales conditions du V.I.E : Être ressortissant de l'Union européenne (plus Norvège, Islande, Liechtenstein et Monaco), diplômé et âgé de moins de 28 ans (la mission peut débuter au plus tard le jour du 29ème anniversaire). Avoir rempli ses obligations militaires dans son pays, le cas échéant. Être inscrit sur le site "Mon Volontariat International" avant l'âge de 28 ans. Pour plus d'informations :https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/ La durée du contrat de ce V.I.E est de 24 months. Un poste de V.I.E – HR Business Partner & Spécialiste Mobilité Internationale est à pourvoir au sein d'Airbus Helicopters Japan à Tokyo, Japon. Vous rejoindrez le département des Ressources Humaines. Ce rôle consistera à agir en tant que partenaire RH (HRBP) basé au Japon, en soutenant la croissance de nos divisions opérationnelles tout en appuyant la fonction de Mobilité Globale. C'est une opportunité passionnante d'aborder la question suivante : "Comment permettre aux talents du monde entier de s'épanouir au Japon, et du Japon vers le monde ?", tant sur l'aspect stratégique que sur le plan opérationnel. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact, responsable de la construction d'une culture organisationnelle qui incarne la diversité et l'inclusion au sein d'une organisation mondiale en pleine croissance. Missions et responsabilités HR Business Partnering (Partenariat RH) Soutien stratégique aux unités opérationnelles : Collaborer avec les chefs de département pour développer la structure organisationnelle et la planification des effectifs afin d'atteindre les objectifs commerciaux. Gestion des talents : Identifier les hauts potentiels, créer des plans de succession et mettre en œuvre la gestion de la performance. Culture d'entreprise : Planifier et mettre en œuvre des mesures pour améliorer l'engagement dans un environnement d'employés multinationaux. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Centre d'Excellence (CoE) pour assurer l'exécution fluide des initiatives RH auprès de l'entreprise et des salariés. Opérations de Mobilité Globale Gestion du système de mobilité : Respect des politiques et mise à jour continue des packages de relocalisation et de rapatriement (allocations, logement, remboursement d'impôts, etc.). Optimisation du support à la relocalisation : Assurer une intégration (onboarding) fluide tout en gérant les prestataires externes (visas, déménagement, logement, conformité fiscale, etc.). Conformité globale : Gestion rigoureuse en conformité avec les traités fiscaux, les accords de sécurité sociale et le droit du travail de chaque pays. Maintenir et suivre toutes les informations relatives aux expatriés au Japon et aux employés en mission à l'étranger. Gestion du changement et projets Projets transfrontaliers : Intégration des systèmes RH avec la zone APAC et pilotage de la mise en œuvre d'un système RH mondial. Accompagnement du changement : Communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes pour assurer leur compréhension lors des changements organisationnels. SIRH (HRIS) et Reporting Effectuer des audits de données réguliers dans le SIRH pour garantir l'exactitude et l'intégrité des données. Préparer et compiler des données RH précises pour le reporting interne (effectifs, turnover) et externe obligatoire. Soutenir l'équipe SIRH dans les tests de mise à niveau du système et des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Support général Réviser et mettre à jour les procédures et flux de travail (workflows). Développer des guides d'utilisation et des supports de formation pour les utilisateurs finaux. Identifier les goulots d'étranglement ou les étapes redondantes dans les processus actuels. Ce rôle implique des déplacements professionnels dans le pays ; vous devez être en mesure de voyager en conséquence. Compétences requises Vous avez les expériences et les compétences suivantes : Titulaire d'un diplôme en Ressources Humaines, Administration des Affaires ou Économie. Maîtrise de la suite Google (GSheet, GSlides, etc.) pour produire des analyses de qualité. Niveau professionnel courant (écrit et oral) en anglais et en japonais indispensable. Excellente capacité à prioriser les tâches et à gérer les délais, particulièrement en période de forte activité. Capacité à identifier les anomalies de données et à effectuer des analyses de cause racine. Soft Skills (Savoir-être) Intégrité et Confidentialité : Faire preuve d'une discrétion absolue lors de la manipulation de données sensibles (salaires, données personnelles). Souci du détail : Approche méticuleuse et vérification systématique des erreurs. Sens du service client : Professionnalisme, patience et clarté avec les parties prenantes internes. - The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) is a unique international program sponsored by the French Ministries of Europe and Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. The VIE is a specific contract, under Business France’s eligibility criteria.
VIE Main Requirements: European Union citizens (plus Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, and Monaco), graduates up to and including 28 years old (a V.I.E mission can begin no later than the day of the twenty-ninth birthday) Have fulfilled military obligations for their country, if any Must be registered on the Mon Volontariat International website before the age of 28 For more information: https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/ (in English, German, Italian and Spanish) The contract duration of VIE is 24 months. A VIE for a VIE – HR Business Partner & Global Mobility Specialist has arisen within Airbus Helicopters Japan in Tokyo, Japan. You will join the Human Resource Department. This role will act as a business partner (HRBP) based in Japan, supporting the growth of our business divisions from an HR perspective while supporting the Global Mobility function. It also offers an exciting opportunity to approach the question of "how can we enable talent from around the world to thrive in Japan, and from Japan to the world?" from both the system proposal and operational perspectives. Change Management & Projects ●　Cross-border projects: Integrating HR systems with APAC and leading the implementation of a global HR system. ●　Change management: Properly communicating with stakeholders and ensuring their understanding during organizational changes and system revisions. Prepare and compile accurate HR data from multiple sources to support routine and ad-hoc internal reporting (e.g., headcount, turnover) and mandatory external reporting requirements. Support the HRIS team member in testing system upgrades, new features, and integrations before deployment. Customer Service Mindset: Approaches internal stakeholders (employees, managers, Finance) with professionalism, patience, and clarity. Language Skills: Advanced level of English & Japanese (written & spoken) This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change? Are you an experienced Vibration Test Engineer? Interested in working with people who have 20+ years of Vibration Testing experience? Then we might have the role for you! This role is highly visible and suits someone with Vibration / Shaker experience from industries like aerospace, automotive, defense, space, electronics, test houses and energy. You will be joining a close knit small team working on Telecommunications, Earth Observation & Science missions Projects like ARIEL, Vigil, ExoMars Rover, OneSat (and more) for ESA and the UK MOD. Varied career progression with this role - Environmental Test Vibration Engineer, EBT Manager, TVac Engineer, RF Test Engineer or Electricals Test Engineer How you will Contribute to the team Perform Environmental test and Electrical testing of Spacecraft Systems and components from preparation of equipment and documentation, test execution and extensive recording of data, lessons learnt, test procedures and reporting. Maintain test instrumentation, facilities and equipment. Ensure strict compliance with quality, safety, and operational standards Configure, instrument, and manage test operations using facilities like Thermal Vacuum, Climatic, Vibration, and Shock testing to ensure high-value, high-precision assemblies to achieve strict test requirements. About you… Proven working knowledge in a test environment, including practical and theoretical knowledge of electrical/electronic, Thermal Vacuum and mechanical testing within either an automated or manual test environment, with competent software skills. Engineering based HNC/HND or equivalent experience Strong foundational engineering knowledge, including competency in using mechanical and electrical formulae (e.g., theoretical loads, power values) and understanding technical documents. Comfortable working in high risk environments and understanding safety is critical. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions. How can we support you Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request. description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Defence and Space is one of the three Divisions of the Airbus Group and Europe’s Number 1
defence and space company. It is the world’s second largest space company and one of the top 10
defence companies globally. Airbus Defence and Space develops and engineers cutting-edge and
peerlessly reliable products in the field of defence and space. Its defence and space technologies
enable governments and institutions to protect natural resources, societies and individual freedom. www.airbusdefenceandspace.com Interest group: Electrical Safety Engineer - Product Regulatory Compliance (PRC) Contract type/working time: Unlimited Work experience: minimum 3 years of experience requested We are looking for an Engineer to work as an Electrical Safety Specialist as part of the Product
Regulatory Compliance (PRC) team in Airbus Defence and Space Romania. The role mission is to
lead the Electrical Safety compliance activities within the larger PRC exercise, ensuring that our
products meet the essential requirements of the European Low Voltage Directive (LVD) and
harmonized standards. You will be the bridge between design and compliance, responsible for
validating electrical designs, creating testing protocols, and verifying/executing physical tests to
prove safety in the context of CE Marking. What is a PRC Safety Engineer? Put simply, after a minimum period of on-the-job training, you’ll be the expert who verifies and
validates the electrical safety compliance status of a Project/Product. You will specifically focus on
Electrical Safety compliance as a core requirement of the European Low Voltage Directive (LVD)
and harmonized standards. PRC Safety Engineer experience and skills: Engineering Background: You must be an engineer with a minimum of 3 years of experience in
electrical engineering (either in field operations or design). Standard Implementation: Ability to study best practices and standards (e.g., EN/IEC standards
harmonised under LvD) and implement their requirements in specific product environments. Effective Communication: Ability to communicate technical compliance solutions to product teams to
ensure their Project/Product meets compliance. Mindset: A strong mindset towards safety and a proactive, self-disciplined approach to assessing
technical risks. Responsibilities: Design Validation: Performs verification and validation of electrical designs to ensure compliance with the Low Voltage Directive and harmonized standards. Testing Protocols: Creates specific electrical testing protocols and verifies test results. Risk Mitigation: Proposes compensatory measures for risk reduction, including redesign or administrative measures when necessary. Hands-on Execution: Executes physical electrical tests in the field and provides guidance/coaching to other field engineers in performing these tests. Technical Documentation: Generates engineering artefacts and organizes the contents of the PRC Record (Technical File) including Hardware Hazard Analysis. Liaison: Acts as the primary specialist for Electrical Safety, coordinating with Project/Product teams through other PRC Stakeholders involved. Decision Making: Has the ability to make independent decisions in solving technical problems related to electrical compliance Supports evolution of PRC across AD, by providing operational feedback to PRC Governance organization, gives strategical feedback to team management; Keeps up to date with latest templates, procedures and best practices, respects AD specific internal PRC process and rules as well as Operational PRC team internal procedures Guides/ coaches team members in technical matters Requirements: Education: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or a related technical area. Experience: Minimum 3 years of practical experience in electrical design or field engineering. Regulatory Knowledge: Good familiarity with EU Directives on CE marking, strong knowledge of the Low Voltage Directive (LVD) and safety-related standards. Language: English language at a minimum business level. Practical Skills: Capability to use electrical testing equipment and interpret technical data. Travel: Ability to travel within and outside the country based on business needs (e.g., electrical field testing/site visits) Competencies: Certifications: Any official certification in the electrical field or regulatory compliance is a major plus. Systems Engineering: Knowledge of Systems Engineering or quality frameworks is a plus. Soft Skills: Good organizational, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities Good written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Airbus Aerosystems Kinston is looking for a Finance Controlling Manager to join our Finance team based in Kinston, NC. The Financial Controlling Manager for Airbus Aerosystems Kinston will be responsible for financial and business controlling activities for the site. Reporting directly to the HO Finance, they will be a key business partner for management at the Kinston site as well as key stakeholders in the US and Europe. This role will be responsible for responsible for managing the multi-year financial forecast for all products at the site and providing gap analysis of actuals to forecast and budget. In addition, he/she will establish annual performance targets through the Operative Planning process, providing accurate business forecasting through ownership of critical KPIs across the P&L, Balance Sheet and Free Cash Flow. Furthermore, the Finance Manager will work closely with other Airbus Finance personnel in Airbus Americas and Europe to ensure alignment for all planning and forecasting activities, securing the regional contribution towards global targets and KPIs of the business. Meet the Team:
Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft. Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar. How We Care for You: Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes; and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Management: Mentor and develop controlling team members fostering a continuous improvement environment.
Strategic business partner for functional business leaders at Kinston site providing guidance to enable optimal financial decisions.
Focal for leaders outside of the Kinston site, providing clear and accurate guidance to enable optimal business decisions. Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management: Plan and execute yearly Annual Operating Plan in accordance to corporate schedules and governance.
Plan and execute quarterly forecasts in accordance to corporate schedules and governance.
Support the monthly and quarterly business reviews with the senior management team providing meaningful variance analysis providing a coherent business narrative to drive actions.
Support the HO Finance in delivering the financial reviews to the Board of Directors, detailing the performance of the
business against measurable KPIs and implementing the strategic guidance as provided by the board.
Responsible for working hand in hand with operational functional leads to capture long term coordinated forecasts and develop a functional-to-finance reporting framework to ensure accuracy and transparency in project transactions and KPI reporting. Financial Controlling: Support the monthly closing process
Responsible for controlling Capital Expenses (CAPEX).
Manages the income statement and balance sheet of the business, monitoring and tracking revenue and cost accruals, tangible and intangible assets, account receivables, account payables, customer advance payments and all other item which have a material impact on the business KPIs
Monitors the free cash flow of the business, including its key underlying drivers such as working capital and other assets/liabilities.
Responsible for managing the cost accounting for the Kinston site. Activity includes managing cost center reporting, rate/overhead structures, and ensuring cost allocates to appropriate products. Internal Controls: Supports adherence to Airbus defined financial internal controls, monitoring and auditing regularly.
Support the HO Finance in identifying, defining and implementing processes ensuring adherence to documented financial directives and Airbus defined financial internal controls.
Supports a culture change in developing awareness of how internal controls impact business practices and processes.
Supports the HO Finance in internal controls assessments and the completion of the annual ICSA campaign. Additional Responsibilities: Other duties as assigned. description_text:
Job Description: In order to support the Connected Intelligence department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a VIE Germany - Quantum Software Development Engineer (d/f/m) You are a highly motivated graduate and want to get to know the work of a Development Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Connected Intelligence department as a Volunteer for International Experience. Location: Ottobrunn Start: 01.11.2026 Duration: 12-24 months This position supports the software development activities within the Quantum Technologies domain at Connected Intelligence of Airbus Defence and Space. The engineer will contribute to the implementation and prototyping of quantum-related software components, as defined and prioritized by the domain technical lead. The role is execution-focused, translating architectural and system-level requirements into working software prototypes, simulations, and proof-of-concept demonstrators. Definition VIE The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) program is an international program sponsored by the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Employment, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. We are looking for highly motivated graduates aged 18 to 28 years, who are citizens of the European Union (all E.U. nationals, plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein). Candidates meeting these criteria and interested in a VIE, please register before your 28th birthday on the website www.civiweb.com. For graduates who would be interested in a career with Airbus, this could be the start of a rewarding future in a dynamic and forward-thinking sector. Your location Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. Your benefits Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime). Mobile working after agreement with the department. Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department. International environment with the opportunity to network globally. Work with modern/diversified technologies. At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings. Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network. Your tasks and responsibilities We’re looking for a candidate with experience in development and testing environments. Develop and implement post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) algorithms and protocols (e.g., NIST PQC standards: CRYSTALS-Kyber, CRYSTALS-Dilithium, FALCON) in embedded and constrained environments. Support hardware-software integration for quantum-secure systems, including FPGA-based implementations of cryptographic primitives. Develop proof-of-concept (PoC) demonstrators for quantum-secure communication use cases. Produce technical documentation, test reports, and development logs in support of project deliverables. You will interact with a group of colleagues with wide experience in the areas of AI and 5G/6G, and interact with colleagues of Airbus Defence and Space as with external partners. Desired skills and qualifications Hands-on programming experience in C/C++ and/or Python and/or Rust, particularly for systems-level or embedded development. Basic familiarity with FPGA development (VHDL, Verilog, or HLS) is a plus. Ability to work within technically complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Structured, rigorous approach to software engineering and documentation. Deep experience in testing and prototyping. Good communication skills. Language: English (fluent level). title: Data Developer
description_text:
Job Description: You will join the Airbus (DCS) organization in charge of the BigData Developments & Support. The mission of the PSL is to deliver innovative IT solutions that support digital transformation and efficient operations for customer services. More precisely the PSL is dedicated to support Customer Services activities related to the Airframe Services product and services portfolio. We are looking for a performance-driven PySpark Developer to join the Airbus (DCS) team. You will be responsible for building the data backbone of Airframe Services, ensuring that our "Skywise" platform delivers rapid insights to maximize aircraft availability and streamline customer contracts. Key Responsibilities Performance Tuning: Optimize Spark jobs by managing partitioning, caching strategies, broadcast joins, and addressing data skew to ensure efficient resource utilization. Data Governance: Implement and manage data assets using Unity Catalog to ensure fine-grained access control and data lineage. CI/CD : Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines using Git and CI/CD frameworks to ensure seamless code promotion across environments. Scalable Engineering: Independently prototype and develop high-quality data objects, KPIs, and dashboards on the Skywise platform. Agile Collaboration: Participate in an Agile development environment, providing weekly updates on algorithms and KPIs while challenging business requirements for technical feasibility. Technical Skill Set Core Requirements (Must-Have) Advanced PySpark: 2–4 years of experience with a heavy focus on performance tuning (e.g., analyzing Spark UI, optimizing DAGs, and memory management). Python Mastery: Strong server-side programming skills for complex data processing. Data Architecture: Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog for metadata management and data governance. Version Control & Automation: Proficiency in Git (branching, merging, PR workflows) and integrated CI/CD pipelines. SQL & Relational Databases: Expert-level SQL for complex querying and data validation. Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have) Cloud Platforms: Knowledge of AWS services (S3, EC2, Glue, or EMR) is a significant plus. Methodology: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum modes of delivery and tools like Jira or VersionOne. Visualization: Exposure to Qlik or similar dashboarding tools. Soft Skills & Qualifications Education: Graduate in Information Technology, Computer Science Engineering or equivalent. Analytical Thinking: Ability to debug complex data transformation pipelines and solve performance bottlenecks. Communication: English (Negotiation level): ability to collaborate with Project Leaders, POs, and multi-disciplinary support teams. Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with weekly deliverables. Deliverables Optimized Spark Algorithms and Data Pipelines. title: Head of General Ledger Accounting ADS France
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an Head of General Ledger Accounting within the Accounting Team in France. As an accountant you will be a virtual part in the Finance community. The Head of General Ledger Accounting is responsible for leading and overseeing the general ledger team and ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial accounting for ADS SAS and its French subsidiaries. This role owns the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes and ensures financial statements are prepared in accordance with accounting principles (IFRS, France GAAP), Airbus Group rules and other internal or external regulations. The position plays a key role in maintaining strong internal controls and continuously improving accounting processes and systems. Financials & Reporting Responsible for preparing Financial Statements reports and submitting them in a timely manner. Responsible for the intercompany reconciliation process with other group entities (prepare and upload data in Airbus Group tools e.g. ICART, FACTS+, etc., resolve differences, improve processes together with trading partner entities) Regular coordination and communication with Airbus Defence and Space Consolidation team. Ensure that Airbus processes and compliance regulations are in place. Perform analytical balance sheet reviews with auditors and the consolidation team Preparation of the Deferred Tax package Coordination for Annual Audits (Internal & External) Take a lead role in coordinating internal and external Financial Audits Prepare various statements as requested by auditors. Contribute to tax audits Supervision of Accounting Operation & Closing Activities Provide guidance and support to the general ledger team, overseeing day-to-day operations, reviewing work for accuracy and completeness, and promoting professional development. Be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing by efficiently supervising accounting operations Supervise TVA TVTS-CFE-CVAE- Organic declarations for ADS SAS and its subsidiaries in cooperation with the Airbus group tax team. Have the ability to manage people and create a team that can deliver the desired results Support Continuous Improvements Process, Digitalization and Automatization Support SAP migration projects within the ERP Roadmap of Airbus Defence and Space and the implementation of other financial tools that enhance operational effectiveness Ensure implementation compliance, segregation of duties and internal controls rules Drive continuous improvement and digitalisation Support the Head of Accounting, the Consolidation Team and other Finance departments in special projects. Required skills: Being an Accountant requires a robust knowledge on financial processes and tools, French GAAP and International Financial reporting Standards (IFRS) as well as a feeling for numbers. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Master Degree in Accounting 10 years of accounting and/or audit experience, Ability to work with SAP and interest in financial systems Ability to quickly analyze and interpret data Continuous improvement mindset Leadership skills Effective verbal and listening communication skills as well as team spirit Promote speak-up culture Flexible, adaptable, enthusiastic and motivated Languages: English advanced level This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities. FRENCH VERSION Airbus Defence and Space recherche un(e) Responsable de la Comptabilité Générale au sein de l’équipe Comptable en France. En tant que comptable, vous ferez partie intégrante de la communauté Finance. Le/la Responsable de la Comptabilité Générale est chargé(e) de diriger et de superviser l’équipe de comptabilité générale et de garantir une comptabilité financière précise, réalisée dans les délais et conforme pour ADS SAS et ses filiales françaises. Ce poste est responsable des processus de clôture mensuelle, trimestrielle et annuelle et veille à ce que les états financiers soient préparés conformément aux principes comptables (IFRS, normes françaises), aux règles du Groupe Airbus ainsi qu’aux autres réglementations internes et externes. La fonction joue un rôle clé dans le maintien de contrôles internes solides et dans l’amélioration continue des processus et systèmes comptables. Finance & Reporting Responsable de la préparation des états financiers et de leur soumission dans les délais. Responsable du processus de réconciliation inter-compagnies avec les autres entités du groupe (préparer et télécharger les données dans les outils du Groupe Airbus tels que ICART, FACTS+, etc., résoudre les écarts, améliorer les processus avec les entités partenaires). Coordination et communication régulières avec l’équipe Consolidation d’Airbus Defence and Space. Veiller à la mise en place des processus Airbus et au respect des exigences de conformité. Réaliser des revues analytiques du bilan avec les auditeurs et l’équipe consolidation. Préparation du package d’impôts différés. Coordination des audits annuels (internes & externes) Préparer différents états demandés par les auditeurs. Contribuer aux contrôles fiscaux. S'assurer que les livrables demandés sont communiqués dans les délais impartis pour respecter les échéances définies Supervision des opérations comptables et des activités de clôture Fournir orientation et support à l’équipe de comptabilité générale, superviser les opérations quotidiennes, revoir les travaux pour en assurer l’exactitude et l’exhaustivité, et promouvoir le développement professionnel. Être responsable du respect des délais et de l’exactitude des clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles grâce à une supervision efficace des opérations comptables. Superviser les déclarations TVA, TVTS, CFE, CVAE, Organic pour ADS SAS et ses filiales en coopération avec l’équipe fiscale du Groupe Airbus. Avoir la capacité de manager des équipes et de créer une dynamique permettant d’atteindre les résultats attendus. Support à l’amélioration continue, à la digitalisation et à l’automatisation Soutenir les projets de migration SAP dans le cadre de la feuille de route ERP d’Airbus Defence and Space ainsi que la mise en place d’autres outils financiers améliorant l’efficacité opérationnelle. Garantir la conformité de mise en œuvre, la séparation des tâches et le respect des règles de contrôle interne. Conduire les initiatives d’amélioration continue et de digitalisation. Soutenir le/la Responsable Comptable, l’équipe Consolidation et les autres départements Finance dans des projets spécifiques. Compétences requises Être comptable requiert une solide connaissance des processus et outils financiers, des normes françaises (French GAAP) et des normes internationales d’information financière (IFRS), ainsi qu’une appétence pour les chiffres.

Au sein de ce département, l'équipe d'essais au sol réalise les activités de développement, de certification et de qualification des aéronefs au sol. Elle couvre les domaines suivants : avionique/systèmes embarqués, compatibilité électromagnétique (CEM/EMC), radio, éclairage, vibrations/acoustique et soutien opérationnel aux essais en vol. Nos principaux objectifs sont de garantir : - la maturité pour les essais en vol en établissant le lien entre la conception et les bancs d'essai avioniques/véhicules - la préparation des prototypes ou des appareils de série en cours d'essais en apportant un soutien à l'ingénieur d'essais en vol et au pilote d'essai expérimental du projet qui effectuent les essais en vol sur ces machines Enfin, nous démontrons la conformité aux réglementations, spécifications et exigences de qualification afin d'obtenir la certification/qualification de l’appareil. Le poste est basé à Marignane et vous serez rattaché(e) au responsable du département « HC Ground Tests & Support ». Il nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou d’être éligible à une telle habilitation par les autorités compétentes. Ce poste est axé sur les tests EMC/EMI/Tempest et les essais radio associés, avec la responsabilité spécifique d'être le référent métier pour ces activités de test, et donc également en charge de : Conseiller/soutenir les autres collègues sur ces tests spécifiques Expertiser sur les problèmes spécifiques et supporter les investigations Proposer, en collaboration avec les collègues du bureau d'études, des modifications de conception pour résoudre ou améliorer les problématiques Diffuser le niveau de connaissances approprié au sein de l'équipe S'assurer que les outils dédiés sont adaptés, à la pointe de la technologie et stimuler l'innovation pour leurs évolutions, voire le développement de nouveaux outils Être le principal point de contact avec le bureau d'études spécialisé pour le métier, les innovations et les problématiques Vérifier techniquement les livrables documentaires du métier sur le domaine Pour ce faire, vous devrez dans un premier temps maîtriser les activités de base des tests EMC/EMI/Tempest et des tests radio ainsi que les processus Métier associés : Organisation des activités d'essais au sol sur hélicoptère (pour le développement et la certification) avec les interfaces concernées (ingénieur en chef, atelier de prototype/production, bureau d'études, coordinateur d'essais…), Préparation des tests (procédures, moyens de test, vérification de la configuration H/C…), Exécution les tests, Analyse et validation des données d'essai sol avec débriefing/rapport immédiat avant les essais en vol, Rédaction de rapports techniques et suivi de l'analyse des problèmes correspondants, Publication du rapport d'essai final, en vue du développement et de la certification/qualification si nécessaire Contribution aux stratégies ou à la logique des tests concernant le périmètre des essais au sol, établissant le lien entre les moyens d’essais amont (par exemple H/C0, banc d'essai d'intégration système, plateforme intégrée virtuelle et autres simulations) et les activités d'essais en vol. Compétences requises : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur en électronique/avionique ou en aéronautique. Vous possédez un niveau élevé de connaissances théoriques en matière de CEM (compatibilité électromagnétique). Les expériences supplémentaires suivantes seraient un atout : - Conception/études pratiques en matière de CEM - Développement de radiocommunications - Opérations de test, y compris la définition, l'exécution et l'analyse - Gestion de projet pour le développement Vous possédez des aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive et systématique d'amélioration continue, même dans un environnement complexe comportant de nombreux intervenants et sous pression temporelle. Vous possédez de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de communication, et vous êtes rigoureux. Un niveau de français négociation, et un niveau avancé d'anglais sont requis. Veuillez soumettre votre CV en anglais et/ou en français. Elle est située à proximité des villes d'Aix-en-Provence et de Marseille, qui accueillent une offre culturelle et touristique riche. Proche des plages de la Côte Bleue, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités nautiques. It comprises the domains of the Avionics/Vehicle System, the Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), the Radio, the Lighting, the Vibration/Acoustics and also the Flight Test Operational Support. Our main goals are to ensure: - maturity for flight tests by making the bridge with Design and avionics/vehicle rigs - readiness of the prototype or production aircraft under test by supporting the Flight Test Engineer, Lead-Flight Test Engineer and Project Experimental Test Pilot who conduct the flight tests on the prototypes or production aircrafts. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond. description_text:

program sponsored by the French Ministries of Europe and Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the
opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. The VIE is a specific contract, under Business France’s eligibility criteria. Security starts with You! Within Airbus Corporate Security, we celebrate diversity and are committed to create an inclusive and safe environment for all employees Discover the cyber world within Airbus: Security teams have a key role to play in Airbus’ competitive and fast moving environment. Our teams’ engagement is to aim for a better-connected, safer and more prosperous world. Reveal yourself and discover a large span of opportunities in aircraft, helicopter, defence and space security segments. Develop yourself in our inclusive environment with 140 nationalities speaking 20 languages, based across 5 continents! About India and South Asia region: The India and South Asia Region consists of India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka and Maldives. The offices are situated in Bangalore and N. Delhi in India . The major activities in India include Engineering, Information Management and Customer Services along with the support functions like, HR, Finance, Procurement, Security. Your mission: You will join the Corporate Security teams in India and South Asia, reporting to the Regional Chief Information Security Officer (Regional CISO), based in Bangalore. Along with your cybersecurity knowledge, your great curiosity and your appeal to get to know others, you will use your skills to proactively serve a diverse range of professionals (cyber, IT/OT, industry…), located in India and South Asia. Building good relationships with all of those stakeholders will be key in this role, in order to create and maintain an efficient collaborative network, while being in a hybrid environment, using the digital tools to collaborate but also meeting people, throughout India and South Asia. Your responsibilities in the team: Quantitative Risk Modeling: Run Monte Carlo simulations to calculate Annual Loss Expectancy (ALE) and use Bayesian inference to update risk probabilities based on internal vulnerability telemetry and external evidence. Vulnerability Life Cycle & Analysis: Collate and track vulnerabilities in a centralized platform, mapping them directly to the corporate security risk register across all divisions. Perform multi-dimensional analysis to determine prioritization scores, determining which vulnerabilities require immediate correction based on Threat Intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, and aggregated incident response data. Streamline and optimize various vulnerability management processes to reduce "Mean Time to Remediate"(MTTR). Governance & Escalation: Support the Security Governance Department with remediation follow-up; continuously monitor risk posture and escalate major risks that exceed the company's risk appetite. Control Efficacy: Use Linear Regression to correlate vulnerability metrics (e.g., patch latency) with business downtime and financial loss. AI Automation: Apply AI Prompt Engineering to automate KRI/KPI generation using Python/SQL and to interpret complex statistical outputs for executive reporting. Required Profile: Master’s degree (or equivalent) majoring in Information Technology or Industrial management, with the following skills: 1. Adaptive Flexibility: Pivots effectively in response to shifting priorities and organizational change. 2. Intellectual Humility: Values external expertise and prioritizes the best solution over personal ego. 3. Accountability: Takes full ownership of outcomes and focuses on remediation rather than excuses. 4. Critical Thinking: Analyzes objective data to make informed, logical business decisions. 5. Resiliency: Maintains consistent performance and a solution-oriented mindset under high pressure. 6. Effective Communication: Distills complex ideas into clear, actionable information for all stakeholders. 7. Collaborative Orientation: Prioritizes cross-functional goals and team success over individual recognition. 8. Solution-Focused Initiative: Proactively identifies challenges and presents viable resolutions independently. 9. Emotional Intelligence: Navigates interpersonal dynamics with self-awareness and professional tact. 10. Continuous Improvement: Actively seeks feedback and upskilling opportunities to refine performance. 11 A good level in English is mandatory - a second language mastered is a plus Required skills: Experience: Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, or Quantitative Risk. Statistics: Understanding of probability distributions (Lognormal, Poisson, Beta) and statistical significance (p-values, R^2). Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python or R for data modeling and SQL for querying security telemetry. Vulnerability Expertise: Deep understanding of the vulnerability management life cycle, prioritization frameworks (CVSS, EPSS), and technical control failure modes. Nice to have: Frameworks: Proficiency with FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk). Cloud: Experience managing security controls in AWS, Azure, or GCP. Certifications: CRISC, CISM, or CISSP. At Airbus, we believe that it’s not just what we make, but how we make it together that counts. We are looking for out-of-the-box thinkers, challenging innovators and passionate people! Feel like you can’t tick some of the boxes above? If you have most of the skills and experience that we are looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Le Volontariat International en Entreprise est un programme unique au monde sponsorisé par les Ministères français de l’Europe et des Affaires Etrangères, du Ministère de l’Economie et des Finances et du Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires et qui permet à Airbus d'offrir à de jeunes professionnels la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience rémunérée et valorisante à l'étranger, dans un métier technique ou commercial. maximum (une mission V.I.E peut débuter au plus tard le jour du vingt-neuvième anniversaire) ● Avoir accompli les obligations militaires de son pays. ● Être impérativement inscrit sur le site Mon Volontariat International avant les 28 ans Pour plus d'informations : https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/ (en anglais, en allemand, en italien et en espagnol). Its portfolio is tailored to the needs of Public Safety, Defence and Transport, Utility and Industry (TUI). It includes infrastructures, devices, applications and services based on Tetra, Tetrapol and Broadband technologies (either single, hybrid or multi-technology solutions). As the European leader and a key international player, PSS has customers in more than 80 countries and employs around 1,150 people in 17 countries. You will act as a vital link between our branch, external partners (such as consortiums and other Airbus entities), and service providers. Oversee the office environment, managing relationships with landlords and suppliers (energy, IT, cleaning) to resolve malfunctions and propose office evolutions. title: 3DX - Domain lead on Industrial DMU (m/f)
description_text:
Job Description: Do you want to make Airbus a more connected, safer and smarter place? Join IM!
We are a core function where sustainable IT is starting to transform our company, where our customers can benefit from our innovative products and services such as Skywise, where we are key to implement the digitalization in our company through programs like DDMS and where we connect thousands of worldwide-end users every day, and all that in a protected and safe environment.
IM is everywhere in the business, from the design of an aircraft until its delivery with linked services to four customers and even more. Context:
As a Solution Architect for iDMU / Industrial Means for 3DEXperience (m/f), you will join the “Process & Resources” Product in the “One PLM” Product Service Line, in charge of developing 3DExperience solutions for Manufacturing Engineering and Customer Services PLM related applications, and will functionally report to the Head of Product. The scope of the organization is to deliver to Airbus Business a single & harmonized set of IS/IT tools for the development of the Aircraft, its industrial set-up and the support and Services part, non-recurring & recurring aspects included. The organization is established to ensure the development and the support of Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) solutions in a context of Airbus Group Process, Method and Tools strategy.
The scope will be linked to topics related to Product Process and Resources in the fields of Manufacturing area but also Support and Services or Quality. iDMU stands for Industrial Digital Mock-Up, where the main goal is to enable a single, collaborative design process that produces a fully validated virtual representation of the product and its manufacturing line and associated Industrial Means. This process aims to de-risk the production system design by enabling collaboration with Engineering, hangar/line/station design and SOI creation in a full 3D industrial environment. The Industrial Digital Mock-Up (iDMU) aims to establish a singular, collaborative design process. Its core objective is to deliver a completely validated virtual representation of both the product and its associated manufacturing line, including all Industrial Means. By facilitating collaboration across Engineering, hangar/line/station design, and Standard Operating Instruction (SOI) creation within a comprehensive 3D industrial environment, this process significantly mitigates risks in the production system's design. Main missions: 1. Take part in E2E PLM Portfolio in the frame of SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) and contribute to the elaboration of the Portfolio Roadmap.
2. Translates the business needs into IT requirements and proactively identify opportunities for business transformation or improvement enabled by technology. Develops a solid understanding of the customer's existing business and business processes ideally end-to-end, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short- and long-term direction of the business and related technologies. Formulates functional and non functional requirements of the business organization and advises on the lifecycle of the information solutions. Evaluates the impact in terms of change management. Collaborates with the IT Product Manager while ensuring that the developed solutions are inline with evolving customer needs 3. Balances technological opportunities with business (process) requirements. Delivers the framing design including the non functional requirements, that guides solution design for the IT Product, in line with the Enterprise Architecture guidelines, in strong collaboration with Technology Specialists. Tasks and accountabilities: Conducts in-depth discovery meetings, targeted at understanding, capturing, and identifying the complex business requirements and operational objectives of the customer, with recommendations on automation. Identify areas for improvement in business processes providing possible IT solutions compliant with the Digital strategy Supports the IT Product Manager in the Product/Service Planning based on the customer requirements Produces documentation of current challenges, future requirements, and benefits in a manner appropriate for the customer Defines and develop the required specification documents to be reviewed with stakeholders and Product team members Performs the technical/functional design of the application and infrastructure components of a new solution according to the defined functional design. Serves as liaison between Product Management teams and technical resources during product development and implementation to ensure integrity of the solution delivered. Provides an expertise on Business processes, change management transformation, function improvement and technology enablement for Business processes reengineering and supports architects during projects. Follow all phases of the application development life cycle including research and design, development, testing, implementation and support. This role will involve some travel for business (once a month) and as such you must be able to travel accordingly. Required skills and experience: Over 5 years of experience in functional architecture, project management, solution engineering or another relevant field. Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or equivalent. Ideally, knowledge in the field of Design, Manufacturing, Support and Services, or in the following domains: Manufacturing Engineering, Shop Floor Execution, Industrial Modelling and Simulation, Configuration Management, Quality, Configured Digital Mock-Up (DMU), Product Lifecycle Management, Engineering IS, Architecture, Maintenance and Repair. Ability to lead a project from start to finish and deliver results. Ability to drive improvement and innovation. Knowledge of IT tools customizing and architecture, IT and business strategy alignment, IT product design and product development, IT business change management. Customer and stakeholder management skills. Good communication and presentation skills. Initiative and creativity. Fluent English (mandatory).
