title: FHS TSP Engineer-  Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness
description_text:
Job Description: Airbus FHS provides customized services to its Customers (mainly Airlines) ranging from FHS-Component upto a TSP (Tailored Support Program) with the objective to provide airlines with significant inventory management and repair cost savings whilst supporting the improvement of their maintenance and engineering activities to allow an increased aircraft reliability and availability. FHS India and South Asia Regional organization is a 50 plus strong team of airline engineering and material management experts. We are committed to be the most trusted and customer centric Materials Hub by driving operational excellence, enhancing Airbus Reliability , promote global competitiveness and strengthening our global footprint through innovation and strategic partnerships whilst keeping our foundation at the centre in All We Do Accountabilities FHS TSP Engineer- Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness is responsible for oversight of fleet configuration and continued airworthiness of TSP services provided to AIC TSP He/she is responsible for oversight of on-time, on-quality delivery of services, including quality of data in IT Tools (including but not limited to MIS) FHS TSP Engineer- Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness is responsible to oversee compliance of the service to local Airworthiness regulation, and to FHS Continued Airworthiness Management directives. FHS TSP Engineer- Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness ensures the whole AIC TSP Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness team is well integrated in the worldwide FHS-TSP/FTM community, by applying AIRBUS common Processes Methods and Tools, and by organizing participation to best practices sharing, improvement projects, ad-hoc support, training... with other entities. He/she shall bring necessary technical expertise to the team & represent organization in regards to technical activities towards Customer or MRO as necessary. Main activities Independently verify aircraft configuration status as maintained by Customer Records/ Configuration teams - Maintain independent oversight of fleet configuration (Component Trees, Constituent Assemblies, Empty Positions, LDND consistency, AMOS transactions by Customer, OT, OQ closure of performed tasks necessary to carry out AIB FTM deliverables) Maintain independent oversight of aircraft airworthiness status (ARC, ADs, SBs, LLPs, TCIs etc.). Coordinate with Customer Technical Records and other necessary stakeholders to ensure Fleet Technical Management Deliverables such as Planning & Engineering are performed in related timeframes, this would also include the need to pull data, records,certifications etc. if not available systematically from the customer. Oversee compliance of the maintenance programs, defect management, Service Bulletins , airworthiness directives & other critical deliverables. Provide alerts/escalations for any non-compliance or approaching deadlines & Escalate non-compliances, overdue tasks, or systemic weaknesses. Flag high-risk defects that may affect airworthiness or dispatch reliability. Ensure reliability findings and safety recommendations are actioned by responsible departments. Escalate significant risks, delays, or compliance gaps to FHS TSP Manager Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness. As FHS TSP Engineer- Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness reporting to the FHS TSP Manager Fleet Configuration and Continued Airworthiness and act as a first point of contact within the FHS TSP for Fleet Configuration and CAM related topics: Participate and Support Regional CAM Leader in the various CAM reviews. Escalating relevant subjects/observations from the different TSP/FTM domains to Regional TSP CAM leader for information or review. Supporting the resolution of FTM relevant issues involving contribution from the region. Job Description: Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre équipe Sûreté Nucléaire au sein de la BU Sustainability.
La mission s’effectue dans le cadre de développement et de l’exploitation de systèmes complexes de type lanceurs dans des environnements contraints (spatial et militaire). Vous interviendrez sur la maîtrise des risques et la démonstration de sûreté nucléaire associée aux systèmes, sous-systèmes et opérations. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et stimulant, notamment dans un contexte de souveraineté européenne.

Votre rôle sera d’identifier les défaillances potentielles avant qu'elles ne
surviennent. ● Réalisation des analyses de Sûreté : Réaliser des analyses de risques (APR,
AMDEC, HAZOP…) afin d’identifier les situations incidentelles et accidentelles, et caractériser les environnements en conditions normales et dégradées. Définir des fonctions de sûreté associées ainsi que les exigences techniques qui en découlent..

Sur la base des démarches de sûreté et des analyses de sûreté, définir et justifier les barrières de sûreté, leurs indépendances ainsi que les paramètres de sûreté associés.,
● Interface technique et intégration projet : interagir avec les équipes multidisciplinaires (système, structures, composants électroniques, opérations, etc.) pour intégrer les exigences de sûreté dès la conception. Participer aux revues techniques et garantir la cohérence entre sûreté nucléaire, sûreté de fonctionnement et contraintes opérationnelles.

title: ATR - Design Supplier Quality Specialist
description_text:
Job Description: About us ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo. From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way. If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR! Our leadership profile: People Centric, Entrepreneurial, Inspiring, Exemplary, Innovative, Humble At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages! Your Mission The Design Supplier Quality Manager is responsible for the qualification and oversight of all design suppliers delivering engineering outputs, ensuring compliance with ATR design organization approval requirements. Manage a defined portfolio of design suppliers, ensuring compliance with ATR Design and DOA requirements while driving sustainable performance improvement.
In close coordination with ATR Engineering and Program teams and any relevant ATR stakeholders, develop and drive common action plans (« one voice ») in response to significant supplier quality issues.
Plan, lead and conduct design product and process audits/assessments to support supplier qualification and surveillance for engineering & intellectual services providers.
Assess and monitor suppliers’ organizational acceptance status in line with ATR DOA requirements.
Act as the ATR focal point for all quality matters related to engineering/design suppliers.
Represent the ATR Supplier Quality function during supplier selection and project development phases – e.g. RFx, Maturity Gates – up to CDR/beginning of industrialization phase.
Represent ATR towards external authorities (EASA) on matters related to design supplier oversight and compliance status About you Degree in Quality, Engineering or another relevant technical discipline
Strong expertise in regulatory and quality assurance standards to the Aerospace products as applicable – i.e. EASA/FAR Part 21J, ISO17025, EN9100.
Minimum 10 years’ experience in the aerospace industry, including at least 5 years in a engineering quality/certification or auditing role (or equivalent).
Proven experience in auditing design supplier's quality management systems.
Solid knowledge of design & manufacturing processes in aeronautic industry
Good technical knowledge/understanding of aircraft systems and/or aerostructure
Expertise in quality tools and root cause analysis methodologies (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa diagrams, 5W methodology)
Strong project management and analytical skills
Proficient in MS pack office tools
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with assertive and diplomacy
Ability to prioritize work in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment
Fluency in English and Italian.
Willingness to travel internationally. A propos d'ATR ATR est le premier constructeur mondial d'avions régionaux et propose une nouvelle génération de turbopropulseurs. Nous sommes une filiale de deux poids lourds de l'aéronautique européenne, Airbus et Leonardo. Des plus grandes villes du monde aux régions les plus reculées de notre planète, notre objectif est d'assurer le transport aérien des personnes, des communautés et des entreprises d'une manière innovante, durable et moderne. Si vous recherchez l'excellence, si vous êtes animé par l'ambition, la confiance et le respect, alors faites décoller votre carrière avec ATR ! Notre Leadership Profile : Centré(e) sur l’humain un esprit entrepreneur inspirant(e) exemplaire innovant(e) humble Vous travaillerez avec des collègues passionnés pour faire la différence dans une entreprise à taille humaine avec des avantages attractifs ! Votre mission Piloter un portefeuille de fournisseurs de conception, en assurant leur conformité aux exigences Design et DOA d’ATR tout en contribuant à l’amélioration durable de leurs performances.
En étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénierie, Programmes et les parties prenantes ATR concernées, définir et déployer des plans d’actions communs (« one voice ») en réponse aux problématiques qualité majeures des fournisseurs.
Planifier, conduire et réaliser des audits et évaluations produits et processus afin de soutenir la qualification et la surveillance des fournisseurs de prestations d’ingénierie et de services intellectuels.
Évaluer et suivre le statut d’acceptation organisationnelle des fournisseurs, en cohérence avec les exigences DOA d’ATR.
Agir en tant que point focal ATR pour toutes les questions qualité relatives aux fournisseurs d’ingénierie et de conception.
Représenter la fonction Supplier Quality lors des phases de sélection des fournisseurs et de développement des projets (RFx, Maturity Gates), jusqu’au CDR et au début de l’industrialisation.
Représenter ATR auprès des autorités externes (notamment l’EASA) sur les sujets liés à la surveillance des fournisseurs de conception et à leur statut de conformité. A propos de vous Diplôme en Qualité, Ingénierie ou dans une autre discipline technique.
Solide expertise des normes réglementaires et qualité applicables aux produits aéronautiques (EASA/FAR Part 21J, EN 9100, ISO 17025).
Minimum 10 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie aéronautique, dont au moins 5 ans dans des fonctions qualité ingénierie, certification ou audit (ou équivalent).
Expérience confirmée dans l’audit des systèmes de management de la qualité des fournisseurs de conception.
Bonne connaissance des processus de conception et de fabrication dans l’industrie aéronautique.
Solide compréhension technique des systèmes avion et/ou des aérostructures.
Maîtrise des outils qualité et des méthodologies d’analyse des causes racines (8D, diagramme d’Ishikawa, méthode des 5 pourquoi).
Excellentes compétences en gestion de projet et en analyse.
Maîtrise des outils MS Office.
Très bonnes capacités de communication et de relations interpersonnelles, alliant assertivité et diplomatie.
Capacité à prioriser efficacement dans un environnement complexe et multi-acteurs.
Maîtrise de l’anglais et de l’italien.

title: Light Twins TechData Production Manager (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: In order to support the TechData Department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Light Twins TechData Workpackage Coordination Manager (d/f/m) Within TechData we produce the Instructions for Continued Airworthiness (ICA) which is the basis for the helicopter maintenance on operator side. ICA contains mainly the Aircraft Maintenance Manuals (AMM), the Illustrated Parts Catalogue (IPC) as well as the Airworthiness Limitation Section (ALS) and the Master Servicing Manual (MSM) that trigger the maintenance activities.
In the frame of the production TechData is closely cooperating with Design, Support Experts and Certification within Airbus DON, Airbus Spain and with different Subcontractors outside the company. In the Tech Data Departments of Light Twin Helicopters, we are organised in a matrix organisation set-up. You will be part of the Light Twins Production and Programmes department that is managing the activity in interface to the different departments that produce the Tech Data per ICA manual. As a Production Manager you are in charge of the assigning and drumbeating TechData work to the different departments who analyse and author the different Tech Data manuals. You will also assist the team in solving of blocking points in order to reach the delivery targets. The assigned work packages integrate the design changes in the ICA for new delivered H/C as well as the existing fleet. You are responsible for organizing and monitoring the work package production and delivering the scheduled tasks in assignment to the teams on time, on quality and on cost. Your location
At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. Your tasks and responsibilities Managing the production plan for the TechData from initialization of technical changes to completion of a revision, the focus will be on the IPC activity management Managing of work load with regards to capacities of the different squads and leading the Weekly meeting with the Key stakeholders within the different squads in Airbus Donauwörth and Airbus Spain and in interface to our subcontractors. Desired skills and qualifications Aerospace Engineering Master Degree (5 years) or comparable Experience within Support and Services departments, Tech Data experience, e.g. for Illustrated Parts Catalogue, Illustrations, Service Bulletins or Maintenance Manuals Experience in schedule management, production/project management or transversal management Digital skills and Customer satisfaction mindset Strong communication skills English negotiation level German negotiation level Spanish would be a plus Not a 100% match? Job Description: Job Description: Full Stack Developer - React / Java Experience: 8+ years Role Overview We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to maintain, optimize, and evolve our enterprise application. The incumbent will be trained on the first shift for two weeks, then rotated to the second shift for two weeks for additional training before moving permanently to the third shift. title: Responsable de l’adoption des nouvelles technologies | New Technologies Adoption Lead
description_text:
Job Description: Responsable de l’adoption des nouvelles technologies - Transformation de l'entreprise ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous êtes passionné par l'accompagnement humain dans le cadre de transformations, la facilitation de l'adoption de nouveaux processus et outils, et le développement d'une culture d'entreprise dynamique en prévision de projets aéronautiques novateurs ? Vous souhaitez progresser et acquérir de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avion commercial A220 est à la recherche de personnes passionnées, qualifiées et avides de défis pour rejoindre notre équipe de Transformation de l’entreprise basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada). Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de Transformation de l’Entreprise, chargée de révolutionner nos méthodes de travail, d'optimiser nos processus et d'exploiter la puissance des données et des technologies innovantes pour bâtir les fondations d'un avenir audacieux. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la transformation d'Airbus Canada, en mobilisant l'ensemble des équipes autour d’une vision commune qui façonnera l'avenir de l'aéronautique. L'organisation de notre équipe cultive spécifiquement une culture collaborative et un état d'esprit adaptatif, nous permettant de travailler de manière autonome, de nous soutenir mutuellement et d'apprendre collectivement pour mener à bien une transformation réussie. En tant que Responsable de l’adoption des nouvelles technologies, votre mission sera de placer l’humain au cœur de l'innovation et de transformer de nouvelles technologies (intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation) en une réalité opérationnelle portée par tous. Vos responsabilités clés : Instaurer la confiance envers les nouvelles technologies : Agir en partenaire de confiance pour lever les freins et humaniser la transition technologique. Fédérer les équipes : Garantir que les parties prenantes et les employés saisissent la valeur ajoutée des nouvelles technologies. Ancrer les usages : Soutenir l'engagement des collaborateurs pour transformer durablement nos méthodes de travail. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employés (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel et application de covoiturage. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: Définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de « Confiance et Adoption » centrée sur l'utilisateur pour les nouvelles technologies au sein d'Airbus Canada, en veillant à ce que la technologie soit d’abord et avant tout au service de nos employés; Créer et garantir une Expérience Agentique (AX) intuitive. Vous positionnez les agents d'IA comme des « co-pilotes » fiables qui renforcent les capacités humaines, tout en maintenant une stricte responsabilité de l'humain dans la boucle (Human-in-the-Loop - HITL); Diriger l'adoption de systèmes agentiques dynamiques, en collaborant étroitement avec les utilisateurs finaux pour s'assurer que la technologie constitue une extension naturelle de leur expertise; Collaborer avec les directions RH et métiers pour accompagner le changement culturel, en donnant à nos équipes les moyens de simplifier les tâches d'exécution courantes et de faire évoluer leurs rôles vers celui de co-pilotes stratégiques des processus pilotés par l'IA; Piloter la gestion du changement et exécuter tous les livrables associés, de la cartographie des parties prenantes et de l'analyse d'impact à l'exécution des stratégies et activités du plan de changement; Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI); Créer et animer un réseau « nouvelles technologies » chez Airbus Canada pour propulser et accélérer vos initiatives; Bâtir un réseau solide de contreparties à travers le Groupe Airbus et collaborer avec des experts externes pour importer les meilleures pratiques d'innovation au Canada; Soutenir la gouvernance du programme de transformation globale (revues de projet, activités de communication, etc.). Votre profil: Vous possédez une solide expertise et une capacité démontrée à orchestrer le changement culturel lors de transformations numériques et d’intelligence artificielle d'envergure, acquise au sein de milieux industriels complexes; Vous maîtrisez le langage de systèmes agentiques “agentic fluent” et vous avez une capacité exceptionnelle à communiquer des concepts techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs non techniques; Vous avez une excellente compréhension des méthodologies de gestion du changement organisationnel dans un contexte de gestion de projet, avec l'agilité nécessaire pour s'adapter à chaque situation; Vous avez d’excellentes capacités de communication et une aptitude à influencer tous les niveaux de l'organisation, des utilisateurs en atelier jusqu'au comité de direction; Vous avez de fortes capacités d'écoute, d'empathie et d'intelligence émotionnelle; Vous avez de grandes capacités d'organisation et de gestion du temps, ainsi qu'une autonomie démontrée dans l'exécution des tâches; Vous êtes à l’aisance dans un environnement international et complexe; Vous êtes parfaitement bilingue (français et anglais). Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels (dans le monde entier). Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* New Technologies Adoption Lead - Company Transformation Job description : Do you thrive on leading organizational transformation, possess expertise in refining existing processes, maximizing data's potential, and cultivating a vibrant company culture in preparation for groundbreaking new ventures, and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for passionate, highly skilled, and challenge-seeking individuals to join our Business Transformation team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will play a central role in the transformation of Airbus Canada, by mobilizing all teams, including European ones, around a common vision that will shape the future of aeronautics. You will be part of the Business Transformation team responsible for revolutionizing how we work, optimizing our processes, and harnessing the power of data and innovative technologies to build the foundation for a bold future. Our team's organization specifically cultivates a collaborative culture and an adaptive mindset, empowering us to work autonomously, support each other, and learn collectively to drive successful transformation. As the New Technologies Adoption Lead, your mission will be to place people at the heart of innovation, transforming new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence and automation, into an operational reality embraced by everyone. Your key responsibilities: Building New Technologies Trust: Act as a trusted partner to overcome resistance and humanize the technological transition. Unifying Teams: Ensure that key stakeholders and employees fully grasp the added value of these new technologies. Embedding New Habits: Drive employee engagement to sustainably transform our ways of working. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. title: Aircraft Static Loads Engineer within Flight Physics
description_text:
Job Description: An opportunity for an Aircraft Static Loads Engineer within Flight Physics has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). This position is offered to people with the Official Master Degree in Aeronautical Engineering on top of the Official Undergraduate Degree in Aerospace Engineering. It is kindly requested to attach the academic reports of both Bachelor and Master Degrees. We are looking for people having excellent academic reports, especially in the subjects related to Flight Physics, focused in the following areas (but not only in them):
1) Flight Mechanics, Aircraft Design, Aeroelasticity.
2) Aerodynamics, Structures.
3) Maths, Programming.
4) Control Systems, Propulsion. Our domain is involved in a wide variety of programs, like military tactical transports (CN-235, C-295, A400M, FMTC), Airbus derivatives and tankers (A330 MRTT, A321-AEW, A321-PATMAR), fighters (EF-2000, FCAS), UAVs (Eurodrone, Sirtap) and technological programs. The main activities that are done in these programs are: Loads models building for flight and ground loads. Management of 6DOF simulation codes for manoeuvre and gust conditions. Load analysis for design, fatigue, 1g, failure cases and operational loads, including trade-offs for sensitivity studies. Nodal loads generation for FEM (NASTRAN). Clearances of flight and ground loads to achieve "Permits to Fly" of prototypes. Specification, tracking and analysis of Flight Tests, regarding loads measurements, with post-flight adjustment of load models if needed. Continuous software development and maintenance of methods and tools for loads calculation. Writing certification documents and presentation to Airworthiness Authorities. Continuous airworthiness support and fleet analysis. Continuous support to aircraft preliminary design. To perform the above passionate tasks, the members of our team have: A great entushiasm and predilection for technical work. A multidisciplinary profile and great learning capacity. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. description_text:
Job Description: Satellitenkonstellationen für Telekommunikation gewinnen zunehmend an Bedeutung, insbesondere im Bereich der niedrigen Umlaufbahnen mit einer großen Anzahl an Satelliten. Durch solche Konstellationen können eine weltweite Abdeckung und kurze Latenzen erreicht werden. Zusätzlich können diese Konstellationen zunehmend mehr Nutzerinnen und Nutzer versorgen und werden insgesamt somit auch für die breite Bevölkerung zugänglich. Die Kommunikation zwischen den Satelliten und den Nutzenden erfolgt mittels Mikrowellen. Dabei werden immer häufiger Phased Array Antennen eingesetzt. Diese bieten eine hohe Flexibilität bezüglich Strahlausrichtung und Anzahl der Teilnehmenden, wodurch einzelne Satelliten der Konstellation viele Teilnehmende gleichzeitig versorgen können. Zur Simulation der Performance einer Phased Array Antenne wird bei TESAT ein digitaler Zwilling entwickelt. Dieser spiegelt alle Komponenten der aktuell in der Entwicklung befindlichen Phased Array Antenne wieder und wird schrittweise um weitere Komponenten erweitert. Im Rahmen des Praktikums / der Arbeit soll dieser digitale Zwilling weiterentwickelt werden. Deine Aufgaben
Einarbeitung in die Hochfrequenztechnik, Antennen und Signalverarbeitung
Einarbeitung in Aufbau und Architektur einer Phased Array Antenne
Weiterentwicklung des digitalen Zwillings durch Programmierung fehlender Module sowie Erweiterung der bestehenden Module
Vergleich von Simulationsergebnissen mit Testergebnissen des aktuell in Entwicklung befindenden Prototyps
Analyse der Auswirkungen der einzelnen Module auf die Systemperformance Deine Qualifikation

Kenntnisse in der Theorie zu elektromagnetischen Wellen sowie der Signalverarbeitung insbesondere in der Hochfrequenztechnik
Grundkenntnisse zu Antennen insbesondere Arrayantennen wünschenswert Was dich erwartet

Our Mission: Safety and Efficiency Technical Data is essential for safe and efficient aircraft operations, as we develop and deliver all maintenance and material documentation to our customers. It is the second most critical deliverable after the aircraft itself. This position makes you a key interface with our customers, directly influencing customer satisfaction. The increasing demands from customers and airworthiness authorities, alongside the complexity of our products, make this role both thrilling and vital to Airbus's reputation. Shape the Future of Technical Data The world of Technical Data is rapidly evolving. Joining us now means you will be at the forefront, helping to shape the future of how Airbus delivers maintenance information. Our core mission is to equip our customers (Airlines, MROs, Lessors) with essential manuals (AMM, TSM & IPC) for safe, efficient, and compliant maintenance operations throughout the aircraft lifecycle. You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and keeping updating these manuals, working closely with the Design Office and our Suppliers. Our Team & Scope SIDY4 offers a broad view of Aircraft Systems, focusing primarily on ATA chapters 24, 33, 36, 47, and 49 for all Airbus Civil Programs (SA, LR, A380, A350). You will be part of a transnational organization (SIDY), collaborating with mirror teams in Germany, France, and the UK.-----Your Key Responsibilities as a TDE A. Technical Data Authoring and Quality Assurance Lead Technical Data Delivery: Manage and coordinate authoring activities, ensuring content creation and updates. Meet specifications, contractual commitments, quality standards, and budget objectives. Proactive Problem-Solving: Take ownership of identifying and solving roadblocks that could delay manual updates within your assigned ATA chapters. Continuous Improvement: Constantly assess existing documentation for potential customer issues. Define and implement improvements to enhance quality and process efficiency. Stakeholder Interface: Act as the critical link between Technical Data, customers, and all internal and external partners (DO, Subcontractors, Programs, etc.). Configuration Management: Manage system configuration at the MSN level for all written procedures. B. Subcontracting Management Oversee Subcontractors: Manage deliveries and monitor the quantitative and qualitative performance of subcontractors supporting authoring activities. Performance Evaluation: Define and analyze KPIs to assess general performance. ​ C. Design Criteria Integration Impact Analysis: Evaluate Aircraft Design Criteria (Mod, Service Bulletin, MMEL, CDL, MPD, etc.) to detect their impact on technical documentation. Ensure Compliance: Guarantee the seamless integration of all affected design criteria into the technical manuals. ​ D. Innovation and Transnational Collaboration Drive Change: Actively participate in transnational and trans-organizational projects to improve our products and processes, sharing daily experience and feedback. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight. Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. YOUR CHALLENGES: Key Responsibilities:
SOC Coordinator & Service Delivery Manager
Define and Drive SOC Strategy: Develop and implement the overarching SOC strategy, ensuring technical coherence across all tools and processes, while strictly adhering to regulatory compliance requirements.
Oversee Tool Deployment and Management: Define, select, and manage the deployment of critical SOC tools, including SIEM, SOAR, ticketing systems, and alert management platforms. You'll also refine associated processes and workflows for security incidents.
Establish End-to-End SOC Processes: Design and implement comprehensive SOC processes for everything from initial notification to incident escalation, ensuring clarity and efficiency.
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Foster strong relationships between security teams and external stakeholders, taking a lead role in coordinating security operations, especially during critical incidents or crisis situations.
Ensure SOC Service Delivery Excellence: Champion the continuous delivery of high-quality SOC services by rigorously monitoring Service Level Agreements (SLAs), tracking service quality, and evaluating the effectiveness of all SOC activities.
Business-SOC Alignment: Cultivate a strong working relationship between SOC teams and business units, providing effective service effectiveness reporting at all management levels to ensure security operations align with business objectives.
Security Analyst
High-Level Security Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis for specific security needs, providing expert insights and recommendations.
Security Incident Response: Actively participate in and lead security incident response efforts, from detection and analysis to containment, eradication, and recovery.
Business Analyst (Cybersecurity Focus)
Business Security Support: Provide expert support to business units on all IT security-related topics.
Security Best Practices Advisory: Advise business stakeholders on industry-leading IT security best practices to enhance their security posture.
Log Onboarding Assessment: Conduct thorough assessments prior to onboarding logs into the SOC SIEM, ensuring data quality and relevance for effective security monitoring.
Cross-Functional Process Efficiency: Drive efficiency across business and security teams by ensuring seamless and optimized processes related to IT security. Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un(e) chef(fe) de service (manager) de l'ingénierie conception aérostructure pour rejoindre notre équipe Aérostructure basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous relèverez directement du Directeur aérostructure (Head of Airframe) d'Airbus Canada. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Ingénierie Aérostructures chargée de la conception des différentes sections de fuselage, du poste de pilotage, des portes, des jonctions voilure-fuselage (Wing to Belly Fairing), de l'isolant, du caisson central ainsi que du cône de queue. Un minimum de 15 ans d'expérience pertinente. This is an opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic Technical Team focused on: • Shape the future based on innovation of our products, new technologies and way of working • State of the art product consolidation
• Continuous Performance improvement Definitely, we are moved by our passion to make it fly! In accordance with the proven Candidate skills, she/he will be part of Thermo-Mechanical Design team and will report/be supported by the relevant Team Leader. Functionally, the Candidate is also part of the Project, with the main mission of developing/designing electronic units for flight equipment to achieve the unit delivery in accordance with project schedule, cost and quality requirements. In a day-to-day basis, she/he will report to Project Manager. Within each project, the tasks are coordinated by a Technical Responsible or a Physical Design Responsible in charge of direct reporting to the Project Manager. The Engineer’s tasks comprise the complete development of an electronic equipment: from the analysis of the requirements to the final delivery of the flight model once accepted. The successful applicant will be in charge of the following tasks: • Support to the Technical Manager or Project Physical Design Responsible for the analysis of project requirements.
• Mechanical and Thermal Architecture analysis and design at module and unit level to assure the robustness of the design in the complete mission scenarios (compatible with mechanical loads, temperature range, radiation shielding…). • Documentation of the design and analysis.
• Support to the Technical Manager or Project Physical Design Responsible in the main project reviews (Requirement Review, Preliminary and Architecture Review, Critical Design Review…)
• Support to Test Team for the acceptance of flight equipment, ensuring a close monitoring of any change, evolution or discrepancy from the agreed baseline in the characterization phase.
• Support to the Technical Manager or Project Physical Design Responsible in the resolution of NCRs (Non-conformance) raised during qualification or acceptance test campaign. Required skills We are looking for Candidates with the following skills and experience: - Experience in Thermodynamics and heat transfer analysis.
- Experience in Mechanical analysis, like static and dynamic analysis, sinusoidal or random vibration analysis, shock transient analysis (Shock Response Spectrum).
- Proficiency in the use of the following Finite Elements Tools: Hypermesh - Femap
- Nastran NX Recommended skills are: • Five years of expertise in Thermodynamics and Mechanical design
• Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
• Digital mindset (automation of tasks, scripting - Python, TCL, Bash, C/C++, use of digital design tools and simulators)
• Knowledge of space environment constraints
• To be familiar with Agile Methodologies
• Fast prototyping HW techniques
• Happy to learn and teach others Education & background requirements Engineering Master's degree Language: English C1 & Spanish Feel like you can't tick some boxes above? If you have most of the skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply! Join our Wing Analysis Engineering Team We are a dynamic and diverse group of structural engineers, technical experts, and program managers, all united by a passion for advancing innovative wing structures. Combining technical expertise with integration skills, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams and technical authorities to find solutions that shape the future of aerospace. Whether you are starting your journey or are an experienced leader in stress analysis, you will find an environment that challenges you to grow. We are recruiting for distinct opportunities and levels within our team: Lead Static Stress Engineers Senior Static Stress Engineers By applying to this job advert, we will consider your skills for all relevant positions. Coordinate with cross-functional leadership to define project requirements, manage technical scopes, and steer engineers and suppliers. Influence and innovate the future of aerospace by collaborating across teams to integrate automated workflows and optimisation tools into the development lifecycle, leading or supporting initiatives appropriate to your level of experience. Strong understanding of aircraft structural layouts, loading, and the mechanics of materials. title: Connectivity & COMMS (TCOMS, SCOMS, MCOMS) Lab Test Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: DESCRIPTION An opportunity for a Lab Test Engineer in the field of Communication Systems (Connectivity & Tactical, Safety and Mission Comms) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe. The selected candidate will join TADVA3, as a member of the Flight & Integration Test Centre.
Are you someone who enjoys getting hands-on with complex systems, interrogating data generated on them and rigorously assessing their performance?
Are you someone who needs to see tangible results, excited by technical challenges, fault finding and resolving technical problems with creative solutions with a digital mind-set?
If so, we would love to have you as part of our team! The position in a nutshell: We are looking for a Systems Test Engineer with a background in Military Aircraft Communication Systems specially focused on Aircraft Tactical Datalinks but also with some experience on Connectivity, Safety Comms and Mission Comms.
The roles and responsibilities lay within the IV&V activities with the final target of demonstrating the correct system’s performance providing the evidences needed for the subsequent testing and clearance processes.
The testing is performed at different levels, from Virtual Testing environments up to Laboratory Subsystem and Global System Integration Rigs but eventually giving also support to on-Aircraft Ground & Flight testing if required.
The team gives support to all the different programs within the Spanish Airbus Defence and Space portfolio (Eurofighter, A400M, Derivatives, Light & Medium, Eurodrone, SIRTAP, Helicopters, FCAS, etc.).
A brief list of typical Systems Under Test within TADVA3 is as follows: TCOMS: Tactical Communication Systems: e.g., Link 16, Link 22 and VMF SCOMS: Safety Communication Systems: e.g., SATCOM, Audio Management Systems, V/UHF Radios MCOMS: Mission Communication Systems: e.g., UAV Primary/Secondary Data Links, payload Video/Datalinks CONNECTIVITY Systems: ALIMS (AIRCRAFT LINKS INTEGRATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM) and JRE (Joint Range Extension) RESPONSIBILITIES/MAIN TASKS The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
Analysis of technical documentation of all the above-mentioned Systems, in combination with the Test Requirements documentation generated by the Design Office, in order to build up a coherent set of Rig Test Cases/Procedures to be executed at Rigs, together with the creation of the Requirements Specification of those Rigs and their associated Validation Procedures.
Creation of all other Test Datasets necessary prior to the run time test execution, including the creation Simulation Requirements (for TSS), Test Scripts, Initialisation Data files, Tactical Scenarios, etc.
Execution of the required test steps as described in the Test Procedures, including pre-run time activities (Crypto loading, Sw Loading (if required), Initialisation, etc) and run-time itself (operation of the Rig Test Support System (e.g., MaTE, AIDASS, SEAS, etc) and other Lab Test Equipment (DataBus Analysers, Datalink Simulators (e.g., TIGER, TACTX, MIGATO, LEGS), data recording and downloading, etc
Analysis of systems' behaviour and creation of Test Reporting documentation.
Declaration of Equipment/System Problem Reports and management of their lifecycle, including root cause investigations. Management of associated tools for controlling and reporting processes (e.g., DOORS, Octane, Dimensions PCMS, or internal tools such as TestNet, DMS, PRMS, Agilo, etc)
Specification of ad-hoc Test Tools (for decoding, recording, translation, emulation, automation, etc), including tool qualification SKILLS We are looking for candidates educated in a Telecommunications, Industrial-Electronics Engineering or Aeronautical Degree with at least 2 years of experience in as many as possible of the above-mentioned systems, especially Tactical Datalinks and protocols (L16, L22, VMF, JREAP). The higher the ‘match’, the better, but don’t panic, since at Airbus and at TADVA3 we support your personal growth with customized development paths, starting from your team colleagues that will provide you with technical training plus coaching support. You will need skills focused on two main `pillars’:
OFF-LAB/RIG:
Technical knowledge on the COMMS Systems Under Test (modes of operation, performance, functionalities, limitations, etc), absolutely independent from the rig environment
Requirements’ interpretation, partitioning and allocation to build-up segregated Test Procedures and any other Test Data Set required before testing, including generic or specific software tooling for requirements’ traceability and configuration control
Systems behavior assessment derived from test results, including problem investigation skills, and the use of generic or specific analysis software tools.
HANDS-ON_LAB/RIG:
Technical knowledge on the Lab Equipment, both Standard or Specific to Tactical Datalinks or Connectivity Systems (sniffers, 1553 Databus Analysers, Link 16 Simulators (TIGER/MIGATO/TACTX), etc)
Technical knowledge on Test Support Systems controlling the execution sessions and associated capabilities (recording, visualisation, automatic scripting, etc)
Advanced level in English and Spanish, technical and general, is required so that meetings, presentations and documentation are properly managed ATTITUDES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS We are looking for candidates with the following attitudes and requirements: Pro-active approach to problem solving and decision making
Open-minded, team spirit minded, rigorous and autonomous with a can-do mindset
Ability to work under strict timescales and milestones as part of an integrated and multifunctional team
High adaptability to work on new topics, new programs with good networking skills
NATO security clearance in force (or equivalent) or at least being eligible for it by the recognized authorities.
Be eligible for ITAR and National Export Control authorisations HOW WE CARE FOR YOU: Remember that in Airbus you will enjoy: Attractive salary and special bonus payments
Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development possibilities, working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities.
Special social benefits
On-site-facilities, including canteen and medical services
Work/Life Balance focus, including hybrid working schemes, nursery school, etc.
And many other benefits that are awaiting you Take your career to a new level and apply online now! Job Description: ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous avez une solide expérience en aérostructures et normes d'ingénierie, vous avez travaillé dans le domaine aéronautique ou des matériaux et procédés et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un(e) Chef de section, Ingénierie Aérostructure – Standards, Surfaces et Assemblage (h/f) pour rejoindre notre équipe des Matériaux et Procédés, Aérostructure basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada) où vous gérerez une équipe pluridisciplinaire responsable de l'ingénierie des traitements de surfaces, des technologies d'assemblage, de la normalisation et de l'éco-conception ainsi que les tests. Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Aérostructures - Matériaux et Procédés chargée d'assurer la qualification des matériaux et de garantir que chaque solution technique est parfaitement adaptée à la conception de l'appareil liées aux matériaux et aux procédés. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant que Chef de section ingénierie sera de gérer une équipe multidisciplinaire pour assurer la livraison des projets de satisfaction client, optimisation industrielle, efficacité opérationnelle, conformité, harmonisation des spécifications et de réduction des coûts, tout en respectant les exigences de qualité et de budget. Votre environnement de travail : Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis : Gérer le rendement de l'équipe de l'ingénierie, des normes et de l'écoconception et veiller à la livraison à temps des livrables selon le budget et la qualité. Définir et déployer la stratégie de durabilité et d'affaires environnementales pour l'A220 en collaboration avec les homologues européens. Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie mondiales pour atteindre les objectifs de réduction des coûts, de cadence et de satisfaction client. Agir en tant qu'agent de changement en soutenant l'intégration de l'A220, la standardisation du matériel et la création de manuels d'ingénierie. Diriger et encadrer une équipe multidisciplinaire en utilisant des indicateurs clés de performance et en réalisant des évaluations de développement. Créer un environnement multidisciplinaire favorisant l'excellence, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue. Appliquer et améliorer les normes d'Airbus en intégrant les leçons tirées du benchmark de l'A220 et des standards d’Airbus commercial. Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales pour externaliser les activités d'ingénierie récurrentes et à faible valeur ajoutée. Votre profil : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou expérience pertinente équivalente. Solide expérience en matière de normes d'ingénierie ou de conception (minimum 8 ans). Connaissance des réglementations environnementales (ex: REACH) et de la R&D, incluant l'utilisation de carburant d'aviation durable (SAF). Expertise dans les activités de développement de programmes d'aéronefs et d'ingénierie de soutien. Solides compétences en gestion de projet permettant d'établir des priorités et de respecter les engagements. Leadership reconnu démontrant la capacité d'inspirer, de développer et de diriger une équipe interfonctionnelle dans un environnement changeant. Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, esprit d'initiative et capacité à simplifier des problèmes complexes. Compétences linguistiques : Niveau avancé en français et en anglais (oral et écrit). Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels (dans le monde entier). Déplacements requis : Déplacements occasionnels au Canada et à l'étranger Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ****************************************************************************** Job description : Do you have solid experience in aerostructures and engineering standards , have you worked in the aerospace industry or in the field of materials and processes and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you! The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is looking for an Head of Airframe Engineering – Standards, Surfaces and Assembly (f/m) to join our Materials & Processes, Airframe team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada). where you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for the engineering of surface treatment, assembly, standards, design for environment and tests. You will be part of the Materials & Processes, Airframe team responsible for ensuring material qualification and guaranteeing that every technical solution is perfectly adapted to the aircraft design regarding materials and processes. The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as Engineering Section Chief will be to a multidisciplinary team to ensure the delivery of projects focused on customer satisfaction, industrial optimization, operational efficiency, compliance, specification harmonization, and cost reduction, all while adhering to quality and budget requirements. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy. Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program and on-site Medical Service. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. Your challenges: Manage the Engineering team’s performance to ensure deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Define and deploy a sustainability and environmental strategy for the A220 aircraft, collaborating with Airbus European counterparts. Engage with global engineering teams and stakeholders to achieve program objectives for cost reduction, ramp-up, and customer satisfaction. Act as a change agent to integrate the A220 program, deploy hardware standardization processes, and create engineering manuals. Lead the multidisciplinary team using KPIs, implementing corrective actions, and fostering team growth through performance assessments. Cultivate an environment that promotes excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within a multi-disciplined operation. Apply and improve Airbus standards and best practices leveraging A220 benchmark lessons learned and Airbus Commercial standards. Identify new business opportunities by outsourcing recurring, repetitive, or low value-added engineering activities. Your boarding pass: Educated to a degree level in Engineering or equivalent relevant experience. Solid experience in Engineering standards or design-related activities (minimum 8 years). Knowledge of aerospace environmental regulations (e.g., REACH) and R&D activities, including Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) usage. Proficiency in aircraft program development and sustaining engineering activities. Strong project management skills, able to prioritize effectively and align team members towards meeting commitments. Recognized leadership skills demonstrating the ability to build, inspire, and steer a cross-functional team in a changing environment. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, resourceful, and able to simplify complex issues. Language Skills: Advanced level of English and French (oral and written). This role may involve some travels for business (worldwide). Travel Required: Occasional travel within Americas & Overseas Travel Required: <5% Domestic and International. Possible on-call duties during week-ends and/or holiday seasons. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. title: Aircraft Performance Engineer (d/f/m)
description_text:
Job Description: Job Description The Flight Physics Centre of Competence (CoC) is a German-Spanish organisation within Airbus Defence & Space (AD&S) Engineering. The organisation is responsible for the flight physics deliverables for all Airbus Defence & Space fixed-wing Aircraft programmes. The technical capabilities within the CoC are provided by 4 domains: 1) Aerodynamics 2) Aircraft Performance & Mass Properties 3) Static Loads, Structural Dynamics & Acoustics 4) Flight Dynamics & Flight Control Laws The CoC has strategic targets such as digitalization, standardization, simplification, and operational excellence. For our current and future challenges in the Aircraft Performance & Mass Properties domain, we are looking for a new candidate to join our Aircraft Performance team. Shape with us the future of air power solutions and let us help you shape your career in the Flight Physics Centre of Competences. As Aircraft Performance Engineer, you report to the Head of Aircraft Performance and will be accountable for the aircraft Performance related deliverables for all AD&S fixed wing programs. Competences and operational accountability: Be accountable for aircraft performance activities that contribute current and future programs as well as R&D/T, the certification process and negotiations with certification authorities. Support the design phase in future programs and derivatives of existing products. Evaluate impact on performance of aircraft & engine configuration changes
Commercial, Customer and Ops. support: Carry out performance studies to support sales campaigns and RFPs, customer enquiries. Support AD&S customer services flight operations for operational tools and documentation, computerized operating data solutions, in-service queries and technical support. Support flight data analysis activities for development, certification, training, incident/accident investigations, etc. Implement roadmaps for harmonization & maintenance of tools, data management, marketing of Aircraft Performance services, etc. Implement the Flight Physics strategy, develop and grow the service portfolio. Ensure the highest standards in quality and clarity of technical dossier content and presentation. Ensure implementation of digitalization, capability & technology roadmaps while ensuring R&T, R&D and Program delivery OTOCOQ. Contribute to team and program transversal activities and synergies. Contribute to the continuous improvement of Aircraft Performance processes. Have strong communication, collaboration and conflict management skills, able to communicate and present effectively within the team and other stakeholders within and outside the Flight Physics Centre of Competence. Have demonstrated problem solving and organizational skills. Be customer focused. Inspire confidence and credibility with internal and external customers and anticipate their needs. Skills & Experience: Minimum Master’s degree in Aeronautical Engineering 3-5 years of experience in Aircraft Performance (development, flight test and certification). Passion for continuous improvement Willingness to roll-up sleeves and do whatever is necessary; owner mentality Ability to think strategically and execute methodically Ability to work under pressure Able to travel as required English skills at negotiation level, German/Spanish skills preferred This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. title: Mission Systems Engineer
description_text:
Job Description: The candidate will join ISR Mission Systems Architectures team, and as part of it, will participate in the following tasks, aimed to the development of Mission Systems for Airbus Derivatives and eventually other platforms, as M&L, A400, RPAS/UAS: Lead all Systems Engineering activities in the Mission Systems field in order to deliver safe, reliable, mature and cost effective solutions for the customers. Analyze customer requirements for its transformation into design solutions, architectures and concepts of operations. Assess innovative technologies and architectures, to deliver independent cost benefit analysis (manufacturer & operator related), deeply involved in the R&D/T initiatives. Specify, integrate, qualify, certify and ensure the continued airworthiness of the Mission Systems used to perform different kinds of missions (ISR - Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance, Maritime Patrol, Anti-Submarine Warfare, Aerial Delivery, Attack/Combat operations...) Specify, require, and support Laboratory, Ground and Flight tests needed for the development, certification and qualification (V&V) of the Mission System. Provide Systems Engineering support for the full lifecycle of the Mission System, from development to in-service support. Support Services and Commercial campaigns in all aspects related to Mission Systems. Useful skills: Systems Engineering background / experience, V&V process, requirements management tools, functional analysis, Model Based Systems Engineering knowledge, etc. At least 5 years of experience in related fields is required Systems architectures transversal / analytical point of view, Think-Out-Of-The-Box way. Networks, Computing, Software, Cybersecurity knowledge. General Mission Systems / Avionics knowledge, including Displays, controls, computers, sensors, data buses / protocols. Willingness to interact, in international environments, with many different people and profiles, using different roles (from Coordinator to Contributor, through Spokesman/woman). description_text:
Job Description: Chef de Service, Centre de Réponse à la Clientèle / Manager Customer Response Centre ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi: Vous avez une expérience dans la direction d'équipes techniques, connaissance des opérations aériennes, de l’avion au niveau système et structure, vous avez travaillé au support à la clientèle et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Chef de Service, Centre de Réponse à la Clientèle A220, pour rejoindre l'équipe des Opérations en Service basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les autres départements d’Airbus soutenant les clients de l’A220 dans le monde. Vous allez diriger l’équipe Service d’assistance technique chargée de fournir, coordonner le soutien nécessaire pour permettre l’exploitation efficace de la flotte d’A220 dans le monde entier. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle en tant que Chef de Service, Centre de Réponse à la Clientèle A220 sera de travailler avec une équipe de spécialistes 24/7 pour garantir une réponse rapide et de haute qualité aux clients, ce qui implique la résolution d'une vaste gamme de problèmes en service. Vous pourriez être amené à être disponible en dehors des heures de bureau, à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais serrés. Votre environnement de travail : Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible sur la région, qui offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés et ainsi qu'aux familles. En équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employés (PAE), programme de rabais et service médical sur site. Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis : Organiser et gérer les activités opérationnelles de l’équipe CRC pour assurer le support de la flotte A220 dans un environnement 24/7; Equipe de première ligne (THD) Equipe de support (TSG et Preventive) Equipe de Chef de quart (DM) Établir et entretenir une excellente relation avec les clients à tous les niveaux hiérarchiques; Établir et entretenir une relation de forte collaboration avec les équipes Customer Support A220; et coordonner les activités pour assurer une réponse rapide aux requêtes des clients; tant au niveau des équipes qu’au niveau de la direction; Veiller à la qualité optimale et au suivi des communications entre le CRC et les clients afin d'assurer une clôture professionnelle et rapide des requêtes; Organiser des activités « on-site support »; Fournir le leadership, direction technique, orientation, encadrement, formation et support pour assurer le développement continu de l’équipe; Faire le suivi de la performance de chacun des employés; Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de Leadership du CRC pour identifier les solutions optimales aux interruptions techniques et aux événements hors service; Proposer des changements, des initiatives et des projets pour l'efficacité des processus et l'alignement de la transformation; Gérer les budgets d’opérations, et en faire les projections annuelles. Votre profil : Vous avez de l'expérience dans la direction d'équipes techniques, connaissance des opérations aériennes; Vous avez un bon niveau de connaissance de l’avion au niveau système et structure; Vous avez un minimum de dix (10) ans d’expérience en ingénierie ou en maintenance d’avion ainsi qu’un minimum de dix (10) ans d’expérience en gestion ou en supervision d'équipe; Vous avez démontré des capacités pour gérer une équipe dans un environnement très variable avec des changements de priorités fréquents; Vous êtes capable de prendre des décisions importantes et précises tout en utilisant votre jugement; Vous êtes un communicateur hors pair et possédez de bonnes qualités interpersonnelles; Vous avez de l'expérience de support à la clientèle; Vous avez de bonnes aptitudes de communication. Dans ce rôle, le candidat sélectionné travaillera pendant les heures de bureau avec une équipe 24/7. Le candidat doit être prêt à devoir être joignable en permanence (cellulaire) en dehors des heures de bureau. Il est important d’être capable de gérer la pression et de pouvoir travailler avec des délais serrés. Ce poste implique des déplacements professionnels occasionnels (dans le monde entier). Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise. Vous ne semblez pas correspondre à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera pour trouver le poste qui correspond le mieux à vos compétences et aspirations. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant ! ************************************* Job description: Do you have experience leading technical teams, knowledge of airline operations, and a deep understanding of aircraft systems and structures? Have you worked in customer support and are looking to grow and develop new skills? This position is for you! The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is seeking a Department Manager, A220 Customer Response Center to join the In-Service Operations team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will work in conjunction with other Airbus departments supporting A220 customers worldwide. You will lead the Technical Support Service team responsible for providing and coordinating the support necessary to ensure the efficient operation of the A220 fleet globally. The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively. Your role as Department Manager, A220 Customer Response Center, will be to work with a 24/7 team of specialists to ensure a rapid, high-quality response to customers, involving the resolution of a wide range of in-service issues. You may be required to be available outside of office hours, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines. Your working environment: The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home. How we care for you: Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan. Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (based on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
